summary: Runs the window animation shown when an app is launched from somewhere other than the recent apps list. Use it to animate the opening of an app started from outside the recent tasks view.

name: onAppTransition
params: fromWindowTarget: WindowAnimationTarget, toWindowTarget: WindowAnimationTarget, finishCallback: WindowAnimationFinishedCallback
description: Called on application transition.
summary: Called when the device switches from one application to another. Use it to play a custom animation during the app switch.

name: onMinimizeWindow
description: Called on minimizing a window.

name: onCloseWindow
description: Called on closing a window.
summary: Called when a window is closing. Use it to play a custom animation as a window closes.

name: onScreenUnlock
description: Called on unlocking the screen.

name: onWindowAnimationTargetsUpdate
description: Called on window animation targets update.

name: duration
description: Sets the animation duration.
summary: Sets how long an animation lasts, in milliseconds. Use it to make an animation play faster or slower.

name: easing
description: Sets the interpolation curve for this animation.
summary: Sets the interpolation curve that controls the speed changes of an animation. Use it to make an animation ease in, ease out, or move at a steady pace.

name: delay
description: Sets the playback delay for this animation.
summary: Sets how long an animation waits before it starts playing, in milliseconds. Use it to delay when an animation begins.

name: fill
description: Sets the fill mode for this animation.
summary: Sets the fill mode that decides how an animated element looks before the animation starts and after it ends. Use it to keep an element in its final state once the animation finishes.

name: direction
description: Sets the playback direction for this animator animation.
summary: Sets the playback direction of an animation, such as forward or reverse. Use it to control which way an animation plays.

name: iterations
description: Sets the number of times that this animation is played.
summary: Sets how many times an animation plays. Use it to repeat an animation, or to loop it forever with -1.

name: update
description: Updates this animator.
summary: Updates an animator with new options. Use it to change an animation's settings while it exists.

name: reset
description: Resets the animation parameters of this animator.
summary: Resets an animation's parameters using the given options. Use it to restart an animation with new settings.

name: play
description: Plays this animation. The animation retains the previous playback state. For example, if the animation is set to
summary: Starts or resumes playing an animation, keeping its previous playback state. Use it to play an animation that was paused or stopped.

name: finish
description: Ends the animation, triggering the [onFinish](docroot://reference/apis-arkui/js-apis-animator.md#properties)
summary: Ends an animation and triggers its finish callback. Use it to stop an animation when it is done.

name: pause
description: Pauses this animation.
summary: Pauses an animation. Use it to temporarily halt a running animation so it can be resumed later.

name: cancel
description: Cancels the animation, triggering the [onCancel](docroot://reference/apis-arkui/js-apis-animator.md#properties)
summary: Cancels an animation and triggers its cancel callback. Use it to stop an animation that is currently running.

name: reverse
description: Plays this animation in reverse order. This API does not take effect when the interpolating spring curve is used.
summary: Plays an animation backwards. Use it to run an animation in reverse order.

name: setExpectedFrameRateRange
description: Sets the expected frame rate range.
summary: Sets the expected frame rate range for an animation. Use it to control how smoothly an animation runs.

name: createAnimator
description: Creates an animation.
summary: Creates an animation from the given options. Use it to set up an animation you can then play.

name: create
description: Creates an **AnimatorResult** object for animations.
summary: Creates an animation object from the given options. Use it to set up an animation you can then play.

summary: Called when a system setting such as language changes. Use it to adjust your app when the system language or other environment settings change.

summary: Runs when a subscribed common event is triggered in static mode. Use it to react to system or app events the extension subscribes to, such as a boot or network change event.

name: startAbility
description: Starts an ability that belongs to the same application as this **StaticSubscriberExtensionAbility**. This API uses
summary: Starts an ability that belongs to the same application as this static subscriber extension. Use it to open an app screen in response to a received event.

name: onConnect
description: Called back when a window extension is first connected to an ability.
summary: Called when a window extension is first connected to an ability, providing the connection information. Use it to set up a window extension when something connects to it.

name: onDisconnect
description: Called back when all abilities connected to a window extension are disconnected.
summary: Called when all abilities connected to a window extension have disconnected, providing the disconnection information. Use it to clean up a window extension once nothing is connected to it.

name: onWindowReady
description: Called back when window is created.
summary: Tells the extension when its window has been created, handing over the window instance. Use it to start setting up the window as soon as it exists.

name: getAbilityDelegator
description: Obtains the **AbilityDelegator** object of the application.
summary: Gets the object used to schedule test framework functions for the application. Use it to run and manage automated tests.

name: getArguments
description: Obtains the **AbilityDelegatorArgs** object of the application.
summary: Gets the object that holds the application's test parameters. Use it to read the settings passed to an automated test.

name: updateConfiguration
description: Updates the configuration. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Changes the current configuration settings. Use it to apply new settings such as language or display options.

name: getAbilityRunningInfos
description: Obtains the ability running information. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets information about abilities that are currently running. Use it to see what is active on the device.

name: registerApplicationStateObserver
description: Register application state observer.
summary: Signs up a watcher that reports when apps change state, such as starting or stopping. Use it to keep track of what apps are running.

name: unregisterApplicationStateObserver
description: Unregister application state observer.
summary: Removes a previously added app state watcher so it no longer reports app changes. Use it when you no longer need to track app states.

name: getForegroundApplications
description: getForegroundApplications.
summary: Gets the list of apps currently in the foreground. Use it to see which apps are open and visible on screen.

name: killProcessWithAccount
description: Kill process with account.
summary: Stops a process for a given app and account. Use it to force-close an app for a specific user account.

name: isRunningInStabilityTest
description: Checks whether the system is undergoing a stability test. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Checks whether the system is currently undergoing a stability test. Use it to tell if the device is in a stability testing state.

name: getProcessRunningInfos
description: Obtains information about the running processes. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets information about the processes currently running on the device. Use it to see what apps or processes are active right now.

name: killProcessesByBundleName
description: Kill processes by bundle name
summary: Stops all running processes belonging to an app, identified by its bundle name. Use it to force an app to shut down completely.

name: clearUpApplicationData
description: Clear up application data by bundle name
summary: Deletes all data stored by an app, identified by its bundle name. Use it to reset an app to a clean state.

name: isRamConstrainedDevice
description: Checks whether the current device is a RAM-constrained device (a device with severely limited memory resources).
summary: Checks whether the device has severely limited memory. Use it to find out if the device is low on RAM before running heavy tasks.

name: getAppMemorySize
description: Obtains the maximum memory (RAM allocation) available to the current application. This API uses a promise to return
summary: Gets the maximum memory available to the current application, in megabytes. Use it to check how much memory the app can use.

name: getProcessRunningInformation
description: Obtains information about the running processes. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets information about processes that are currently running. Use it to check what is running in the background.

name: createFormBindingData
description: Creates a **FormBindingData** object.
summary: Creates a data object for a widget to display. Use it to prepare the content a home screen widget shows.

name: deleteForm
description: Deletes a widget. After this API is called, the application can no longer use the widget, and the Widget Manager
summary: Deletes a widget so the app can no longer use it and its information is not kept. Use it to remove a widget from the home screen.

name: releaseForm
description: Releases a widget. After this API is called, the application can no longer use the widget, but the Widget Manager
summary: Releases a widget so the app can no longer use it, while the widget manager keeps or clears cached data. Use it to stop using a widget and optionally free its cache.

name: requestForm
description: Requests a widget update. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Requests an update for a widget. Use it to refresh a widget's displayed content.

name: castTempForm
description: Converts a temporary widget to a normal one. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Turns a temporary widget into a permanent one. Use it to keep a widget that was only meant to be shown briefly.

name: notifyVisibleForms
description: Instructs the widget framework to make a widget visible. After this API is called, **onVisibilityChange** is
summary: Tells the widget framework to make a widget visible. Use it to show widgets when they should appear on screen.

name: notifyInvisibleForms
description: Instructs the widget framework to make a widget invisible. After this API is called, **onVisibilityChange** is
summary: Tells the widget framework to make a widget invisible. Use it to hide widgets when they are no longer on screen.

name: enableFormsUpdate
description: Instructs the widget framework to make a widget updatable. After this API is called, the widget is in the enabled
summary: Lets a widget receive updates from its provider again. Use it to resume refreshing a widget that was paused.

name: disableFormsUpdate
description: Instructs the widget framework to make a widget not updatable. After this API is called, the widget cannot receive
summary: Stops a widget from receiving updates from its provider. Use it to freeze a widget so it no longer refreshes.

name: isSystemReady
description: Checks whether the system is ready. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Checks whether the system is ready for widget hosting. Use it to wait until the system is prepared before showing widgets.

name: getAllFormsInfo
description: Obtains the widget information provided by all applications on the device. This API uses a promise to return the
summary: Gets information about all widgets offered by every app on the device. Use it to browse available widgets to add.

name: getFormsInfo
description: Obtains the widget information provided by a given application on the device. This API uses a promise to return
summary: Gets information about the widgets offered by one app on the device. Use it to see which widgets a particular app provides.

name: deleteInvalidForms
description: Deletes invalid widgets from the list. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Deletes invalid widgets from a list and reports how many were removed. Use it to clean up widgets that no longer work.

name: acquireFormState
description: Obtains the widget state. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Looks up the current state of a widget, such as whether it is ready or unavailable. Use it to check a widget's status before showing it.

name: on
description: Subscribes to widget uninstall events. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the result.
summary: Listens for widget uninstall events so the host app knows when a widget is removed. Use it to react when a user deletes a widget from the home screen.

name: off
description: Unsubscribes from widget uninstall events. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the result.
summary: Stops listening for widget uninstall events. Use it to stop being notified when a widget is removed.

name: notifyFormsVisible
description: Instructs the widgets to make themselves visible. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Tells widgets to make themselves visible. Use it to show widgets when their host screen comes into view.

name: notifyFormsEnableUpdate
description: Instructs the widgets to enable or disable updates. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Tells widgets to turn their updates on or off. Use it to pause or resume refreshing widgets on the home screen.

name: setFormNextRefreshTime
description: Sets the next refresh time for a widget. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets when a widget should refresh next, in minutes. Use it to schedule a home screen widget to update itself later.

name: updateForm
description: Updates a widget. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Updates a widget with new data. Use it to refresh what a home screen widget shows.

name: registerMissionListener
description: Registers a listener to observe the mission status.
summary: Registers a listener that watches mission status changes. Use it to be notified when open tasks or apps change.

name: unregisterMissionListener
description: Unregisters a mission status listener. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Stops a previously registered listener from receiving mission status updates. Use it when you no longer need to be told when a task is locked, unlocked, cleared, or brought to the foreground.

name: getMissionInfo
description: Obtains the information about a given mission. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets information about a given mission. Use it to look up details of a recent task.

name: getMissionInfos
description: Obtains information about all missions. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets information about all missions, up to a maximum number. Use it to see what tasks or apps are currently open.

name: getMissionSnapShot
description: Obtains the snapshot of a given mission. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets a snapshot image of a given mission. Use it to show a preview thumbnail of an open app or task.

name: lockMission
description: Locks a given mission. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Locks a given mission so it stays in place. Use it to keep a task from being cleared or removed.

name: unlockMission
description: Unlocks a given mission. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Unlocks a given mission that was previously locked. Use it to allow a task to be cleared or removed again.

name: clearMission
description: Clears a given mission, regardless of whether it is locked. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Clears a given mission whether it is locked or not. Use it to close a specific recent task.

name: clearAllMissions
description: Clears all unlocked missions. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Clears all unlocked missions. Use it to close all recent tasks that are not locked.

name: moveMissionToFront
description: Switches a given mission to the foreground, with the startup parameters for the switching specified. This API uses
summary: Brings a given mission to the foreground. Use it to switch back to an open app or task.

name: onPrepare
description: Prepare the unit testing environment for running test cases.
summary: Prepares the unit testing environment for running test cases. Use it to set up conditions before your unit tests run.

name: onRun
description: Run all test cases.
summary: Runs all test cases in the test framework. Use it to execute your full set of unit tests at once.

name: grantUriPermission
params: uri: string, flag: wantConstant.Flags, targetBundleName: string
description: Grants the URI permission to an application. If the call is successful, the application obtains the permission to
summary: Gives another app permission to read or write a file identified by a URI. Use it to let a chosen app open or save a shared file.

name: revokeUriPermission
description: Revokes the URI permission from an application. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Takes back permission that let another app open a file you had shared. Use it to stop an app from accessing a file you previously allowed.

name: grantUriPermissionByKey
params: key: string, flag: wantConstant.Flags, targetTokenId: int
description: Grants the URI access permission of the current application to the target application through the unique key of the
summary: Gives another app permission to access files shared through a data key. Use it to let a chosen app open or save shared files.

name: grantUriPermissionByKeyAsCaller
params: key: string, flag: wantConstant.Flags, callerTokenId: int, targetTokenId: int
description: Grants the URI access permission of the specified application to the target application through the unique key of
summary: Gives another app permission to access files shared by a specified app through a data key. Use it to let a chosen app open or save shared files.

name: color
description: Sets the text color of the index items in the normal state.
summary: Sets the text color of index items in their normal state. Use it to style the letters of an alphabet index.

name: selectedColor
description: Sets the text color of the selected item.
summary: Sets the text color of the selected item. Use it to make the current letter readable against its background.

name: popupColor
description: Sets the text color for the pop-up window.
summary: Sets the text color of the pop-up window. Use it to change the color of the letter shown in the index pop-up.

name: selectedBackgroundColor
description: Sets the background color of the selected item.
summary: Sets the background color behind the selected item. Use it to make the current letter stand out.

name: popupBackground
description: Sets the background color of the pop-up window.
summary: Sets the background color of the pop-up window. Use it to change the backdrop color behind the letter shown when an index item is pressed.

name: usePopup
description: Sets whether to display the pop-up window.
summary: Sets whether a pop-up window is shown. Use it to turn the pop-up on or off.

name: selectedFont
description: Sets the font style of the selected item, including size, weight, style, and font family.
summary: Sets the font size, weight, style, and family of the selected item. Use it to style the highlighted letter.

name: popupFont
description: Sets the font style of the pop-up window.
summary: Sets the font style of the pop-up window. Use it to change the size, weight, or family of the letter shown in the index pop-up.

name: font
description: Sets the default font style of the index items.
summary: Sets the default font style of index items. Use it to control the size, weight, and family of alphabet index letters.

name: itemSize
description: Sets the size of the index item area.
summary: Sets the size of each index item area, using the circle diameter for circular items. Use it to make the letters in an alphabet index bigger or smaller.

name: selected
description: Sets the index of the selected item.
summary: Sets which item in the index is currently selected. Use it to highlight the letter or entry the user is on.

name: autoCollapse
description: Sets whether to enable the adaptive collapse behavior for the indexer.
summary: Sets whether the indexer automatically collapses its items. Use it to make a long alphabet index shrink to fit the screen.

name: onSelect
description: Triggered when an index item is selected. The return value is the index of the selected item.
summary: Runs when an index item is selected and reports the index of the chosen item. Use it to react when someone taps a letter in an alphabet index.

name: popupBackgroundBlurStyle
description: Sets the background blur style of the pop-up window. If this API is not used, the blur is disabled by default. The
summary: Sets the background blur style of the pop-up window, disabled by default. Use it to blur what shows behind the letter pop-up in an alphabet index.

name: digitalCrownSensitivity
description: Sets the sensitivity of the digital crown's event response.
summary: Sets how quickly the digital crown responds to turning. Use it to make the crown scroll feel faster or slower.

name: space
description: Sets the spacing between list items.
summary: Sets the spacing between list items. Use it to add breathing room between rows in a list.

name: scrollBar
description: Sets the state of the scrollbar.
summary: Sets whether the scrollbar is shown, hidden, or automatic. Use it to control the scrollbar on a scrolling list.

name: scrollBarColor
description: Sets the color of the scrollbar.
summary: Sets the color of the scrollbar. Use it to match the scrollbar to your app's look.

name: scrollBarWidth
description: Sets the width of the scrollbar. Once the width is set, the scrollbar will use this
summary: Sets how wide the scrollbar is. Use it to make the scrollbar thicker or thinner for easier grabbing.

name: cachedCount
description: Sets the number of arc list items to be preloaded (cached). In a lazy loading scenario,
summary: Sets how many arc list items are preloaded outside the visible area. Use it to make scrolling through a long arc list smoother.

name: chainAnimation
description: Sets whether to enable chained animations, which provide a visually connected, or
summary: Turns on chained animations that give a connected spring-like effect when the arc list is scrolled or dragged at its edges. Use it for a bouncy, linked scrolling feel.

name: childrenMainSize
description: Sets the size information of the child components of the **ArcList** component along the
summary: Sets the size of each child along the main axis so scrolling positions stay accurate. Use it when list items differ in size or change, so scrolling to an item lands in the right place.

name: enableScrollInteraction
description: Sets whether to enable scroll gestures.
summary: Turns scrolling by finger or mouse on or off. Use it to lock a list in place while still allowing programmatic scrolling.

name: fadingEdge
description: Sets whether to enable the edge fading effect.
summary: Turns the fading effect at the edges of the list on or off. Use it to soften the top and bottom edges as content scrolls.

name: friction
description: Sets the friction coefficient. It applies only to gestures in the scrolling area, and it
summary: Sets the friction that slows inertial scrolling. Use it to make scrolling stop sooner or glide longer after a flick.

name: flingSpeedLimit
description: Sets the maximum initial speed for inertial scrolling after a fling gesture. If this
summary: Sets the maximum starting speed of inertial scrolling after a fling. Use it to keep fast flicks from scrolling too far.

name: onScrollIndex
description: Triggered when a child component enters or leaves the visible area of the **ArcList**
summary: Runs when a child item enters or leaves the visible area of a list. Use it to track which items are on screen, such as highlighting the current one.

name: onReachStart
description: Triggered when the list reaches the start position.
summary: Runs when a list reaches its start position. Use it to refresh content or show a message when the user scrolls back to the top.

name: onReachEnd
description: Triggered when the list reaches the end position.
summary: Runs when a list reaches its end position. Use it to load more items or show a message when the user scrolls to the bottom.

name: onScrollStart
description: Triggered when the list starts scrolling initiated by the user's finger dragging the list
summary: Runs when a list starts scrolling from a finger drag or a scroll animation. Use it to pause updates or hide controls while the user scrolls.

name: onScrollStop
description: Triggered when the list stops scrolling after the user's finger leaves the screen.
summary: Runs when a list stops scrolling after the finger leaves the screen or a scroll animation ends. Use it to resume updates or show controls once scrolling settles.

name: onWillScroll
description: Triggered before each frame during list scrolling. The callback returns the offset amount
summary: Runs a callback before each frame while a list scrolls, reporting how far it will move and the current scroll state. Use it to react to scrolling as it happens.

name: onDidScroll
description: Triggered when the list scrolls. The return value is the offset amount by which the list
summary: Reports how far a list has scrolled and whether it is still scrolling. Use it to react while a list is being scrolled, such as updating a position indicator.

name: autoScale
description: Sets whether to enable auto-scaling for the **ArcListItem** component.
summary: Turns automatic scaling of a list item on or off. Use it to make items grow or shrink as they scroll.

name: swipeAction
description: Sets the swipe action item displayed when the **ArcListItem** component is swiped out from the screen edge.
summary: Shows action items when a list item is swiped out from the screen edge. Use it to reveal buttons like delete or archive when someone swipes a list row.

name: arcDirection
description: Sets the direction of the arc navigation indicator.
summary: Sets the direction the arc navigation indicator points. Use it to place the indicator at a chosen clock position.

name: itemColor
description: Sets the color of the unselected navigation points in the arc navigation indicator.
summary: Sets the color of the unselected dots in the arc navigation indicator. Use it to style the dots that are not currently active.

name: selectedItemColor
description: Sets the color of the selected navigation point in the arc navigation indicator.
summary: Sets the color of the currently selected dot in the arc navigation indicator. Use it to highlight which dot is active.

name: backgroundColor
description: Sets the color of the arc navigation indicator when it is long-pressed.
summary: Sets the color shown on the arc navigation indicator while it is long-pressed. Use it to highlight the indicator when someone presses and holds it.

name: maskColor
description: Sets the mask gradient color of the arc navigation indicator.
summary: Sets the gradient color of the mask over the arc navigation indicator. Use it to shade the indicator with a fading color.

name: finishTransition
description: Notifies the **ArcSwiper** component that the custom animation has finished playing.
summary: Tells the swiper that its custom page transition animation has finished playing. Use it to signal the end of a custom swipe animation.

name: index
description: Sets the index of the child component currently displayed in the container. If the value is less than 0 or greater
summary: Sets which child item is currently shown in the container. Use it to open a carousel or gallery on a specific page.

name: indicator
description: Sets the style of the arc dot navigation indicator.
summary: Sets the style of the arc dot navigation indicator, or turns it on or off. Use it to show or hide the dots that tell you which page you are on.

name: duration
description: Sets the duration of the animation for child component switching.
summary: Sets how long the animation takes when switching between child components. Use it to make page changes faster or slower.

name: vertical
description: Sets whether vertical swiping is used.
summary: Sets whether swiping through pages goes up and down instead of left and right. Use it to make a page swiper scroll vertically.

name: disableSwipe
description: Sets whether to disable the swipe feature.
summary: Turns swiping on or off. Use it to stop people from swiping between pages.

name: digitalCrownSensitivity
description: Sets the sensitivity to the digital crown rotation.
summary: Sets how sensitive the view is to rotation of the digital crown. Use it to make crown scrolling feel faster or slower.

name: onChange
description: Triggered when the index of the currently displayed child component changes. The return value is the index of the
summary: Runs when the currently displayed child item changes. Use it to know which page is now showing, such as updating a label or loading content for that page.

name: onAnimationStart
description: Triggered when the page transition animation starts.
summary: Runs when the page transition animation starts. Use it to react as soon as a swipe begins.

name: onAnimationEnd
description: Triggered when the page transition animation ends.
summary: Runs when the page transition animation ends. Use it to react after a swipe finishes, such as updating something once the new page has settled.

name: onGestureSwipe
description: Triggered on a frame-by-frame basis when the page is turned by a swipe.
summary: Runs your handler on every frame while a swipe turns the page. Use it to animate or track page turning as the user swipes.

name: effectMode
description: Sets the effect used when the scroll boundary is reached. For details about the supported effects, see
summary: Sets the effect shown when you swipe past the first or last item. Use it to choose how the edge of a carousel or gallery bounces or stretches.

name: customContentTransition
description: Defines a custom page transition animation. During finger-following swipes and post-release transition animations,
summary: Lets you define a custom animation for pages as they swipe, adjusting things like opacity, scale, and position frame by frame. Use it to make page swipes look the way you want.

name: disableTransitionAnimation
description: Sets whether to disable the transition animation.
summary: Turns the transition animation on or off. Use it to switch pages instantly without any animation.

name: prefetch
description: Prefetches a specified data item from the dataset. This API can be either synchronous or asynchronous. When the
summary: Loads a data item at a given index ahead of time. Use it to prepare items about to scroll into view so lists and grids feel smooth.

name: cancel
description: Cancels the prefetching of a specified data item from the dataset. This API can be either synchronous or
summary: Stops the prefetching of a data item at a given index. Use it to cancel loading an item that is no longer about to appear when scrolling a list or grid.

name: setDataSource
description: Sets the prefetching-capable data source to bind to the **Prefetcher**.
summary: Binds a data source that supports prefetching to the prefetcher. Use it to connect your list or grid data so upcoming items load ahead while swiping.

name: visibleAreaChanged
description: Called when the boundary of the visible area changes. It notifies **Prefetcher** of the current visible area range
summary: Reports the first and last visible item indexes when the visible area changes. Use it so the prefetcher knows which items to load ahead or stop loading while scrolling.

name: setDataSource
description: Sets the prefetching-capable data source to bind to the **Prefetcher**.
summary: Binds a data source that supports prefetching to the prefetcher. Use it to load list data ahead of time so scrolling stays smooth.

name: visibleAreaChanged
description: Called when the boundary of the visible area changes. It notifies **Prefetcher** of the current visible area range
summary: Tells the prefetcher which items are currently visible so it can load or stop loading data ahead of time. Use it to keep scrolling lists, grids, and swipers smooth by preloading items as you scroll.

name: connect
params: type: TypeConstructorWithArgs<T>, keyOrDefaultCreator?: string | StorageDefaultCreator<T>, defaultCreator?: StorageDefaultCreator<T>

summary: Stores key-value data in application memory and returns the value for a key, creating a default if it doesn't exist. Use it to share and reuse app-wide state across pages.

name: remove
description: Removes the specified key-value pair from [AppStorageV2](docroot://ui/state-management/arkts-new-appstoragev2.md).

name: keys
description: Obtains all keys in [AppStorageV2](docroot://ui/state-management/arkts-new-appstoragev2.md).
summary: Gets all keys currently stored in application memory. Use it to list which app-wide state values exist.

name: globalConnect
description: Stores key-value pair data on the application disk. If the given key already exists in
summary: Stores key-value data on the application disk and returns the existing value or a newly created default. Use it to keep app state saved so it survives restarts.

name: save

summary: Saves the data for a given key or type so it is kept persistently. Use it to store app state so it survives after the app is closed and reopened.

name: notifyOnError
description: Called when persistence fails.
summary: Registers a callback that runs when saving data for persistence fails. Use it to detect and handle problems when your app tries to keep its state saved.

name: getTarget

summary: Gets the original object behind a state-managed proxy object. Use it to read the plain data without the framework's wrapper.

name: makeObserved

summary: Turns ordinary data into observable data so changes can be tracked. Use it to make plain objects, arrays, maps, sets, or dates react to updates.

summary: Makes an object observable so changes to it can be tracked and linked to other objects. Use it when you need a piece of data to update automatically in the interface.

name: enableV2Compatibility
description: Enables V1 state variables to be observable in @ComponentV2. This API is primarily used in scenarios where V1 and V
summary: Makes older state data watchable in the newer component style. Use it when mixing old and new state handling so changes still show up.

name: addMonitor
params: target: object, path: string | string[], monitorCallback: MonitorCallback, options?: MonitorOptions
description: Dynamically adds a listener to the state variable of state management V2. For details, see
summary: Adds a listener that watches a state variable and reacts when it changes. Use it to keep an eye on a value and run something when it updates.

name: clearMonitor
params: target: object, path: string | string[], monitorCallback?: MonitorCallback
description: Deletes the listener added to the state variable of the state management V2 by calling the
summary: Removes a listener that was watching a state variable. Use it to stop watching a value when you no longer need updates.

name: makeBinding
description: Creates a read-only one-way data binding instance, which is used to construct the arguments of the **Binding** type
summary: Creates a read-only one-way binding that always reads the latest value. Use it to pass live values into builder functions.

name: applySync
