summary: Runs a piece of code that changes state variables and applies those changes right away. Use it when you need the screen to update immediately after a change.

name: flushUpdates
description: Synchronously updates all state variable modifications before this API call, including the updates
summary: Applies all pending state changes, including computed values and watchers, and redraws the UI right away. Use it when you need the screen and related logic to update immediately.

name: flushUIUpdates
description: Processes all state variable modifications before this API call and synchronizes the
summary: Applies all pending state changes and refreshes the affected UI parts right away. Use it when you need the screen to show the latest data immediately.

name: canBeObserved
description: Determines whether a data object can be observed and returns the observation result. For details, see
summary: Checks whether a data object can be watched for changes and tells you the result. Use it to find out if a value will trigger updates when it changes.

name: getLifecycle
description: Obtains the [lifecycle of a custom component]{@link ComponentInit}.
summary: Gets the lifecycle object of a custom component. Use it to track or respond to that component's lifecycle events.

name: getCustomComponentContext
description: Obtains [CustomComponentContext]{@link CustomComponentContext} of the given @Component(V1) or @ComponentV2.
summary: Gets the context of a custom component, which lets you reach its reuse pool. Use it to manage recycling and reuse of components.

name: getCurrentState
description: getCurrentState(): CustomComponentLifecycleState
summary: Tells you the current lifecycle state of a custom component. Use it to check whether a component is created, appearing, or destroyed.

name: addObserver
description: Registers a listener for the lifecycle of a custom component. Lifecycle changes will trigger the lifecycle callback in the listener.
summary: Registers a listener that is notified when a custom component's lifecycle changes. Use it to run your own code when a component appears, disappears, or changes state.

name: removeObserver
description: Removes a listener for the lifecycle of a custom component. After the listener is removed,
summary: Removes a previously registered lifecycle listener from a custom component. Use it to stop receiving lifecycle callbacks when you no longer need them.

name: aboutToAppear
description: Called after a new instance of the custom component is created and before its **build()** function is executed.
summary: Runs just after a custom component instance is created and before it is built. Use it to set up state variables before the component first appears.

name: onDidBuild
description: Called after a new instance of the custom component is created and its **build()** function is executed.
summary: Runs after a custom component is created and its layout is built. Use it for background tasks like reporting event data.

name: aboutToDisappear
description: Called before the custom component is destroyed. You are advised not to change state variables
summary: Runs just before a custom component is destroyed. Use it to clean up or release resources when a screen or view goes away.

name: aboutToReuse
description: Called when a reusable custom component is re-added to the node tree from the cache to receive the component
summary: Runs when a cached reusable component is added back to the screen. Use it to refresh the component with new data when it reappears.

name: aboutToRecycle
description: Called after necessary component recycling operations defined in the application are performed.
summary: Runs after a component is recycled and frozen so it stops updating the screen. Use it to prepare a component for being put in the recycling pool.

name: getReusePool
description: Obtains the global reuse pool of the custom component. If the component does not configure the reuse pool through
summary: Gets the shared pool that recycles and reuses components. Use it to check whether the current component has a reuse pool configured.

name: getReusableInfo
description: Obtains the information about the recycling instance of a given reusable component type in this reuse pool.
summary: Gets information about recycled instances of a reusable component type in the reuse pool. Use it to check how many reusable components are available before creating new ones.

name: preRender
description: Pre-creates @Reusable/@ReusableV2 decorated components and places them in this reuse pool.
summary: Pre-creates reusable components and places them in the reuse pool. Use it to have components ready in advance so scrolling and rendering stay smooth.

name: registerFont
description: Registers a custom font with the font manager.
summary: Registers a custom font file with the font manager so it can be used in text. Use it to add your own font to an app.

name: getSystemFontList
description: Obtains the list of supported fonts.
summary: Gets the list of supported fonts, working only on PCs and 2-in-1 devices and returning an empty list elsewhere. Use it to see which fonts are installed on a computer.

name: getFontByName
description: Obtains information about a system font based on the font name.
summary: Looks up a system font by name and returns its details, or nothing if the font is not found. Use it to check whether a font is available before using it in text.

name: matchMediaSync
description: Sets the media query criteria and returns the corresponding listening handle
summary: Sets media query criteria and returns a listening handle for them. Use it to watch for changes in screen or device conditions.

name: createComponentObserver
description: Registers a callback for layout and drawing display completion notifications for a specific component.
summary: Registers a callback that fires when a specific component finishes layout and drawing display. Use it to know when a component has been laid out and drawn on screen.

name: pushUrl
description: Navigates to a specified page in the application. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Opens a specified page in the app, with a choice of routing mode. Use it to go to another screen, like opening a details page.

name: replaceUrl
description: Replaces the current page with another one in the application and destroys the current page. This API uses a
summary: Replaces the current page with another page and removes the current one, with a choice of routing mode. Use it to swap screens so the old one is gone.

name: back
description: Returns to the previous page or a specified page.
summary: Returns to the previous page or to a page with a given URL. Use it to go back after navigating forward.

name: clear
description: Clears all historical pages in the stack and retains only the current page at the top of the stack.
summary: Removes all earlier pages from the page history, keeping only the page currently shown. Use it to stop someone from going back to previous screens.

name: getLength
description: Obtains the number of pages in the current stack.
summary: Tells you how many pages are currently in the page stack. Use it to check how many pages deep the user has navigated.

name: getStackSize
description: Obtains the number of pages in the current stack.
summary: Tells you how many pages are currently in the page stack. Use it to check how many pages deep the user has navigated.

name: getState
description: Obtains state information about the current page.
summary: Gets state information about the current page. Use it to find out where the user is in the page stack.

name: getStateByIndex
description: Obtains the status information about a page by its index.
summary: Gets the status information of a page at a given position in the stack. Use it to look up details about a specific page in the navigation history.

name: getStateByUrl
description: Obtains the status information about a page by its URL.
summary: Gets the status information of a page by its web address. Use it to look up details about a page in the navigation history by its address.

name: showAlertBeforeBackPage
description: Enables the display of a confirm dialog box before returning to the previous page.
summary: Shows a confirm dialog box before going back to the previous page. Use it to ask the user to confirm leaving a page, such as when unsaved changes might be lost.

name: hideAlertBeforeBackPage
description: Disables the display of a confirm dialog box before returning to the previous page.
summary: Turns off the confirmation dialog that appears before going back to the previous page. Use it to let the user go back without being asked to confirm.

name: getParams
description: Obtains the parameters passed from the page that initiates redirection to the current page.
summary: Gets the parameters that were passed in when navigating to the current page. Use it to read data handed over from the previous page.

name: pushNamedRoute
description: Navigates to a page using the named route. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Opens a page by its named route, with a choice of routing mode. Use it to go to another screen in the app by name.

name: replaceNamedRoute
description: Replaces the current page with another one using the named route and destroys the current page. This API uses a
summary: Replaces the current page with another page by its named route and removes the current one. Use it to swap screens by name so the old one is gone.

name: setBackgroundLuminanceSamplingConfigs
description: Sets the color picking parameters. If the luminance threshold is not within the specified range or the dark
summary: Sets the parameters for background luminance color picking, including the brightness and dark thresholds. Use it to tune when your app reacts to background brightness changes.

name: onBackgroundLuminanceChange
description: Registers the callback for listening to color picking.
summary: Starts listening for background luminance color picking changes and reports the current background brightness. Use it to adapt your app's colors when the background brightness changes.

name: offBackgroundLuminanceChange
description: Unregisters the callback for listening to color picking. If no callback is specified, all listeners are canceled.
summary: Stops listening for background luminance color picking changes. Use it to stop adapting your app's colors when the background brightness changes.

name: showToast
description: Creates and displays a toast.
summary: Creates and displays a toast. Use it to briefly show a short message on screen, like a quick confirmation.

name: openToast
description: Displays a toast. This API uses a promise to return the toast ID for use with **closeToast**.
summary: Shows a brief toast message and returns its ID so you can close it. Use it to flash a short notice like "saved" on screen.

name: closeToast
description: Closes the specified toast.
summary: Closes the specified toast using the ID returned when it was shown. Use it to hide a brief message before it disappears on its own.

name: showDialog
description: Creates and displays a dialog box. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Creates and displays a dialog box. Use it to ask someone a question or show a message that needs a response.

name: showActionMenu
description: Shows an action menu in the given settings. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the result.
summary: Shows an action menu with the given settings. Use it to offer someone a list of choices to pick from.

name: openCustomDialog
description: Opens a custom dialog box corresponding to **dialogContent**. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Shows a custom dialog box and returns its ID so you can close it later. Use it to pop up your own dialog, such as a confirmation or sign-in prompt.

name: openCustomDialogWithController
params: dialogContent: ComponentContent<T>, controller: promptAction.DialogController, options?: promptAction.BaseDialogOptions
description: Opens a custom dialog box corresponding to **dialogContent**. This API uses a promise to return the result. A dialog box controller can be bound to the custom dialog box, allowing for subsequent control of the dialog box through the controller.
summary: Shows a custom dialog box whose content follows your own styling, with a controller to manage it afterwards. Use it to display a custom popup you can later control.

name: updateCustomDialog
description: Updates a custom dialog box corresponding to **dialogContent**. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Updates a custom dialog box's alignment, offset, auto-cancel, or mask color. Use it to change how an open custom dialog looks or behaves.

name: closeCustomDialog
description: Closes a custom dialog box corresponding to **dialogContent**. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Closes a custom dialog box using the ID returned when it was opened. Use it to dismiss a custom popup after the user is done with it.

name: presentCustomDialog
params: builder: CustomBuilder | CustomBuilderWithId, controller?: promptAction.DialogController, options?: promptAction.DialogOptions
description: Creates and displays a custom dialog box. This API uses a promise to return the dialog box ID for use with **closeCustomDialog**.
summary: Shows a custom dialog box and returns its ID, optionally with a controller to manage it. Use it to present your own dialog, such as a confirmation prompt.

name: getTopOrder
description: Obtains the order of the topmost dialog box.
summary: Returns the order of the dialog box currently at the top layer. Use it to decide the stacking order for dialog boxes you show next.

name: getBottomOrder
description: This API returns the order of the dialog box currently at the bottom layer. This information can be used to specify
summary: Returns the order of the dialog box currently at the bottom layer. Use it to decide the stacking order for dialog boxes you show next.

name: openPopup
params: content: ComponentContent<T>, target: TargetInfo, options?: PopupCommonOptions
description: Creates and displays a popup with the specified content. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Creates and shows a popup with your chosen content attached to a target component. Use it to display a small popup near a button or item.

name: updatePopup
params: content: ComponentContent<T>, options: PopupCommonOptions, partialUpdate?: boolean
description: Updates the style of the popup corresponding to the provided **content**. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Updates the style of a popup. Use it to change how an open popup looks while it is showing.

name: closePopup
description: Closes the popup corresponding to the provided **content**. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Closes the popup shown for the given content. Use it to dismiss a popup after the user finishes with it.

name: openMenu
params: content: ComponentContent<T>, target: TargetInfo, options?: MenuOptions
description: Opens a menu with the specified content. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Opens a menu with your chosen content attached to a target component. Use it to show a context or options menu when someone taps something.

name: updateMenu
params: content: ComponentContent<T>, options: MenuOptions, partialUpdate?: boolean
description: Updates the style of the menu corresponding to the provided **content**. This API uses a promise to return the
summary: Updates the style of a menu. Use it to change how an open menu looks while it is showing.

name: closeMenu
description: Closes the menu corresponding to the provided content. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Closes the menu shown for the given content. Use it to dismiss an action menu after the user picks an option or taps away.

name: present
description: Presents a fixed-style dialog box.
summary: Shows a custom dialog box with your own content. Use it to pop up a custom message or prompt over the current screen.

name: update
description: Updates a presented custom dialog box.
summary: Changes the content of a dialog box that is already showing. Use it to refresh a custom popup while it stays open.

name: dismiss
description: Dismisses a dialog box.
summary: Closes a dialog box, using either its ID or its content reference. Use it to dismiss a dialog when the user is done with it.

name: on
params: type: 'navDestinationUpdate', options: { navigationId: ResourceStr }, callback: Callback<observer.NavDestinationInfo>
description: Subscribes to status changes of this **NavDestination** component.
summary: Registers a callback that runs when a node's rendering state changes, such as when a component moves off-screen. Use it to react when something scrolls out of view or is drawn again.

name: off
params: type: 'navDestinationUpdate', options: { navigationId: ResourceStr }, callback?: Callback<observer.NavDestinationInfo>
description: Removes a callback function that was previously registered with `on()`.
summary: Unregisters listeners for UI events such as window size breakpoint changes. Use it to stop receiving those change notifications when they are no longer needed.

name: addGlobalGestureListener
params: type: GestureListenerType, option: GestureObserverConfigs, callback: GestureListenerCallback
description: Registers a callback to listen for gesture triggering information.
summary: Registers a callback that listens for gesture triggering information. Use it to detect when gestures are triggered anywhere in the UI.

name: removeGlobalGestureListener
description: Unregisters the specified global gesture listener.
summary: Stops listening for a global gesture you previously registered. Use it to turn off gesture tracking when you no longer need it.

name: onSwiperContentUpdate
description: Listens for content switching events of the **Swiper** component. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return
summary: Listens for content switching events on a chosen swiper component. Use it to react when a user swipes to a different page in a carousel.

name: offSwiperContentUpdate
description: Unregister the listener for content switching events of the **Swiper** component.
summary: Stops listening for content switching events on a chosen swiper component. Use it to stop reacting when a user swipes to a different page in a carousel.

name: onRouterPageSizeChange
description: Registers a callback that is triggered when the size of the visible router page changes. This API uses an
summary: Registers a callback that runs when the size of the visible router page changes. Use it to react when the current page area is resized.

name: offRouterPageSizeChange
description: Removes the listener callback registered using the **onRouterPageSizeChange** API. This API uses an asynchronous
summary: Removes the listener that was registered for router page size changes. Use it to stop being notified when a router page's size changes.

name: onNavDestinationSizeChange
description: Registers a callback that is triggered when the size of the visible navigation destination changes. This API uses
summary: Registers a callback that runs when the size of the visible navigation destination changes. Use it to react when the current page area is resized.

name: offNavDestinationSizeChange
description: Removes the listener callback registered using the **onNavDestinationSizeChange** API. This API uses an
summary: Removes the listener that was registered for navigation destination size changes. Use it to stop being notified when a navigation destination's size changes.

name: onNavDestinationSizeChangeByUniqueId
description: Removes the listener callback registered using the **onNavDestinationSizeChangeByUniqueId** API. This API uses an
summary: Removes a listener that watched size changes of a navigation destination. Use it to stop reacting when a particular page area is resized.

name: offNavDestinationSizeChangeByUniqueId
description: Removes a callback function that was previously registered with 'onNavDestinationSizeChangeByUniqueId()'.
summary: Stops listening for size changes of a navigation destination. Use it to cancel a size-change watch you set up earlier.

name: getRectangleById
description: Obtains the size, position, translation, scaling, rotation, and affine matrix information of the specified
summary: Gets the size, position, translation, scaling, rotation, and affine matrix of a component by its ID. Use it to find where a component is on screen and how it is transformed.

name: addComponentContent
description: Adds a specified **ComponentContent** node to the **OverlayManager**.
summary: Adds a component content node as an overlay, centered on the page by default. Use it to show a floating popup or overlay on top of the page.

name: addComponentContentWithOrder
description: Creates an overlay node with the specified display order.
summary: Creates an overlay node with a chosen display order so you control how overlays stack. Use it to show floating popups layered above or below each other.

name: removeComponentContent
description: Removes a specified node from the **OverlayManager**.
summary: Removes a specified node from the overlay manager. Use it to take down an overlay you previously added.

name: showComponentContent
description: Shows a specified **ComponentContent** node on the **OverlayManager**.
summary: Shows a specified overlay content node. Use it to make a hidden overlay visible again.

name: hideComponentContent
description: Hides a specified **ComponentContent** node on the **OverlayManager**.
summary: Hides one specified overlay component content node. Use it to dismiss a particular floating popup or overlay.

name: showAllComponentContents
description: Shows all **ComponentContent** nodes on the **OverlayManager**.
summary: Shows all overlay content nodes managed by the overlay manager. Use it to bring back every overlay that was hidden.

name: hideAllComponentContents
description: Hides all **ComponentContent** nodes on the **OverlayManager**.
summary: Hides all overlay component content nodes at once. Use it to dismiss every floating popup or overlay on the page.

name: openOrderOverlay
description: Opens an overlay with the specified ComponentContent and options.
summary: Opens an overlay with the given content and options, centered on the page by default. Use it to show a floating panel or pop-up layer above the current screen.

name: bind
description: Binds the magnifier to the component with the specified ID.
summary: Attaches the magnifier to a component by its ID so its content can be enlarged. Use it to let someone zoom in and see details of a specific component.

name: show
description: Sets the position of the component content displayed by the magnifier relative to the upper left corner of the
summary: Shows the magnifier centered on a point within the bound component. Use it to enlarge and inspect details at a chosen spot on a component.

name: unbind
description: Unbinds the magnifier from the current component.
summary: Detaches the magnifier from the current component. Use it to stop enlarging a component's content.

name: setVisible
description: Set the visibility of the bar, except the icon.
summary: Shows or hides the bar, leaving its icon in place. Use it to hide the bar when it is not needed.

name: setBackgroundColor
description: Set the background color of the bar.
summary: Sets the background color of the bar. Use it to change the bar's background to match your app's look.

name: setTitleContent
description: Set the title of the bar.
summary: Sets the title text shown on the bar. Use it to change the label displayed on an atomic service bar.

name: setTitleFontStyle
description: Set the font style of the bar's title.
summary: Changes the font style of the title shown on the bar. Use it to make the bar's title bold or italic.

name: setIconColor
description: Set the color of the icon on the bar.
summary: Sets the color of the icon on the bar. Use it to recolor the bar icon to fit your theme.

name: getBarRect
description: Get size and position of the bar.
summary: Gets the size and position of the bar relative to the window. Use it to find where the bar sits so you can place things around it.

name: onBarRectChange
description: When size and position of the bar changed, callback will be called.
summary: Calls your callback whenever the bar's size or position changes. Use it to react when the bar moves or resizes.

name: setFrameRateRange
description: Sets the FrameRateRange of the DynamicSyncScene.
summary: Sets the range of frame rates for a dynamic sync scene. Use it to control how smoothly an animation or moving content is drawn.

name: getFrameRateRange
description: Gets the FrameRateRange of the DynamicSyncScene.
summary: Gets the range of frame rates set for a dynamic synchronization scene. Use it to check how smoothly that scene is allowed to animate.

name: executeDrag
description: Initiates a drag action, with the object to be dragged and the drag information passed in. This API uses a promise
summary: Starts a drag action with the item to drag and drag information. Use it to let a user pick up and drag content on screen.

name: createDragAction
description: Creates a drag action object for initiating drag and drop operations. You need to explicitly specify one or more
summary: Creates a drag action object with drag previews, drag data, and handle point. Use it to set up a drag-and-drop operation before starting the drag.

name: getDragPreview
description: Obtains the **DragPreview** object, which represents the preview displayed during a drag operation.
summary: Gets the preview shown while an item is being dragged. Use it to style what the user sees when dragging an item across the screen.

name: setDragEventStrictReportingEnabled
description: Sets whether the **onDragLeave** callback of the parent component is triggered when an item is dragged from the
summary: Sets whether dragging an item out of a parent into a child tells the parent the item left. Use it to control when a parent is notified that a dragged item moved away.

name: notifyDragStartRequest
description: Controls whether the application can initiate a drag operation.
summary: Controls whether the app is allowed to start a drag operation. Use it to turn dragging on or off during a gesture.

name: cancelDataLoading
description: Cancels the data loading initiated by the [startDataLoading]{@link DragEvent.startDataLoading}
summary: Cancels data loading that was started for a drag. Use it to stop fetching drag data after the drag is released.

name: interruptFollowHandMorphDropAnimation
description: Interrupt the pending follow-hand morph drop animation and trigger the finish sequence immediately.
summary: Stops a pending follow-hand drop animation and finishes it right away. Use it to end a drag-and-drop animation early.

name: enableDropDisallowedBadge
description: Specifies whether to enable the display of a disallowed badge when dragged content is incompatible with a component
summary: Turns on a badge that shows when dragged content cannot be dropped on a target. Use it to warn users during drag and drop that a drop is not allowed.

name: measureText
description: Measures the single-line display width of the specified text. For multi-line text (separated by newline characters
summary: Measures the display width of given text, returning the width of the longest line for multi-line text. Use it to check how wide a piece of text will appear before laying it out.

name: measureTextSize
description: Measures the width and height of the given single-line text.
summary: Measures the width and height of a single line of text. Use it to find out how much space text will take up before placing it on screen.

name: getParagraphs
description: Converts a styled string into an array of corresponding [Paragraph]{@link @ohos.graphics.text:text.Paragraph}
summary: Converts a styled string into an array of paragraph objects based on text layout options. Use it to break styled text into paragraphs for layout.

name: clearFocus
description: Clears the focus and forcibly moves the focus to the root container node of the page, causing other nodes in the
summary: Clears the focus and moves it back to the page's root container, so other nodes lose focus. Use it to reset keyboard or remote-control focus to the top of a page.

name: requestFocus
description: Transfers focus to a component node by the component ID, which is effective immediately.
summary: Moves focus straight to a component identified by its ID. Use it to jump focus to a specific button or field, such as when a page opens.

name: activate
description: Sets the [focus activation state](docroot://ui/arkts-common-events-focus-event.md) of this page.
summary: Turns the page's focus activation state on or off. Use it to make a page start or stop receiving focus, for example when switching between pages.

name: isActive
description: Obtains the focus activation state of the UI instance.
summary: Tells whether the UI instance is currently in the focus activation state. Use it to check if a page can receive focus before moving focus around.

name: setAutoFocusTransfer
description: Sets whether the new page automatically obtains focus during page switching.
summary: Sets whether a newly opened page automatically gets focus when switching pages. Use it to control where focus lands after opening a menu, dialog, or new page.

name: setKeyProcessingMode
description: Sets the mode for processing key events.
summary: Sets how key events are processed. Use it to choose how key presses are handled when navigating with a keyboard or remote control.

name: restoreDefault
description: Restores the default cursor style.
summary: Restores the default cursor style. Use it to bring the pointer back to its normal look after changing it.

name: setCursor
description: Sets the cursor style.
summary: Sets the cursor style. Use it to change how the pointer looks, such as showing a hand or resize arrow.

name: setCustomCursor
params: value: image.PixelMap, focusX?: int, focusY?: int
description: Sets the custom cursor style.
summary: Sets a custom mouse cursor image. Use it to replace the pointer with your own picture, such as a crosshair or hand.

name: close
description: Closes this context menu.
summary: Closes this context menu. Use it to dismiss an open context menu.

name: onFrame
description: Called when the next frame is rendered.
summary: Runs when the next frame is rendered, giving the frame start time in nanoseconds. Use it to run a task at the start of the next screen refresh.

name: onIdle
description: Called after the rendering of the subsequent frame has finished and there is more than 1 millisecond left before
summary: Runs after a frame finishes when more than a millisecond remains before the next refresh, otherwise it waits for a later frame. Use it to do small work in spare moments between frames.

name: createFromBuilder
params: builder: CustomBuilder, delay?: number, checkImageStatus?: boolean, options?: componentSnapshot.SnapshotOptions
description: Captures a snapshot of an offscreen-rendered component created from a [CustomBuilder]{@link common:CustomBuilder}.
summary: Captures a snapshot of an offscreen-rendered component built from a custom builder. Use it to get a picture of a screen element that is not currently shown.

name: getSync
description: Obtains the snapshot of a component that has been loaded based on the provided [component ID]{@link common}. This
summary: Takes a snapshot of a loaded component by its ID and returns the image right away. Use it to grab a picture of a screen element on the spot.

name: getWithUniqueId
description: Obtains the snapshot of a component that has been loaded based on the provided **uniqueId**. This API uses a
summary: Takes a snapshot of a loaded component by its unique ID. Use it to get a picture of a screen element for saving or sharing.

name: getSyncWithUniqueId
description: Obtains the snapshot of a component that has been loaded based on the provided **uniqueId**. This API synchronously
summary: Takes a snapshot of a loaded component by its unique ID and returns the image right away. Use it to grab a picture of a screen element on the spot.

name: createFromComponent
params: content: ComponentContent<T>, delay?: number, checkImageStatus?: boolean, options?: componentSnapshot.SnapshotOptions
description: Captures a snapshot of the provided component content. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Captures a snapshot of the given component content currently displayed on screen. Use it to save or share a picture of a visible part of the screen.

name: getWithRange
params: start: NodeIdentity, end: NodeIdentity, isStartRect: boolean, options?: componentSnapshot.SnapshotOptions
description: Captures a snapshot of the area between two specified components. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Captures a picture of the screen area between two components. Use it to save or share a snapshot of part of the screen.

name: getSizeLimitation
description: Obtains the size limit of a component screenshot.
summary: Gets the size limit for a component screenshot. Use it to check how large a screenshot can be before capturing one.

name: enableSmartTapAndSlideGestures
description: Sets whether to enable the tap and slide operations of smart gestures.
summary: Turns the tap and slide operations of smart gestures on or off. Use it to allow or block tap and slide gesture handling.

name: registerMonitor
description: Registers a smart gesture monitoring callback. Before the system processes the current smart gesture, the
summary: Registers a callback that receives the system's default handling of a smart gesture before it is processed, so the app can intervene. Use it to customize how smart gestures are handled.

name: unregisterMonitor
description: Unregisters a smart gesture monitoring callback.
summary: Removes a previously registered smart gesture monitoring callback. Use it to stop receiving monitoring updates for smart gestures.

name: clearMonitors
description: Clears all monitoring callbacks registered for the current **UIContext**.
summary: Removes all monitoring callbacks registered for the current UI context. Use it to stop receiving smart gesture monitoring updates.

name: requestSelected
description: Requests to set the specified component as the current smart gesture selected node. After successful selection, a
summary: Requests that a specified component become the current smart gesture selected node, showing a selection prompt box. Use it to highlight a component for smart gesture selection.

name: clearSelected
description: Clears the currently selected node of smart gestures.
summary: Clears the currently selected node for smart gestures. Use it to deselect the component that was highlighted for gesture selection.

name: getCallingScopeUIContext
description: Obtains the UIContext of this [calling scope](docroot://ui/arkts-global-interface.md#basic-concepts). This API
summary: Gets the UI context of the current calling scope, or undefined if the scope is unclear. Use it to find which UI context is in effect.

name: getLastFocusedUIContext
description: Obtains the UIContext of the UI instance that most recently switched to the focused state.
summary: Gets the UI instance that most recently became focused. Use it to find which screen or window the user was last working in.

name: getLastForegroundUIContext
description: Obtains the UIContext of the UI instance that most recently switched to the foreground state.
summary: Gets the UI instance that most recently came to the foreground. Use it to find which screen or window the user last had open on top.

name: getAllUIContexts
description: Obtains all currently valid UIContext instances.
summary: Gets all currently valid UI context instances, or an empty array if none exist. Use it to find every active UI context in the app.

name: resolveUIContext
description: Obtains a UIContext instance along with its resolution strategy using a predefined priority order.
summary: Gets a UI context instance and how it was resolved. Use it to find the right UI context for your app's current screen.

name: isAvailable
description: Checks whether the UI instance corresponding to this **UIContext** object is valid. The **UIContext** object can be
summary: Checks whether the UI instance for this object is still valid. Use it to tell if a window's UI is still active before using it.

name: getFont
description: Obtains a **Font** object.
summary: Gets a font object. Use it to work with text fonts.

name: getMediaQuery
description: get object mediaQuery.
summary: Gets the media query object for the current UI context. Use it to check screen size or orientation so a layout can adapt.

name: getUIInspector
description: Obtains the **UIInspector** object.
summary: Gets the UI inspector object. Use it to inspect the layout and properties of interface elements.

name: getLuminanceSampler
description: get the luminance sampler of the specified node. If the node cannot be found, return undefined.
summary: Gets the luminance sampler for a specified node, or nothing if the node is not found. Use it to read brightness information from a node on screen.

name: getFilteredInspectorTree
description: Obtains the component tree and component attributes. This API has a long processing time and is intended for
summary: Gets the component tree and its attributes as a text string, for testing only. Use it to inspect what is on screen while testing an app.

name: getFilteredInspectorTreeById
params: id: string, depth: number, filters?: Array<string>
description: Obtains the attributes of the specified component and its child components. This API has a long processing time
summary: Gets the attributes of a component and its child components as a JSON string, for testing. Use it to inspect a component's details and its children during testing.

name: getRouter
description: Obtains a Router object.
summary: Gets a Router object for moving between pages in the app. Use it to open a new page or go back to the previous one.

name: getPromptAction
description: Obtains a PromptAction object.
summary: Gets a PromptAction object used to show prompts and dialogs on screen. Use it to pop up a message or ask the user to confirm something.

name: getDialogPresenter
description: Get the Dialog object.
summary: Gets an object for showing dialogs. Use it to pop up a dialog box on screen.

name: getComponentUtils
description: get object ComponentUtils.
summary: Gets a helper object for working with UI components. Use it when you need to inspect or measure parts of the screen layout.

name: getUIObserver
description: Obtains the **UIObserver** object.
summary: Gets a UIObserver object used to watch for UI changes. Use it to listen for and react to UI events in your app.

name: getOverlayManager
description: Obtains the OverlayManager object.
summary: Obtains the overlay manager object. Use it to show or hide floating overlays on top of the page.

name: getMagnifier
description: Obtains a [Magnifier]{@link Magnifier} object, which can be used to control the display and hiding of a magnifier.
summary: Gets a magnifier object that controls showing and hiding a magnifier. Use it to magnify part of the screen for easier reading.

name: setOverlayManagerOptions
description: Init OverlayManager.
summary: Sets up the overlay manager so overlays can be shown on the screen. Use it to prepare floating content that appears above the page.

name: getOverlayManagerOptions
description: Get object OverlayManagerOptions.
summary: Gets the overlay manager options object. Use it to read the current settings that control how overlays are shown.

name: createAnimator
description: Creates an **Animator** object.
summary: Creates an object for running animations. Use it to play an animation.

name: animateTo
description: Adds transition animations for state changes in closure code.
summary: Adds transition animations for state changes made inside the given closure. Use it to make a button, panel, or other element animate smoothly when it changes.

name: showAlertDialog
description: Shows an alert dialog box.
summary: Shows an alert dialog box with a message and buttons. Use it to warn someone or ask them to confirm something.

name: showActionSheet
description: Shows an action sheet in the given settings.
summary: Shows an action sheet with a set of choices. Use it to let someone pick from several actions, like share or delete.

name: showDatePickerDialog
description: datePickerDialog display.
summary: Shows a dialog for picking a date. Use it when someone needs to choose a day, month, and year, such as setting a birthday or appointment date.

name: showTimePickerDialog
description: timePickerDialog display.
summary: Shows a dialog for picking a time. Use it when someone needs to choose an hour and minute, such as setting an alarm or reminder time.

name: showTextPickerDialog
description: textPickerDialog display.
summary: Shows a dialog for picking from a list of text options. Use it when someone needs to select one item from a set of choices, such as a city or category.

name: setImageCacheCount
description: Set image cache capacity of decoded image count.
summary: Sets how many decoded images are kept in the image cache. Use it to cache decoded images so they load faster.

name: setImageRawDataCacheSize
description: Set image cache capacity of raw image data size in bytes before decode.
summary: Sets how much raw image data in bytes is kept in the image cache before decoding. Use it to cache raw image data so images load faster.

name: runScopedTask
description: Run custom functions inside the UIContext scope.
summary: Runs your own code inside the UI context's scope. Use it to run tasks that need to work with that UI context.

name: setKeyboardAvoidMode
description: Sets the avoidance mode for the virtual keyboard.
summary: Sets how the page avoids the on-screen keyboard. Use it to choose whether the page moves up when the keyboard appears.

name: getKeyboardAvoidMode
description: Obtains the avoidance mode of the virtual keyboard.
summary: Gets the avoidance mode of the virtual keyboard. Use it to find out how the on-screen keyboard moves content out of its way.

name: setPixelRoundMode
description: Sets the pixel rounding mode for this page.
summary: Sets how pixels are rounded when drawing this page. Use it to control how sharp or smooth edges look on screen.

name: getPixelRoundMode
description: Obtains the pixel rounding mode for this page.
summary: Obtains the pixel rounding mode for the current page. Use it to check how edges are rounded to whole pixels when drawing.

name: dispatchKeyEvent
description: Dispach keyboard event to the frameNode with inspector key.
summary: Sends a keyboard event to a specific UI element. Use it to simulate typing or key presses.

name: getAtomicServiceBar
description: Get AtomicServiceBar.
summary: Gets the atomic service bar. Use it to access the bar shown for an atomic service.

name: getDragController
description: Get DragController.
summary: Gets a controller for drag operations. Use it to start or manage dragging items on screen.

name: getMeasureUtils
description: Obtains a **MeasureUtils** object for text calculation.
summary: Gets a tool for measuring text. Use it to find out how tall and wide a piece of text will be before placing it.

name: keyframeAnimateTo
description: Generates a key frame animation. For details about how to use this API, see [keyframeAnimateTo]{@link common}.
summary: Generates a key frame animation from a list of keyframe states. Use it to animate a view through several steps.

name: getFocusController
description: Get FocusController.
summary: Gets the focus controller. Use it to manage which element has focus.

name: animateToImmediately
description: Specifies a clear animation host instance context via the UIContext object and triggers the explicit animation to
summary: Triggers an explicit animation right away using the given animation settings and closure. Use it to make a state change animate immediately without missing its end callback.

name: getFrameNodeById
description: Get FrameNode by id.
summary: Gets a frame node by its id. Use it to find a component's node by id.

name: getAttachedFrameNodeById
description: Get the FrameNode attached to current window by id.
summary: Gets the frame node attached to the current window by its id. Use it to look up a specific node in the window.

name: getFrameNodeByUniqueId
description: Get FrameNode by uniqueId.
summary: Gets a frame node by its unique id. Use it to find a component's node by unique id.

name: getPageInfoByUniqueId
description: Get page information of the frameNode with uniqueId.
summary: Gets the page information for a given frame node, including its navigation destination and router page details. Use it to find out which page a piece of UI belongs to.

name: getNavigationInfoByUniqueId
description: Get navigation information of the frameNode with uniqueId.
summary: Gets the navigation information for a frame node by its unique ID. Use it to find out where a page sits in the navigation stack.

name: setDynamicDimming
description: Sets the dynamic dimming degree of the component.
summary: Sets how dim or bright a component appears, from 0 to 1, with higher values brighter. Use it to adjust the brightness of a specific component.

name: getCursorController
description: Get object cursor controller.
summary: Gets a controller for the text cursor. Use it to manage where the cursor sits while typing.

name: addLocalInputEventMonitor
description: Registers a local input event monitor.
summary: Registers a monitor that watches input events within the current UI context and returns an identifier you save to cancel it later. Use it to detect taps, keys, or other input in one part of the screen.

name: removeLocalInputEventMonitor
description: Removes a local input event monitor.
summary: Stops a previously added local input event monitor. Use it to stop watching touch or key input after you no longer need it.

name: getContextMenuController
description: Get object context menu controller.
summary: Gets a controller for context menus. Use it to show or manage the menu that pops up on a long press.

name: getComponentSnapshot
description: Get ComponentSnapshot.
summary: Gets the component snapshot helper. Use it to capture a picture of a component.

name: vp2px
description: Converts a value in vp units to a value in px.
summary: Converts a size given in vp units into px units. Use it to turn a design measurement into the pixel value needed for drawing or layout.

name: px2vp
description: Converts a value in px units to a value in vp.
summary: Converts a size in pixels to virtual pixels. Use it to keep layout sizes consistent across different screen densities.

name: fp2px
description: Converts a value in fp units to a value in px.
summary: Converts a font-size value in fp units to pixels. Use it to turn a font size into screen pixels for layout or drawing.

name: px2fp
description: Converts a value in px units to a value in fp.
summary: Converts a size in pixels to font points. Use it to keep text the same visual size across different screen densities.

name: lpx2px
description: Converts a value in lpx units to a value in px.
summary: Converts a value in lpx units to a value in px. Use it to turn lpx sizes into pixels for layout.

name: px2lpx
description: Converts a value in px units to a value in lpx.
summary: Converts a size in pixels to logical pixels. Use it to keep layout sizes consistent across different screen densities.

name: getSharedLocalStorage
description: Obtains the **LocalStorage** instance shared by this stage.
summary: Gets the shared storage instance for this stage, or nothing if it does not exist. Use it to read and share saved values across pages.

name: getHostContext
description: Obtains the context of this ability.
summary: Gets the context of the current ability. Use it to access the ability's context.

name: getWindowName
description: Obtains the name of the window where this instance is located.
summary: Gets the name of the window the app instance is in. Use it to identify the current window by name.

name: getWindowId
description: Obtains the ID of the window to which the current application instance belongs.
summary: Gets the ID of the window the app instance belongs to. Use it to identify or manage the current window.

name: getWindowWidthBreakpoint
description: Obtains the width breakpoint value of the window where this instance is located. The specific value is determined
summary: Gets the width breakpoint of the window, based on its width. Use it to adapt your layout to different window widths.

name: getWindowHeightBreakpoint
description: Obtains the height breakpoint value of the window where this instance is located. The specific value is determined
summary: Gets the height breakpoint of the window, based on its aspect ratio. Use it to adapt your layout to different window heights.

name: openBindSheet
params: bindSheetContent: ComponentContent<T>, sheetOptions?: SheetOptions, targetId?: number
description: Creates a sheet whose content is as defined in **bindSheetContent** and displays the sheet. This API uses a promise
summary: Creates a sheet with the given content and displays it. Use it to show a pop-up sheet over the current screen.

name: updateBindSheet
params: bindSheetContent: ComponentContent<T>, sheetOptions: SheetOptions, partialUpdate?: boolean
description: Updates the style of the sheet corresponding to the provided **bindSheetContent**. This API uses a promise to
summary: Updates the style of a sheet shown on screen. Use it to change how a bottom sheet or pop-up panel looks while it is open.

name: closeBindSheet
description: Closes the sheet corresponding to **bindSheetContent**. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Closes the sheet shown for the given sheet content. Use it to dismiss a pop-up sheet when the user is done with it.

name: postFrameCallback
description: Post a frame callback to run on the next frame.
summary: Schedules a callback to run on the next frame. Use it to update animations or visuals right before the next screen refresh.

name: postDelayedFrameCallback
description: Post a frame callback to run on the next frame after the specified delay.
summary: Posts a frame callback to run on the next frame after a delay. Use it to run drawing work on a later frame.

name: requireDynamicSyncScene
description: Require DynamicSyncScene by id.
summary: Gets the dynamic sync scene objects for a given id. Use it to control the motion of a swiper by its id.

name: clearResourceCache
description: Clear the cache generated by using $r/$rawfile to retrieve resources in HSP. This cache is used to accelerate the
summary: Clears the cached resources loaded from app resource files. Use it to free cached resources, though pages may load resources more slowly afterward.

name: isFollowingSystemFontScale
description: Checks whether current font scale follows the system.
summary: Checks whether the current font scale follows the system setting. Use it to tell if text size matches the system font size.

name: getMaxFontScale
description: Get the max font scale.
summary: Gets the largest font scale currently allowed. Use it to check how big text can be shown when supporting larger fonts.

name: bindTabsToScrollable
description: Bind tabs to scrollable container component to automatically hide tab bar.
summary: Binds tabs to a scrollable container so the tab bar hides automatically as you scroll. Use it to give a scrolling page a tab bar that slides away.

name: unbindTabsFromScrollable
description: Unbind tabs from scrollable container component.
summary: Removes the link between tabs and a scrolling container. Use it to stop tab switching from being driven by scrolling in a scrollable area.

name: bindTabsToNestedScrollable
params: tabsController: TabsController, parentScroller: Scroller, childScroller: Scroller
description: Bind tabs to nested scrollable container components to automatically hide tab bar.
summary: Binds tabs to nested scrollable containers so the tab bar hides automatically as you scroll. Use it to give a page with nested scrolling a tab bar that slides away.

name: unbindTabsFromNestedScrollable
params: tabsController: TabsController, parentScroller: Scroller, childScroller: Scroller
description: Unbind tabs from nested scrollable container components.
summary: Removes the link between tabs and nested scrolling containers. Use it to stop tab switching from being driven by scrolling inside nested scrollable areas.

name: enableSwipeBack
description: whether to enable or disable swipe to back event.
summary: Turns swipe-to-go-back on or off. Use it to control whether swiping back navigates to the previous screen.

name: freezeUINode
description: Sets whether to freeze a specific component by **id** to prevent it from being marked as dirty and triggering
summary: Freezes or unfreezes a specific component so it stops being marked dirty and triggering layout updates. Use it to hold a component's layout steady while other parts of the screen change.

name: getTextMenuController
description: Obtains a [TextMenuController]{@link TextMenuController} object, which can be used to control the context menu on
summary: Gets a controller for the menu that appears when text is selected. Use it to control the copy, paste, and select menu on selected text.

name: setKeyboardAppearanceConfig
description: Set the keyboard appearance config for this input component before attach InputMethod.
summary: Sets the keyboard look for an input component before the keyboard is attached. Use it to choose how the keyboard appears when typing in a field.

name: createUIContextWithoutWindow
description: Creates a UI instance that does not depend on a window and returns its UI context. The created UI instance is a
summary: Creates a UI instance that does not depend on a window and returns its context. Use it to set up UI without a window.

name: destroyUIContextWithoutWindow
description: Destroys the UI instance created using
summary: Destroys the UI instance created without a window. Use it to clean up that UI instance.

name: setResourceManagerCacheMaxCountForHSP
description: Set the upper limit for the cache count of HSP resource management objects.
summary: Sets the maximum number of cached resource management objects kept for shared packages. Use it to limit memory used by cached resources.

name: getId
description: Obtains the unique ID of a UI instance object. In multi-instance scenarios, you can use this unique ID to
summary: Gets the unique ID of a UI instance object. Use it to tell different UI instances apart when managing several at once.

name: recycleInvisibleImageMemory
description: Set the switch for memory recycling of invisible image nodes
summary: Turns memory recycling for invisible image nodes on or off. Use it to free up memory when images are not shown on screen.

name: setCustomKeyboardContinueFeature
description: Set custom keyboard continue feature.
summary: Sets the custom keyboard continue feature. Use it to control how a custom keyboard keeps working.

name: getPageRootNode
description: Obtains the root node of the page corresponding to the UIContext.
summary: Obtains the root node of the page for this UI context. Use it to reach the top of the page's view tree when working with its elements.

name: isEasySplit
description: Checks whether the current UI instance is in easy split mode.
summary: Checks whether the current UI instance is in easy split mode. Use it to tell if the screen is showing an easy split layout.

name: enableEventPassthrough
description: Whether to enable or disable event passthrough.
summary: Turns passing of raw input events through to lower layers on or off. Use it to let touches pass through to what is behind.

name: setTextSelectionClearPolicy
description: Sets the text selection clear policy for text component.
summary: Sets whether selected text stays selected when you touch outside it. Use it to control how text selection behaves when tapping elsewhere.

name: getSmartGestureController
description: Get object smart gesture controller.
summary: Gets the smart gesture controller object. Use it to work with smart gesture controls in the interface.

name: setMenuOptions
description: Sets menu options.
summary: Sets options for the text selection menu. Use it to control how the menu appears when text is selected.

name: disableSystemServiceMenuItems
description: Disables all system service menu items in the text selection menu.
summary: Turns off all system service items in the text selection menu. Use it to hide system menu entries when text is selected.

name: disableMenuItems
description: Disables specified system service menu items in the text selection menu.
summary: Turns off chosen system service items in the text selection menu. Use it to hide specific menu entries when text is selected.

name: env
description: Defining System Environment Variables
summary: Sets a system environment variable to a chosen value. Use it to define system environment settings for a component.

name: customEnv
description: Defining Custom Environment Variables
summary: Sets a custom environment variable to a chosen value. Use it to define your own environment settings for a component.

name: createFromBuilder
params: builder: CustomBuilder, delay?: number, checkImageStatus?: boolean, options?: SnapshotOptions
description: Renders a custom component in the application background and outputs its snapshot. This API uses a promise to
summary: Renders a custom component in the background and returns its snapshot image. Use it to capture a picture of a component that is not currently shown on screen.

name: getSync
description: Obtains the snapshot of a component that has been loaded based on the provided [component ID]{@link common}. This
summary: Gets a snapshot image of an already loaded component by its ID, waiting until it is ready. Use it to capture a picture of a component on screen.

name: getItemsInShapePath
description: Get the image objects located within the selected area.
summary: Gets the image objects located within a selected area. Use it to find which images fall inside a drawn shape or region.

name: getRectangleById
description: Obtains a **ComponentInfo** object based on the component ID and synchronously returns the geometric properties of
summary: Gets the size, position, rotation, and scaling of a component by its ID. Use it to find where a component is and how big it is on screen.

name: space
description: The spacing between rows.
summary: Sets the spacing between rows in a lazy column layout. Use it to add breathing room between list items so they are easier to read.

name: alignItems
description: Sets the horizontal alignment of the row content.
summary: Sets the horizontal alignment of content in a lazy column row. Use it to line up items left, center, or right in a scrolling list.

name: header
description: Sets the header of the lazy column layout.
summary: Sets the header shown at the top of a lazy column layout. Use it to add a fixed top area, such as a title or banner, above the scrolling rows.

name: footer
description: Sets the footer of the lazy column layout.
summary: Sets the footer shown at the bottom of a lazy column layout. Use it to add a fixed bottom area, such as a load-more button, below the scrolling rows.

name: sticky
description: Sets sticky style for header and footer.
summary: Sets whether the header and footer stay pinned while the content scrolls. Use it to keep a title or footer visible as the user scrolls through the rows.

name: onVisibleIndexesChange
description: Triggered when the index of child components in the visible area changes.
summary: Runs when the indexes of the child items currently visible on screen change. Use it to react to scrolling, such as loading more items or tracking which rows the user can see.

name: onVisibleIndexesChange
description: Called when visible indexes change.
summary: Runs when the indexes of the child items currently visible on screen change. Use it to react to scrolling, such as loading more items or tracking which items the user can see.

name: rowsGap
description: The spacing between rows.
summary: Sets the spacing between rows in a waterflow layout. Use it to add breathing room between rows of items like cards or images.

name: columnsGap
description: The spacing between columns.
summary: Sets the spacing between columns in a waterflow layout. Use it to add breathing room between columns of items like cards or images.

name: header
description: Sets the header of the lazy waterflow layout.
summary: Sets a header shown at the top of a waterflow layout. Use it to add a title or banner above the items.

name: footer
description: Sets the footer of the lazy waterflow layout.
summary: Sets a footer shown at the bottom of a waterflow layout. Use it to add a closing area, such as a load-more button or end note, below the items.

name: sticky
description: Sets the sticky style for header and footer.
summary: Sets whether the header and footer stay fixed while the content scrolls. Use it to keep a header or footer visible in a scrolling waterflow list.

name: onVisibleIndexesChange
description: Called when the first or last item displayed in the component changes.
summary: Runs when the first or last visible item in the layout changes, and once at startup. Use it to react to scrolling, such as loading more items or tracking what is on screen.

name: columnsTemplate
description: This parameter specifies the number of columns in the current waterflow layout.
summary: Sets how many columns the waterflow layout has, or their relative widths. Use it to arrange items into a grid of columns, such as a photo gallery or product list.

name: breakpointConfig
description: Sets the breakpoint configuration for container dimension analysis.
summary: Sets breakpoint thresholds for container size analysis, triggering different layout behaviors based on container size. Use it to make layouts adapt when the container gets wider or narrower.

name: closeSelectionMenu
description: Closes the custom or default selection menu of the SelectionContainer.
summary: Closes the custom or default selection menu of a selection container. Use it to dismiss the menu that appears when text is selected.

name: clearTextSelection
description: Clears the current text selection of the SelectionContainer,
summary: Clears the current text selection and closes the selection menu. Use it to deselect text and dismiss the menu.

name: copyOption
description: Set whether to allow copy and where data can be copied.
summary: Sets whether selected text can be copied and where it can be copied to. Use it to allow or restrict copying text in your app.

name: caretColor
description: Set the caret color for selected text.
summary: Sets the color of the caret shown in selected text. Use it to make the text cursor match your app's theme.

name: selectedBackgroundColor
description: Set selected text background color.
summary: Sets the background color of selected text. Use it to highlight the text a user has selected.

name: enableHapticFeedback
description: Enable or disable haptic feedback.
summary: Turns haptic feedback on or off. Use it to make the device vibrate when the user selects text.

name: textJoinStyle
description: Set text join style for aggregated text in SelectionContainer.
summary: Sets how aggregated text is joined together. Use it to control how copied or selected text is combined.

name: bindSelectionMenu
params: spanType: Optional<TextSpanType>, content: Optional<CustomBuilder>, responseType: Optional<TextResponseType>, options?: Optional<SelectionContainerMenuOptions>
description: Bind to the selection menu.
summary: Binds a custom menu that appears when text is selected. Use it to offer actions like copy or share on the selected text.

name: editMenuOptions
description: Set the custom text menu.
summary: Sets a custom menu for selected text, including its text, icon, and action. Use it to add your own options to the text selection menu.

name: onTextSelectionChange
description: Called when text selection changes in SelectionContainer.
summary: Runs when the text selection changes. Use it to track which text a user has selected.

name: onWillCopy
description: Called before using the Clipboard copy menu.
summary: Runs just before the copy menu copies text. Use it to react before a user copies text.

name: onCopy
description: Called when selected text is copied.
summary: Runs when selected text is copied. Use it to react to a user copying text.

name: close
description: Close the corresponding dialog.
summary: Closes the dialog it controls. Use it to dismiss a popup or dialog when the user is done with it.

name: getState
description: Get the state.
summary: Returns the current state of the dialog. Use it to check whether a dialog is open or closed before acting on it.

name: startDrag
description: Starts the drag service. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Starts the drag service so a drag operation begins. Use it to begin dragging an item after a touch or long-press.

name: on
description: Subscribes to drag state changes.
summary: Subscribes to changes in drag state. Use it to react while a user drags something on screen.

name: off
description: Unsubscribes from drag state changes.
summary: Stops listening for drag state changes. Use it when you no longer need to know when a drag starts or ends.

name: setForegroundColor
description: Sets the foreground color of the drag preview. This API does not work in the **OnDrop** and **OnDragEnd**
summary: Sets the foreground color of the drag preview. Use it to change the color of what the user sees while dragging an item.

name: animate
description: Applies a foreground color animation to the drag preview. This API does not work in the **OnDrop** and
summary: Runs a foreground color animation on the drag preview. Use it to animate the look of the preview while dragging an item.

name: executeDrag
description: Initiates a drag action, with the object to be dragged and the drag information passed in. This API uses a promise
summary: Starts a drag action for an item and returns the drag result. Use it to let a user drag an item and get what happened when the drag ends.

name: createDragAction
description: Initiates a drag action, with the object to be dragged and the drag information passed in. This API uses a promise
summary: Starts a drag action with the item to drag and its drag information. Use it to let a user pick up and drag an item on screen.

name: getDragPreview
description: Obtains the **DragPreview** object, which represents the preview displayed during a drag operation.
summary: Gets the preview object shown while an item is being dragged. Use it to style the image the user sees while dragging an item.

name: abort
description: Terminates subsequent hover detection. This API does not trigger CANCEL state notifications, and the application
summary: Stops further hover detection during a drag. Use it to end drag hover handling and clean up state yourself.

name: updateConfiguration
description: Updates the hover detection configuration. This API is effective only when the hover detection state is BEGIN.
summary: Changes the hover detection settings while a drag hover is in its beginning state. Use it to adjust how a drag hover responds before detection continues.

name: getPixelMap
description: Obtains this **PixelMap** instance.
summary: Gets the pixel map for this drawable. Use it to obtain the image data so you can display or process the picture.

name: loadSync
description: Synchronously loads the image resource and returns the loading result.
summary: Loads the drawable's image resource immediately and gives back the loading result. Use it when you need the image ready right away to show on screen.

name: load
description: Asynchronously loads the image resource and returns the loading result. This API uses a promise to return the
summary: Loads the drawable's image resource and gives back the loading result. Use it to get an image ready to show on screen.

name: release
description: Releases the resource held by **DrawableDescriptor**. After the **release** API is called, the object becomes
summary: Frees the resources held by a drawable, after which it can no longer be used. Use it to clean up an image you are finished showing.

name: isReleased
description: Checks whether **DrawableDescriptor** is released. If **true** is returned, the object has been released. In this
summary: Checks whether a drawable's resources have been released. Use it to confirm a drawable is still usable before loading or reading its image.

name: invalidate
description: Redraws **DrawableDescriptor**. Currently, this API is supported for the
summary: Redraws a picture-based drawable so its image is refreshed. Use it to update a displayed picture after its content changes.

name: getForeground
description: Obtains the **DrawableDescriptor** object of the foreground.
summary: Gets the foreground image part of a layered icon. Use it to draw or show just the foreground layer of an app icon.

name: getBackground
description: Obtains the **DrawableDescriptor** object of the background.
summary: Gets the background image part of a layered icon. Use it to draw or show just the background layer of an app icon.

name: getMask
description: Obtains the **DrawableDescriptor** object of the mask.
summary: Gets the mask image part of a layered icon. Use it to draw or show the mask layer that shapes an app icon.

name: setBlendMode
description: Sets the blend mode of **LayeredDrawableDescriptor**. If this API is called for multiple times on the same
summary: Sets how the layers of a layered icon blend when drawn. Use it to change how an app icon's layers combine on screen.

name: getMaskClipPath
description: Obtains the built-in clipping path parameters of the system. It is a static method of
summary: Gets the system's built-in clipping path text for a layered icon. Use it to clip an icon to the standard shape.

name: start
description: Starts playback from the first frame.
summary: Starts an animation playing from its first frame. Use it to begin playing an animation.

name: stop
description: Stops playback and resets to the first frame.
summary: Stops an animation and resets it to the first frame. Use it to halt a running animation and return it to its starting state.

name: pause
description: Pauses playback on the current frame.
summary: Pauses an animation on its current frame. Use it to stop a playing animation temporarily and keep its place.

name: resume
description: Resumes playback from the current frame.
summary: Continues an animation from the frame where it was paused. Use it to restart a paused animation.

name: getStatus

name: removeVirtualScreenSurface

summary: Adds windows to the list of windows not allowed to be shown during casting. Use it to hide chosen app windows from a screen cast.

summary: Removes windows from the list of windows that are hidden during casting. Use it to make an app's main window visible again when casting or screen sharing.

summary: Turns coordinates measured from the top-left of a screen into coordinates measured from the top-left of the main screen. Use it to compare positions across the main screen and an extended screen.

name: convertGlobalToRelativeCoordinate
description: Converts global coordinates (based on the top-left corner of the primary screen) into relative coordinates (based
summary: Turns coordinates measured from the top-left of the main screen into coordinates measured from the top-left of a chosen screen. Use it to place a window or pointer correctly on a second monitor.

name: getBrightnessInfo
description: Obtains the screen brightness information of a display. If the screen does not support HDR, the
summary: Gets the screen brightness information of a display, including HDR headroom values. Use it to check how bright a screen is or to read brightness details for a display.

name: offBrightnessInfoChange

name: getCutoutInfo

summary: Gets information about the screen cutout, such as a notch or camera hole. Use it to check where the cutout is so you can avoid placing content there.

name: hasImmersiveWindow
description: Checks whether this display contains an immersive window. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Checks whether a display currently shows an immersive window. Use it to tell if an app is running in full-screen immersive mode.

name: getAvailableArea
description: Obtains the available area of the display of the current device. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the screen space left for apps after system bars are removed. Use it to lay out content that fits the usable screen area.

name: getLiveCreaseRegion
description: Obtains the live crease region of the foldable device in the current display mode.
summary: Gets the crease area of a foldable device's screen in the current display mode. Use it to keep content away from the fold line.

name: on

summary: Listens for changes to the display's available area, such as when the screen rotates or system bars appear. Use it to adjust your layout to the usable screen area.

name: onAvailableAreaChange

summary: Listens for changes to the display's available area. Use it to keep your layout fitting the usable screen area.

name: off

summary: Stops listening for changes to the display's available area. Use it when you no longer need to react to the screen area changing.

name: offAvailableAreaChange

summary: Stops listening for changes to the display's available area. Use it to stop reacting when the usable screen area changes.

summary: Gets the current screen's fold state, display mode, rotation, and orientation. Use it to adapt your layout to how the device screen is positioned or folded.

name: getRoundedCorner
description: Obtains the rounded corner information of the display. The rounded corner information of the display is
summary: Gets the rounded corner details of a display, such as the corner radius. Use it to match your app's layout to the screen's rounded corners.

name: getRemoteAbilityInfo

summary: Gets details about an ability on another device by its element name. Use it to look up a remote app's ability before connecting to it across devices.

name: getRemoteAbilityInfos
description: Obtains the information about remote abilities that match the given element names. This API uses a promise to
summary: Gets details about several abilities on other devices by their element names, up to ten at once. Use it to look up multiple remote abilities in one go.

summary: Creates a manager for distributed devices, the starting point for working with trusted and local devices. Use it to find nearby trusted devices and see your own device's information.

name: getLocalDeviceName

summary: Gets the name of your own device. Use it to show this device's name when connecting or sharing.

name: getLocalDeviceType

name: getLocalDeviceId

summary: Gets the ID of your own device. Use it to identify this device when connecting or sharing.

name: getDeviceName

summary: Gets a device's name from its network ID. Use it to show which device you are connected to.

name: getDeviceType

summary: Gets a device's type from its network ID. Use it to tell what kind of device you are connected to.

name: startDiscovering

summary: Starts searching for devices nearby, taking up to two minutes and finding up to 99 devices. Use it to find other devices to connect to.

summary: Replies to the user's UI operation, such as granting or removing permission or confirming PIN input. Use it to report what the user chose in a permission or PIN dialog.

summary: Warns you when the device management service stops unexpectedly. Use it to know when nearby device features stop working.

summary: Tells you when a device's state changes, such as connecting or disconnecting. Use it to react when a nearby device comes online or goes away.

name: onDeviceNameChange

name: offDeviceNameChange

summary: Stops listening for changes to a device's name. Use it to stop being notified when a nearby device is renamed.

name: onDiscoverFailure

summary: Tells you when searching for nearby devices fails. Use it to know that a device search did not succeed.

name: offDiscoverFailure

summary: Stops listening for failed device discovery. Use it to stop being notified when searching for nearby devices fails.

name: onServiceDie

summary: Tells your app when the device manager service has stopped working. Use it to detect that device management has failed and handle the situation.

name: getDeviceProfileInfoList

name: restoreLocalDeviceName

summary: Restores the local device name. Use it to reset the name shown for this device.

name: getTrustedDeviceList

summary: Gets the list of devices you have already trusted and paired with. Use it to see which of your devices you can connect to.

name: getLocalDeviceInfo

name: getDeviceInfo

summary: Gets details about one device from its network ID. Use it to look up a specific trusted or local device.

summary: Starts discovering nearby peripheral devices for up to two minutes, finding at most 99 devices. Use it to search for other devices to connect to or manage.

name: getCameraTrackingLayout

name: getRotationLimits
