summary: Turns a device feature such as Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, camera or USB on or off; once off, the feature cannot be used. Use it to block or allow a feature on the device.

name: getDisallowedPolicy
description: Queries whether a feature is disabled.
summary: Checks whether a chosen device feature, such as Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, camera or USB, is currently switched off. Use it to see if a feature has been blocked on the device.

name: setDisallowedPolicyForAccount
params: admin: Want, feature: string, disallow: boolean, accountId: number
description: Disallows a feature for a specified user.
summary: Turns off a device feature for one user, such as Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, camera, USB, or fingerprint unlock. Use it to block a feature for a chosen person on a shared or managed device.

name: getDisallowedPolicyForAccount
params: admin: Want | null, feature: string, accountId: number
description: Obtains the status of a feature for a specified user.
summary: Checks whether a chosen device feature is switched off for a particular user account. Use it to see if a feature like fingerprint unlock is blocked for one user.

name: addDisallowedListForAccount
params: admin: Want, feature: string, list: Array<string>, accountId: number
description: Adds a list of applications that are not allowed to use a feature for a specified user.
summary: Adds apps that are not allowed to use a feature for a specified user. Use it to block chosen apps from a capability such as taking screenshots.

name: removeDisallowedListForAccount
params: admin: Want, feature: string, list: Array<string>, accountId: number
description: Removes the list of applications that are not allowed to use a feature for a specified user.
summary: Removes apps from the list that is not allowed to use a feature, such as screen snapshot, for a particular user account. Use it to let those apps use the feature again for that user.

name: getDisallowedListForAccount
params: admin: Want, feature: string, accountId: number
description: Obtains the list of applications that are not allowed to use a feature for a specified user.
summary: Gets the apps that are not allowed to use a feature for a specified user. Use it to check which apps are blocked from a capability such as taking screenshots.

name: setUserRestriction
params: admin: Want, settingsItem: string, restricted: boolean
description: Sets restrictions on user behaviors.
summary: Stops users from changing certain device settings, such as APN configuration or the long-press power menu. Use it to lock down settings so people cannot alter them.

name: getUserRestricted
description: Obtains the disabled status of a setting item.
summary: Checks whether a device setting item, such as the device name or Ethernet IP settings, is currently disabled. Use it to see if a setting has been locked so it cannot be changed.

name: setUserRestrictionForAccount
params: admin: Want, settingsItem: string, accountId: int, restricted: boolean
description: Sets restrictions on specified user behaviors.
summary: Stops one user from changing certain device settings, such as the wallpaper. Use it to keep a chosen person from altering settings on a managed device.

name: getUserRestrictedForAccount
params: admin: Want | null, settingsItem: string, accountId: int
description: Obtains the disabled status of a setting item for a specified user.
summary: Checks whether a device setting item, such as changing the wallpaper, is disabled for a particular user account. Use it to see if a setting is locked for one user.

name: getSecurityPatchTag
description: Queries the security patch tag of a device.
summary: Gets the security patch tag of the device. Use it to check which security patch level the device is on.

name: getDeviceEncryptionStatus
description: Queries the encryption status of the device file system.
summary: Checks whether the device's file system is encrypted. Use it to confirm files on the device are protected by encryption.

name: getSecurityStatus
description: Obtains the security status of the current device. This API is applicable to scenarios such as device compliance
summary: Checks the device's security patch or file encryption status. Use it to audit whether a device meets security requirements.

name: installUserCertificate
description: Installs a user certificate. This API uses a promise to return the result. Enterprises can use this API to install
summary: Installs a user certificate on the device. Use it for secure connections such as enterprise VPN or authentication.

name: uninstallUserCertificate
description: Uninstalls a user certificate. This API uses a promise to return the result. This API is applicable to enterprise
summary: Removes a user certificate from the device. Use it to replace an expired certificate or revoke an employee's access to enterprise resources.

name: getUserCertificates
description: Obtains the user certificate of a specified system account. Enterprises can use this API to query the list of user
summary: Lists the user certificates installed for a given system account. Use it to audit installed certificates and manage their validity.

name: setPasswordPolicy
description: Sets the device screen lock password policy. After the policy is set, when a user sets a lock screen password, if
summary: Sets the screen lock password policy for the device, prompting users to reset passwords that do not meet requirements. Use to require strong passwords and periodic changes for enterprise security.

name: getPasswordPolicy
description: Obtains the device screen lock password policy.
summary: Gets the device screen lock password policy. Use it to check the current password rules for compliance.

name: setAppClipboardPolicy
params: admin: Want, tokenId: number, policy: ClipboardPolicy
description: Sets the device clipboard policy. After the policy is set, applications will be restricted in their clipboard usage
summary: Sets a clipboard policy for an app to restrict how it can use the clipboard. Use to stop sensitive data being copied out of apps like email or finance systems.

name: getAppClipboardPolicy
description: Obtains the device clipboard policy.
summary: Gets an app's clipboard policy for a user. Use it to audit whether an app is allowed to use the clipboard.

name: setWatermarkImage
params: admin: Want, bundleName: string, source: string | image.PixelMap, accountId: number
description: Sets a watermark policy for a specified application of a specified user. Currently, a maximum of 100 policies can
summary: Sets a watermark image for a chosen app of a chosen user. Use it to mark a specific app's screen with an identifying image.

name: cancelWatermarkImage
params: admin: Want, bundleName: string, accountId: number
description: Cancels the watermark policy for a specified user. When an application no longer requires watermark protection or
summary: Removes the watermark for a chosen app and user. Use it when an app no longer needs watermark protection or is being updated.

name: getWatermarkImageApps
description: Obtains the list of application bundle names for which watermarks have been set for a specified user.
summary: Lists the apps that have watermarks set for a given user. Use it to check which apps show a watermark.

name: setPermissionManagedState
params: admin: Want, applicationInstance: ApplicationInstance, permissions: Array<string>, managedState: PermissionManagedState
description: Sets the management policy for the [user_grant permission]{@link permissions:Permissions} of a specified
summary: Sets the management policy for an app's user-granted permissions. Use to silently grant permissions to enterprise apps and avoid permission prompts during batch deployment.

name: getPermissionManagedState
params: admin: Want, applicationInstance: ApplicationInstance, permission: string
description: Obtains the management policy for the [user_grant permission]{@link permissions:Permissions} of a specified
summary: Gets the management policy for a user-granted permission of an app. Use it to check how a permission is being managed for that app.

name: setExternalSourceExtensionsPolicy
description: Sets the management policy for extensions from external sources. After the policy is set, the system controls the
summary: Sets the management policy for extensions from external sources, controlling whether they can run. Use to stop employees installing unauthorized browser extensions or to force enterprise-approved ones.

name: getExternalSourceExtensionsPolicy
description: Obtains the management policy for extensions from external sources.
summary: Gets the policy for extensions installed from outside sources. Use it to check whether external-source extensions are allowed on the device.

name: installEnterpriseReSignatureCertificate
params: admin: Want, certificateAlias: string, fd: int, accountId: int
description: Installs the enterprise application re-signing certificate. After the installation is successful, the enterprise
summary: Installs an enterprise app re-signing certificate so the enterprise can re-sign applications. Use it to set up enterprise app distribution.

name: uninstallEnterpriseReSignatureCertificate
params: admin: Want, certificateAlias: string, accountId: int
description: Uninstalls the enterprise application re-signing certificate. After the enterprise re-signing certificate is
summary: Removes the enterprise app re-signing certificate, so apps signed with it stop running after the next restart. Use it when replacing or retiring an enterprise signing certificate.

name: setScreenWatermarkImage
description: Sets a screen watermark policy, which takes effect for all users.
summary: Sets a watermark image that appears on the screen for all users. Use it to display an ownership or confidentiality mark across the device.

name: cancelScreenWatermarkImage
description: Cancels a screen watermark policy, which takes effect for all users. After the cancellation is successful, the
summary: Removes the screen watermark from the device for all users. Use it when a device no longer needs watermark protection on its screen.

name: setDisallowedPermission
params: admin: Want, permission: string, disallow: boolean, accountId: number
description: Disables the specified permission of the specified user. After the permission is disabled, all applications under
summary: Disables a permission for all apps of a user, so they are denied when requesting or using it. Use to block high-risk permissions such as camera or microphone to prevent privacy leaks.

name: getDisallowedPermissions
description: Obtains the list of disabled permissions of a specified user.
summary: Lists the permissions that are disabled for a user. Use it to check which permissions have been turned off on the device.

name: addAllowedPermissionBundle
params: admin: Want, permission: string, applicationInstance: common.ApplicationInstance
description: Adds an application to the permission usage exception list. Applications in the list are not subject to the
summary: Adds an app to a permission exception list so it keeps using a permission even when that permission is blocked for others. Use it so essential work apps can still use the camera when the camera is otherwise disabled.

name: removeAllowedPermissionBundle
params: admin: Want, permission: string, applicationInstance: common.ApplicationInstance
description: Removes an application from the permission usage exception list. After the application is removed, it cannot use
summary: Removes an app from the permission exception list so it can no longer use that permission. Use to take back a permission that was previously allowed for an app.

name: getAllowedPermissionBundles
params: admin: Want | null, permission: string, accountId: number
description: Obtains the list of applications in the permission exception list.
summary: Lists the apps that are allowed an exception to a permission. Use it to check which apps may keep a permission that is otherwise blocked.

name: setScreenLockDisabledForAccount
description: Disables or enables swipe-to-unlock for the current user. When enabled, the user must swipe on the screen after the
summary: Turns swipe-to-unlock on or off for the current user, so the screen either requires a swipe or goes straight to the home screen. Use it to simplify access on managed devices or to keep a basic lock-screen step.

name: isScreenLockDisabledForAccount
description: Checks whether swipe-to-unlock is disabled for the current user.
summary: Checks whether swipe-to-unlock is disabled for the current user. Use it to verify the screen lock policy on a device.

name: setNTPServer
description: Sets the Network Time Protocol (NTP) time server. After successful configuration, the system will use the specified
summary: Sets the time server used to synchronize the system clock. Use it to keep enterprise devices on the same accurate time, so logs and certificates stay valid.

name: getNTPServer
description: Obtains the NTP server information. This API is applicable to scenarios where you need to query the current NTP
summary: Obtains the NTP server address configured on the device. Use it to check whether time synchronization is set up correctly or to see the current server before changing it.

name: setOtaUpdatePolicy
description: Sets the update policy. After the setting is successful, the system performs OTA updates based on the specified
summary: Sets the policy that controls how the system performs over-the-air updates. Use it to choose the update behavior for enterprise devices, including intranet updates.

name: getOtaUpdatePolicy
description: Checks the update policy. This API is applicable to scenarios where you need to obtain the current OTA update
summary: Checks the current OTA update policy of the device. Use it to verify whether an update policy was delivered correctly or to see the current policy before adjusting it.

name: notifyUpdatePackages
description: Notifies the system of the update packages. In intranet updates, call this API to notify the system of the update
summary: Tells the system about update packages for an intranet update. Use it to prepare a device for a system update before setting the update policy.

name: getUpdateResult
description: Obtains the system update result. This API uses a promise to return the result. This API is applicable to scenarios
summary: Obtains the result of a system update for a given version. Use it to check whether an update succeeded and to handle update failures.

name: getUpdateAuthData
description: Obtains the authentication data for system update verification. This API uses a promise to return the result. This
summary: Obtains authentication data for verifying a system update package. Use it in intranet updates to check that an update package is valid and not malicious.

name: setAutoUnlockAfterReboot
description: Sets automatic unlocking upon device reboot. This setting takes effect only on devices without a screen lock
summary: Sets whether the device unlocks automatically after a reboot, on devices without a screen lock password. Use it for unattended devices that must restart without manual unlocking.

name: getAutoUnlockAfterReboot
description: Checks whether the device is automatically unlocked upon reboot.
summary: Checks whether the device unlocks automatically after a reboot. Use it to confirm whether the automatic unlock setting is on.

name: addDisallowedNearLinkProtocols
params: admin: Want, protocols: Array<NearLinkProtocol>, accountId: number
description: Adds a list of NearLink protocols that are not allowed to be used for a specified user. NearLink Kit provides a low
summary: Blocks chosen NearLink protocols for a specified user, so those short-range connections cannot be used. Use it to restrict which NearLink devices or services a user may connect with.

name: removeDisallowedNearLinkProtocols
params: admin: Want, protocols: Array<NearLinkProtocol>, accountId: number
description: Removes the list of disallowed NearLink protocols for a specified user. After successful removal, the specified
summary: Removes the list of disallowed NearLink protocols for a user, letting them use those protocols again. Use it to restore NearLink communication for a specific user.

name: getDisallowedNearLinkProtocols
description: Obtains the list of disallowed NearLink protocols for a specified user. This API is applicable to scenarios where
summary: Gets the list of NearLink protocols that are blocked for a user. Use it to check which wireless connection types are restricted.

name: setInstallLocalEnterpriseAppEnabled
description: Sets whether local installation of enterprise applications is supported. When local installation is enabled, users
summary: Turns on or off whether users can install enterprise apps locally by double-tapping their installation packages. Use it to allow or block local installation of company apps on enterprise PCs and 2-in-1 devices.

name: getInstallLocalEnterpriseAppEnabled
description: Checks whether local installation of enterprise applications is supported. This API is applicable to scenarios
summary: Checks whether installing enterprise apps locally is allowed on the device. Use it to confirm whether local enterprise app installation is turned on.

name: addKeyEventPolicies
description: Adds a key event handling policy. When the system triggers a key event, if the event matches the delivered key
summary: Adds a policy so the management app is notified when a matching key event, such as a power or volume key press, occurs. Use it to watch for button presses like volume or power keys.

name: removeKeyEventPolicies
description: Removes a key event handling policy. After the deletion is successful, the system restores the default handling
summary: Removes a key event handling policy so the system restores the default behavior for those keys. Use it to bring back normal key responses on a device.

name: getKeyEventPolicies
description: Obtains the key event handling policy.
summary: Obtains the current key event handling policy. Use it to check whether a key policy has been applied or to see the current configuration before changing it.

name: setActivationLockDisabled
params: admin: Want, isDisabled: boolean, credential?: string
description: Enables or disables the device activation lock. After the device activation lock is disabled, the Find Device
summary: Enables or disables the device activation lock; disabling it also turns off Find Device. Use it to manage whether a device can be activation-locked.

name: isActivationLockDisabled
description: Checks whether the device activation lock is disabled. This API is applicable to scenarios where you need to verify
summary: Checks whether the device activation lock is disabled. Use it to confirm the security setting before transferring or recycling a device.

name: startCollectLog
description: Starts to collect the fault logs of the [FaultType]{@link @ohos.faultLogger:FaultLogger.FaultType} type that have
summary: Starts collecting fault logs already stored on the device's hard disk. Use it to gather device fault logs for troubleshooting.

name: finishLogCollected
description: Deletes the device logs collected by the current MDM app under the current user.
summary: Deletes the device logs that the management app collected for the current user. Use it to clear collected logs after they have been gathered.

name: setInstallLocalEnterpriseAppEnabledForAccount
params: admin: Want, isEnable: boolean, accountId: number
description: Sets whether local installation of enterprise applications is supported for a specified user. After the policy of
summary: Turns on or off local installation of enterprise apps for a specific user. Use it to let a chosen user install company apps by double-clicking their installation packages on a PC or 2-in-1 device.

name: getInstallLocalEnterpriseAppEnabledForAccount
description: Checks whether local installation of enterprise applications is supported for a specified user. This API is
summary: Checks whether installing enterprise apps locally is allowed for a specific user. Use it to confirm whether that user can install enterprise apps locally.

name: setOtaUpdateNonceEnable
description: Sets whether to enable nonce for OTA update (nonce is enabled by default). When nonce is enabled, the system
summary: Turns the nonce check for system updates on or off. Use it to make the device verify update validity and block replay attacks during updates.

name: isOtaUpdateNonceEnable
description: Checks whether nonce is enabled for OTA update. This API is applicable to scenarios where you need to verify the
summary: Checks whether nonce verification is enabled for OTA updates. Use it to confirm the security configuration of system updates on a device.

name: setSimDisabled
description: Disables the SIM card in the specified slot. After being disabled, the SIM card in the specified slot cannot be
summary: Disables the SIM card in a chosen slot so it cannot make calls, send messages, or use data. Use it to cut off phone service when a device is lost or an employee leaves.

name: setSimEnabled
description: Enables the SIM card in a specified slot. After it has been disabled with **setSimDisabled**, the card must be
summary: Turns on the SIM card in a chosen slot. Use it to switch a phone line back on for calls and mobile data.

name: isSimDisabled
description: Checks whether the SIM card in a specified slot is disabled. This API is applicable in scenarios where enterprise
summary: Checks whether the SIM card in a chosen slot is disabled. Use it to confirm that a SIM card has been turned off and cannot make calls or use data.

name: addOutgoingCallPolicyNumbers
params: admin: Want, policy: adminManager.Policy, numbers: Array<string>
description: Adds the trustlist or blocklist for outgoing calls. If no list is set, all numbers can make outgoing calls. Once a
summary: Adds a trustlist or blocklist of phone numbers for outgoing calls, so only listed numbers can be dialed or are blocked. Use it to let employees call only customer service hotlines or stop calls to certain numbers.

name: removeOutgoingCallPolicyNumbers
params: admin: Want, policy: adminManager.Policy, numbers: Array<string>
description: Removes the trustlist or blocklist for outgoing calls. If the list is not set, the removal fails. For example, an
summary: Removes numbers from the outgoing call trustlist or blocklist. Use it to lift call restrictions and let employees make calls again.

name: getOutgoingCallPolicyNumbers
description: Obtains the trustlist or blocklist for outgoing calls.
summary: Gets the list of phone numbers set as the outgoing call trustlist or blocklist. Use it to review which numbers can be dialed or are blocked from being dialed.

name: addIncomingCallPolicyNumbers
params: admin: Want, policy: adminManager.Policy, numbers: Array<string>
description: Adds the trustlist or blocklist for incoming calls. If no list is set, all numbers can make incoming calls. Once a
summary: Adds a trustlist or blocklist of phone numbers for incoming calls, so only listed numbers can call or are blocked from calling. Use it to let employees answer only customer calls or block harassment calls.

name: removeIncomingCallPolicyNumbers
params: admin: Want, policy: adminManager.Policy, numbers: Array<string>
description: Removes the trustlist or blocklist for incoming calls. If the list is not set, the removal fails. For example, an
summary: Removes numbers from the incoming call trustlist or blocklist. Use it to lift call restrictions and let employees answer calls again.

name: getIncomingCallPolicyNumbers
description: Obtains the trustlist or blocklist for incoming calls.
summary: Gets the list of phone numbers set as the incoming call trustlist or blocklist. Use it to review which numbers are allowed to call or blocked from calling.

name: hangupCalling
description: Ends the current call. Only carrier calls are supported, excluding MeeTime calls. For example, an enterprise device
summary: Ends the current carrier call on the device. Use it to forcibly hang up a phone call that an employee is on.

name: activeSim
description: Activates the SIM card in the specified slot. In scenarios where a SIM card is inserted but not yet activated, this
summary: Activates the SIM card in a chosen slot so it can be used for communication. Use it to activate a newly inserted SIM card without the user doing it manually.

name: deactiveSim
description: Deactivates the SIM card in the specified slot. After deactivation, the SIM card in that slot cannot be used for
summary: Turns off the SIM card in a chosen slot so it cannot make or receive calls, send or receive texts, or use the internet. Use it to pause a phone line during employee leave or device maintenance.

name: setDefaultData
description: Sets the SIM card in the specified slot as the default data SIM card. The device will use the data connection from
summary: Sets the SIM card in a chosen slot as the default data SIM. Use it to pick which SIM provides internet access on a dual-SIM device.

name: getDefaultData
description: Obtains the slot ID of the SIM card currently used as the default data SIM card on the device. For example, an
summary: Tells you which SIM card slot is currently set as the default for mobile data. Use it to check which data card is in use when managing data usage or switching data cards.

name: setUsbPolicy
description: Sets the USB read/write policy. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets whether USB storage can be read and written or only read. Use it to restrict copying files to or from USB drives.

name: disableUsb
description: Enables or disables USB.
summary: Turns USB on or off on the device. Use it to block or allow USB connections on a managed device.

name: isUsbDisabled
description: Queries whether the USB is disabled.
summary: Checks whether USB is currently disabled. Use it to see if USB access is blocked on the device.

name: addAllowedUsbDevices
description: Adds allowed USB devices.
summary: Adds USB devices that are allowed to be used. Use it to let only approved USB devices, such as a keyboard or storage drive, work on a device.

name: removeAllowedUsbDevices
description: Removes allowed USB devices.
summary: Removes USB devices from the allowed list so they are no longer trusted. Use it to revoke access for specific USB devices in enterprise security management.

name: getAllowedUsbDevices
description: Obtains allowed USB devices.
summary: Lists the USB devices that are currently allowed. Use it to check which USB devices are permitted before changing the policy.

name: setUsbStorageDeviceAccessPolicy
description: Sets the USB storage device (baseClass = 0x08) access policy.
summary: Sets the access policy for USB storage devices. Use it to allow or block USB storage devices on a managed device.

name: getUsbStorageDeviceAccessPolicy
description: Obtains the access policy of the USB storage device.
summary: Gets the access policy for USB storage devices. Use it to check whether USB storage devices are allowed or blocked on a managed device.

name: addDisallowedUsbDevices
description: Adds disallowed USB device types.
summary: Blocks chosen types of USB devices. Use it to stop USB storage drives or other device types from being used and prevent data leaks.

name: removeDisallowedUsbDevices
description: Removes the disallowed USB device types.
summary: Removes USB device types from the disallowed list. Use it to lift restrictions on blocked USB device types in enterprise security management.

name: getDisallowedUsbDevices
description: Obtains the disallowed USB device types.
summary: Gets the list of USB device types that are currently blocked. Use it to review or display which USB devices are restricted on a managed device.

name: addDisallowedPermissiveUsbDevices
description: Adds disallowed USB device types. Unlike the [addDisallowedUsbDevices]{@link addDisallowedUsbDevices}
summary: Blocks chosen types of USB devices, taking effect right away on plugged-in devices. Use it to stop a USB headset or other device from working immediately.

name: removeDisallowedPermissiveUsbDevices
description: Removes the USB device types that have been disallowed via
summary: Removes USB device types from the disallowed list so they can be used normally again. Use it to lift restrictions on previously blocked USB device types.

name: getDisallowedPermissiveUsbDevices
description: Obtains the USB device types that have been disallowed via
summary: Lists the USB device types that have been blocked. Use it to check which USB devices are currently not allowed.

name: isWifiActive
description: Queries the Wi-Fi status of the current device. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Checks whether Wi-Fi is turned on. Use it to see if the device's Wi-Fi is enabled.

name: isWifiActiveSync
description: Queries the Wi-Fi status of the current device.
summary: Tells whether Wi-Fi is currently switched on for the device. Use it to check if Wi-Fi is on before changing network settings.

name: setWifiProfile
description: Configures Wi-Fi for the current device to connect to a specified network. This API uses a promise to return the
summary: Sets up Wi-Fi so the device connects to a chosen network. Use it to join the device to a specific Wi-Fi network.

name: setWifiProfileSync
description: Configures Wi-Fi for the current device to connect to a specified network.
summary: Configures the device to connect to a specified Wi-Fi network using its SSID, key, and security type. Use it to set up which Wi-Fi network the device joins.

name: setWifiDisabled
description: Sets the Wi-Fi disabling policy.
summary: Turns Wi-Fi off or on for the device. Use it to disable Wi-Fi to enforce a no-wireless policy.

name: isWifiDisabled
description: Queries whether Wi-Fi is disabled on the current device.
summary: Checks whether Wi-Fi is turned off on the device. Use it to see if Wi-Fi is disabled before changing network settings.

name: addDisallowedWifiList
description: Adds disallowed Wi-Fi networks. The current device cannot connect to the disallowed Wi-Fi networks. This API is
summary: Adds Wi-Fi networks the device is forbidden to connect to. Use it to stop devices joining unsafe public Wi-Fi like cafe or airport hotspots.

name: removeDisallowedWifiList
description: Removes disallowed Wi-Fi networks. If some Wi-Fi networks are removed from the disallowed list, the current device
summary: Removes Wi-Fi networks from the disallowed list so the device can connect to them again. Use it to lift restrictions on a specific Wi-Fi network or allow employees onto newly approved office networks.

name: getDisallowedWifiList
description: Obtains disallowed Wi-Fi networks.
summary: Lists the Wi-Fi networks the device is forbidden to connect to. Use it to check which blocked Wi-Fi networks are currently in force.

name: addAllowedWifiList
description: Adds allowed Wi-Fi networks. The current device can only connect to the allowed Wi-Fi networks. This API is
summary: Adds Wi-Fi networks that the device is allowed to connect to, blocking all others. Use it to keep work devices on approved office Wi-Fi only.

name: removeAllowedWifiList
description: Removes Wi-Fi networks from the allowed list. If some Wi-Fi networks are removed from the allowed list, the current
summary: Removes Wi-Fi networks from the allowed list, so the device may connect to others again. Use it to lift old Wi-Fi restrictions after an office network change.

name: getAllowedWifiList
description: Obtains Wi-Fi networks from the allowed list.
summary: Lists the Wi-Fi networks the device is allowed to connect to. Use it to check which approved Wi-Fi networks are currently permitted.

name: turnOnWifi
description: Enables Wi-Fi. This API is applicable to enterprise device remote management scenarios, such as administrators
summary: Turns Wi-Fi on, optionally forcing it on so it cannot be switched off manually. Use it to remotely enable Wi-Fi on employee devices or when enforcing a policy.

name: turnOffWifi
description: Disables Wi-Fi.
summary: Turns Wi-Fi off on the device. Use it to disable Wi-Fi, for example to enforce an enterprise policy that keeps devices off wireless networks.

name: on
description: Subscribes to an event in persistent manner and executes a callback after the event is received.
summary: Keeps listening for an event and runs your callback each time it arrives. Use it to react whenever something happens, such as updating the screen when new data arrives.

name: onEventData
description: Subscribes to an event in persistent manner and executes a callback after the event is received.
summary: Keeps listening for a named event and runs your callback each time it arrives. Use it to react to repeated events, such as a message arriving or a sensor updating.

name: onGenericEventData
description: Subscribes to an event in persistent manner and executes a callback after the event is received.
summary: Keeps listening for a named event and runs your callback with its data each time it arrives. Use it to react to repeated events that carry information, such as a message arriving.

name: once
description: Subscribes to an event in one-shot manner and unsubscribes from it after the event callback is executed.
summary: Listens for a named event just once, then stops listening after your callback runs. Use it when you only need to react to the next occurrence, such as the first time something finishes.

name: onceEventData
description: Subscribes to an event in one-shot manner and unsubscribes from it after the event callback is executed.
summary: Listens for a named event just once and stops listening after your callback runs. Use it when you only need to react to the next occurrence of an event.

name: onceGenericEventData
description: Subscribes to an event in one-shot manner and unsubscribes from it after the event callback is executed.
summary: Listens for a named event just once and stops listening after your callback runs with its data. Use it when you only need to react once to an event that carries information.

name: off
description: Unsubscribes from all events with the specified event ID.
summary: Stops listening for a specific event. Use it to cancel a subscription when you no longer need to react to that event.

name: offEventData
description: Unsubscribes from an event with the specified event ID and processed by the specified callback.
summary: Stops listening for a specific event for one particular callback. Use it to remove just one listener while others keep receiving the event.

name: offGenericEventData
description: Unsubscribes from an event with the specified event ID and processed by the specified callback.
summary: Stops listening for a specific event for one particular callback. Use it to remove just one listener while others keep receiving the event.

name: emit
description: Emits a specified event.

name: getListenerCount
description: Obtains the number of subscriptions to a specified event.
summary: Tells you how many listeners are currently subscribed to a given event. Use it to check whether anything is listening before you send an event.

name: on
description: Subscribes to an event specified by the Emitter instance in persistent manner and executes a callback after the
summary: Keeps listening for a named event and runs your callback each time that event is received. Use it to react whenever something happens, such as updating the screen when new data arrives.

name: once
description: Subscribes to an event specified by the Emitter instance in one-shot manner and unsubscribes from it after the
summary: Listens for a named event only once, then stops listening after your callback runs. Use it for a one-time reaction, such as showing a message the first time something happens.

name: onEventData
description: Subscribes to an event in persistent manner and executes a callback after the event is received.
summary: Keeps listening for a named event and runs your callback each time that event is received. Use it to react whenever something happens, such as updating the screen when new data arrives.

name: onGenericEventData
description: Subscribes to an event in persistent manner and executes a callback after the event is received.
summary: Keeps listening for a named event and runs your callback each time that event is received. Use it to react whenever something happens, such as updating the screen when new data arrives.

name: onceEventData
description: Subscribes to an event in one-shot manner and unsubscribes from it after the event callback is executed.

name: onceGenericEventData

name: off

name: offEventData

name: offGenericEventData

name: emit

name: getListenerCount
description: Obtains the number of subscriptions to a specified event of the Emitter instance.
summary: Obtains the number of subscriptions to a specified event. Use it to check how many listeners are subscribed to an event.

name: alloc
params: size: number, fill?: string | FastBuffer | number, encoding?: BufferEncoding
description: Allocates a new FastBuffer for a fixed size bytes. If fill is undefined, the FastBuffer will be zero-filled.
summary: Creates a new binary buffer of a given size, filled with zeros unless a fill value is given. Use it to set aside a block of bytes to hold binary data.

name: allocUninitializedFromPool
description: Allocates a new FastBuffer for a fixed size bytes. The FastBuffer will not be initially filled.
summary: Creates a new binary buffer of a given size from a shared pool, without filling it with initial data. Use it to set aside a block of bytes when you will write the contents yourself.

name: allocUninitialized
description: Allocates a new un-pooled FastBuffer for a fixed size bytes. The FastBuffer will not be initially filled.
summary: Creates a new binary buffer of a given size that is not filled with any initial data. Use it to set aside a block of bytes when you will write the contents yourself.

name: byteLength
params: value: string | FastBuffer | TypedArray | DataView | ArrayBuffer | SharedArrayBuffer, encoding?: BufferEncoding
description: Returns the byte length of a string when encoded using `encoding`.
summary: Tells you how many bytes a string or binary data takes up when encoded. Use it to find the real byte size of text before storing or sending it.

name: concat
description: Returns a new `FastBuffer` which is the result of concatenating all the `FastBuffer`instances in the `list` together.
summary: Joins several binary buffers together into one new buffer. Use it to combine pieces of binary data into a single block.

name: from
description: Allocates a new FastBuffer using an array of bytes in the range 0 – 255. Array entries outside that range will be truncated to fit into it.
summary: Creates a new FastBuffer from an array of bytes or other binary data. Use it to hold raw binary data for reading or processing.

name: isBuffer
description: Returns true if obj is a FastBuffer, false otherwise
summary: Checks whether an object is a FastBuffer and returns true or false. Use it to tell binary data apart from other objects.

name: isEncoding
description: Returns true if encoding is the name of a supported character encoding, or false otherwise.
summary: Checks whether a character encoding name is supported and returns true or false. Use it to validate an encoding before converting text to bytes.

name: compare
params: buf1: FastBuffer | Uint8Array, buf2: FastBuffer | Uint8Array
description: Compares buf1 to buf2
summary: Compares two binary buffers and reports which one comes first when sorted. Use it to sort or check whether two blocks of binary data are equal.

name: transcode
params: source: FastBuffer | Uint8Array, fromEnc: string, toEnc: string
description: Re-encodes the given FastBuffer or Uint8Array instance from one character encoding to another.
summary: Re-encodes binary data from one character encoding to another. Use it to convert text bytes between encodings.

name: fill
params: value: string | FastBuffer | Uint8Array | number, offset?: number, end?: number, encoding?: BufferEncoding
description: Fills buf with the specified value. If the offset and end are not given, the entire buf will be filled.
summary: Fills a buffer with a chosen value, or only part of it. Use it to set or reset bytes in binary data.

name: compare
params: target: FastBuffer | Uint8Array, targetStart?: number, targetEnd?: number, sourceStart?: number, sourceEnd?: number
description: Compares buf with target and returns a number indicating whether buf comes before, after,
summary: Compares two buffers byte by byte and tells whether one comes before, after, or matches the other. Use it to sort or check binary data, such as file contents.

name: copy
params: target: FastBuffer | Uint8Array, targetStart?: number, sourceStart?: number, sourceEnd?: number
description: Copies data from a region of buf to a region in target, even if the target memory region overlaps with buf.
summary: Copies bytes from one buffer into another, even when the memory regions overlap. Use it to move binary data between buffers.

name: equals
description: Returns true if both buf and otherBuffer have exactly the same bytes, false otherwise
summary: Checks whether two buffers contain exactly the same bytes. Use it to compare binary data for equality.

name: includes
params: value: string | number | FastBuffer | Uint8Array, byteOffset?: number, encoding?: BufferEncoding
description: Returns true if value was found in buf, false otherwise
summary: Checks whether a value appears anywhere in the buffer. Use it to test if binary data contains something.

name: indexOf
params: value: string | number | FastBuffer | Uint8Array, byteOffset?: number, encoding?: BufferEncoding
description: The index of the first occurrence of value in buf
summary: Finds the position of the first occurrence of a value in the buffer, or -1 if absent. Use it to locate bytes in binary data.

name: keys
description: Creates and returns an iterator of buf keys (indices).
summary: Gives you an iterator over the index positions in a buffer of binary data. Use it to walk through every byte position when processing raw data.

name: values
description: Creates and returns an iterator for buf values (bytes).
summary: Returns an iterator over the bytes in a buffer, letting you step through each byte one at a time. Use it to read through binary data byte by byte.

name: entries
description: Creates and returns an iterator of [index, byte] pairs from the contents of buf.
summary: Gives an iterator of index and byte pairs for the buffer's contents. Use it to walk through every byte in order.

name: lastIndexOf
params: value: string | number | FastBuffer | Uint8Array, byteOffset?: number, encoding?: BufferEncoding
description: The index of the last occurrence of value in buf
summary: Finds the position of the last time a value appears in a buffer of binary data, or -1 if it is not there. Use it to locate the final occurrence of a byte or pattern in raw data.

name: readInt32LE

summary: Checks whether a file is a socket. Use it to tell whether a file is a network socket rather than a regular file.

name: isSymbolicLink
description: Checks whether this file is a symbolic link.
summary: Checks whether a file is a symbolic link. Use it to tell whether a file is a shortcut pointing to another file.

name: close
description: Closes the file stream. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Closes a file stream. Use it to finish working with a file and release it when you are done reading or writing.

name: closeSync
description: Closes the file stream. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Closes a file stream right away. Use it to finish working with a file and release it when you are done reading or writing.

name: flush
description: Flushes the file stream. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Flushes a file stream, writing out any buffered data. Use it to make sure saved data is actually written to the file.

name: flushSync
description: Flushes the file stream. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Flushes a file stream right away, writing out any buffered data. Use it to make sure saved data is actually written to the file.

name: write
description: Writes data to a stream file. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Writes text or buffer data to a stream file. Use it to save content to a file, such as storing a note or saving a downloaded image.

name: writeSync
description: Writes data to a stream file. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Writes text or buffer data to a stream file and returns right away. Use it to save content to a file when you need it done immediately, such as storing a note.

name: read
description: Reads data from a stream file. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Reads data from a stream file into a buffer. Use it to load the contents of a file, such as reading a saved document or image.

name: readSync
description: Reads data from a stream file. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Reads data from a stream file and returns it right away. Use it to load file contents when you need the data immediately, such as opening a saved document.

name: start
description: Starts listening.
summary: Starts watching a file or directory for changes. Use it to be notified when files or folders are modified.

name: stop
description: Stops listening and removes the **Watcher** object.
summary: Stops watching for file or directory changes and removes the watcher. Use it when you no longer need change notifications.

name: next
description: Obtains the **ReaderIterator** result.
summary: Gets the next result from a reader iterator, letting you step through lines one at a time. Use it to read a file line by line.

name: filter
description: Filtering function, which determines whether the specified file name should be included in the file list.
summary: Decides whether a file name should appear in a file list. Use it to pick which files show up when listing files.

name: onStatus
description: Called to return the specified status. Its parameters are passed in by
summary: Reports the status of a distributed file system connection for a device. Use it to find out whether a connection to another device's shared files has failed.

name: hash
description: Calculates a hash value for a file. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Calculates a hash value for a file using md5, sha1, or sha256. Use it to check a file's fingerprint or verify that a file has not been altered.

name: digest
description: Generates a message digest.
summary: Produces the message digest of the data added so far, returned as a hexadecimal string. Use it to get a file's checksum or fingerprint after feeding in its contents.

name: update
description: Updates the data for generating a message digest. This API can be called multiple times.
summary: Adds a chunk of data to the message digest being calculated, and can be called repeatedly. Use it to feed file contents piece by piece before getting the final hash.

name: createHash
description: Creates a **HashStream** instance, which can be used to generate a message digest (a hash value) using the given
summary: Creates a hash calculator that can produce a message digest using md5, sha1, or sha256. Use it to check a file's fingerprint or verify that data has not changed.

name: deactivateUserKey
description: When the screen is locked, the specified user key is uninstalled synchronously.
summary: Uninstalls the specified user key when the screen is locked. Use it in lock screen apps to remove a user's key on lock.

name: getPhotoAccessHelper
description: Obtains a PhotoAccessHelper instance for accessing and modifying media files in the album.
summary: Gets a helper for the given user to browse and change media files in albums. Use it to work with someone's photos, videos, and albums.

name: onProgress
description: Called when the progress of the requested video is returned.
summary: Reports how far along a video's processing has got, as a percentage from 0 to 100. Use it to show a progress bar while a video is being prepared.

name: onDataPrepared
description: Called when the requested media asset is ready. If an error occurs, **data** returned by the callback is
summary: Called when a requested media asset is ready, providing the image or video data. Use it to receive a photo or video after requesting it.

name: onDataPrepared
params: data: T, imageSource: image.ImageSource, map: Map<string, string>
description: Called when the requested image is ready. If an error occurs, **data** returned by the callback is **undefined**.
summary: Runs when a requested image is ready, giving the image data and its quality. Use it to handle each image as it finishes loading in a custom image flow.

name: requestImage
params: context: Context, asset: PhotoAsset, requestOptions: RequestOptions, dataHandler: MediaAssetDataHandler<image.ImageSource>
description: Requests an image. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Requests an image and returns it through a handler when ready. Use it to load and display a picture from the media library.

name: quickRequestImage
params: context: Context, asset: PhotoAsset, requestOptions: RequestOptions, dataHandler: QuickImageDataHandler<image.Picture>
description: Requests an image quickly. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Quickly requests an image and returns it through a handler when ready. Use it to show a picture fast, such as a thumbnail or preview.

name: requestImageData
params: context: Context, asset: PhotoAsset, requestOptions: RequestOptions, dataHandler: MediaAssetDataHandler<ArrayBuffer>
description: Requests image data. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Requests the raw data of an image and returns it through a handler when ready. Use it to get a picture's bytes for processing or saving.

name: requestMovingPhoto
params: context: Context, asset: PhotoAsset, requestOptions: RequestOptions, dataHandler: MediaAssetDataHandler<MovingPhoto>
description: Requests a moving photo object, which can be used to request the asset data of the moving photo. This API uses a
summary: Requests a moving photo object that can provide its asset data. Use it to get and work with a moving photo from the media library.

name: cancelRequest
description: Cancels a request for the asset, the callback of which has not been triggered yet. This API uses a promise to
summary: Cancels a media asset request whose callback has not yet been triggered. Use it to stop waiting for a photo or video you no longer need.

name: requestVideoFile
params: context: Context, asset: PhotoAsset, requestOptions: RequestOptions, fileUri: string, dataHandler: MediaAssetDataHandler<boolean>
description: Requests a video and saves it to the specified sandbox directory. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Requests a video and saves it to a chosen sandbox folder, reporting success through a handler. Use it to download a video into your app's files.

name: loadMovingPhoto
params: context: Context, imageFileUri: string, videoFileUri: string
description: Loads a moving photo in the application sandbox. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Loads a moving photo from the app's sandbox using separate image and video file URIs. Use it to open and work with a moving photo stored in your app's files.

name: cancel
description: cancel batch operation.
summary: Stops a batch operation that is already running. Use it to interrupt a long batch job such as a bulk file operation.

name: commitModify
description: Commits the modification on the file metadata to the database. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Saves changes made to a file's metadata into the database. Use it to keep edits to a photo or video's details.

name: open
description: Opens this file asset. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Opens a photo or video file and gives a file descriptor for reading, writing, or both. Use it to read or save the contents of a picture or video.

name: getReadOnlyFd
description: Opens this file in read-only mode. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Opens the file in read-only mode and returns its file descriptor. Use it to read a photo or video's contents.

name: close
description: Closes the current file. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Closes an open file by its file descriptor. Use it to release a photo or video file after you finish reading or writing it.

name: getThumbnail
description: Obtains the file thumbnail of the given size. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets a small preview image of a photo or video at a chosen size. Use it to show picture thumbnails in a gallery or file list.

name: getThumbnailData
description: Obtains the ArrayBuffer of a file thumbnail by specifying its type. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the raw image data of a photo or video thumbnail by thumbnail type. Use it to show a small preview picture in a gallery or file list.

name: setFavorite
description: Favorites or unfavorites this file asset. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Marks a photo or video as a favorite, or removes it from favorites. Use it to favorite a picture or video, or to unfavorite it.

name: setHidden
description: Sets this file asset to the hidden state. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Hides a photo or video in the private album, or unhides it. Use it to move a picture or video into the private album, or to take it out again.

name: setUserComment
description: Sets user comment information of an image or video. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets a text comment on a photo or video. Use it to add a note or caption to a picture or video.

name: getExif
description: Obtains the Exif data from a JPG image and returns a JSON string. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the Exif details of a JPG image as a JSON string. Use it to read camera settings and other photo information like date, location, or exposure.

name: getAnalysisData
description: Obtains analysis data. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets smart analysis results for a photo or video as a JSON string. Use it to read what the system found in a picture, such as its content or scene.

name: setPending
description: Sets the pending state for this image or video asset. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Puts a photo or video into a pending state, or clears that state. Use it to mark a picture or video as still being worked on, then clear the mark when done.

name: isEdited
description: Checks whether this image or video asset is edited. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Tells whether a photo or video has been edited. Use it to show an edited marker or decide whether to offer the original version.

name: requestEditData
description: Obtains the edit data of this image or video asset. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the edit data saved for a photo or video, or an empty string if it was never edited. Use it to restore or reapply previous edits to a picture or video.

name: getEditData
description: Obtains the edited data of this asset. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the edit data of a photo or video, or an empty string if it was never edited. Use it to check or reuse the edits made to a picture.

name: clone
description: Clones a media asset. The file name can be set, but the file type cannot be changed. This API uses a promise to
summary: Creates a copy of a media asset with a new file name, keeping the same file type. Use it to duplicate a photo or video under a different name.

name: convertImageFormat
description: Duplicates an image within the same album (either user-created or application-specific) and converts it to the
summary: Duplicates an image in the same album and converts it to a specified format. Use it to create a copy of a photo in a different image format.

name: createTemporaryCompatibleDuplicate
description: Creates a JPEG-compatible copy for a third-party application that does not support HEIF/HEIC image encoding. This
summary: Makes a JPEG copy of a photo so apps that cannot open HEIF or HEIC images can use it. Use it to share or view a photo in an app that only supports JPEG.

name: requestSource
description: Opens the source file and returns the FD. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Opens the original source file of a photo or video and gives a file descriptor. Use it to read the full-resolution original picture or video.

name: commitEditedAsset
description: Commits the edited image or video asset. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Commits an edited image or video asset to the media library. Use it to save changes made to a photo or video.

name: revertToOriginal
description: Reverts to the state of the file before being edited. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Restores a photo or video to how it looked before it was edited. Use it to undo edits and get the original picture or clip back.

name: requestPhoto
description: Obtains the quick thumbnail and quality thumbnail of this asset. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return
summary: Fetches a quick small thumbnail and then a larger quality thumbnail of a photo or video. Use it to show a fast preview that sharpens as the picture loads.

name: cancelPhotoRequest
description: Cancels a task for obtaining media thumbnails.
summary: Cancels a task for obtaining media thumbnails. Use it to stop a thumbnail request that is no longer needed.

name: getKeyFrameThumbnail
description: Obtains the thumbnail of the specified type for the key frame. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets a thumbnail image for a chosen key frame of a video. Use it to show a preview picture of a video at a certain moment.

name: getReadOnlyFdWithCached
description: Open the file and cache it in the gallery sandbox when streaming video from the cloud.
summary: Opens a photo or video file for reading and caches it while streaming from the cloud. Use it to read a cloud photo or video file without downloading it fully first.

name: getCount
description: Obtains the total number of files in the result set.
summary: Counts how many files are in a set of found photos and videos. Use it to see how many pictures or clips your search turned up.

name: isAfterLast
description: Checks whether the cursor is in the last row of the result set.
summary: Checks whether the cursor has reached the last row of a set of results. Use it to know when you have gone through all photos or videos.

name: getFirstObject
description: Obtains the first file asset in the result set. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gives you the first photo or video in a set of found files. Use it to grab the top picture or clip from a search.

name: getNextObject
description: Obtains the next file asset in the result set. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the next file in a set of results. Use it to step through photos or videos one by one.

name: getLastObject
description: Obtains the last file asset in the result set. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the last file in a set of results. Use it to jump to the final photo or video in a list.

name: getObjectByPosition
description: Obtains a file asset with the specified index in the result set. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the file at a given position in a set of results, counting from zero. Use it to open a specific photo or video by its place in a list.

name: getRangeObjects
description: Obtains the file asset array of a specified length (second parameter) from the specified index (first parameter)
summary: Gets a chosen number of file assets starting from a given position in a result set. Use it to page through search or album results a few files at a time.

name: getAllObjects
description: Obtains all the file assets in the result set. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gives you every photo and video in a set of found files. Use it to grab all the pictures and clips from a search at once.

name: close
description: Closes this FetchResult instance to invalidate it. After this instance is released, the APIs in this instance
summary: Releases a set of found files so it can no longer be used. Use it to free up a search result once you are done looking through your photos and videos.

name: contains
description: Checks whether the specified file asset is contained in the result set. This API uses a promise to return the
summary: Tells you whether a particular photo or video is part of a set of found files. Use it to check if a certain picture or clip turned up in your search.

name: getObjectsByIndexSet
description: Obtains the file asset array corresponding to the specified index set in the result set. This API uses a promise
summary: Gets several files at once from a set of results by their positions. Use it to load a chosen group of photos or videos together.

name: getIndex
description: Obtains the index of a specified file asset in the result set. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Finds the position of a given file in a set of results, returning -1 if it is not there. Use it to tell where a photo or video sits in a list.

name: getAssets
description: Obtains image and video assets. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the photos and videos in an album, so you can show or use them in your app.

name: getSharedPhotoAssets
description: Fetch shared photo assets in an album.
summary: Fetches the shared photos and videos in an album. Use it to show the photos and videos that have been shared with you.

name: commitModify
description: Commits the modification on the album attributes to the database. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Saves changes made to an album's attributes to the database, so the album's details are updated.

name: addAssets
description: Adds image and video assets to a user album. Before the operation, ensure that the image and video assets to add
summary: Adds photos and videos to a user album, so you can organize them into collections.

name: removeAssets
description: Removes image and video assets from a user album. The album and file resources must exist. This API uses a
summary: Takes pictures and videos out of one of your albums. Use it to tidy an album by deleting chosen photos or clips from it.

name: recoverAssets
description: Recovers image or video assets from the trash. Before the operation, ensure that the image or video assets exist
summary: Restores photos or videos from the trash back into the album. Use it to bring back pictures or clips you deleted by mistake.

name: deleteAssets
description: Deletes image or video assets from the trash. Before the operation, ensure that the image or video assets exist
summary: Permanently removes photos or videos that are already in the trash. Use it to clear out unwanted pictures or clips for good.

name: setCoverUri
description: Sets the cover of the user album. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets the cover image of a user album using a file URI. Use it to choose which photo appears as the album cover.

name: getFaceId
description: Obtains the face identifier on the cover of a portrait album or group photo album.
summary: Gets the face identifier shown on the cover of a portrait or group photo album. Use it to find which person's face represents an album.

name: getSelectedAssets
description: Obtains portrait album assets that meet filter criteria.
summary: Gets the portrait album photos or videos that match your filter, up to a set limit. Use it to pick out selected pictures from a portrait album.

name: getFusionAssetsInfo
description: Obtains fusion assets information.
summary: Gets information about the combined assets in an album. Use it to see details of merged photos or videos in an album.

name: getAttribute
description: Gets album attribute info.
summary: Reads details about an album, such as its name or other stored properties. Use it to look up information about a photo album.

name: getAssets
description: Obtains image and video assets. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the photos and videos in the library. Use it to show someone their pictures and videos or pick one to view.

name: getBurstAssets
description: Obtains burst assets. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the burst photos that belong to one burst group. Use it to show all shots taken in a single burst so the user can pick the best one.

name: createAsset
description: Creates an image or video asset with the specified file name. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Creates a new image or video file in the photo library with a chosen name. Use it to save a picture or video you have made into the gallery.

name: createPhotoAsset
params: photoType: PhotoType, extension: string, title?: string
description: Creates an image or video resource with the specified file type, extension, and title. This API uses a promise to
summary: Creates a new image or video file of a given type and extension. Use it to save a picture or video into the gallery.

name: createAlbum
description: Creates an album. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Creates a new photo album with the given name. Use it to make a new album to organize pictures and videos.

name: deleteAlbums
description: Deletes user albums. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Deletes user albums. Use it to remove photo albums you no longer want.

name: getAlbums
params: type: AlbumType, subtype: AlbumSubtype, options?: FetchOptions
description: Obtains albums based on the specified options and album type. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets albums of a chosen type and subtype from the photo library. Use it to list someone's photo albums so they can browse or open them.

name: getHiddenAlbums
description: Obtains hidden albums based on the specified display mode and retrieval options. This API uses a promise to
summary: Gets the hidden photo albums for a chosen display mode. Use it to find albums you have hidden from the main gallery.

name: getPhotoAlbums
description: Obtains system, user, and source albums based on the specified options. This API uses a promise to return the
summary: Gets the system, user, and source photo albums. Use it to list the albums in the gallery.

name: deleteAssets
description: Deletes media assets. The deleted assets are moved to the trash. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Deletes media files, moving them to the trash. Use it to remove photos or videos from the gallery.

name: registerChange
params: uri: string, forChildUris: boolean, callback: Callback<ChangeData>
description: Registers listening for the specified URI. This API uses a callback to return the result.
summary: Watches a photo, album, or all photos for changes and reports them back. Use it to keep a gallery view up to date when pictures are added, edited, or removed.

name: getDataAnalysisProgress
description: Obtains the asset analysis progress. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Reports how far along the analysis of your photos and videos is, as a JSON string. Use it to check the progress of scanning your gallery.

name: unRegisterChange
description: Unregisters listening for the specified URI. Multiple callbacks can be registered for a URI for listening. You
summary: Stops listening for changes to a photo, album, or default change URI. Use it to stop being notified when photos or albums change.

name: createDeleteRequest
description: Creates a dialog box for deleting media files. This API uses a promise to return the result. The deleted media
summary: Shows a dialog to delete chosen photos or videos, moving them to the trash. Use it to let someone remove pictures or videos from their gallery.

name: showAssetsCreationDialog
description: Displays a dialog box for the user to confirm whether to save the images or videos. If the user agrees to save
summary: Shows a dialog asking the user to confirm saving images or videos, then returns URIs to write them. Use it to save a photo or video to the gallery with the user's consent.

name: showAssetsCreationDialogEx
description: Displays a dialog box for the user to confirm whether to save the images or videos. This API uses a promise to
summary: Shows a dialog asking the user to confirm saving images or videos to the media library. Use it to save pictures or videos after the user agrees.

name: showSingleAssetCreationDialogEx
params: srcFileUri: string, creationSetting: CreationSetting, isImageFullyDisplayed: boolean
description: Displays a dialog box for the user to confirm whether to save an image or video. This API uses a promise to
summary: Shows a dialog asking the user to confirm saving one image or video to the media library. Use it when you want the user to approve saving a photo or video.

name: createAssetsForApp
params: bundleName: string, appName: string, tokenId: long, photoCreationConfigs: Array<PhotoCreationConfig>
description: Creates media assets for an application with the specified token ID. The returned URIs have been granted with the
summary: Creates photo or video items for another app and gives it write access to them. Use it to let an app save pictures or videos into the gallery without extra permission.

name: createAssetWithShortTermPermission
description: Creates an asset with a temporary permission of the given period. When this API is called by an application for
summary: Asks the user to allow saving a photo or video, then gives a temporary address to write the file to. Use it to save a picture or video to the gallery with the user's consent.

name: createAssetWithShortTermPermissionEx
description: Displays the dialog box for the first time for the user to confirm whether to save the asset. This API uses a
summary: Shows a dialog asking the user to confirm saving a photo or video, then returns a file address to write it to. Use it to save a picture or video to the gallery with the user's approval.

name: createAssetsForAppWithMode
params: bundleName: string, appName: string, appId: string, tokenId: long, authorizationMode: AuthorizationMode, photoCreationConfigs: Array<PhotoCreationConfig>
description: Creates assets with a temporary permission. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Creates media files in the photo library with temporary permission, returning their URIs. Use it to let an app save photos or videos without asking the user each time.

name: requestPhotoUrisReadPermission
description: <!--RP1--><!--RP1End-->Grants the read permission for unauthorized URIs, returning a list of URIs that have been created and granted the permission.
summary: Grants read access to image and video URIs that are not yet authorized. Use it to open or view photos and videos the app could not otherwise read.

name: requestPhotoUrisReadPermissionEx
description: Grants the read permission for unauthorized URIs. This API uses a promise to return the authorization result.
summary: Grants read access to image and video URIs and reports which ones succeeded and which were invalid. Use it to open photos and videos and know which files could not be accessed.

name: getPhotoIndex
params: photoUri: string, albumUri: string, options: FetchOptions
description: Obtains the index of an image or video in an album. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Finds the position of a photo or video within an album. Use it to tell where a picture sits in an album's order.

name: release
description: Releases the **PhotoAccessHelper** instance. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Frees the photo and album helper once you are done with it. Use it to clean up after browsing or managing photos and albums.

name: saveFormInfo
description: Saves the Gallery widget information bound to a single image to the database. This API uses a promise to return
summary: Saves the Gallery widget information bound to a single image to the database. Used to bind an image to a Gallery widget.

name: saveGalleryFormInfo
description: Saves the Gallery widget information bound to a group of images to the database. This API uses a promise to
summary: Saves the Gallery widget information bound to a group of images to the database. Used to bind images or albums to a Gallery widget.

name: removeFormInfo
description: Removes the Gallery widget information bound to a single image from the database. This API uses a promise to
summary: Removes the Gallery widget information bound to a single image from the database. Used to unbind an image from a Gallery widget.

name: removeGalleryFormInfo
description: Removes the Gallery widget information bound to a group of images from the database. This API uses a promise to
summary: Removes the Gallery widget information bound to a group of images from the database. Used to unbind images or albums from a Gallery widget.

name: updateGalleryFormInfo
description: Updates the information about a Gallery widget and saves the information to the database. This API uses a promise
summary: Updates the information about a Gallery widget and saves it to the database. Use it to change which images or albums a Gallery widget shows.

name: applyChanges
description: Applies media changes. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Applies requested changes to photos or albums. Use it to save edits or updates made to a photo or album.

name: getIndexConstructProgress
description: Obtains the index construction progress. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Reports how far the photo and video indexing has gotten, as counts of analyzed and total items. Use it to check progress while the gallery builds its search index.

name: grantPhotoUrisPermission
