name: grantPhotoUriPermission
params: tokenId: long, uri: string, photoPermissionType: PhotoPermissionType, hideSensitiveType: HideSensitiveType
description: Grants an application the permission to access a URI. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gives another app permission to open one photo or video. Use it to let an app access a single picture you choose.

name: cancelPhotoUriPermission
params: tokenId: long, uri: string, photoPermissionType: PhotoPermissionType
description: Cancels the permission for accessing a URI from an application. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Cancels an app's permission to access a photo or video by its URI. Use it to take away another app's access to a specific media file.

name: startThumbnailCreationTask
description: Generates a thumbnail based on the specified rule.
summary: Generates thumbnails for photos matching a rule and tells you whether any are still missing. Used to make photo previews appear quickly in a gallery.

name: stopThumbnailCreationTask
description: Stops generating a thumbnail.
summary: Stops generating a thumbnail for a given task ID. Use it to cancel a thumbnail creation job that is no longer needed.

name: getSharedPhotoAssets
description: Obtains the shared photo assets.
summary: Gets the photo assets that have been shared with you. Use it to view or work with photos others have shared.

name: getSupportedPhotoFormats
description: Obtains the list of image or video file name extensions supported by the media library.
summary: Gets the image or video file name extensions the media library supports. Use it to check which photo or video file types can be saved or opened.

name: startAssetAnalysis
description: Starts asset analysis.
summary: Starts analyzing photos and videos, either all of them or only the ones you list. Used to build a searchable index of your photos so you can find them by what is in them.

name: startAssetAnalysisAsync
description: Starts asynchronous asset analysis. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the result.
summary: Starts analyzing photos and videos in the background and reports the result when done. Used to build a searchable index of your photos so you can find them by what is in them.

name: stopAssetAnalysis
description: Stops asset analysis.
summary: Stops an ongoing analysis of photos and videos. Used to cancel building a searchable index of your photos.

name: onMediaLibraryAvailability
description: Subscribes to changes of medialibrary availability.
summary: Watches whether the photo library is available and reports when that changes. Use it to know when the photo library can be used again, for example after it becomes unavailable.

name: offMediaLibraryAvailability
description: Unsubscribes to changes of medialibrary availability.
summary: Stops listening for changes in whether the photo library is available. Use it to stop being notified when the photo library becomes available or unavailable.

name: getAlbumsByIds
description: Obtains album information by album IDs. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets album information for a list of album IDs. Use it to look up details of several photo albums at once.

name: createAssetsForAppWithAlbum
params: source: PhotoCreationSource, albumUri: string, isAuthorized: boolean, photoCreationConfigs: Array<PhotoCreationConfig>
description: Creates assets for the current application or other applications in the specified source or user album. This API
summary: Creates photo or video items for an app inside a chosen album, optionally allowing other apps to write them. Use it to save pictures or videos into a specific album on an app's behalf.

name: batchGetPhotoAssetParams
description: Obtains the values of specified properties for an array of
summary: Gets the values of chosen properties for many photos or videos at once. Use it to read details like size or date for a group of files in one go.

name: on
description: Registers a listener for the **'photoChange'** event to monitor media asset changes. This API uses a callback to
summary: Watches for changes to photos, hidden photos, or photos in the trash, and reports each change. Use it to keep a gallery or cleanup app up to date when photos are added, hidden, or deleted.

name: off
description: Unregisters the listener for the **'photoChange'** event to stop monitoring media asset changes. If multiple
summary: Stops listening for changes to photos and videos, including hidden or trashed ones. Use it to stop being notified when photos are added, changed, or moved to the trash.

name: onAnalysisPhotoChange
description: Listens for the changes of media assets associated with the smart analysis album. The change carries the smart
summary: Watches for changes to media in the smart analysis album and reports them when they happen. Use it to keep an app's view of smart analysis album contents up to date.

name: offAnalysisPhotoChange
description: Cancels the listening for the media asset changes related to the smart analysis album. If multiple listeners are
summary: Stops listening for changes to photos in the smart analysis album. Use it to stop being notified when smart analysis album photos change.

name: onPhotoChange
description: Subscribes to changes of photos and videos.
summary: Watches for changes to photos and videos and reports them. Use it to refresh a gallery when photos or videos are added, edited, or deleted.

name: offPhotoChange
description: Unsubscribes from changes of photos and videos.
summary: Stops listening for changes to photos and videos. Use it to stop being notified when photos or videos are added, changed, or deleted.

name: onHiddenPhotoChange
description: Subscribes to changes of hidden photos and videos.
summary: Watches for changes to hidden photos and videos and reports them when they happen. Use it to keep an app's hidden photo and video view up to date.

name: offHiddenPhotoChange
description: Unsubscribes from changes of hidden photos and videos.
summary: Stops listening for changes to hidden photos and videos. Use it to stop being notified when hidden photos or videos change.

name: onTrashedPhotoChange
description: Subscribes to changes of trashed photos and videos.
summary: Watches for changes to trashed photos and videos and reports them when they happen. Use it to keep an app's trash view up to date.

name: offTrashedPhotoChange
description: Unsubscribes from changes of trashed photos and videos.
summary: Stops listening for changes to trashed photos and videos. Use it to stop being notified when trashed photos or videos change.

name: onPhotoAlbumChange
description: Subscribes to album changes.
summary: Watches for changes to photo albums and reports them. Use it to refresh an album list when albums are added, renamed, or removed.

name: offPhotoAlbumChange
description: Unsubscribes from album changes.
summary: Stops listening for changes to photo albums. Use it to stop being notified when albums are added, renamed, or removed.

name: onHiddenAlbumChange
description: Subscribes to changes of hidden albums.
summary: Watches for changes to hidden albums and reports them when they happen. Use it to keep an app's list of hidden albums up to date.

name: offhiddenAlbumChange
description: Unsubscribes from changes of hidden albums.
summary: Stops listening for changes to hidden albums. Use it to stop being notified when hidden albums change.

name: onTrashedAlbumChange
description: Subscribes to changes of the trashed album.
summary: Watches for changes to the trashed album and reports them when they happen. Use it to keep an app's view of the trash album up to date.

name: offTrashedAlbumChange
description: Unsubscribes from changes in the trashed album.
summary: Stops listening for changes in the trashed album. Use it to stop being notified when the trash album changes.

name: onSinglePhotoAlbumChange
description: Registers a listener for changes of a single common asset. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the
summary: Watches one chosen album and reports changes to it. Use it to follow a single album, such as a favorites album, and update when its contents change.

name: offSinglePhotoAlbumChange
description: Unregisters a listener for a single album. Note the following:
summary: Stops listening for changes to one album, or to all albums if none is given. Use it to stop being notified when a specific album changes.

name: onSinglePhotoChange
description: Registers a listener for changes of a single common asset. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the
summary: Watches one chosen photo or video and reports changes to it. Use it to follow a single photo or video and update when it is edited or removed.

name: offSinglePhotoChange
description: Unregisters the listener for a single asset. Note the following:
summary: Stops listening for changes to one photo or video, or to all if none is given. Use it to stop being notified when a specific photo or video changes.

name: onAnalysisAlbumChange
description: Listens for the smart analysis album and returns the album change result using a callback. You can register
summary: Listens for changes to the smart analysis album and reports them. Use it to be notified when the smart analysis album changes.

name: offAnalysisAlbumChange
description: Cancels the listener for the smart analysis album. If multiple listeners are registered, you can unregister a
summary: Stops listening for changes to smart analysis albums, either one listener or all of them. Use it to stop being notified when smart albums change.

name: getPhotoPickerComponentDefaultAlbumName
description: Obtains the name of the album that the **PhotoPickerComponent** shows by default. The name string is localized to
summary: Gets the name of the album the photo picker shows by default, in the current system language. Use it to label that default album in a photo picker.

name: isCompatibleDuplicateSupported
description: Checks whether a temporary JPEG copy should be created for an application. This API uses a promise to return the
summary: Checks whether a temporary JPEG copy should be made for an app. Use it to decide if an app needs a JPEG copy of a photo.

name: getPhotoAlbumOrder
description: Obtains the sorting order for system, user, and source albums. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the sorting order used for system, user, and source albums, in phone or PC style. Use it to see how albums are arranged in the gallery.

name: setPhotoAlbumOrder
description: Sets the sorting order for system, user, and source albums. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets the sorting order for system, user, and source photo albums. Used to arrange how albums appear in the gallery.

name: getRecentPhotoInfo
description: Obtains the information about the recent image or video when the application uses the **RecentPhotoComponent** to
summary: Gets details about the most recent photo or video. Use it to show a recent picture or clip in a recent-photos view.

name: query
description: Queries data in the database using the specified SQL statement. This API does not support write operations or
summary: Runs a read-only SQL query against the photo database and returns the matching rows. Use it to look up photos and albums by custom conditions.

name: getClonedAssetUris
description: Obtains the current URIs of cloned assets. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gives the current addresses of cloned photos and videos from their old addresses on a previous device. Use it to find where your photos and videos ended up after moving to a new phone.

name: getClonedAlbumUris
description: Obtains the current URIs of cloned albums. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gives the current addresses of cloned albums from the old addresses on a previous device. Use it to find where your albums ended up after moving to a new phone.

name: acquireDebugDatabase
description: Start medialibrary database backup and wait for returning with backup information which only works on beta
summary: Starts a backup of the media library database and returns backup details, working only on beta devices. Use it to collect database backup information for troubleshooting on a beta device.

name: releaseDebugDatabase
description: Release medialibrary database backup resources incluses closing backup database fd and
summary: Closes the backup photo database and deletes its temporary file on a beta device. Used to clean up after debugging the photo library database.

name: getAlbumIdByBundleName
description: Get the corresponding albumId of a bundleName.
summary: Gets the album ID that belongs to an app. Use it to find which album an app's photos are stored in.

name: getAlbumIdByLpath
description: Obtains the album ID in the media library based on the album's virtual path. This API uses a promise to return
summary: Finds the album ID for an album's virtual path, such as the camera or screenshot album. Use it to look up where a photo album is stored.

name: convertToAsset
description: Convert to PhotoAsset from path of filemanagerr.
summary: Turns a file manager path into a photo or video item. Use it to open or work with a picture or video by its file path.

name: getPhotoAssets
description: Converts the **ValuesBucket** record to a **PhotoAsset** object.
summary: Turns stored asset records into photo and video items. Use it to work with photos and videos from records you already have.

name: isMediaDataReady
description: Checks whether the specified media data is ready.
summary: Checks whether the specified media data, such as an asset's added date, is ready. Use it to confirm a photo's details are available before showing them.

name: setAssetCompatibleCapability
description: Sets the asset compatibility capability. The system performs compatibility processing on special assets (such as
summary: Registers a compatibility capability so the system can handle special assets like high-resolution ones. Use it to get the original photos and videos instead of compatible versions.

name: getAssetCompatibleCapability
description: Obtains the asset compatibility capability based on the bundle name. When an application obtains a file, it can
summary: Checks whether an app needs compatibility conversion when it gets a file, based on the app's bundle name. Use it to find out if a photo or video must be converted before an app can open it.

name: checkPhotoUrisReadPermission
description: Query whether the assets exist and whether the invoker has read permission on the assets without permission.
summary: Checks whether photos exist and whether you can read them. Use it to find out which photos you are allowed to open.

name: setPreferredCompatibleMode
description: Configure the preferred compatible mode configured by the application based on bundleName.
summary: Sets the preferred compatible mode for an app, identified by its bundle name. Used to choose how an app handles photos and albums.

name: getPreferredCompatibleMode
description: Obtains the preferred compatible mode configured by the application based on bundleName.
summary: Finds out which compatible mode an app prefers for handling photos. Use it to check how an app wants its pictures treated.

name: getAssetCompatibleUris
params: bundleName: string, assets: Array<PhotoAsset>, compatibleFlag?: int
description: Obtain the URI list to be transcoded based on bundleName, photoAsset list, and compatibleFlag.
summary: Gives the list of photo or video file addresses that need transcoding, based on the app, the assets, and a flag for large or Heif images. Use it to find which photos or videos must be converted before an app can display them.

name: createAssetsWithAlbum
params: creationSettings: CreationSetting[], isRealTimeThumb: boolean, albumUri?: string
description: Batch create assets,
summary: Creates several media files at once, optionally in a chosen album and with thumbnails made right away. Use it to save a batch of photos or videos into the gallery.

name: modifyAlbumDefaultCoverOrder
params: coverOrderInfos: DefaultCoverOrderInfo[], disableModification: boolean, isAsyncRefreshAlbum: boolean
description: modify the default cover order of album.
summary: Changes the default cover order of albums. Use it to control which photo appears as an album's cover.

name: modifyHiddenAlbumDefaultCoverOrder
params: coverOrderInfos: DefaultCoverOrderInfo[], disableModification: boolean, isAsyncRefreshAlbum: boolean
description: modify the default cover order of hidden album.
summary: Changes the default cover order of the hidden album. Use it to control which photo appears as the hidden album's cover.

name: moveAssetsToDir
params: assets: string[], target: string, option?: BatchOperationOptions
description: move assets of medialibrary sandbox to directory of filemanager.
summary: Moves photos or videos from the media library into a file manager directory. Use it to export media out of the gallery into a folder.

name: moveAssetsByPath
params: assets: string[], target: Album, option?: BatchOperationOptions
description: move assets of filemanager to Album.
summary: Moves files from the file manager into an album. Use it to add photos or videos from folders into an album.

name: cloneToAlbum
description: clone assets to Album.
summary: Copies photos or videos into an album. Use it to add existing media files to an album.

name: cloneToDir
params: assets: string[], target: string, option?: BatchOperationOptions
description: clone assets of medialibrary sandbox to directory of filemanager.
summary: Copies photos or videos from the media library into a folder in the file manager. Use it to save or export pictures and videos to a chosen folder.

name: cloneAssetsByPath
params: assets: string[], target: Album, option?: BatchOperationOptions
description: clone assets of filemanager to Album.
summary: Copies files from a file path into an album. Use it to add photos or videos from file storage into an album.

name: canPerformDeepOptimizeSpace
description: Whether deep storage space optimization can be performed.
summary: Tells you whether deep storage space optimization can be started. Use it to check before freeing up space taken by photos and videos.

name: getDeepOptimizeSpace
description: Obtains the size of the deep storage space.
summary: Gives the size in bytes of the deep storage space that can be freed. Use it to see how much space deep cleaning your photos and videos could free up.

name: startDeepOptimizeSpace
description: Start deep optimize storage space.
summary: Starts a deep cleanup to free up storage space used by photos and videos. Used when you want to reclaim space on your phone.

name: stopDeepOptimizeSpace
description: Stop deep optimize storage space.
summary: Stops deep optimization of storage space. Use it to end the process that frees up space by optimizing stored photos and videos.

name: invokeAnalysisTool
description: Triggers the execution of an analysis tool. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the result.
summary: Starts an analysis tool working on your photos and returns a task ID. Use it to run a photo analysis job and track it.

name: cancelAnalysisTool
description: Cancels the execution of an intelligent analysis tool.
summary: Stops a running intelligent analysis tool. Use it to cancel an analysis task you no longer need.

name: convertAssetToCompatibleAsset
description: Convert Asset Attributes to Compatibility Attributes
summary: Converts photo or video items into a compatible form. Use it when an app needs photos or videos in a format it can handle.

name: select
description: Starts a **photoPicker** page for the user to select one or more images or videos. This API uses a promise to
summary: Opens a picker page where the user chooses one or more images or videos. Use it to let someone pick photos or videos to attach or upload.

name: createImageAssetRequest
description: Creates an image asset change request.
summary: Creates a request to add an image from a file URI. Use it to save a picture into the media library.

name: createVideoAssetRequest
description: Creates a video asset change request.
summary: Creates a request to add a video from a file URI. Use it to save a video into the media library.

name: createAssetRequest
params: context: Context, displayName: string, options?: PhotoCreateOptions
description: Creates an asset change request with the specified file name.
summary: Creates a request to make a new photo or video with a given file name. Use it to start saving a new picture or clip into the gallery.

name: deleteAssets
description: Deletes media assets. The deleted assets are moved to the trash. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Deletes media assets, moving them to the trash. Use it to remove photos or videos from the gallery.

name: deleteAssetsToTrashWithUris
description: Deletes media assets. This API uses a promise to return the result. The deleted assets are moved to the trash.
summary: Deletes media assets by their URIs, moving them to the trash. Use it to remove photos or videos from the gallery.

name: getAsset
description: Obtains the asset in this asset change request.
summary: Gets the asset held in this change request. Use it to access the photo or video being added or changed.

name: setFavorite
description: Favorites or unfavorites this file asset.
summary: Marks a file as a favorite or removes it from favorites. Use it to favorite or unfavorite a photo or video.

name: setHidden
description: Hides this file.
summary: Hides a file or makes it visible again. Use it to keep a photo or video out of normal view.

name: setUserComment
description: Sets the user comment information of this media asset.
summary: Sets a comment on a media asset, up to 420 characters. Use it to add a note or description to a photo or video.

name: setLocation
description: Sets location information.
summary: Sets the location of a media file by longitude and latitude. Use it to record where a photo or video was taken.

name: setTitle
description: Sets the media asset title.
summary: Sets the title of a media asset. Use it to give a photo or video a name.

name: setEditData
description: Saves the edited data of an asset.
summary: Saves edited data for a media asset. Use it to keep changes made to a photo or video.

name: setCameraEditData
description: Saves the camera edited data of an asset.
summary: Saves the camera-edited data of a media asset. Use it to keep edits made to a photo or video taken with the camera.

name: setMovingPhotoVersion
description: Saves MovingPhoto version which is used to determine what special efficacy is supported.
summary: Saves the version of a moving photo, which decides what special effects it supports. Use it when saving a motion picture so the right effects work.

name: getWriteCacheHandler
description: Obtains the handler used for writing a file to cache. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets a handler for writing a file to cache. Use it to write media files to a temporary cache location.

name: addResource
description: Adds resources from the application sandbox based on the file URI. For details about the data source, see
summary: Adds a photo or video file from the app's own storage into the media library. Use it to save a picture or clip the app made so it appears in the gallery.

name: setCameraShotKey
description: Sets the Key for the Ultra Snapshot feature, which allows the camera to take photos or record videos with the
summary: Sets the key for the Ultra Snapshot feature, which lets the camera take photos or record videos with the screen off. Use it to enable quick capture without waking the screen.

name: saveCameraPhoto
description: Saves the photo taken by the camera.
summary: Saves a photo taken by the camera. Use it to keep a picture you just captured.

name: discardCameraPhoto
description: Discards the photo taken by the camera.
summary: Discards the photo just taken by the camera. Use it to throw away a camera shot you do not want to keep.

name: setEffectMode
description: Sets the effect of this moving photo.
summary: Sets the effect applied to a moving photo. Use it to choose how a moving photo plays or looks.

name: setOrientation
description: Sets the orientation of this image.
summary: Sets the rotation angle of an image to 0, 90, 180, or 270 degrees. Use it to fix a photo that appears sideways.

name: setVideoEnhancementAttr
description: Set video enhancement attribute
summary: Sets the video enhancement type for a video asset. Use it to apply an enhancement to a video in the gallery.

name: setSupportedWatermarkType
description: Sets the watermark type supported by photos.
summary: Sets which watermark type a photo supports. Use it to choose the watermark applied to a photo.

name: addResourceForPicker
description: Adds a resource using fileUri from file management directory
summary: Adds a photo or video to a media asset request using a file URI from the app sandbox. Use it to include a file when picking or adding media.

name: deleteLocalAssetsPermanently
description: Permanently deletes images or videos in batches. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Permanently deletes images or videos in batches, up to 500 at a time. Use it to erase photos or videos from the device for good.

name: deleteLocalAssetsPermanentlyWithUri
description: Permanently deletes images or video assets in batches by URI. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Permanently deletes images or videos in batches by their URIs, up to 500 at a time. Use it to erase photos or videos from the device for good.

name: deleteLocalAssetsWithUri
description: Deletes local media assets to the trash in batches. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Deletes local images or videos to the trash in batches, up to 500 at a time. Use it to move photos or videos to the trash so they can be recovered.

name: deleteCloudAssetsWithUri
description: Deletes cloud media assets to the trash in batches. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Deletes cloud images or videos to the trash in batches, up to 500 at a time. Use it to remove cloud photos or videos from the gallery.

name: deleteAssetsPermanentlyWithUri
description: Permanently deletes images or videos in batches by URI. The deleted images or videos are not stored in the
summary: Permanently deletes photos or videos by their URIs, without sending them to the recycle bin. Use it to erase selected images or videos for good.

name: setHasAppLink
description: Sets the status of the app link association.
summary: Sets whether a media file is linked to an app. Use it to turn an app link association on or off for a photo or video.

name: setAppLinkState
description: Sets the status of the app link association.
summary: Sets whether the app link association is enabled or disabled. Use it to turn the link between a media asset and an app on or off.

name: setAppLinkInfo
description: Sets the information about the app link association.
summary: Sets the app link association information for a media asset. Use it to link a photo or video to an app.

name: setCompositeDisplayMode
description: Sets the display mode of the composite image. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets the display mode of a composite image. Use it to choose how a combined image is shown.

name: setHiddenAttribute
description: Set hidden state of asset.
summary: Sets whether a media asset is hidden. Use it to hide or unhide a photo or video.

name: setTitleByFile
description: Set title by filemanger.
summary: Sets the title of a media asset from a file name, without the extension. Use it to rename a photo or video in the gallery.

name: setFavorite
description: Favorites or unfavorites this file asset.
summary: Marks a file as a favorite or removes it from favorites. Use it to favorite or unfavorite photos and videos in the gallery.

name: setHidden
description: Hides this file.
summary: Hides a file or makes it visible again. Use it to hide photos or videos from the gallery.

name: setUserComment
description: Sets the user comment information of this media asset.
summary: Sets the user comment text on a media asset. Use it to add or change a note or caption on a photo or video.

name: setIsRecentShow
description: Sets whether this asset is displayed in the **Recent** list.
summary: Sets whether an asset appears in the Recent list. Use it to show or hide a photo or video in the Recent album.

name: createAlbumRequest
description: Creates a MediaAlbumChangeRequest instance.
summary: Creates a request to make a new media album with the given name. Use it to set up a new album to hold photos or videos.

name: deleteAlbums
description: Deletes user albums. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Deletes the user's media albums. Use it to remove albums you no longer want.

name: deleteAlbumsWithUri
description: Deletes user albums by URI. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Deletes the user's media albums identified by their URIs. Use it to remove specific albums when you have their URIs.

name: setUploadStatus
params: context: Context, albums: Album[], allowUpload: boolean
description: Sets whether the albums can be synced to cloud storage or family storage. This API uses a promise to return the
summary: Sets whether albums can sync to cloud or family storage. Use it to allow or stop albums from backing up online.

name: getAlbum
description: Obtains the album in the current album change request.
summary: Gets the album that the current album change request works on. Use it to check which album you are about to change.

name: setCoverUri
description: Sets the album cover.
summary: Sets the cover image of a media album. Use it to choose which picture shows as the album's cover.

name: setAlbumName
description: Sets the album name.
summary: Sets the name of an album. Use it to rename an album, for example to give it a clearer title.

name: addAssets
description: Add assets to the album.
summary: Adds photos and videos to an album. Use it to put pictures or clips into a chosen album.

name: removeAssets
description: Removes assets from the album.
summary: Removes photos and videos from an album. Use it to take pictures or clips out of an album.

name: moveAssets
description: Moves assets to another album.
summary: Moves photos and videos to another album. Use it to organize photos and videos into a different album.

name: moveAssetsWithUri
description: Moves assets in an album to another album.
summary: Moves photos or videos to another album. Use it to organize your pictures into a different album.

name: recoverAssets
description: Restores the assets corresponding to the specified PhotoAsset object array from the trash.
summary: Restores photos or videos from the trash. Use it to bring back deleted pictures or videos.

name: recoverAssetsWithUri
description: Restores the assets corresponding to the specified URI string array from the trash.
summary: Restores photos or videos from the trash using their URIs. Use it to bring back deleted pictures or videos.

name: deleteAssets
description: Permanently deletes assets from the trash.
summary: Permanently deletes photos and videos from the trash. Use it to clear out items you no longer want to keep.

name: deleteAssetsWithUri
description: Permanently deletes assets from the trash.
summary: Permanently deletes photos and videos from the trash using their URIs. Use it to clear out items you no longer want to keep.

name: setIsMe
description: Sets the relationship between people in the portrait album to **Me**.
summary: Marks the person in a portrait album as you. Use it to label your own face in a portrait album.

name: setDisplayLevel
description: Sets the display level of the portrait album.
summary: Sets how a portrait album is shown, such as favorite or first. Use it to control whether a portrait album appears first or is hidden.

name: dismissAssets
description: Removes assets from this portrait album or group photo album.
summary: Removes photos and videos from a portrait or group photo album. Use it to take items out of a portrait or group photo album.

name: mergeAlbum
description: Merges two portrait albums.
summary: Merges two portrait albums into one. Use it to combine portrait albums.

name: placeBefore
description: Places this album before an album.
summary: Places this album before another album in the list. Use it to reorder albums so your favorites appear first.

name: dismiss
description: Removes this group photo album.
summary: Removes a group photo album. Use it to delete a group photo album you no longer need.

name: resetCoverUri
description: Resets the cover.
summary: Resets an album's cover. Use it to remove the custom cover and return to the default.

name: setHiddenAttribute
description: set hidden state of album.
summary: Hides or unhides a media album, optionally for all its contents. Use it to make an album private or visible again.

name: setAlbumNameByFile
description: set album name by filemanger.
summary: Renames a media album to a new name. Use it to give an album a different name.

name: operateAttribute
description: Operates album attribute.
summary: Changes an album's attribute. Use it to update album details like its name or cover.

name: requestContent
description: Requests the image data and video data of this moving photo and writes them to the specified URIs, respectively.
summary: Fetches the image and video parts of a moving photo and saves them to the given locations. Use it to export or save a moving photo's picture and clip.

name: getUri
description: Obtains the URI of this moving photo.
summary: Gives the address of a moving photo so it can be opened or shared. Use it to find where a moving photo is stored.

name: isVideoReady
description: Checks whether the video of the moving photo is ready. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Checks whether the video part of a moving photo is ready to use. Use it to know when a moving photo's video can be played.

name: setOrderPosition
description: Sets the sequence of assets in the **Analysis** album.
summary: Sets the order of photos and videos within an analysis album. Use it to arrange how items appear in a smart album.

name: setRelationship
description: Sets the relationships of a person in the portrait album.
summary: Sets the relationship label for a person in a portrait album, such as mother, friend, or colleague. Use it to label who someone is in your people albums.

name: createAnalysisAlbumRequest
description: Creates a MediaAnalysisAlbumChangeRequest instance.
summary: Creates a request to make a new smart album with a given name and subtype. Use it to set up a smart album for grouping photos automatically.

name: setDefaultCoverUri
description: Sets the default cover image for the smart album.
summary: Sets the default cover image for a smart album using a file URI. Use it to choose which picture shows on the album cover.

name: setHighlightAttribute
description: Sets the specified attribute value in the highlights album.
summary: Sets a chosen attribute value in a highlights album, such as whether it has been viewed or favorited. Use it to mark a highlight album as seen or as a favorite.

name: getOrderPosition
description: Obtains the sequence of assets in the **Analysis** album.
summary: Gets the position order of given photos within an analysis album. Use it to find where each photo sits in the album's sequence.

name: getRelationship
description: Obtains the relationships of a person in the portrait album.
summary: Gets the relationship of a person shown in a portrait album. Use it to find how that person is related, such as family or friend.

summary: Stops listening for per-frame updates. Use it to stop reacting to each screen frame, such as when pausing an animation.

name: start
description: Starts callback for each frame.
summary: Begins calling back on every screen frame. Use it to start a smooth animation or game loop.

name: stop
description: Stops callback for each frame.
summary: Stops calling back on every screen frame. Use it to pause a smooth animation or game loop.

name: create
description: Creates a **DisplaySync** object, through which you can set the frame rate of the custom UI content.
summary: Creates a display sync object that lets you set the frame rate for your custom UI content. Use it to control how smoothly your custom drawing updates.

name: setCorner
params: pos: CornerPos, x: double, y: double
description: Sets the radii of the specified rounded corner in this rounded rectangle.
summary: Sets the radii of one rounded corner of a rounded rectangle. Use it to adjust how round a specific corner looks.

name: getCorner
description: Obtains the radii of the specified rounded corner in this rounded rectangle.
summary: Gets the corner radii of a rounded rectangle at the chosen corner. Use it to find how round a specific corner is when drawing or adjusting a shape.

name: offset
description: Translates this rounded rectangle by an offset along the X axis and Y axis.
summary: Moves a rounded rectangle sideways and up or down by given amounts. Use it to reposition a rounded rectangle on screen.

name: next
description: Retrieves the next operation in this path and moves the iterator to that operation.
summary: Reads the next path operation and moves the iterator forward, filling in its coordinate points. Use it to walk through a path step by step.

name: peek
description: Retrieves the next operation in this path, without moving the iterator.
summary: Reads the next path operation without moving the iterator forward. Use it to look ahead at the next drawing step of a path.

name: hasNext
description: Checks whether there is any next operation in the path operation iterator.
summary: Checks whether the path iterator has another operation to read. Use it to loop through the drawing steps of a path.

name: moveTo
description: Sets the start point of this path.
summary: Sets the starting point of a path. Use it to begin drawing a shape at a chosen spot.

name: lineTo
description: Draws a line segment from the last point of this path to the target point. If the path is empty, the start point
summary: Draws a straight line from the path's last point to a target point, starting at (0, 0) if the path is empty. Use it to draw straight edges of a shape.

name: arcTo
params: x1: double, y1: double, x2: double, y2: double, startDeg: double, sweepDeg: double
description: Draws an arc to this path using angle arc mode. This mode first defines a rectangle and takes its inscribed
summary: Adds an arc to a path by defining a rectangle, taking its inscribed ellipse, and drawing the part between a start angle and sweep angle. Use it to draw curved arc shapes in a drawing or graphic.

name: quadTo
params: ctrlX: double, ctrlY: double, endX: double, endY: double
description: Draws a quadratic Bezier curve from the last point of this path to the target point. If the path is empty, the
summary: Draws a quadratic Bezier curve from the path's last point to a target point. Use it to draw smooth curved lines or shapes.

name: conicTo
params: ctrlX: double, ctrlY: double, endX: double, endY: double, weight: double
description: Draws a conic curve from the last point of this path to the target point. If the path is empty, the start point (
summary: Draws a conic curve from the path's last point to a target point, shaped by a control point and weight. Use it to draw smooth curved shapes such as rounded outlines or arcs.

name: cubicTo
params: ctrlX1: double, ctrlY1: double, ctrlX2: double, ctrlY2: double, endX: double, endY: double
description: Draws a cubic Bezier curve from the last point of this path to the target point. If the path is empty, the start
summary: Draws a cubic Bezier curve from the path's last point to a target point using two control points. Use it to draw smooth flowing curves such as waves or rounded shapes.

name: rMoveTo
description: Sets the start position relative to the last point of this path. If the path is empty, the start point (0, 0) is
summary: Moves the path's start point by an offset from its last point, or from (0,0) if empty. Use it to start a new subpath at a position relative to where you left off when drawing shapes.

name: rLineTo
description: Draws a line segment from the last point of this path to a point relative to the last point. If the path is empty
summary: Draws a straight line from the path's last point to a point relative to it. Use it to draw straight edges of shapes or lines.

name: rQuadTo
params: dx1: double, dy1: double, dx2: double, dy2: double
description: Draws a quadratic Bezier curve from the last point of this path to a point relative to the last point. If the
summary: Draws a quadratic Bezier curve from the path's last point to a point given as an offset, using an offset control point. Use it to add smooth curved segments when drawing shapes or outlines.

name: rConicTo
params: ctrlX: double, ctrlY: double, endX: double, endY: double, weight: double
description: Draws a conic curve from the last point of this path to a point relative to the last point. If the path is empty,
summary: Draws a conic curve from the path's last point to a point relative to it. Use it to draw smooth curved lines or shapes.

name: rCubicTo
params: ctrlX1: double, ctrlY1: double, ctrlX2: double, ctrlY2: double, endX: double, endY: double
description: Draws a cubic Bezier curve from the last point of this path to a point relative to the last point. If the path is
summary: Draws a cubic Bezier curve from the path's last point to a point relative to it. Use it to draw smooth curved lines or shapes.

name: addPolygon
description: Adds a polygon to this path.
summary: Adds a polygon shape to a path from a list of corner points, optionally closing it back to the start. Use it to draw custom polygon shapes in a drawing or graphic.

name: op
description: Combines this path with the passed-in path based on the specified operation mode.
summary: Combines this path with another path using a chosen operation mode. Use it to merge, intersect, or subtract drawn shapes.

name: addArc
params: rect: common2D.Rect, startAngle: double, sweepAngle: double
description: Adds an arc to this path.
summary: Adds an arc to a path, or an oval when the start angle is a multiple of 90 and the sweep is outside -360 to 360. Use it to draw curved shapes.

name: addCircle
params: x: double, y: double, radius: double, pathDirection?: PathDirection
description: Adds a circle to this path in the specified direction. The start point of the circle is (x + radius, y).
summary: Adds a circle to a path in the chosen direction, starting at the rightmost point. Use it to draw round shapes.

name: addOval
params: rect: common2D.Rect, start: int, pathDirection?: PathDirection
description: Adds the inscribed ellipse of a rectangle to this path in the specified direction.
summary: Adds the ellipse that fits inside a rectangle to a path, starting from the top, right, bottom, or left point. Use it to draw oval shapes.

name: addRect
description: Adds a rectangle to a path in the specified direction. The start point is the upper left corner of the rectangle.
summary: Adds a rectangle to a path, starting at its upper left corner, in a chosen direction. Use it to draw rectangular shapes in a drawing or graphic.

name: addRoundRect
description: Adds a rounded rectangle to a path in the specified direction. When the path direction is clockwise, the start
summary: Adds a rounded rectangle to a path in a chosen direction. Use it to draw rounded rectangle shapes in a drawing or graphic.

name: addPath
description: Transforms the points in a path by a matrix and stores the resulting path in the current **Path** object.
summary: Transforms the points of another path by a matrix and adds the result to this path. Use it to copy or move a shape.

name: transform
description: Transforms the points in a path by matrix.
summary: Moves, rotates, scales, or skews all points of a path using a matrix. Use it to reposition or reshape a drawn shape on screen.

name: contains
description: Checks whether a coordinate point is included in this path. For details, see
summary: Checks whether a coordinate point lies inside this path. Use it to tell if a tap or touch point falls within a drawn shape.

name: setLastPoint
description: Sets the last point of a path.
summary: Sets the last point of the path to the given coordinates. Use it to adjust where the next line or curve will start from when drawing a shape.

name: setFillType
description: Sets the fill type of this path. The fill type determines how "inside" of the path is drawn. For example, when
summary: Sets how the inside of a path is decided when filling, such as by winding or even-odd crossing rules. Use it to control which areas get filled when drawing overlapping shapes.

name: getFillType
description: Obtains the fill type of a path.
summary: Gets the rule used to fill a path. Use it to find out how a shape's inside is decided when drawing.

name: getBounds
description: Obtains the minimum bounding rectangle that encloses this path.
summary: Gets the smallest rectangle that encloses this path. Use it to find the size or position of a drawn shape.

name: close
description: Closes this path by adding a line segment from the start point to the last point of the path.
summary: Closes a path by adding a line segment from its start point to its last point. Use it to finish an outline so a shape can be filled or drawn as a closed figure.

name: offset
description: Offsets this path by specified distances along the X axis and Y axis and stores the resulting path in the
summary: Moves a path by given distances along the X and Y axes and returns the shifted path. Use it to reposition a drawn shape or line on screen.

name: reset
description: Resets the path data.
summary: Clears all path data, removing every point and line. Use it to start drawing a fresh shape with the same path object.

name: rewind
description: Rewinds a path by clearing all its points and lines but reserves the memory space.
summary: Clears all points and lines from the path but keeps its memory for reuse. Use it to restart a drawing without allocating new memory.

name: isEmpty
description: Checks whether a path is empty.
summary: Tells whether a path has no content. Use it to check if a drawn shape or line is blank.

name: isRect
description: Checks whether a path forms a rectangle.
summary: Checks whether a path forms a rectangle, and can give back that rectangle. Use it to detect when a drawn shape is a plain rectangle.

name: getLength
description: Obtains the path length.
summary: Measures how long a path is, optionally treating it as closed. Use it to find the distance around a drawn shape or line.

name: getPositionAndTangent
params: forceClosed: boolean, distance: double, position: common2D.Point, tangent: common2D.Point
description: Obtains the coordinates and tangent at a distance from the start point of this path.
summary: Finds the coordinates and tangent direction at a given distance along a path. Use it to place or aim something that travels along a drawn line or curve.

name: getSegment
params: forceClosed: boolean, start: double, stop: double, startWithMoveTo: boolean, dst: Path
description: Extracts a segment of a path and appends it to a destination path.
summary: Copies part of a path between two distances and adds it to another path. Use it to cut out a piece of a drawn shape or line.

name: isClosed
description: Checks whether a path is closed.
summary: Tells whether a path forms a closed loop. Use it to check if a drawn shape is sealed shut.

name: getMatrix
params: forceClosed: boolean, distance: double, matrix: Matrix, flags: PathMeasureMatrixFlags
description: Obtains a transformation matrix at a specific position along the path, which represents the coordinates and
summary: Gets the position and orientation at a given distance along a path. Use it to place or turn something so it follows a path, like a marker moving along a line.

name: buildFromSvgString
description: Parses the path represented by an SVG string.
summary: Parses an SVG string and builds the path it describes. Use it to draw a shape defined by SVG path data.

name: convertToSvgString
description: Converts path to an SVG string.
summary: Converts the path into an SVG string. Use it to save or share a drawn shape as SVG text.

name: getPointData
description: Gets path point data.
summary: Gets the points that make up a path. Use it to read the coordinates of a drawn shape's corners and curve points.

name: getVerbData
description: Gets path verb data.
summary: Lists the drawing commands that make up a path. Use it to inspect how a shape or line was built.

name: getConicWeightData
description: Gets path conic weight data.
summary: Gets the weight values used for the conic curves in a path. Use it to inspect or reuse the shape of curved path segments.

name: getPathIterator
description: Obtains the operation iterator of this path.
summary: Gets an iterator for stepping through the drawing operations of a path. Use it to walk through and inspect each segment of a shape.

name: approximate
description: Converts the existing path into an approximate path consisting of consecutive line segments.
summary: Turns a path into a close approximation made of straight line segments, within a given error. Use it to simplify a curved path into straight lines for drawing or measuring.

name: interpolate
params: other: Path, weight: double, interpolatedPath: Path
description: Interpolates between the existing path and another path based on the given weight and stores the result in the
summary: Blends two paths by a weight to make an in-between path. Use it to smoothly morph one drawn shape into another.

name: isInterpolate
description: Checks whether the existing path and another path are compatible for interpolation in terms of structure and
summary: Checks whether two paths are compatible for interpolation, meaning they can be smoothly morphed into each other. Use it to set up shape morphing animations.

name: isInverseFillType
description: Checks whether the current path fill type is the inverse fill type. For example, the fill types **Winding** and
summary: Checks whether the path's fill type is an inverse type, which fills everything outside the shape instead of inside. Use it to find out if a shape is drawn as an inverted fill.

name: toggleInverseFillType
description: Toggles the fill type of the path to the inverse type. For example, if the **Winding** fill type is used, the
summary: Switches a path's fill area to its opposite, so what was filled becomes empty and what was empty becomes filled. Use it to invert which parts of a shape are painted.

name: getLastPoint
description: Gets the last point of the path.
summary: Gets the last point of a path. Use it to find where a drawn line or shape ends.

name: isEqual
description: Checks if two paths are equal.
summary: Checks whether two paths are equal. Use it to tell if two drawn shapes are exactly the same.

name: drawRect
description: Draws a rectangle. By default, black is used for filling.
summary: Draws a rectangle, filled black by default. Use it to draw a rectangular shape or box on the canvas.

name: drawRoundRect
description: Draws a rounded rectangle.
summary: Draws a rounded rectangle. Use it to draw a rectangle with rounded corners, such as a button or card.

name: drawNestedRoundRect
description: Draws two nested rounded rectangles. The outer rectangle boundary must contain the inner rectangle boundary.
summary: Draws two rounded rectangles, one inside the other. Use it to draw a rounded frame or border around a rounded shape.

name: drawBackground
description: Uses a brush to fill the drawable area of the canvas.
summary: Fills the drawable area of the canvas with a brush. Use it to paint a background color or pattern behind your drawing.

name: drawShadow
params: path: Path, planeParams: common2D.Point3d, devLightPos: common2D.Point3d, lightRadius: double, ambientColor: common2D.Color, spotColor: common2D.Color, flag: ShadowFlag
description: Draws a spot shadow and uses a given path to outline the ambient shadow.
summary: Draws a spot shadow and outlines an ambient shadow along a given path. Use it to add realistic shadows to shapes or objects.

name: drawCircle
params: x: double, y: double, radius: double
description: Draws a circle. If the radius is less than or equal to zero, nothing is drawn. By default, black is used for
summary: Draws a filled circle at a given center point and radius. Use it to draw round dots or circular shapes on the canvas.

name: drawImage
params: pixelmap: image.PixelMap, left: double, top: double, samplingOptions?: SamplingOptions
description: Draws an image. The coordinates of the upper left corner of the image are (left, top).
summary: Draws an image with its top-left corner at the given coordinates. Use it to place a picture or photo on the canvas.

name: drawImageLattice
params: pixelmap: image.PixelMap, lattice: Lattice, dstRect: common2D.Rect, filterMode: FilterMode
description: Splits an image into multiple sections based on the lattice object's configuration and draws each section into
summary: Splits an image into sections and draws them into a target rectangle, stretching the parts that do not fit. Use it to resize a picture while keeping its corners and edges undistorted.

name: drawImageNine
params: pixelmap: image.PixelMap, center: common2D.Rect, dstRect: common2D.Rect, filterMode: FilterMode
description: Splits an image into nine sections using two horizontal and two vertical lines: four edge sections, four corner
summary: Splits an image into nine parts and draws them into a target rectangle, keeping the corners unscaled. Use it to stretch a picture or button background without distorting its corners.

name: drawImageRect
params: pixelmap: image.PixelMap, dstRect: common2D.Rect, samplingOptions?: SamplingOptions
description: Draws an image onto a specified area of the canvas.
summary: Draws an image into a specified rectangle area of the canvas. Use it to place or resize a picture at a chosen spot.

name: drawImageRectWithSrc
params: pixelmap: image.PixelMap, srcRect: common2D.Rect, dstRect: common2D.Rect, samplingOptions?: SamplingOptions, constraint?: SrcRectConstraint
description: Draws a portion of an image onto a specified area of the canvas.
summary: Draws part of an image onto a chosen area of the canvas. Use it to show a cropped piece of a picture, like a sprite from a sprite sheet.

name: drawColor
description: Fills the drawable area of the canvas with the specified color and
summary: Fills the whole drawing area with one color. Use it to paint a solid background or clear the canvas to a chosen color.

name: drawOval
description: Draws an oval on the canvas, where the shape and position of the oval are defined by its bounding rectangle.
summary: Draws an oval inside a given rectangle. Use it to draw circles or ellipses on a canvas.

name: drawArc
params: arc: common2D.Rect, startAngle: double, sweepAngle: double
description: Draws an arc on the canvas. with the start angle and sweep angle specified. If the absolute value of the sweep
summary: Draws an arc inside a rectangular boundary, using a start angle and sweep angle. Use it to draw curved shapes such as part of a circle or oval.

name: drawArcWithCenter
params: arc: common2D.Rect, startAngle: double, sweepAngle: double, useCenter: boolean
description: Draws an arc on the canvas. It enables you to define the start angle, sweep angle, and whether the arc's
summary: Draws an arc inside a rectangular boundary, choosing the start angle, sweep angle, and whether the ends connect to the center. Use it to draw pie-slice or curved shapes.

name: drawPoint
description: Draws a point.
summary: Draws a single point at the given x and y coordinates. Use it to plot a dot on a drawing or chart.

name: drawPoints
description: Draws a group of points, line segments, or polygons on the canvas, with the specified drawing mode. An array is
summary: Draws a group of points, line segments, or polygons on the canvas in the chosen drawing mode. Use it to plot many dots or connect them into lines or shapes.

name: drawPath
description: Draws a custom path, which contains a set of path outlines. Each path outline can be open or closed.
summary: Draws a custom path made of outlines that can be open or closed. Use it to draw freeform shapes, icons, or signatures.

name: drawLine
params: x0: double, y0: double, x1: double, y1: double
description: Draws a line segment from the start point to the end point. If the coordinates of the start point are the same as
summary: Draws a straight line from one point to another. Use it to draw lines, borders, or simple shapes on a canvas.

name: drawSingleCharacter
params: text: string, font: Font, x: double, y: double
description: Draws a single character. If the typeface of the current font does not support the character to draw, the system
summary: Draws one character at a given position using a font, falling back to the system typeface if needed. Use it to place a single letter or symbol on a drawing.

name: drawSingleCharacterWithFeatures
params: text: string, font: Font, x: double, y: double, features: Array<FontFeature>
description: Draws a single character with font features. If the typeface of the current font does not support the character
summary: Draws one character at a given position using a font and chosen font features. Use it to place a single letter or symbol with specific typographic styling.

name: drawTextBlob
params: blob: TextBlob, x: double, y: double
description: Draws a text blob. If the typeface used to construct **blob** does not support a character, that character will
summary: Draws a text blob at a given position; characters unsupported by the blob's typeface are skipped. Use it to render a prepared block of text on a drawing.

name: drawGlyphs
params: glyphIds: Array<int>, glyphIdOffset: int, positions: Array<common2D.Point>, positionOffset: int, glyphCount: int, font: Font
description: Draws the array of glyphs with specified font. Nothing is drawn if glyphCount is smaller than or equals to 0.
summary: Draws a set of glyphs using a chosen font at given positions. Use it to render text characters onto a drawing surface.

name: drawPixelMapMesh
params: pixelmap: image.PixelMap, meshWidth: int, meshHeight: int, vertices: Array<double>, vertOffset: int, colors: Array<int> | null, colorOffset: int
description: Draws a **PixelMap** based on a mesh, with the mesh vertices evenly distributed across the **PixelMap**. (This
summary: Draws an image stretched over a grid of mesh points. Use it to warp or distort a picture, like a flag waving.

name: drawVertices
params: vertexMode: VertexMode, vertexCount: int, positions: Array<common2D.Point>, texs: Array<common2D.Point> | null, colors: Array<int> | null, indexCount: int, indices: Array<int> | null, mode: BlendMode
description: Draws a triangle mesh described by the vertex array.
summary: Draws a triangle mesh from an array of vertices. Use it to render custom shapes or textured surfaces built from triangles.

name: drawRegion
description: Draws a region.
summary: Draws a region on the canvas. Use it to draw a defined area or shape.

name: attachPen
description: Attaches a pen to the canvas. When you draw on the canvas, the pen's style is used to outline shapes.
summary: Attaches a pen to the canvas so shapes you draw are outlined with the pen's style. Use it to draw outlines around shapes.

name: attachBrush
description: Attaches a brush to the canvas. When you draw on the canvas, the brush's style is used to fill the interior of
summary: Attaches a brush to the canvas so shapes you draw are filled with the brush's style. Use it to fill shapes with a chosen color or style.

name: detachPen
description: Detaches the pen from the canvas. When you draw on the canvas, the pen is no longer used to outline shapes.
summary: Stops the pen from outlining shapes drawn on the canvas. Use it when you want later shapes to be drawn without that outline.

name: detachBrush
description: Detaches the brush from the canvas. When you draw on the canvas, the brush is no longer used to fill the interior
summary: Stops the brush from filling the inside of shapes drawn on the canvas. Use it when you want later shapes to be drawn without that fill.

name: save
description: Saves the canvas states (canvas matrix and drawable area) to the top of the stack. This API must be used in pair
summary: Saves the canvas drawing state, such as its matrix and drawable area, onto a stack so it can be restored later. Use it to temporarily change how you draw and then return to the earlier state.

name: saveLayer
params: rect?: common2D.Rect | null, brush?: Brush | null
description: Saves the matrix and cropping region of the canvas, and allocates a **PixelMap** for subsequent drawing. If you
summary: Saves the canvas matrix and clipping region and allocates a pixel map for later drawing, which is drawn when you restore. Use it to draw a group of shapes with effects like transparency or blending applied together.

name: clear
description: Clears the canvas with a given color. This API has the same effect as
summary: Fills the whole canvas with one color, wiping what was drawn before. Use it to reset the drawing surface to a solid background color.

name: restore
description: Restores the canvas state (canvas matrix and clipping area) saved on the top of the stack.
summary: Restores the canvas transform and clipping area saved most recently. Use it to undo a saved drawing state after finishing a group of shapes.

name: restoreToCount
description: Restores the canvas state (canvas matrix and clipping area) to a specified number.
summary: Restores the canvas transform and clipping area back to a chosen saved depth. Use it to jump back several saved states at once instead of undoing them one by one.

name: getSaveCount
description: Obtains the number of canvas states (canvas matrix and clipping area) saved in the stack.
summary: Tells you how many saved canvas states are currently on the stack. Use it to check how many times you have saved the drawing state before restoring.

name: getWidth
description: Obtains the canvas width.
summary: Gives you the width of the canvas. Use it to find out how wide the drawing area is.

name: getHeight
description: Obtains the canvas height.
summary: Gets the height of the canvas. Use it to find how tall the drawing area is.

name: getLocalClipBounds
description: Obtains the bounds of the cropping region of the canvas.
summary: Gets the bounds of the canvas cropping region. Use it to find the visible area of a drawing.

name: getTotalMatrix
description: Obtains the canvas matrix.
summary: Gives you the canvas transformation matrix. Use it to find out how the canvas is currently scaled, rotated, or moved.

name: scale
description: Applies a scaling matrix on top of the current canvas matrix (identity matrix by default). Subsequent drawing and
summary: Applies a scaling matrix to the canvas so later drawing and clipping are scaled in shape and position. Use it to zoom drawings larger or smaller on the canvas.

name: skew
description: Applies a skewing matrix on top of the current canvas matrix (identity matrix by default). Subsequent drawing and
summary: Applies a skewing matrix to the canvas so later drawing and clipping are tilted in shape and position. Use it to slant drawings along the X or Y axis.

name: rotate
params: degrees: double, sx: double, sy: double
description: Applies a rotation matrix on top of the current canvas matrix (identity matrix by default). Subsequent drawing
summary: Rotates the canvas around a given point so later drawing and clipping appear turned. Use it to draw tilted shapes, dials, or rotated images.

name: translate
description: Applies a translation matrix on top of the current canvas matrix (identity matrix by default). Subsequent drawing
summary: Applies a translation matrix to the canvas so later drawing and clipping are shifted in shape and position. Use it to move drawings to a different position on the canvas.

name: clipPath
params: path: Path, clipOp?: ClipOp, doAntiAlias?: boolean
description: Clips the drawable area of the canvas using a custom path.
summary: Limits drawing to the inside of a custom shape, so later drawing only shows within that shape. Use it to keep artwork inside an outline or mask.

name: clipRect
params: rect: common2D.Rect, clipOp?: ClipOp, doAntiAlias?: boolean
description: Clips the drawable area of the canvas using a rectangle.
summary: Limits drawing to a rectangle, so later drawing only shows inside that rectangle. Use it to keep drawing within a chosen rectangular area.

name: concatMatrix
description: Multiplies the current canvas matrix by the incoming matrix on the left. This API does not affect previous
summary: Applies a matrix to the canvas so later drawing and clipping are moved, rotated, scaled, or skewed. Use it to shift or turn everything drawn afterwards.

name: clipRegion
description: Clips a region on the canvas.
summary: Limits drawing to a chosen region, so later drawing only shows inside that region. Use it to restrict drawing to a specific area of the canvas.

name: clipRoundRect
params: roundRect: RoundRect, clipOp?: ClipOp, doAntiAlias?: boolean
description: Clips a rounded rectangle on the canvas.
summary: Limits drawing to a rounded rectangle, so later drawing only shows inside that shape. Use it to keep drawing inside a rounded card or panel shape.

name: isClipEmpty
description: Checks whether the region that can be drawn is empty after clipping.
summary: Tells you whether the drawable region is empty after clipping. Use it to check if anything can still be drawn.

name: isOpaque
description: Checks whether the current layer that drawn into the device is opaque.
summary: Tells you whether the current layer drawn to the device is opaque. Use it to check if the drawing is fully solid.

name: setMatrix
description: Sets a matrix for the canvas. Subsequent drawing and clipping operations will be affected by this matrix in terms
summary: Sets a matrix for the canvas so later drawing and clipping are affected in shape and position. Use it to apply a custom transform to everything you draw afterwards.

name: resetMatrix
description: Resets the matrix of this canvas to an identity matrix.
summary: Resets the canvas transform back to its default identity matrix. Use it to undo panning, zooming, or rotation before drawing in normal coordinates again.

name: resetClip
description: Resets the clip status.
summary: Clears the current clipping area so the whole canvas can be drawn on again. Use it to undo earlier clipping before drawing something that should not be cut off.

name: quickRejectPath
description: Checks whether the path is not intersecting with the canvas area. The canvas area includes its boundaries.
summary: Tells you whether a path does not intersect the canvas area. Use it to skip drawing shapes that are off the canvas.

name: quickRejectRect
description: Checks whether the rectangle is not intersecting with the canvas area. The canvas area includes its boundaries.
summary: Checks whether a rectangle lies completely outside the canvas area, including its boundaries. Use it to skip drawing shapes that are off-screen and save work.

name: makeFromString
params: text: string, font: Font, encoding?: TextEncoding
description: Converts a value of the string type into a **TextBlob** object.
summary: Turns a string into a drawable block of text using a chosen font. Use it to draw a piece of text on a canvas.

name: makeFromPosText
params: text: string, len: number, points: common2D.Point[], font: Font
description: Creates a **TextBlob** object from the text. The coordinates of each font in the **TextBlob** object are
summary: Creates a drawable block of text where each character is placed at a given coordinate. Use it to draw text along custom positions, such as curved or scattered lettering.

name: makeFromRunBuffer
params: pos: Array<TextBlobRunBuffer>, font: Font, bounds?: common2D.Rect
description: Creates a **TextBlob** object based on the **RunBuffer** information.

name: bounds
description: Obtains the rectangular bounding box of the text blob.
summary: Gives the rectangular box that encloses a block of text. Use it to find how much space drawn text takes up, for example to position or align it.

name: uniqueID
description: Obtains the unique, non-zero identifier of this **TextBlob** object.
summary: Gets the unique non-zero identifier of a text block. Use it to tell one drawn text block apart from another.

name: addVariation
description: Adds variation axis for the TypefaceArguments.
summary: Adds a variation axis setting to typeface arguments, using a four-character axis tag and a value. Use it to fine-tune a variable font's style, such as weight or width.

name: getFamilyName
description: Obtains the name of the typeface family, which is the name given to a collection of related typeface designs.
summary: Gets the family name of a typeface, such as the name of a font collection. Use it to find out which font family a typeface belongs to.

name: makeFromCurrent
description: Constructs a typeface object from the current typeface and its arguments.
summary: Creates a typeface from the current typeface and its settings. Use it to make a font variant based on an existing one.

name: makeFromFile
description: Constructs a typeface from a file.
summary: Creates a typeface from a font file. Use it to load a custom font for your text.

name: makeFromRawFile
description: Constructs a typeface from a file, which must be stored in the **resources/rawfile** directory of the application
summary: Creates a typeface from a font file stored in the app's rawfile resources. Use it to load a bundled custom font for your text.

name: makeFromFileWithArguments
description: Constructs a typeface from the typeface file path and arguments.
summary: Creates a typeface from a font file and its settings. Use it to load a custom font with specific options for your text.

name: makeFromRawFileWithArguments
description: Constructs a typeface from a file with typeface arguments, which must be stored in the **resources/rawfile**
summary: Builds a typeface from a font file stored in the app's rawfile resources, with adjustable style settings. Use it to load a custom font for your text.

name: isBold
description: Checks whether the font is bold.
summary: Checks whether a font is bold. Use it to tell if text will appear in bold style.

name: isItalic
description: Checks whether the font is italic.
summary: Checks whether a font is italic. Use it to tell if text will appear slanted.

name: enableSubpixel
description: Enables subpixel font rendering.
summary: Turns subpixel font rendering on or off. Use it to make small text look smoother and sharper on screen.

name: enableEmbolden
description: Enables emboldened fonts.
summary: Turns bold text on or off. Use it to make rendered text appear thicker and heavier.

name: enableLinearMetrics
description: Enables linear font scaling.
summary: Turns linear font scaling on or off. Use it to keep text spacing consistent when scaling text smoothly.

name: setSize
description: Sets the font size.
summary: Sets how large the text is drawn. Use it to make text bigger or smaller, such as for titles or captions.

name: getSize
description: Obtains the font size.
summary: Gets the font size. Use it to find out how large text will be when drawing or laying out text.

name: setTypeface
description: Sets the typeface style (including attributes such as font name, weight, and italic) for the font.
summary: Sets the font style, including name, weight, and italic. Use it to pick a bold, italic, or specific font for drawing text.

name: getTypeface
description: Obtains the typeface.
summary: Gets the typeface used by this font. Use it to check or reuse which font style is being drawn with.

name: getMetrics
description: Obtains the font metrics of the typeface.
summary: Gets the font metrics of the typeface, such as its measurements. Use it to find out how tall or wide text will be when laying out text.

name: measureSingleCharacter
description: Measures the width of a single character. If the typeface of the current font does not support the character to
summary: Measures the width of a single character, falling back to the system typeface if the current one does not support it. Use it to find how wide one character is when laying out text.

name: measureSingleCharacterWithFeatures
description: Measures the width of a single character with font features. If the typeface of the current font does not support
summary: Measures the width of a single character with font features, falling back to the system typeface if the current one does not support it. Use it to find how wide one character is with specific font features.

name: measureText
description: Measures the text width.
summary: Measures how wide a piece of text is, returning the width as a number. Use it to work out how much space text will take before drawing it.

name: setScaleX
description: Sets a horizontal scale factor for this font.
summary: Stretches or squeezes text horizontally by a scale factor. Use it to make text wider or narrower when drawing labels or headings.

name: setSkewX
description: Sets a horizontal skew factor for this font.
summary: Slants text sideways by a skew factor. Use it to make text look italic or slanted when drawing it.

name: setEdging
description: Sets a font edging effect.
summary: Sets the edging effect used when drawing a font. Use it to control how smooth or sharp the edges of text look.

name: setHinting
description: Sets a font hinting effect.
summary: Sets the hinting effect used for a font. Use it to adjust how glyph shapes are fitted for clearer text.

name: countText
description: Obtains the number of glyphs represented by text.
summary: Counts how many glyphs a piece of text contains. Use it to measure text length before drawing or laying out words on screen.

name: setBaselineSnap
description: Sets whether to request that baselines be snapped to pixels when the current canvas matrix is axis aligned.
summary: Sets whether text baselines are snapped to whole pixels when the canvas is axis aligned. Use it to keep text looking crisp and sharp when drawing.

name: isBaselineSnap
description: Checks whether baselines are requested to be snapped to pixels when the current canvas matrix is axis aligned.
summary: Checks whether baselines are set to snap to pixels when the canvas is axis aligned. Use it to see if text baselines will be pixel-aligned.

name: setEmbeddedBitmaps
description: Sets whether to use bitmaps in this font.
summary: Sets whether bitmaps stored inside the font are used. Use it to control whether the font draws with its built-in bitmap images.

name: isEmbeddedBitmaps
description: Checks whether bitmaps are used in this font.
summary: Checks whether this font uses embedded bitmaps. Use it to find out if the font draws from bitmap images.

name: setForceAutoHinting
description: Sets whether to forcibly use auto hinting, that is, whether to always hint glyphs.
summary: Sets whether glyphs are always auto hinted. Use it to force extra shape adjustment so small text stays clear.

name: isForceAutoHinting
description: Checks whether auto hinting is forcibly used.
summary: Checks whether auto hinting is forcibly used for this font. Use it to find out if text rendering forces auto hinting.

name: getWidths
description: Obtains the width of each glyph in an array.
summary: Gets the width of each glyph in an array. Use it to measure how wide characters will be when laying out text.

name: textToGlyphs
description: Converts text into glyph indexes.
summary: Turns a text string into the glyph indexes used for drawing. Use it to get the glyphs needed to render or measure text.

name: isSubpixel
description: Checks whether sub-pixel rendering is used for a font.
summary: Checks whether sub-pixel rendering is used for a font. Use it to find out if the font renders text with sub-pixel precision.

name: isLinearMetrics
description: Checks whether linear scaling is used for this font.
summary: Checks whether linear scaling is used for this font. Use it to find out if the font scales text linearly.

name: getSkewX
description: Obtains the horizontal skew factor of this font.
summary: Gets the horizontal skew factor of this font, how slanted it is. Use it to check the slant applied to text when drawing text.

name: isEmbolden
description: Checks whether the bold effect is set for this font.
summary: Checks whether the bold effect is set for this font. Use it to tell if text will be drawn bold.

name: getScaleX
description: Obtains the horizontal scale ratio of this font.
summary: Gets the horizontal scale ratio of this font. Use it to check how stretched or squeezed text is horizontally when drawing text.

name: getHinting
description: Obtains the font hinting effect.
summary: Gets the font hinting effect, the adjustment that sharpens text at small sizes. Use it to check how text is tuned for clearer rendering.

name: getEdging
description: Obtains the font edging effect.
summary: Gets the font edging effect, the smoothing applied to the edges of drawn text. Use it to check how smooth or sharp text edges will look when drawing text.

name: createPathForGlyph
description: Obtains the outline path of a glyph.
summary: Gets the outline path of a single glyph. Use it to draw or animate the shape of a letter or character.

name: getBounds
description: Obtains the rectangular bounding box of each glyph in an array.
summary: Gets the rectangular bounding box around each glyph in an array. Use it to measure where drawn characters will appear on screen.

name: getTextPath
params: text: string, byteLength: number, x: number, y: number
description: Obtains the outline path of a text.
summary: Gets the outline path of a piece of text at a given position. Use it to draw text as a shape or outline.

name: getTextPathWithFallback
params: text: string, byteLength: number, x: number, y: number
description: Gets the path outline for the given text with font fallback support.
summary: Gets the outline path for text, using fallback fonts for characters the main font lacks. Use it to turn text into a shape you can draw or measure.

name: setThemeFontFollowed
description: Sets whether to follow the theme font. When **followed** is set to **true**, the theme font is used if it is
summary: Chooses whether text uses the system theme font when no other typeface is set. Use it to keep text matching the device's theme look.

name: isThemeFontFollowed
description: Checks whether the font follows the theme font. By default, the font follows the theme font.
summary: Checks whether the font follows the theme font, which it does by default. Use it to find out if the font follows the theme font.

name: createImageLattice

name: createCornerPathEffect

summary: Rounds off the sharp corners where line segments meet, using a given radius. Use it to soften the hard angles of a drawn shape.

name: createDiscretePathEffect
