summary: Breaks a path into segments and scatters them irregularly along the path. Use it to give a line a rough, hand-drawn or jittery look.

name: createComposePathEffect
description: Creates a path effect by sequentially applying the inner effect and then the outer effect.
summary: Combines two path effects so the first is applied and then the second on top. Use it to stack two line styles, such as dashes with rounded corners, on one shape.

name: createPathDashEffect
params: path: Path, advance: number, phase: number, style: PathDashStyle

summary: Creates a dashed path effect where each dash is shaped by a given path. Use it to draw dashed outlines with custom dash shapes.

name: createSumPathEffect
description: Creates an overlay path effect based on two distinct path effects. Different from **createComposePathEffect**,
summary: Creates an overlay path effect by applying two path effects separately and drawing them on top of each other. Use it to combine two outline styles in one drawing.

name: createColorShader
description: Creates a **ShaderEffect** object with a single color.
summary: Creates a shader effect filled with a single colour. Use it to paint shapes or text with one solid colour.

name: createLinearGradient

name: createRadialGradient
params: centerPt: common2D.Point, radius: double, colors: Array<int>, mode: TileMode, pos?: Array<double> | null, matrix?: Matrix | null
description: Creates a **ShaderEffect** object that generates a radial gradient based on the center and radius of a circle. A
summary: Fills shapes with a colour blend spreading outward from the centre of a circle. Use it to paint a glowing spot or a round colour fade.

name: createSweepGradient
params: centerPt: common2D.Point, colors: Array<number>, mode: TileMode, startAngle: number, endAngle: number, pos?: Array<number> | null, matrix?: Matrix | null

summary: Fills shapes with colours that sweep around a centre point from a start angle to an end angle. Use it to paint a colour wheel or a circular rainbow effect.

name: createBlendModeColorFilter

name: createComposeColorFilter

summary: Creates a color filter by applying one color filter and then another on top of it. Use it to stack two color effects, such as a tint followed by a brightness change.

name: createLinearToSRGBGamma
description: Creates a **ColorFilter** object that applies the sRGB gamma curve to the RGB channels.
summary: Creates a color filter that applies the sRGB gamma curve to the red, green, and blue channels. Use it to correct colors so they look right on standard screens.

name: createSRGBGammaToLinear
description: Creates a **ColorFilter** object that applies the RGB channels to the sRGB gamma curve.
summary: Creates a color filter that applies the sRGB gamma curve to the RGB channels. Use it to convert colors to a linear gamma for correct blending or image processing.

name: createLumaColorFilter
description: Creates a **ColorFilter** object that multiplies the luma into the alpha channel and sets the RGB channels to
summary: Creates a color filter that puts brightness into the alpha channel and sets red, green, and blue to zero. Use it to make a brightness-based mask or silhouette.

name: createMatrixColorFilter
description: Creates a color filter object with a 4*5 color matrix.
summary: Creates a color filter from a 4 by 5 color matrix. Use it to shift colors precisely, such as adjusting saturation, hue, or contrast.

name: createLightingColorFilter
params: mutColor: common2D.Color | number, addColor: common2D.Color | number
description: Creates a lighting color filter. It multiplies the RGB channel values by one color and then adds another color
summary: Creates a color filter that multiplies colors by one color and then adds another, keeping results in range. Use it to brighten, darken, or tint an image.

name: createBlurImageFilter

summary: Creates an image filter that applies a Gaussian blur with given horizontal and vertical strength and edge tiling. Use it to blur an image or picture.

name: createFromColorFilter
description: Creates an image filter object with a given color filter effect.
summary: Creates an image filter that applies a color filter effect. Use it to recolor or tint an image.

name: createOffsetImageFilter

summary: Creates an image filter from a given image. Use it to draw or blend one image onto another.

name: createComposeImageFilter
description: Cascades two image filters to create a new image filter. The first filter's output becomes the second filter's
summary: Chains two image filters so the first one's result is fed into the second. Use it to stack effects, such as blurring an image and then shifting its colors.

name: createFromShaderEffect
description: Creates an **ImageFilter** object based on a shader.
summary: Creates an image filter that renders the contents of a shader. Use it to apply a shader pattern or effect to an image.

name: setMiterLimit

summary: Sets the largest allowed ratio of a sharp corner's length to the line width. Use it to control when sharp corners become beveled instead of pointed when outlining a shape.

name: setShaderEffect
description: Sets the shader effect for this pen.

name: setColor
description: Sets a color for this pen.
summary: Sets the color of a pen used to outline shapes. Use it to choose what color your drawn outlines appear in.

name: setColor4f
description: Sets the color and standard color gamut for this pen. The difference between this method and
summary: Sets the color and color range of a pen used to outline shapes, with color values given as decimals. Use it when you need precise color control for drawn outlines.

name: getColor
description: Obtains the color of this pen.
summary: Gets the color of a pen used to outline a shape. Use it to find out what color an outline will be drawn in.

name: getColor4f

summary: Gets the pen color as floating point numbers. Use it when you need the outline color with decimal precision.

name: getHexColor

name: setStrokeWidth

summary: Sets how thick the pen's outline stroke is, with values below 1 drawn as 1 pixel wide. Use it to make drawn lines and shape outlines thicker or thinner.

name: getWidth
description: Obtains the stroke width of this pen. The width describes the thickness of the outline of a shape.
summary: Gets the stroke width of a pen, which is how thick the outline of a shape is. Use it to check how thick the line drawn around a shape will be.

name: setAntiAlias
description: Enables anti-aliasing for this pen. Anti-aliasing makes the edges of the content smoother. If this API is not
summary: Turns smoothing on or off for a pen's outline, making drawn edges look smoother. Use it when drawing shapes and you want clean, non-jagged outlines.

description: Sets an alpha value for this pen.

name: getAlpha

name: setColorFilter

summary: Sets a color filter on a pen so its outline colors are altered, or clears the filter. Use it to change or tint the colors of drawn outlines.

name: getColorFilter
description: Obtains the color filter of this pen.
summary: Gets the color filter applied to a pen. Use it to check how an outline's colors are being altered.

name: setImageFilter
description: Sets an image filter for this pen.
summary: Sets an image filter on the pen, or clears it by passing null. Use it to give the outline of a shape an image-filter look.

name: setMaskFilter
description: Adds a mask filter for this pen.
summary: Adds a mask filter to the pen, or clears it by passing null. Use it to give the outline of a shape a masked, softened effect.

name: setPathEffect
description: Sets the path effect for this pen.
summary: Sets a path effect on the pen, or clears it by passing null. Use it to change how the outline path of a shape is drawn.

name: setShadowLayer
description: Sets a shadow layer for this pen. The shadow layer effect takes effect only when text is drawn.
summary: Sets a shadow layer on a pen, which shows as a shadow when text is drawn. Use it to give drawn text a drop shadow.

name: setBlendMode

summary: Sets how a pen's outline blends with what is already drawn underneath. Use it to control how drawn lines mix with existing content.

name: setDither

summary: Turns dithering on or off for the pen so drawn colors look more realistic. Use it when outlining shapes and you want smoother, more natural color.

summary: Sets how the corners where lines of a shape meet are joined. Use it to choose between mitered, rounded, or beveled corners when outlining a shape.

name: getJoinStyle
description: Obtains the join style of this pen.
summary: Gets the corner join style of a pen, which controls how the corners of an outlined shape look. Use it to check how sharp or rounded the corners of a drawn outline are.

summary: Sets the shape of the ends of lines drawn with a pen, such as flat or rounded. Use it when drawing lines and you want the line ends to look a certain way.

name: getCapStyle
description: Obtains the cap style of this pen.
summary: Gets the cap style of a pen, which is how the ends of an outlined line look. Use it to check whether a drawn line has flat, round, or square ends.

name: reset

summary: Resets a pen back to its initial state. Use it to clear all pen settings and start drawing outlines with default style again.

summary: Sets the brush's fill color and the color range it belongs to. Use it when you need precise color values or a specific color standard for filling shapes.

name: getColor

summary: Gets the color currently set on a brush used to fill shapes. Use it to read back the fill color before drawing or changing it.

name: getColor4f
description: Obtains the brush color. The difference between this method and [getColor]{@link drawing.Brush#getColor()} is
summary: Gets the brush color as floating-point values instead of whole numbers. Use it when you need precise color values for filling shapes.

name: getHexColor
description: Obtains the color of this brush.
summary: Gets the brush color as a hexadecimal number. Use it to read the fill color in hex form for drawing shapes.

summary: Turns smoothing on or off for the brush so the edges of filled shapes look less jagged. Use it when drawing shapes and you want clean, smooth outlines.

name: isAntiAlias
description: Checks whether anti-aliasing is enabled for this brush.
summary: Checks whether anti-aliasing is turned on for a brush. Use it to see if shape edges will be smoothed when filling.

name: setAlpha

name: getAlpha
description: Obtains the alpha value of this brush.
summary: Reads the transparency value of a brush, from fully transparent to fully opaque. Use it to check how see-through a brush's color is before drawing.

name: setColorFilter

summary: Attaches a color filter to the brush, or clears it by passing nothing. Use it to shift or tint the colors of shapes you fill.

name: getColorFilter

summary: Gets the color filter applied to a brush. Use it to check what color effect is set before filling a shape.

name: setImageFilter
description: Sets an image filter for this brush.

name: setMaskFilter

name: setShaderEffect

name: setBlendMode

summary: Sets how the brush's color mixes with what is already drawn underneath. Use it to control whether a filled shape covers, blends with, or lightens the colors below it.

name: reset

summary: Returns a brush to its starting state, clearing any color or settings. Use it to reuse a brush for a fresh fill.

summary: Checks whether a matrix only moves, turns, or scales things without skewing. Use it to confirm a drawing transform is a simple move, rotation, or zoom.

name: setScale

name: setTranslation

summary: Moves a drawing horizontally and vertically by given distances. Use it to shift an image to a new position.

name: setSkew

summary: Tilts a drawing along the X or Y axis by given amounts. Use it to slant an image for a skewed look.

name: setSinCos

name: setMatrix
description: Sets parameters for this matrix.
summary: Replaces the current matrix with values from a nine-number array that sets scaling, skew, translation, and perspective. Use it to apply a specific transformation to a drawing.

name: setConcat

name: postConcat

name: preConcat
description: Preconcats the existing matrix with the passed-in matrix.
summary: Combines the current matrix with another matrix by multiplying them. Use it to stack transformations like move, rotate, or scale in a drawing.

name: isEqual
description: Checks whether two **OH_Drawing_Matrix** objects are equal.
summary: Checks whether two matrices are the same. Use it to tell if two drawings have the same position, rotation, and scale.

name: invert
description: Inverts this matrix and returns the result.
summary: Reverses a matrix so it undoes the original transformation. Use it to undo a rotation, scale, or move applied to a drawing.

name: isIdentity
description: Checks whether an **OH_Drawing_Matrix** object is an identity matrix:
summary: Checks whether a matrix leaves everything unchanged. Use it to tell if a drawing has no move, rotation, or scale applied.

name: getValue
description: Obtains a matrix value of a given index, which ranges from 0 to 8.
summary: Returns one value from the matrix at a given index from 0 to 8. Use it to check a single part of a transform, such as scale or rotation.

summary: Rotates the matrix by a given angle around a chosen point. Use it to spin a drawing or image clockwise or counterclockwise on screen.

summary: Scales the matrix by given factors around a chosen point. Use it to make a drawing or image bigger, smaller, or mirrored.

name: postTranslate

summary: Moves the matrix by a given horizontal and vertical distance. Use it to shift a drawing or image to a new position on screen.

name: preRotate

summary: Rotates the matrix by a given angle around a chosen point. Use it to turn a drawing or shape clockwise or counterclockwise.

summary: Scales the matrix by given factors around a chosen point. Use it to make a drawing bigger or smaller, or to mirror it.

name: preTranslate

summary: Moves the matrix by a given horizontal and vertical distance. Use it to shift a drawing left, right, up, or down.

name: preSkew
params: kx: double, ky: double, px: double, py: double
description: Left-multiply the existing matrix by a skew transformation matrix.
summary: Tilts the matrix along the X or Y axis. Use it to slant a drawing for a skewed or italic look.

name: reset
description: Resets this matrix to an identity matrix.
summary: Resets a matrix back to its identity state, clearing any rotation, scaling, or translation. Use it to start fresh before applying new transformations to a drawing.

name: mapPoints
description: Maps a source point array to a destination point array by means of matrix transformation.
summary: Moves a set of points through a matrix to get their new positions. Use it to find where points land after a drawing is moved, turned, or scaled.

name: mapRadius
description: Returns the average radius of the ellipse formed after a circle with the specified **radius** is mapped by the
summary: Gives the average radius of the ellipse a circle becomes after a matrix is applied. Use it to find how big a round shape looks after scaling or turning.

name: getAll
description: Obtains all element values of this matrix.
summary: Returns all nine values of the matrix as an array. Use it to read the full transform, such as position, scale, and rotation.

name: mapRect
description: Sets the destination rectangle to the bounding rectangle of the shape obtained after transforming the source
summary: Finds the smallest upright rectangle that contains a source rectangle after a matrix transformation. Use it to know where a rotated or skewed shape ends up on screen.

name: setRectToRect
params: src: common2D.Rect, dst: common2D.Rect, scaleToFit: ScaleToFit

summary: Builds a transformation that maps one rectangle onto another, with a chosen fit mode. Use it to scale or position an image so it fits a target area.

name: setPolyToPoly

description: Sets this matrix to a transformation matrix that maps the source point array to the destination point array. Both
summary: Builds a transformation that maps up to four source points onto matching destination points. Use it to warp or align a shape so its corners land where you want.

name: isEqual
description: Checks whether another region is equal to this region.
summary: Checks whether two regions cover exactly the same area. Use it to compare two shapes' drawable areas.

name: isComplex
description: Checks whether this region contains multiple rectangles.
summary: Checks whether a region is made of more than one rectangle. Use it to tell if a region has a simple or complex shape.

name: isEmpty
description: Checks whether the existing region is empty.
summary: Checks whether a region has no area. Use it to tell if a shape's drawable area is empty before drawing.

name: getBounds
description: Obtains the boundaries of the existing region.
summary: Gets the smallest rectangle that encloses a region. Use it to find the bounding box of a shape's drawable area.

name: getBoundaryPath
description: Obtains a new path that is the boundary of the existing region.
summary: Gets the outline of a region as a path. Use it to draw or trace the edge of a shape's drawable area.

name: isPointContained
description: Checks whether a point is contained in this region.
summary: Checks whether a point lies inside a region. Use it to tell if a tap or touch position falls within a drawn shape.

name: isRegionContained
description: Checks whether another region is contained in this region.
summary: Checks whether one region lies entirely inside another. Use it to tell if a drawn shape is fully covered by another area.

name: op
description: Performs an operation on this region and another region, and stores the resulting region in this **Region**
summary: Combines this region with another using an operation and keeps the result here. Use it to merge, intersect, or subtract drawn shapes.

name: offset
description: Translates a region.
summary: Moves a region by given horizontal and vertical amounts. Use it to shift a drawn shape to a new position.

name: quickReject

summary: Checks whether a rectangle does not overlap a region, using the region's bounding rectangle. Use it to quickly skip drawing or hit-testing shapes that are outside a given area.

name: quickRejectRegion
description: Checks whether the existing region does not intersect with another region. Actually, the outer rectangles of the
summary: Checks whether two regions do not overlap, comparing their outer rectangles. Use it to quickly skip work when two drawn areas are far apart.

name: setPath
description: Sets a region that matches the outline of a path within the cropping area.
summary: Sets a region to match the outline of a path inside a clipping area. Use it to make a drawing area follow a shape's outline.

name: setRect
params: left: int, top: int, right: int, bottom: int
description: Sets a rectangle.
summary: Sets a region to a rectangle given by its left, top, right, and bottom edges. Use it to define a rectangular drawing area.

name: setRegion
description: Sets the existing region to another region.
summary: Copies another region into this one. Use it to reuse an existing drawing area for a new region.

name: setEmpty
description: Set the existing region to empty.
summary: Clears a region so it covers nothing. Use it to reset a drawing area before setting new bounds.

name: isRect
description: Checks whether this region is the same as a single rectangle.
summary: Checks whether a region is exactly one rectangle. Use it to tell if a drawn area is a simple rectangle rather than a complex shape.

name: quickContains
params: left: int, top: int, right: int, bottom: int
description: Checks whether this region is the same as a single rectangle and contains the specified rectangle.
summary: Checks whether a region is a single rectangle that contains the given rectangle. Use it to quickly test if a rectangular area fits inside a drawn shape.

name: makeColorFromResourceColor
description: Converts a color value of the **ResourceColor** type to a **common2D.Color** object.
summary: Turns a resource color value into a plain color object. Use it to get a usable color from a defined resource.

name: makeEmpty
description: Creates a rectangle with the top, bottom, left, and right boundary coordinates all being **0**.
summary: Creates a rectangle whose top, bottom, left, and right edges are all zero. Use it as a starting blank rectangle to fill in later.

name: makeLtrb
params: left: number, top: number, right: number, bottom: number
description: Creates a rectangle with specified top, bottom, left, and right boundaries.
summary: Creates a rectangle from given left, top, right, and bottom edge positions. Use it to define a specific area on screen, such as a button or image region.

name: makeCopy
description: Copies a rectangle.
summary: Creates a separate copy of a rectangle so changes to one do not affect the other. Use it to keep an original rectangle safe while editing a duplicate.

name: getWidth
description: Obtains the width of a rectangle.
summary: Gets the width of a rectangle. Use it to measure how wide a shape or area is on screen.

name: getHeight
description: Obtains the height of a rectangle.
summary: Gets the height of a rectangle. Use it to measure how tall a shape or area is on screen.

name: centerX
description: Obtains the X coordinate of the rectangle center.
summary: Gets the x coordinate at the horizontal centre of a rectangle. Use it to find the middle of a rectangle, such as to place something centred on it.

name: centerY
description: Obtains the Y coordinate of the rectangle center.
summary: Finds the Y coordinate of a rectangle's center point. Use it to locate the middle of a shape on screen, for example to place something at the vertical center of a box.

name: contains
description: Checks whether a rectangle completely contains another rectangle.
summary: Checks whether one rectangle completely contains another rectangle. Use it to test if a shape or area fully sits inside another, such as whether a button lies within a panel.

name: inset
params: rect: common2D.Rect, left: double, top: double, right: double, bottom: double
description: Adds the input left, top, right, and bottom values to the left, top, right, and bottom boundaries of a specified
summary: Shrinks or grows a rectangle by adding values to its left, top, right, and bottom edges. Use it to make a shape smaller or larger, such as adding padding around a box.

name: intersect
description: Calculates the intersection of two rectangles and updates the intersection result to the rectangle represented by
summary: Finds where two rectangles overlap and updates the first rectangle to that overlapping area. Use it to get the shared region of two shapes, such as the visible part of a clipped view.

name: isIntersect
description: Checks whether two rectangles intersect.
summary: Checks whether two rectangles overlap with real area, not just touching edges or corners. Use it to detect when two on-screen areas collide.

name: union
description: Calculates the union of two rectangles and updates the union result to the rectangle represented by the first
summary: Combines two rectangles into one that covers both, updating the first rectangle. Use it to merge overlapping areas into a single bounding box.

name: isEmpty
description: Checks whether a rectangle is empty (the left boundary is greater than or equal to the right boundary or the top
summary: Checks whether a rectangle has no area, such as when its edges cross or touch. Use it to skip drawing or handling shapes that would not show anything.

name: offset
params: rect: common2D.Rect, dx: double, dy: double
description: Translates a rectangle.
summary: Moves a rectangle left, right, up or down by given amounts. Use it to shift a drawn shape or layout box to a new position.

name: offsetTo
params: rect: common2D.Rect, newLeft: double, newTop: double
description: Translates a rectangle to a specified position.
summary: Moves a rectangle so its top-left corner sits at a chosen position. Use it to place a shape or layout box at exact coordinates.

name: setRect
description: Assigns the existing rectangle with another rectangle.
summary: Copies one rectangle's boundaries onto another rectangle. Use it to make a rectangle match an existing one.

name: setLtrb
params: rect: common2D.Rect, left: double, top: double, right: double, bottom: double
description: Updates the top, bottom, left, and right boundary values of the existing rectangle using the input top, bottom,
summary: Sets a rectangle's left, top, right and bottom boundary values. Use it to define the exact size and position of a shape or layout box.

name: setEmpty
description: Sets the left, right, top, and bottom boundaries of the rectangle to **0**.
summary: Resets a rectangle's left, right, top and bottom boundaries to zero. Use it to clear a rectangle before reusing it.

name: sort
description: If the rectangle is reversed (that is, the left boundary is greater than the right boundary or the top boundary
summary: Swaps a rectangle's boundaries when they are reversed so left is less than right and top is less than bottom. Use it to fix an upside-down or backwards rectangle before drawing.

name: isEqual
description: Checks whether two rectangles are equal.
summary: Checks whether two rectangles have the same position and size. Use it to tell if two areas on screen match exactly.

name: negate
description: Negates the point's coordinates.
summary: Flips a point's coordinates to their opposite values. Use it to mirror a point's position across the origin.

name: offset
params: point: common2D.Point, dx: double, dy: double
description: Offsets the point's coordinates by dx, dy.
summary: Moves a point by given distances along the x and y axes. Use it to shift a point's position on screen.

name: getGlobalInstance
description: Obtains a global **FontCollection** instance.
summary: Gets the shared global font collection. Use it to draw text with fonts anywhere in an app.

name: getLocalInstance
description: Obtains the local **FontCollection** instance. This API is recommended for widgets.
summary: Gets a font collection for the current widget. Use it to draw text in a widget with its own fonts.

name: loadFontSync
description: Loads a custom font. This API returns the result synchronously. In this API, **name** specifies the alias of the
summary: Loads a custom font file right away so text can be drawn with it. Use it to display text in your own TTF or OTF font.

name: loadFont
description: Loads the custom font. This API uses a promise to return the result. In this API, **name** specifies the alias of
summary: Loads a custom font file so text can be drawn with it. Use it to display text in your own TTF or OTF font.

name: loadFontSyncWithCheck
params: name: string, path: string | Resource, index?: int
description: Loads a custom font. This API returns the result synchronously. In this API, **name** specifies the alias of the
summary: Loads a custom font file right away, including TTC files, so text can be drawn with it. Use it to display text in your own font.

name: loadFontWithCheck
params: name: string, path: string | Resource, index?: int
description: Loads a custom font. This API uses a promise to return the result. In this API, **name** specifies the alias of
summary: Loads a custom font file (TTF, OTF, or TTC) under a chosen name so text can use it. Use it to add your own font for displaying styled text.

name: unloadFontSync
description: Uninstalls a specified custom font. This API is synchronous.
summary: Removes a previously loaded custom font by its name immediately, so it is no longer available. Use it to stop using a custom font you added.

name: unloadFont
description: Uninstalls a specified custom font. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Removes a previously loaded custom font by its name so it is no longer available. Use it to stop using a custom font you added.

name: clearCaches
description: Clears the font cache. (The font cache has a memory limit and a clearing mechanism. It occupies limited memory.
summary: Clears the stored font cache to free up memory. Use it only when you need to reclaim memory used by fonts.

name: setParagraphCachesEnabled
description: Sets whether to enable the typesetting paragraph caching. Typesetting paragraph caching can accelerate the
summary: Turns typesetting paragraph caching on or off, which speeds up repeated text layout but uses extra memory. Use it to make repeated text layout faster or to save memory.

name: layoutWithConstraints
description: Performs layout with the given height and width and calculates the positions of all glyphs.
summary: Arranges text within a given width and height and reports the resulting size and character range. Use it to fit text into a fixed area before drawing.

name: layoutSync
description: Performs layout and calculates the positions of all glyphs.
summary: Calculates the positions of all glyphs within a maximum line width, finishing before returning. Use it to arrange text before drawing it on screen.

name: layout
description: Performs layout and calculates the positions of all glyphs. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Calculates the positions of all glyphs within a maximum line width. Use it to arrange text before drawing it on screen.

name: paint
params: canvas: drawing.Canvas, x: double, y: double
description: Paints the text on the canvas with the coordinate point (x, y) as the upper left corner.
summary: Draws the text onto a canvas starting at a chosen corner point. Use it to show laid-out text on screen.

name: paintOnPath
params: canvas: drawing.Canvas, path: drawing.Path, hOffset: double, vOffset: double
description: Draws text along a path on the canvas.
summary: Draws text following a curved or shaped path on a canvas. Use it to make text run along a curve or outline.

name: getMaxWidth
description: Obtains the maximum width of the line in the text.
summary: Gives the maximum line width of the text in pixels. Use it to measure how wide the text can be when drawn.

name: getHeight
description: Obtains the total height of the text.
summary: Gets the total height of the text. Use it to find how tall a block of text is when laying out a page or screen.

name: getLongestLine
description: Obtains the longest line in the text.
summary: Finds the longest line in the text and gives its length in pixels. Use it to measure how wide the text will be when drawn.

name: getLongestLineWithIndent
description: Obtains the width of the longest line, including its indentation, in the text. You are advised to round up the
summary: Finds the width of the longest line in the text, counting its indentation, in pixels. Use it to measure the space the text needs when drawn.

name: getMinIntrinsicWidth
description: Obtains the minimum intrinsic width of the paragraph.
summary: Gives the minimum intrinsic width of the paragraph in pixels. Use it to find the narrowest the text can be without breaking words.

name: getMaxIntrinsicWidth
description: Obtains the maximum intrinsic width of the paragraph.
summary: Gives the maximum intrinsic width of the paragraph in pixels. Use it to find the widest the text naturally wants to be.

name: getAlphabeticBaseline
description: Obtains the alphabetic baseline.
summary: Gives the alphabetic baseline of laid-out text, in pixels. Use it to line up text or other elements along the text baseline.

name: getIdeographicBaseline
description: Obtains the ideographic baseline.
summary: Gets the ideographic baseline of the text. Use it to line up East Asian characters correctly when drawing or positioning text.

name: getRectsForRange
params: range: Range, widthStyle: RectWidthStyle, heightStyle: RectHeightStyle
description: Obtains the rectangles occupied by the characters in the range of the text under the given rectangle width and
summary: Gives the rectangles the characters in a chosen text range occupy, at a chosen width and height. Use it to highlight or measure a piece of text.

name: getRectsForPlaceholders
description: Obtains the rectangles occupied by all placeholders in the text.
summary: Gives the rectangles taken up by all placeholders in the text. Use it to find where placeholder boxes sit when laying out text.

name: getGlyphPositionAtCoordinate
description: Obtains the position of a glyph closest to the given coordinates.
summary: Finds the glyph closest to a given point in the text area. Use it to turn a tap or click location into a glyph position in laid-out text.

name: getWordBoundary
description: Obtains the range of the word where the glyph with a given offset is located.
summary: Gives the range of the word containing the glyph at a given offset. Use it to select or highlight a whole word where the user tapped.

name: getLineCount
description: Obtains the number of text lines.
summary: Counts how many lines the text takes up. Use it to know how many lines a paragraph has when arranging a layout.

name: getLineHeight
description: Obtains the height of a given line.
summary: Gets the height of one line of text by its index. Use it to space lines evenly when drawing a paragraph.

name: getLineWidth
description: Obtains the width of a given line.
summary: Gets the width of one line of text by its index. Use it to check how wide a line is when fitting text into a layout.

name: didExceedMaxLines
description: Checks whether the number of lines in the paragraph exceeds the maximum.
summary: Checks whether a paragraph has more lines than its maximum. Use it to tell if text was cut off or overflowed.

name: getTextLines
description: Obtains all the text lines.
summary: Gives all the lines of text in a paragraph. Use it to work with each line when laying out or drawing text.

name: getActualTextRange
description: Obtains the actually visible text range in the specified line, excluding any overflow ellipsis.
summary: Finds which characters are actually shown on a given line of laid-out text, optionally counting spaces, and leaves out any overflow ellipsis. Use it to tell what text is visible on a line.

name: getLineMetrics
description: Obtains an array of line measurement information.
summary: Gets measurement details for the lines of text. Use it to inspect line positions and sizes when laying out or drawing text.

name: updateColor
description: Updates the color of the entire text span. This API call also updates the decoration color if it hasn't been set
summary: Changes the color of all the text, and of its decoration if none was set. Use it to recolor text without rebuilding it.

name: updateDecoration
description: Updates the decoration line of the entire text span.
summary: Changes the decoration line, such as an underline or strikethrough, for all the text in a paragraph. Use it to add or change underlines and similar lines under text.

name: getCharacterRangeForGlyphRange
description: Obtains the character range corresponding to the specified glyph range.
summary: Finds which characters correspond to a given range of glyphs. Use it to map drawn glyphs back to the text characters they represent.

name: getGlyphRangeForCharacterRange
description: Obtains the glyph range corresponding to the specified character range.
summary: Finds which glyphs correspond to a given range of characters. Use it to map a selection of text characters to the glyphs that are drawn for them.

name: getCharacterPositionAtCoordinate
params: x: double, y: double, encoding: drawing.TextEncoding
description: Obtains the character position information closest to the given coordinates.
summary: Finds the character position closest to a given point in the text area. Use it to turn a tap or click location into a text position, such as placing a cursor.

name: getProcessState
description: Obtains the text processing status of a paragraph.
summary: Tells you how far a paragraph's text processing has got. Use it to check whether text is ready to lay out or draw.

name: getTextDisplayState
description: Obtains the text display status of a paragraph.
summary: Gets the display status of a paragraph of text. Use it to check how a paragraph is currently shown.

name: getParagraphStyle
description: Obtains the style configuration of a paragraph.
summary: Gives the style settings of the paragraph, such as its text look. Use it to check how the text is styled before drawing it.

name: getVisibleTextRanges
description: Obtains the range of text that is visible on the screen in a paragraph. Excludes text that is not displayed due
summary: Gives the ranges of text actually shown on screen, leaving out text cut off by line limits or ellipsis. Use it to find what text the reader can see.

name: forceReuseRasterResult
description: Whether to force reuse the rasterization result.
summary: Sets whether to force reuse of a paragraph's rasterization result. Use it to keep text rendering cached instead of updating it.

name: getLineBreak
description: Obtains the number of characters that can fit in the layout from the specified position within a limited width.
summary: Tells how many characters fit from a given position within a set width. Use it to wrap text so each line fits the space available.

name: createLine
description: Generates a text line object based on the specified layout range.
summary: Creates a text line object for a chosen range of characters so its layout can be measured. Use it to lay out and position a line of text on screen.

name: pushStyle
description: Applies a new style to the current text blob.
summary: Applies a new style to the current text blob, such as font, size, color, weight, spacing, underline, strikethrough, or shadow. Use it to style a piece of text.

name: popStyle
description: Restores the previous text style.
summary: Restores the previous text style. Use it to undo the last style change when building styled text.

name: addText
description: Inserts a text string into the paragraph being built.
summary: Inserts a text string into the paragraph being built. Use it to add the words that make up a paragraph before drawing it.

name: addPlaceholder
description: Inserts a placeholder into the paragraph being built.
summary: Inserts a placeholder into the paragraph being built, describing its size, alignment, and baseline. Use it to reserve space for an image or other object inside text.

name: build
description: Creates a paragraph object that can be used for subsequent layout and rendering.
summary: Creates a paragraph object from the text and content added so far, ready for layout and drawing. Use it to turn built-up text into something you can lay out and render.

name: buildLineTypeset
description: Builds a line typesetter.
summary: Builds a line typesetter from the paragraph content. Use it to lay out and render text line by line.

name: addSymbol
description: Inserts a symbol into the paragraph being built.
summary: Inserts a symbol into the paragraph being built, chosen by its symbol code. Use it to place an icon or symbol character within text.

name: getGlyphCount
description: Obtains the number of glyphs in this text line.
summary: Counts how many glyphs make up a text line. Use it to measure a line of text, for example when fitting or laying out words on screen.

name: getTextRange
description: Obtains the range of the text in this text line in the entire paragraph.
summary: Finds where a line of text sits inside the whole paragraph. Use it to locate or highlight a line of text.

name: getGlyphRuns
description: Obtains the array of glyph runs in the text line.
summary: Gets the runs of glyphs that make up a text line. Use it to inspect or draw the pieces of a rendered line of text.

name: paint
params: canvas: drawing.Canvas, x: double, y: double
description: Paints this text line on the canvas with the coordinate point (x, y) as the upper left corner.
summary: Draws a line of text on a canvas starting at a given corner point. Use it to show a line of text on screen.

name: createTruncatedLine
params: width: double, ellipsisMode: EllipsisMode, ellipsis: string
description: Creates a truncated text line object.
summary: Creates a shortened text line that fits a given width, with a marker string showing where it was cut. Use it to fit a line of text into a narrow space, like a label or list row.

name: getTypographicBounds
description: Obtains the typographic boundaries of the text line. These boundaries depend on the typographic font and font
summary: Gives the typographic boundaries of a line of text, based on font and size rather than the characters. Use it to lay out or align lines of text.

name: getImageBounds
description: Obtains the image boundaries of this text line. The image boundaries, equivalent to visual boundaries, depend on
summary: Gives the visible boundary box of a text line, ignoring leading and trailing spaces. Use it to place or measure text tightly when drawing words on screen.

summary: Gets the character indices for glyphs in a range of a text run, as offsets from the whole paragraph. Use it to map glyphs back to characters when selecting or editing text.

name: getStringRange
description: Obtains the range of glyphs generated by this run.

description: Obtains the typographic boundaries of the typographic unit. These boundaries are associated with the typographic
summary: Gets the typographic boundaries of a run of text, including spaces at the start and end. Use it to measure how much room a line of text takes up.

summary: Gets the visible image boundaries of a text layout unit, excluding leading and trailing spaces. Use it to find the exact area text occupies when drawing or aligning text.

summary: Finds all system fonts that match a given font description. Use it to look up which fonts are available for your text.

name: getFontDescriptorsFromPath

name: isFontSupported

summary: Checks whether the system supports a given font file. Use it to find out if a font can be used before displaying text with it.

name: getFontUnicodeSet

name: getFontCount

name: hdrBrightnessRatio

name: variableRadiusBlur

name: backgroundColorBlender

name: borderLight

name: colorGradient

name: liquidMaterial

summary: Applies a liquid material visual effect to a component. Use it to give a UI element a flowing, liquid-like appearance.

name: distortionCollapse
description: Sets distortion collapse effect.

summary: Sets up how the app records its events, such as turning logging on or limiting file size. Use it to control event logging for your app.

summary: Exports system events in batches and saves them as a file in the app's cache directory. Use it to collect system event logs for later review or analysis.

summary: Subscribes to occasional or low-frequency real-time system events and saves them as a file in the app's cache directory. Use it to capture system events for monitoring or debugging.

summary: Registers a callback that tells you when application trace capture is turned on or off. Use it to react when performance tracing starts or stops.

summary: Checks whether a given rule is already in the set of added rules. Use it to confirm a check is active before relying on it.

summary: Checks whether a given rule is already in the set of added rules. Use it to confirm a check is active before relying on it.

name: getOutputDir

summary: Releases resources and clears the running status when the system service finishes disconnecting. Use it to clean up when a fault notification connection ends.

summary: Writes a custom application event that can later be subscribed to. Use it to record your own events for logging and analysis.

summary: Attaches custom parameters to an event, linking them by event domain and name. Use it to add your own details to crash, freeze, or resource leak reports.

summary: Sets how many event records are fetched at a time from a subscription. Use it to control the batch size when reading subscribed events.

summary: Gets the list of registered objects that were not reclaimed after garbage collection, marking them as leaked. Use it to find memory leaks in your app's objects.

summary: Listens for audio interruption events, such as when another app takes over the audio focus during recording. Use it to pause or adjust recording when a phone call or other audio interrupts it.

name: onMarkReach
description: Subscribes to mark reached events. When the number of frames captured reaches the value of the frame parameter,
summary: Listens for a mark-reached event, triggered when the number of captured frames reaches a set value. Use it to be notified at a specific point during recording.

name: off
description: Unsubscribes from the mark reached event. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the result.
summary: Stops listening for changes to the audio capturer's settings. Use it when you no longer need to be told that recording settings changed.

name: offMarkReach
description: Unsubscribes from the mark reached events.
summary: Stops listening for the mark-reached event during recording. Use it when you no longer need to be told that a set number of captured frames was reached.

name: onPeriodReach
description: Subscribes to period reached events. When the period of frame capturing reaches the value of frame parameter,
summary: Notifies you when a set amount of audio has been captured. Use it to track recording progress or trigger actions at regular capture intervals.

name: offPeriodReach
description: Unsubscribes from period reached events.
summary: Stops listening for the period-reached event during recording. Use it when you no longer need to be told that each set number of captured frames was reached.

name: onStateChange
description: Subscribes audio state change event callback.
summary: Notifies you when the audio capture state changes. Use it to know when recording starts, stops, or changes state.

name: offStateChange
description: Unsubscribes audio state change event callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes in the audio capturer's state. Use it to stop being notified when recording starts, pauses, or stops.

name: onAudioInterrupt
description: Listens for audio interrupt events. This method uses a callback to get interrupt events. The interrupt event is
summary: Listens for audio interrupt events, triggered when audio recording is interrupted. Use it to handle interruptions to recording, such as when another app takes over audio.

name: offAudioInterrupt
description: UnSubscribes to audio interrupt events.
summary: Stops listening for audio focus changes during recording. Use it to stop being told when something else takes over the sound, such as a phone call.

name: onInputDeviceChange
description: Subscribes input device change event callback.
summary: Listens for changes to the recording input device for this stream. Use it to know when the microphone or other recording input is switched.

name: offInputDeviceChange
description: Unsubscribes input device change event callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes to which microphone or input device is being used. Use it when you no longer need to know that the recording input device changed.

name: onAudioCapturerChange
description: Subscribes audio capturer info change event callback.
summary: Listens for changes to the audio capturer's information, triggered when the input device for the recording stream changes. Use it to know when the microphone or other recording input switches.

name: offAudioCapturerChange
description: Unsubscribes audio capturer info change event callback.
summary: Stops receiving notifications when audio capture information changes. Use it to stop listening for changes in the current recording setup.

name: onReadData
description: Subscribes audio data callback.
summary: Tells you when captured audio data is ready to be read. Use it to receive microphone or other audio input as it is recorded.

name: offReadData
description: Unsubscribes audio data callback.
summary: Stops listening for captured audio data. Use it when you no longer want to receive the recorded sound as it is captured.

name: onReadMicInData
description: Subscribes to micIn audio data callback. This callback has higher priority than 'readData' callback.
summary: Subscribes to a callback that delivers microphone audio data whenever a buffer is ready to read. Use it to capture live mic audio for recording or voice input.

name: offReadMicInData
description: Unsubscribes from micIn audio data callback.
summary: Stops receiving microphone audio data through the subscribed callback. Use it to stop listening to the mic when recording is no longer needed.

name: setInputDeviceToAccessory
description: Sets default input device of this Capturer to DEVICE_TYPE_ACCESSORY.
summary: Sets this capturer's default input device to a connected audio accessory, before capture starts. Use it to record from an attached headset or external mic.

name: setIndependentAudioSessionStrategy
description: Sets the independent audio session strategy and behavior parameters.
summary: Sets the audio session strategy and behavior for recording. Use it to control how a recording session behaves while capturing sound.

name: setNoiseReductionMode
description: Sets noise reduction mode for current audio capturer.
summary: Sets the noise reduction mode for the current recording. Use it to reduce background noise while recording audio.

name: getNoiseReductionMode
description: Gets the noise reduction mode for current audio capturer.
summary: Gets the noise reduction mode currently set for the audio capturer. Use it to check how much background noise is being filtered out while recording.

name: getSupportedNoiseReductionModes
description: Gets all the supported noise reduction modes for current device platform.
summary: Lists the noise reduction modes the device supports for recording. Use it to see which background-noise filtering options are available before choosing one.

name: setAsrAecMode
description: Set ASR AEC mode.
summary: Sets the echo cancellation mode for speech recognition. Use it to reduce echo so spoken commands are heard clearly.

name: getAsrAecMode
description: Get ASR AEC mode.
summary: Reports the current echo-cancellation setting used for speech recognition. Use it to check how echo is being handled during voice input.

name: setAsrNoiseSuppressionMode
description: Set ASR noise suppression mode.
summary: Sets the noise suppression mode for speech recognition. Use it to cut background noise so spoken words are picked up better.

name: getAsrNoiseSuppressionMode
description: Get ASR noise suppression mode.
summary: Reports the current noise-suppression setting used for speech recognition. Use it to check how background noise is being reduced during voice input.

name: isWhispering
description: Query whether user is whispering.
summary: Checks whether the person speaking is whispering. Use it to tell if someone is speaking very quietly into the microphone.

name: setAsrVoiceControlMode
description: Set ASR voice control mode.
summary: Turns a voice control mode for speech recognition on or off. Use it to control how spoken input is handled.

name: setAsrVoiceMuteMode
description: Set ASR voice mute mode.
summary: Turns a voice mute mode for speech recognition on or off. Use it to mute or unmute voice input.

name: setAsrWhisperDetectionMode
description: Set ASR whisper detection mode.
summary: Sets the whisper detection mode for speech recognition. Use it to make voice input respond to quiet, whispered speech.

name: getAsrWhisperDetectionMode
description: Get ASR whisper detection mode.
summary: Gets the current whisper detection mode used for speech recognition. Use it to check how quietly spoken speech is being detected.

name: createAsrProcessingController
description: Create ASR processing controller on one audio capturer.
summary: Creates a controller that manages automatic speech recognition processing on an audio capturer. Use it to control speech recognition audio capture.

name: load
description: Loads tone. This method uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Loads a tone so it is ready to play. Use it to prepare a beep or alert sound before playing it.

name: start
description: Starts player. This method uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Starts playing the loaded tone. Use it to play a beep or alert sound.

name: stop
description: Stops player. This method uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Stops the tone player. Use it to silence a beep or alert sound that is playing.

name: release
description: Releases the player. This method uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Releases the tone player and its resources. Use it when you are done playing tones and want to free them up.

name: getStatus
description: Obtains the audio loopback status. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Obtains the current audio loopback status. Use it to check whether audio monitoring is running or stopped.

name: setVolume
description: Sets the volume for audio loopback. This volume does not affect other audio streams or the system volume.
summary: Sets the volume for audio monitoring only, without changing other audio or the system volume. Use it to adjust how loud monitoring sounds.

name: getVolume
description: Gets the output volume for audio loopback.
summary: Gets the output volume level for audio loopback. Use it to check how loud the monitored audio is playing.

name: on
description: Subscribes to the audio loopback status change event, which is triggered when the status of the audio loopback is
summary: Watches for changes in audio monitoring status and reports them when they happen. Use it to keep track of whether audio monitoring is active.

name: onStatusChange
description: Subscribes to audio loopback status changes.
summary: Watches for changes in audio monitoring status. Use it to react when audio monitoring starts or stops.

name: off
description: Unsubscribes from the audio loopback status event. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the result.
summary: Stops listening for changes to the audio loopback status. Use it to stop being notified when audio monitoring starts or stops.

name: offStatusChange
description: Unsubscribes audio loopback status change event callback.
summary: Stops listening for audio loopback status change events. Use it to stop being notified when audio monitoring status changes.

name: getSupportedDevicePairs
description: Gets supported audio device pairs in current device connection situation.
summary: Gets the audio device pairs that can currently be used for loopback. Use it to find which input and output devices can be paired for audio monitoring.

name: getPreferredDevicePair
description: Gets the preferred audio device pair in current device connection situation.
summary: Reports the preferred pair of audio devices for monitoring with the devices currently connected. Use it to find which input and output to use for in-ear monitoring.

name: enable
description: Enable or disable audio loopback.
summary: Turns audio loopback on or off, letting you hear your own voice through earphones with low delay. Use it for in-ear monitoring while singing or recording.

name: setReverbPreset
description: Sets the reverberation of the audio loopback.
summary: Sets the reverberation preset for audio monitoring. Use it to add a reverb effect to monitored audio.

name: getReverbPreset
description: Get the current reverberation.
summary: Gets the current reverberation preset used for audio loopback, defaulting to theater if none was set. Use it to check which reverb effect is applied while monitoring audio.

name: setEqualizerPreset
description: Sets the equalizer preset of the audio loopback.
summary: Sets the equalizer preset for audio monitoring. Use it to pick a sound style for what you are listening to.

name: getEqualizerPreset
description: Gets the current equalizer preset.
summary: Tells you which equalizer preset the audio monitoring is currently using. Use it to check the current sound style before changing it.

name: getAudioHapticManager
description: Obtains an {@link AudioHapticManager} instance. This object is singleton in one process.
summary: Obtains the audio-haptic manager, used to give rhythmic sound and vibration feedback for incoming calls or messages.

name: registerSource
description: Registers audio and haptic resources via URIs. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Registers an audio file and a vibration file together by their locations. Use it to prepare a sound-and-vibration pair for playback.

name: unregisterSource
description: Unregisters an audio-haptic source. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Unregisters an audio-haptic source. Use it to remove a sound-and-vibration effect you no longer need.

name: setAudioLatencyMode
description: Sets the latency mode for an audio-haptic source.
summary: Sets the latency mode for an audio-haptic source. Use it to make a vibration-and-sound effect play with lower delay.

name: setStreamUsage
description: Sets the stream usage for an audio-haptic source.
summary: Sets the stream usage for an audio-haptic source. Use it to choose how the sound of a vibration effect is treated, such as for a ringtone or alarm.

name: createPlayer
description: Create an audio haptic player. This method uses a promise to return the result. If haptics is needed, caller
summary: Creates a player that plays sound together with matching vibration. Use it to play a ringtone or alert with a buzz.

name: registerSourceFromFd
description: Registers audio and haptic resources via file descriptors. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Registers an audio file and a vibration file together using opened file handles. Use it to prepare a sound-and-vibration pair for playback.

name: isMuted
description: Checks whether an audio-haptic type is muted.
summary: Checks whether an audio-haptic type is muted. Use it to find out if the sound or the vibration of a playback effect is currently silenced.

name: start
description: Starts playback. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Begins playing the audio together with its matching vibration. Use it to start a ringing or buzzing alert that you can hear and feel.

name: stop
description: Stops playback. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Stops the audio-haptic playback that is currently running. Use it to silence and end a ringing or buzzing alert.

name: release
description: Releases this audio-haptic player. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Frees the audio-haptic player and the resources it holds. Use it when you are done playing sounds and vibrations and want to clean up.

name: on
description: Subscribes to end of stream (EOS) event, which is triggered when the audio stream playback ends. This API uses an
summary: Listens for the event that fires when the audio stream finishes playing. Use it to know when a sound or vibration clip has reached its end.

name: onEndOfStream
description: Subscribes end of stream event.
summary: Listens for the event that fires when the audio stream finishes playing. Use it to know when a sound or vibration clip has reached its end.

name: off
description: Unsubscribes from the EOS event. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the result.
summary: Unsubscribes from the audio interruption event. Use it to stop being notified when playback of a sound-and-vibration effect ends or is interrupted.

name: offEndOfStream
description: Unsubscribes end of stream event.
summary: Stops listening for the event that fires when the audio stream finishes playing. Use it to stop being notified when a sound or vibration clip reaches its end.

name: onAudioInterrupt
description: Subscribes audio interrupt event.
summary: Listens for events that tell you when the audio focus changes, such as when another sound takes over. Use it to react when your audio is interrupted.

name: offAudioInterrupt
description: Unsubscribes audio interrupt event.
summary: Unsubscribes from the audio interrupt event. Use it to stop being notified when something interrupts the sound-and-vibration playback.

name: enableHapticsInSilentMode
description: Enable haptics when the ringer mode is silent mode.
summary: Lets haptics play even when the ringer is in silent mode. Use it so a game or app still vibrates when the phone is silenced.

name: setVolume
description: Sets the volume for this audio-haptic player. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets how loud the audio-haptic playback is, from silent to full volume. Use it to turn the sound and vibration of a ringtone or alert up or down.

name: isHapticsIntensityAdjustmentSupported
description: Check whether the device supports haptics intensity adjustment.
summary: Checks whether the device can adjust haptics intensity. Use it to find out if vibration strength can be changed before setting it.

name: setHapticsIntensity
description: Set haptics intensity for this player. This method uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets how strong the haptics vibration is for this player, from 0.00 to 1.00. Use it to make the vibration weaker or stronger.

name: isHapticsRampSupported
description: Check whether the device supports haptics intensity ramp effect.
summary: Checks whether the device supports a haptics intensity ramp effect. Use it to find out if vibration can gradually build up or fade out.

name: setHapticsRamp
params: duration: int, startIntensity: double, endIntensity: double
description: Set haptics intensity ramp effect for this player. This method uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets a haptics ramp so vibration gradually changes from a starting strength to an ending strength over a set time. Use it to make vibration build up or fade out smoothly.

name: setLoop
description: Sets this audio-haptic player to play in a loop. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Makes the audio-haptic player repeat playback over and over. Use it to keep a sound or vibration playing continuously until stopped.

name: createAVMusicTemplate
description: Create an AVMusicTemplate instance.
summary: Creates a music template instance for media enhancement. Use it to set up enhanced music playback, such as in a smart car.

name: createAVMusicTemplateController
description: Create AVMusicTemplate controller instance.
summary: Creates a controller for a music template session. Use it to control and enhance music playback for that session.

name: getAllAVMusicTemplateDescriptors
description: Get all AVMusicTemplate descriptors.
summary: Gets all available music template descriptors. Use it to list the music templates that can be used for playback.

name: onAVMusicTemplateCreate
description: Register session create event
summary: Starts listening for when a media session is created. Use it to be notified when a music session starts.

name: offAVMusicTemplateCreate
description: UnRegister session create event
summary: Stops listening for music template creation events. Use it when you no longer need to be notified when a music template is created.

name: onAVMusicTemplateDestroy
description: Register session destroy event
summary: Starts listening for when a media session is destroyed. Use it to be notified when a music session ends.

name: offAVMusicTemplateDestroy
description: UnRegister session destroy event
summary: Stops listening for when a media session is destroyed. Use it to stop being notified that a music session has ended.

name: startTemplate
description: Start media center template interface.
summary: Starts the media center template interface. Use it to open the media center screen.

name: onQueryMainTabs
description: Register query main tabs callback.
summary: Sets up a handler that supplies the main tabs of the music screen. Use it to build the top-level navigation of a music app.

name: offQueryMainTabs
description: Unregister query main tabs callback.
summary: Stops listening for requests to show the main tabs of a music app. Use it when you no longer need to refresh the main tabs shown while playing a song.

name: onQueryMediaTabContent
description: Register query media tab content callback.
summary: Sets up a handler that supplies the content of a media tab. Use it to fill a tab with songs or albums.

name: offQueryMediaTabContent
description: Unregister query media tab content callback.
summary: Stops listening for requests for the content of a media tab. Use it when you no longer need to fill a music tab with songs or lists.

name: onQueryMediaEntity
description: Register query media entity callback.
summary: Sets up a handler that supplies a media item's details. Use it to show information about a song or album.

name: offQueryMediaEntity
description: Unregister query media entity callback.
summary: Stops listening for requests for details about a media item. Use it when you no longer need to supply song or album details while playing music.

name: onQueryCompilation
description: Register query compilation callback.
summary: Sets up a handler that runs when a compilation is requested. Use it to respond when someone asks for a music compilation.

name: offQueryCompilation
description: Unregister query compilation callback.
summary: Stops listening for compilation queries. Use it to stop receiving requests for a music compilation.

name: onQueryPlaylist
description: Register query playlist callback.
summary: Registers a callback that supplies the playlist when it is asked for. Use it to show the list of songs in a music app.

name: offQueryPlaylist
description: Unregister query playlist callback.
summary: Stops listening for requests for a playlist. Use it when you no longer need to supply the list of songs in a playlist.

name: onQueryCurrentSingle
description: Register query current single callback.
summary: Sets up a handler that runs when the current single is requested. Use it to respond when someone asks for the current single track.

name: offQueryCurrentSingle
description: Unregister query current single callback.
summary: Stops listening for current single queries. Use it to stop receiving requests about the song currently playing.

name: onQueryCompilationByKeyword
description: Register query compilation by keyword callback.
summary: Sets up a handler that runs when a compilation is requested by keyword. Use it to respond when someone searches for a music compilation by keyword.

name: offQueryCompilationByKeyword
description: Unregister query compilation by keyword callback.
summary: Stops listening for compilation-by-keyword queries. Use it to stop receiving requests for a music compilation matching a keyword.

name: onQueryMediaEntityByKeyword
description: Register query media entity by keyword callback.
summary: Sets up a handler that finds media items matching a keyword. Use it to power search for songs or artists.

name: offQueryMediaEntityByKeyword
description: Unregister query media entity by keyword callback.
summary: Stops listening for requests to search media by keyword. Use it when you no longer need to handle music searches by word.

name: onQueryRecommendMediaEntityList
description: Register query recommend media entity list callback.
summary: Registers a callback that supplies a list of recommended media items when requested. Use it to show recommended songs or albums in a music app.

name: offQueryRecommendMediaEntityList
description: Unregister query recommend media entity list callback.
summary: Stops listening for requests for a list of recommended songs or media. Use it to stop receiving suggestions for what to play next.

name: onQueryHotWords
description: Register query hot words callback.
summary: Sets up a handler that supplies the current hot search words. Use it to show trending searches in a music app.

name: offQueryHotWords
description: Unregister query hot words callback.
summary: Stops listening for hot words queries. Use it to stop receiving requests for popular music search words.

name: onQuerySearchHistory
description: Register query search history callback.
summary: Registers a callback that supplies past search terms when they are requested. Use it to show a user's recent music searches.

name: offQuerySearchHistory
description: Unregister query search history callback.
summary: Stops listening for requests to show past searches. Use it to stop responding when someone wants to see their earlier music searches.

name: onClearSearchHistory
description: Register clear search history callback.
summary: Listens for requests to clear the search history. Use it to wipe out past music searches when the user asks to clear them.

name: offClearSearchHistory
description: Unregister clear search history callback.
summary: Stops listening for requests to clear search history. Use it to remove a handler that erased past music searches when the user asked.

name: onLogin
description: Register login callback.
summary: Registers a callback for signing in. Use it to let someone log in to their music account.

name: offLogin
description: Unregister login callback.
summary: Stops listening for when a user logs in. Use it to stop responding when someone signs in to the music service.

name: onRequestDialogInfo
description: Register request dialog info callback.
summary: Registers a callback that supplies information for a dialog when it is requested. Use it to provide the content shown in a music app's pop-up dialog.

name: offRequestDialogInfo
description: Unregister request dialog info callback.
summary: Stops listening for requests for dialog information. Use it to stop handling pop-up dialog requests in the music player.

name: onHandleMemberPurchase
description: Register handle member purchase callback.
summary: Registers a callback for handling a membership purchase. Use it to let someone buy a subscription while listening to music.

name: offHandleMemberPurchase
description: Unregister handle member purchase callback.
summary: Stops listening for when a user makes a membership purchase. Use it to stop responding when someone buys a subscription or membership.

name: onQueryMemberPurchase
description: Register query member purchase callback.
summary: Sets up a handler that supplies membership purchase information. Use it to show subscription or membership offers in a music app.

name: offQueryMemberPurchase
description: Unregister query member purchase callback.
summary: Stops listening for requests about a member purchase. Use it when you no longer need to handle membership buying prompts while playing music.

name: onQueryCustomContent
description: Register query custom content callback.
summary: Sets up a handler that runs when custom content is requested. Use it to respond when someone asks for custom content.

name: offQueryCustomContent
description: Unregister query custom content callback.
summary: Stops listening for custom content queries. Use it to stop receiving requests for custom music content.

name: onDownloadMediaEntity
description: Register download media entity callback.
summary: Registers a callback for downloading a media item. Use it to let someone save a song or track for offline listening.

name: offDownloadMediaEntity
description: Unregister download media entity callback.
summary: Stops listening for requests to download a media item. Use it to remove a handler that saved a song or album for offline listening.

name: onSettingsChange
description: Register settings change callback.
summary: Registers a callback that runs when settings change. Use it to react when a user changes music app settings.

name: offSettingsChange
description: Unregister settings change callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes to settings. Use it to stop being told when music player settings change.

name: onProblemAndAdvice
description: Register problem and advice callback.
summary: Sets up a handler that runs when a problem and advice event occurs. Use it to react when something goes wrong and advice is given.

name: offProblemAndAdvice
description: Unregister problem and advice callback.
summary: Stops listening for problem and advice events. Use it to stop receiving suggestions while playing a song.

name: onPlayForSearch
description: Register play for search callback.
summary: Registers a callback for playing media in response to a search. Use it to start playing a song someone searched for.

name: offPlayForSearch
description: Unregister play for search callback.
summary: Stops listening for when a user plays a song from search results. Use it to stop responding when someone plays a track found through search.

name: onExecuteAction
description: Register execute action callback.
summary: Registers a callback for carrying out an action. Use it to respond when someone triggers a control such as play, pause, or skip.

name: offExecuteAction
description: Unregister execute action callback.
summary: Stops listening for when a user triggers an action on the music template. Use it to stop responding to play, pause, or skip requests from the media controls.

name: onPlayMediaEntity
description: Register play media entity callback.
summary: Sets up a handler that runs when a media item is played. Use it to respond when someone plays a song or video.

name: offPlayMediaEntity
description: Unregister play media entity callback.
summary: Stops listening for when a user plays a media item. Use it to stop responding when someone starts playing a song or media entity.

name: onFavoriteMediaEntity
description: Register favorite media entity callback.
summary: Registers a callback for marking a media item as a favorite. Use it to let someone like or save a song they enjoy.

name: offFavoriteMediaEntity
description: Unregister favorite media entity callback.
summary: Stops listening for when a user favorites a song or media item. Use it to stop responding when someone marks a track as a favorite.

name: onCustomCommand
description: Register custom command callback.
summary: Listens for custom commands sent to the music player. Use it to handle your own extra playback actions beyond play and pause.

name: offCustomCommand
description: Unregister custom command callback.
summary: Stops listening for custom commands. Use it to remove a handler that responded to extra playback commands from the user.

name: setUserInfo
description: Report user infomation to MediaUI.
summary: Reports user information to the media interface. Use it to show who is listening or signed in.

name: setDialogCommand
description: Report dialog command to MediaUI.
summary: Reports a dialog command to the media interface. Use it to show a dialog prompt during music playback.

name: setCurrentSingle
description: Report current single song to MediaUI.
summary: Reports the currently playing single song to the media interface. Use it to show which song is playing now.

name: setMediaEntities
description: Report media resource change information to MediaUI.
summary: Reports changes to media resources to the media interface. Use it to update the list of songs shown while playing music.

name: setTabContent
description: Report tab page content information to MediaUI.
summary: Reports tab page content to the media interface. Use it to fill a tab with content in the media view.

name: setPlaylist
description: Report play list information to MediaUI.
summary: Reports play list information to the media interface. Use it to show the current playlist while playing music.

name: setDownloadMediaEntityStatus
description: Report single download status information to MediaUI.
summary: Reports the download status of a single item to the media interface. Use it to show download progress for a song.

name: setCustomElements
params: actionType: ActionType, customType: CustomType, customElement: CustomElement
description: Report custom elements change information to MediaUI.
summary: Reports changes to custom elements to the media interface. Use it to update custom controls or items shown while playing a song.

name: setSettings
description: Report settings information to MediaUI.
summary: Reports settings information to the media interface. Use it to show music settings such as playback options.

name: reportExecuteAction
description: Report execute action information to MediaUI.
summary: Reports that an action was performed, with its type and details, to the media interface. Use it to tell the music interface when a user plays, pauses, or skips a song.

name: setExtensionAbility
description: Report execute extension ability to MediaUI.
summary: Reports an extension ability to run to the media interface. Use it to launch an ability from the music playback screen.

name: destroy
description: Destroy the AVMusicTemplate instance.
summary: Shuts down and releases the music template instance. Use it to clean up when the music screen or player is closed.

name: queryMainTabs
description: Query main tabs.
summary: Gets the main tabs of the music template. Use it to build the top navigation of a music app.

name: queryMediaTabContent
description: Query media tab content.
summary: Gets the content of a media tab by its id. Use it to show what is inside a music tab.

name: queryMediaEntity
description: Query media entity.
summary: Finds media items using given query parameters. Use it to look up songs, albums, or artists.

name: queryCompilation
description: Query compilation.
summary: Queries a compilation by its id and page index. Use it to browse the songs in a playlist or album.

name: queryPlaylist
description: Query playlist.
summary: Gets a page of the playlist, sorted as you choose. Use it to show songs in a playlist.

name: queryCurrentSingle
description: Query current single.
summary: Gets the single track that is currently playing. Use it to show what song is playing now.

name: queryCompilationByKeyword
description: Query compilation by keyword.
summary: Finds music compilations that match a keyword. Use it to search for playlists or albums by name.

name: queryMediaEntityByKeyword
params: keyword: string, searchType: EntityType, pageIndex: int
description: Query media entity by keyword.
summary: Finds media items matching a keyword, search type, and page. Use it to search for songs, albums, or artists by name.

name: queryRecommendMediaEntityList
description: Query recommend media entity list.
summary: Gets the list of recommended media items. Use it to show recommended songs or media.

name: queryHotWords
description: Query hot words.
summary: Gets a list of popular search words. Use it to show suggested searches in a music app.

name: querySearchHistory
description: Query search history.
summary: Gets the list of past search terms. Use it to show what the user searched for before.

name: clearSearchHistory
description: Clear search history.
summary: Clears the search history. Use it to wipe past music searches.

name: updateSettings
description: Report settings change.
summary: Reports a changed setting item back to the music template. Use it to keep playback settings such as repeat or shuffle in sync.

name: reportProblemAndAdvice
description: Report problem and advice.
summary: Sends a problem report along with advice text. Use it to give feedback or report an issue.

name: login
description: Login.
summary: Logs in and returns QR code information. Use it to sign in to a music service, often by scanning a code.

name: requestDialogInfo
description: Request dialog info.
summary: Gets the information for a dialog to show, based on the action type. Use it to fetch what a music dialog should display before showing it.
