name: handleMemberPurchase
description: Handle member purchase.
summary: Handles a membership purchase and returns dialog information. Use it to buy or manage a music subscription.

name: queryMemberPurchase
description: Query member purchase.
summary: Gets the member purchase information for a given purchase type. Use it to show membership or subscription purchase options.

name: queryCustomContent
description: Query custom content.
summary: Queries custom content by type. Use it to fetch custom elements shown in a music template.

name: downloadMediaEntity
description: Download media entity.
summary: Downloads a media item such as a song or album. Use it to save music for offline listening.

name: playForSearch
description: Play for search.
summary: Plays a song chosen from search results. Use it to start playing the track a user searched for.

name: executeAction
description: Execute action.
summary: Runs a named action with the given settings. Use it to trigger a music control action such as play or skip.

name: playMediaEntity
description: Play media entity.
summary: Plays a given media entity. Use it to start playing a specific song or media item.

name: favoriteMediaEntity
description: Favorite media entity.
summary: Marks a media item as a favorite or removes it. Use it to like or unlike a song or album.

name: sendCustomCommand
description: Send custom commands to AVMusicTemplate
summary: Sends a named custom command with arguments to the music template. Use it to trigger your own playback actions, like a custom skip or like button.

name: onUserInfoChange
description: Register report user info callback.
summary: Registers a callback that reports changes to user info. Use it to keep the user's details shown in a music app current.

name: offUserInfoChange
description: Unregister report user info callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes to user information. Use it to stop updating the screen when user info changes.

name: onDialogCommandChange
description: Register report dialog command callback.
summary: Listens for commands sent from a dialog, so your app can react when someone uses a dialog control. Use it to handle actions like play or pause from a dialog.

name: offDialogCommandChange
description: Unregister report dialog command callback.
summary: Stops reporting dialog commands. Use it to stop handling pop-up commands in a music player.

name: onCurrentSingleChange
description: Register report current single callback.
summary: Starts listening for changes to the current single. Use it to update the screen when the current song changes.

name: offCurrentSingleChange
description: Unregister report current single callback.
summary: Stops reporting when the current song changes. Use it to stop updating the screen when a new song starts playing.

name: onMediaEntitiesChange
description: Register report media entities change callback.
summary: Watches for changes to the list of media items. Use it to refresh the displayed list of songs or videos.

name: offMediaEntitiesChange
description: Unregister report media entities change callback.
summary: Stops reporting changes to the list of media items. Use it to stop refreshing the song list shown in a music player.

name: onTabContentChange
description: Register report tab content callback.
summary: Registers a callback that reports changes to tab content. Use it to refresh the tabs shown in a music app.

name: offTabContentChange
description: Unregister report tab content callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes to tab content. Use it to stop updating the screen when tab content changes.

name: onPlaylistChange
description: Register report playlist callback.
summary: Watches for changes to the playlist. Use it to update the playlist shown while playing music.

name: offPlaylistChange
description: Unregister report playlist callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes to the playlist. Use it to stop updating the screen when the playlist changes.

name: onDownloadMediaEntityStatusChange
description: Register report download media entity status callback.
summary: Watches for changes in the download status of a media item. Use it to show download progress or completion for a song or video.

name: offDownloadMediaEntityStatusChange
description: Unregister report download media entity status callback.
summary: Stops reporting download status changes for media items. Use it to stop tracking a song or video download.

name: onCustomElementsChange
description: Register report custom elements change callback.
summary: Registers a callback for changes to custom elements. Use it to be notified when custom content in a music template changes.

name: offCustomElementsChange
description: Unregister report custom elements change callback.
summary: Stops reporting changes to custom elements. Use it to stop refreshing custom parts of a music player screen.

name: onSettingsChange
description: Register report settings callback.
summary: Registers a callback that reports changes to settings. Use it to keep a music app's settings display up to date.

name: offSettingsChange
description: Unregister report settings callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes to settings. Use it to stop updating the screen when settings change.

name: onReportExecuteAction
description: Register report execute action callback.
summary: Listens for reported action events. Use it to react when a user triggers an action such as play or skip.

name: offReportExecuteAction
description: Unregister report execute action callback.
summary: Stops listening for reported action events. Use it to stop reacting when a user triggers an action.

name: onExtensionAbilityChange
description: Register report extension ability callback.
summary: Listens for changes to an extension ability. Use it to react when an extension ability starts or stops.

name: offExtensionAbilityChange
description: Unregister report extension ability callback.
summary: Stops reporting extension ability changes. Use it to stop receiving updates about extra player features.

name: destroy
description: Destroy the controller.
summary: Shuts down the music template controller when it is no longer needed. Use it to stop controlling music playback from the template.

name: createAVSession
params: context: Context, tag: string, type: AVSessionType
description: Create an AVSession instance. An ability can only create one AVSession
summary: Creates a media session for your app, giving it a name and type. Use it to start controlling audio or video playback, like play a song.

name: getAVSession
description: Get an AVSession instance if already created.
summary: Gets the media session your app already created. Use it to control the current playback, like pause or skip a song.

name: getAllSessionDescriptors
description: Get all avsession descriptors which can be shown on system entrance.
summary: Gets details of all media sessions that can be shown on the system entrance. Use it to list what media is currently playing on the device.

name: getSessionDescriptors
description: Get session descriptors of the system based on different session category.
summary: Gets details about the media sessions currently running on the system, filtered by category. Use it to see what is playing or available to control.

name: getHistoricalSessionDescriptors
description: Get history avsession records. These sessions have been destroyed.
summary: Gets records of past media sessions that have already ended. Use it to see what media was played previously.

name: getHistoricalAVQueueInfos
description: Get history play list information records.
summary: Gets records of previously played playlists. Use it to look back at playlists that were played before.

name: createController
description: Create an avsession controller
summary: Creates a controller for a media session so you can control its playback. Use it to play, pause, or skip a song playing in another app.

name: castAudio
description: Cast Audio to the remote devices or cast back local device
summary: Sends the audio of a session or all sessions to remote devices, or brings it back to this device. Use it to play a song on a speaker or other device.

name: castAudioSession
description: Cast Audio to the remote devices or cast back local device
summary: Sends the audio of one session to remote devices, or brings it back to this device. Use it to play a song on a speaker or other device.

name: castAudioSessionAll
description: Cast all the media audio to the remote devices or cast back local device
summary: Sends all media audio to remote devices, or brings it back to this device. Use it to play all songs on a speaker or other device.

name: startAVPlayback
description: Start an application for media playback.
summary: Starts an application for media playback using its bundle name and asset ID. Use it to begin playing a specific media item.

name: getDistributedSessionController
description: Get distributed avsession controller
summary: Gets controllers for distributed media sessions. Use it to control media sessions shared across connected devices.

name: isDesktopLyricSupported
description: Whether desktop lyric feature is supported.
summary: Tells whether showing lyrics on the desktop is supported. Use it to check if you can display song lyrics on the screen.

name: on
description: Register session create callback
summary: Registers a callback for session events such as session creation, destruction, top session changes, service death, and distributed session changes. Use it to be notified when media sessions start, stop, or change.

name: onSessionCreate
description: Register session create callback
summary: Registers a callback that runs when a media session is created. Use it to react when a song or video starts playing in a new session.

name: onSessionDestroy
description: Register session destroy callback
summary: Registers a callback that runs when a media session is destroyed. Use it to react when a song or video stops playing and its session ends.

name: onTopSessionChange
description: Register top session changed callback
summary: Registers a callback that runs when the top media session changes. Use it to react when a different song or video becomes the one currently playing.

name: off
description: Unregister session create callback
summary: Stops listening for when the media session service ends, so the app can clean up. Use it to stop reacting to the session service shutting down.

name: offSessionCreate
description: Unregister session create callback
summary: Stops listening for new media sessions being created. Use it to stop being notified when another app starts playing audio or video.

name: onActiveSessionChanged
description: Register active session changed callback.
summary: Registers a callback for when the active session changes. Use it to be notified when the active media session switches.

name: offActiveSessionChanged
description: Unregister active session changed callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes to which media session is active. Use it to stop being told when the active session switches.

name: offSessionDestroy
description: Unregister session destroy callback
summary: Stops listening for media sessions being closed. Use it to stop being notified when another app stops playing audio or video.

name: offTopSessionChange
description: Unregister top session changed callback
summary: Stops listening for changes to the top media session. Use it to stop being notified when the active playback switches to another app.

name: onSessionServiceDie
description: Register Session service death callback, notifying the application to clean up resources.
summary: Registers a callback for when the session service dies, telling the app to clean up resources. Use it to release resources when the session service stops.

name: offSessionServiceDie
description: Unregister Session service death callback, notifying the application to clean up resources.
summary: Stops listening for the session service dying, which tells the app to clean up resources. Use it to stop being notified when the session service ends.

name: onDistributedSessionChange
description: Register distributed   session changed callback
summary: Registers a callback that fires when distributed sessions change, giving the current session controllers. Use it to keep track of sessions shared across devices.

name: offDistributedSessionChange
description: Unregister distributed session changed callback
summary: Stops listening for changes to distributed sessions. Use it to stop receiving updates when distributed sessions change.

name: sendSystemAVKeyEvent
description: Send system media key event.The system automatically selects the recipient.
summary: Sends a system media key event, with the system choosing the recipient. Use it to trigger media key actions like play, pause, or skip.

name: sendSystemControlCommand
description: Send system control command.The system automatically selects the recipient.
summary: Sends a system control command, with the system choosing the recipient. Use it to control media playback remotely.

name: sendSystemCommonCommand
description: Send system control command. The system automatically selects the recipient.
summary: Sends a system control command, with the system choosing the recipient. Use it to send a named command and get back sync information.

name: startCastDeviceDiscovery
description: Start device discovery.
summary: Starts searching for devices that can receive a cast. Use it to find nearby screens or speakers to send your media to.

name: stopCastDeviceDiscovery
description: Stop device discovery.
summary: Stops searching for devices that can receive a cast. Use it when you are done looking for a screen or speaker to cast to.

name: setDiscoverable
description: Enable or disable device to be discoverable, used at sink side.
summary: Enables or disables whether the device can be discovered, used on the sink side. Use it to make a device findable for connections.

name: onDeviceAvailable
description: Register device discovery callback
summary: Registers a callback that fires when a device is discovered. Use it to know when a device becomes available for playback or connection.

name: offDeviceAvailable
description: Unregister device discovery callback
summary: Stops listening for newly discovered output devices. Use it to stop being told when a new speaker or headset is found.

name: onDeviceOffline
description: Register device offline callback
summary: Registers a callback that fires when a device goes offline. Use it to know when a connected device is no longer available.

name: offDeviceOffline
description: Unregister device offline callback
summary: Stops listening for when an output device goes offline. Use it to stop being told when a speaker or headset disconnects.

name: getAVCastController
description: Get the current session's remote controller client.
summary: Gets a controller for casting a media session so playback can be controlled on both sides. Use it to control a song being cast to another device.

name: startCasting
description: Cast resource to remote device.
summary: Sends the media of a session to a chosen remote device. Use it to play what you are watching or listening to on another screen or speaker.

name: stopCasting
description: Stop current cast and disconnect device connection.
summary: Stops casting and disconnects from the remote device. Use it to end playback on another screen or speaker and return to your own device.

name: startDeviceLogging
description: Begin to write device logs into a file descriptor for the purpose of problem locating.
summary: Begins writing device logs to a file for troubleshooting. Use it to capture logs when you need to diagnose a problem.

name: stopDeviceLogging
description: Stop the current device written even the discovery is ongoing.
summary: Stops writing device logs to the file. Use it when you have finished capturing logs for troubleshooting.

name: onDeviceLogEvent
description: Register log event callback.
summary: Registers a callback for log events. Use it to receive log notifications about device activity.

name: offDeviceLogEvent
description: UnRegister log event callback.
summary: Stops listening for device log events. Use it to stop receiving device log notifications.

name: onDeviceStateChanged
description: Registers a system callback for the device connection phase.
summary: Registers a callback for the device connection phase, including error codes, connection status, radar errors, and user behavior codes. Use it to track how a device connection is progressing.

name: offDeviceStateChanged
description: Unregisters a system callback for the device connection phase.
summary: Stops listening for changes in the device connection phase. Use it to stop receiving updates about device connections.

name: onSystemCommonEvent
description: Register system common event callback
summary: Registers a callback for system common events. Use it to react when the system sends a common event.

name: offSystemCommonEvent
description: Unregister system common event callback
summary: Stops listening for system common events. Use it to stop receiving system common event updates.

name: setAVMetadata
description: Set the metadata of this session.
summary: Sets the metadata of this session, such as the title and artist. Use it to show what is currently playing.

name: setCallMetadata
description: Set the metadata related with current call.
summary: Sets the metadata related to the current call. Use it to show details about an ongoing phone call.

name: setAVPlaybackState
description: Set the playback state of this session.
summary: Sets the playback state of this session, such as playing, paused, or stopped. Use it to keep the playback status up to date.

name: setAVCallState
description: Set the call state of this session.
summary: Sets the call state of the session. Use it to show whether a phone call is ringing, active, or ended.

name: setLaunchAbility
description: Set the ability to start the session corresponding to
summary: Sets the ability to start for the session. Use it so tapping the session opens the app that is playing.

name: dispatchSessionEvent
description: Dispatch the session event of this session.
summary: Sends a named event with parameters to the media session. Use it to tell the session about custom actions or updates.

name: setAVQueueItems
description: Set the playlist of queueItem. Identifies the content of the playlist presented by this session.
summary: Sets the playlist of queue items for this session. Use it to show the list of songs or videos queued up to play.

name: setAVQueueTitle
description: Set the name of the playlist presented by this session.
summary: Sets the name of the playlist presented by this session. Use it to label the queue of songs or videos being played.

name: setExtras
description: Set the custom media packets for this session.
summary: Sets custom media packets for this session. Use it to attach your own extra media information to a playing session.

name: setSupportedPlaySpeeds
description: Set supported speeds supplied by application.
summary: Sets the playback speeds the app supports. Use it so a media player offers the right speed choices, like fast-forward or slow motion.

name: setSupportedLoopModes
description: Set supported loop modes supplied by application.
summary: Sets the loop modes the application supports. Use it to offer repeat or shuffle options while playing a song.

name: enableDesktopLyric
description: Enable desktop lyric for this session.
summary: Turns desktop lyrics on or off for this session. Use it to show song lyrics on the desktop while playing music.

name: setDesktopLyricVisible
description: Set desktop lyric visible state for this session.
summary: Shows or hides the desktop lyric window for this session. Use it to turn desktop lyrics on or off while playing a song.

name: isDesktopLyricVisible
description: Query desktop lyric visible state for this session.
summary: Checks whether the desktop lyrics are currently shown for this session. Use it to see if song lyrics are displayed on the desktop while music plays.

name: onDesktopLyricVisibilityChanged
description: Register desktop lyric visible state change callback.
summary: Registers a callback that runs when the desktop lyric visible state changes. Use it to know when desktop lyrics are shown or hidden.

name: offDesktopLyricVisibilityChanged
description: Unregister desktop lyric visible state change callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes in whether desktop lyrics are visible. Use it to stop reacting when desktop lyrics show or hide.

name: setDesktopLyricState
description: Set desktop lyric state such as lock state for this session.
summary: Sets the desktop lyric state, such as its lock state, for this session. Use it to control how lyrics show on the desktop while a song plays.

name: getDesktopLyricState
description: Get desktop lyric state such as lock state for this session.
summary: Gets the desktop lyric state, such as whether lyrics are locked. Use it to check how lyrics are displayed while playing a song.

name: onDesktopLyricStateChanged
description: Register desktop lyric state changed callback.
summary: Registers a callback that runs when the desktop lyric state changes. Use it to keep track of whether lyrics are shown on the desktop.

name: offDesktopLyricStateChanged
description: Unregister desktop lyric state changed callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes in the desktop lyric state. Use it to stop reacting when desktop lyrics change state.

name: setBackgroundPlayMode
description: Set the background playback mode.
summary: Sets the background playback mode for this session. Use it to keep audio or video playing while the app is in the background.

name: setMediaCenterControlType
description: Set media control types that can be displayed on the media center.
summary: Sets which media control types can appear on the media center. Use it to choose which playback controls show for your session.

name: getController
description: Get the current session's own controller
summary: Gets the controller for the current session. Use it to control media playback for the session you created.

name: getAVCastController
description: Get the cast controller when the session is casted to remote device.
summary: Gets the controller for a session that is being cast to a remote device. Use it to control playback on a TV or speaker.

name: getOutputDevice
description: Get output device information
summary: Gets information about the current audio output device. Use it to see where the sound is playing, like a speaker or headphones.

name: getOutputDeviceSync
description: Get output device information
summary: Gets information about the output device for this session. Use it to find out where the sound is currently playing, such as a speaker or headphones.

name: getAllCastDisplays
description: Get all the current virtual display information for extended display.
summary: Gets information about all available virtual displays for casting. Use it to find a screen or device to cast media to.

name: on
description: Register play command callback.
summary: Registers a callback for playback commands like play, pause, stop, next, previous, fast forward, rewind, seek, and speed. Use it so your app responds when the user controls a song or video.

name: onPlay
description: Register play command callback.
summary: Lets the app respond when the user starts playback. Use it so a play button starts the song or video.

name: onPause
description: Register pause command callback.
summary: Lets the app respond when the user pauses playback. Use it so a pause button stops the song or video.

name: onStop
description: Register stop command callback.
summary: Registers a callback for the stop command, showing the app supports stopping playback. Use it to stop the current song when the user presses stop.

name: onPlayNext
description: Register playNext command callback.
summary: Lets the app respond when the user skips to the next track. Use it so a next button plays the following song.

name: onPlayPrevious
description: Register playPrevious command callback.
summary: Lets the app respond when the user goes back to the previous track. Use it so a previous button plays the earlier song.

name: onFastForward
description: Register fastForward command callback.
summary: Registers a callback for the fast-forward command, giving the forward time and the controller it came from. Use it to skip ahead in a song when the user presses fast-forward.

name: onRewind
description: Register rewind command callback.
summary: Listens for rewind commands from a controller and reports the rewind time and command details. Use it to skip backward in a song or video when the user presses rewind.

name: off
description: Unregister play command callback.
summary: Stops listening for a playback command such as play, pause, or skip. Use it when you no longer want your app to respond to that control.

name: offPlay
description: Unregister play command callback.
summary: Stops listening for play commands sent to the session. Use it when you no longer want your app to start playing a song when the user presses play.

name: offPause
description: Unregister pause command callback.
summary: Stops listening for pause commands sent to the session. Use it when you no longer want your app to pause the song when the user presses pause.

name: offStop
description: Unregister stop command callback.
summary: Stops listening for stop commands from a media session. Use it to stop responding when the user presses stop on a song or video.

name: offPlayNext
description: Unregister playNext command callback.
summary: Stops listening for next-track commands sent to the session. Use it when you no longer want your app to skip to the next song on a next press.

name: offPlayPrevious
description: Unregister playPrevious command callback.
summary: Stops listening for previous-track commands sent to the session. Use it when you no longer want your app to go back to the previous song on a previous press.

name: offFastForward
description: Unregister fastForward command callback.
summary: Stops listening for fast-forward commands on a session. Use it to stop reacting when the user fast-forwards playback.

name: offRewind
description: Unregister rewind command callback.
summary: Stops listening for rewind commands from a media session. Use it to stop responding when someone presses rewind on a song or video.

name: onPlayWithAssetId
description: Subscribes to playWithAssetId events.
summary: Listens for requests to start playing a specific media item by its asset ID. Use it to begin playback of a chosen song or video when a controller asks for it.

name: offPlayWithAssetId
description: Unsubscribes from playWithAssetId events.
summary: Stops listening for requests to play a specific media item by its identifier. Use it when you no longer want your app to start a particular song on request.

name: onSeek
description: Register seek command callback
summary: Listens for seek commands from a controller and reports the target position. Use it to jump to a chosen point in a song or video when the user drags the progress bar.

name: offSeek
description: Unregister seek command callback
summary: Stops listening for seek commands from a media session. Use it to stop responding when someone jumps to a different point in a song or video.

name: onSetSpeed
description: Register setSpeed command callback
summary: Listens for requests to change the playback speed. Use it to play a song or video faster or slower when the user adjusts the speed.

name: offSetSpeed
description: Unregister setSpeed command callback
summary: Stops listening for playback speed change commands from a media session. Use it to stop responding when someone speeds up or slows down a song or video.

name: onSetLoopMode
description: Register setLoopMode command callback
summary: Listens for requests to change the loop mode. Use it to switch between repeat-one, repeat-all, or no repeat while playing a song.

name: offSetLoopMode
description: Unregister setLoopMode command callback
summary: Stops listening for loop mode change commands from a media session. Use it to stop responding when someone switches a song or video to repeat or shuffle.

name: onSetTargetLoopMode
description: Register setTargetLoopMode command callback
summary: Listens for requests to change the loop mode and tells the app to apply the requested mode. Use it to switch repeat settings for a song or video when a controller asks for it.

name: offSetTargetLoopMode
description: Unregister setTargetLoopMode command callback
summary: Stops listening for target loop mode change commands from a media session. Use it to stop responding when someone changes how a song or video repeats.

name: onToggleFavorite
description: Register toggle favorite command callback
summary: Registers a callback for the toggle-favorite command. Use it to mark or unmark the current song as a favorite.

name: offToggleFavorite
description: Unregister toggle favorite command callback
summary: Stops listening for favorite-toggle commands. Use it to stop responding when the user marks a song or video as a favorite.

name: onHandleKeyEvent
description: Register media key handling callback
summary: Registers a callback for handling media key events. Use it to respond when the user presses play, pause, or other media keys.

name: offHandleKeyEvent
description: Unregister media key handling callback
summary: Stops listening for media key events on a session. Use it to stop reacting when media keys are pressed.

name: onOutputDeviceChange
description: Register session output device change callback
summary: Tells the app when the audio output device changes. Use it to react when sound switches between speaker, headphones, or a car system.

name: offOutputDeviceChange
description: Unregister session output device change callback
summary: Stops listening for changes to the device the session plays through. Use it to stop reacting when audio switches to another speaker or headset.

name: onCommonCommand
description: Register session custom command change callback
summary: Registers a callback that runs when a custom command changes in the session. Use it to react to custom playback commands sent to your media session.

name: offCommonCommand
description: Unregister session custom command change callback
summary: Stops listening for custom session commands. Use it when you no longer want your app to receive those custom control commands.

name: onSkipToQueueItem
description: Register the item to play from the playlist change callback
summary: Registers a callback that tells the app which playlist item to play next. Use it to jump to a chosen song when the playlist selection changes.

name: offSkipToQueueItem
description: Unregister the item to play from the playlist change callback
summary: Stops listening for playlist item selection changes from a media session. Use it to stop responding when someone picks a different song from a playlist.

name: onAnswer
description: Register answer command callback.
summary: Registers a callback for the answer command. Use it so your app answers an incoming phone call when the user taps answer.

name: offAnswer
description: Unregister answer command callback.
summary: Stops listening for the answer command. Use it when you no longer want your app to handle answering a phone call.

name: onHangUp
description: Register hangUp command callback.
summary: Lets the app respond when the user hangs up a call. Use it so a phone call can be ended from a headset or car control.

name: offHangUp
description: Unregister hangUp command callback.
summary: Stops listening for hang-up commands on a session. Use it to stop reacting when the user hangs up a call.

name: onToggleCallMute
description: Register toggleCallMute command callback.
summary: Registers a callback for the toggle-call-mute command, showing the app supports muting a call. Use it to mute or unmute the microphone during a phone call.

name: offToggleCallMute
description: Unregister toggleCallMute command callback.
summary: Stops listening for mute-toggle commands during a call. Use it to stop responding when the user mutes or unmutes a phone call.

name: onCastDisplayChange
description: Register listener for cast display information changed.
summary: Listens for changes to cast display information. Use it to know when a screen being cast to changes, such as when casting a video to a TV.

name: offCastDisplayChange
description: Unregister listener for cast display information changed.
summary: Stops listening for changes to cast display information. Use it when you no longer need updates about which screen is showing the cast.

name: onCustomDataChange
description: Register listener for custom data sent from remote device.
summary: Registers a listener for custom data sent from a remote device. Use it to receive custom messages from another device during a media session.

name: offCustomDataChange
description: Unsubscribes from custom data changes.
summary: Stops listening for changes to custom data on a session. Use it to stop reacting when custom session data changes.

name: sendCustomData
description: Sends custom data to a remote device.
summary: Sends custom data from the app to a remote device. Use it to share app-specific information with another device.

name: stopCasting
description: Stop current cast and disconnect device connection.
summary: Stops the current cast and disconnects the remote device. Use it to end playing media on a TV or speaker and disconnect.

name: activate
description: Activate the session, indicating that the session can accept control commands
summary: Activates the session so it can accept control commands. Use it when playback starts and you want play, pause, or skip controls to work.

name: deactivate
description: Deactivate the session, indicating that the session not ready to accept control commands
summary: Deactivates the session so it no longer accepts control commands. Use it when playback stops and controls should no longer respond.

name: destroy
description: Destroy this session, the server will clean up the session resources
summary: Destroys the session and frees its resources on the server. Use it when you are finished with playback and want to clean up the session.

name: setDisplaySurface
description: Set a surface instance to display playing view, used at sink side.
summary: Sets the surface used to show the playing video on the receiving device. Use it to display the cast video on a screen.

name: getAVPlaybackState
description: Get the playback status of the current player
summary: Gets the playback status of the current player. Use it to check whether a cast is playing, paused, or stopped.

name: getSupportedDecoders
description: Get supported decoders of remote player.
summary: Gets the decoders the remote player supports. Use it to check what video formats can be played while casting.

name: getRecommendedResolutionLevel
description: Get recommended resolution of remote player based on each decoder.
summary: Gets the recommended resolution for the remote player for a given decoder type. Use it to pick the best picture quality when casting.

name: getSupportedHdrCapabilities
description: Get supported hdr capabilities of remote player.
summary: Gets the HDR formats the remote player supports. Use it to check whether high dynamic range video can be shown while casting.

name: getSupportedPlaySpeeds
description: Get supported speed of remote player.
summary: Gets the playback speeds the remote player supports. Use it to offer speed choices when casting.

name: sendControlCommand
description: Send control commands to remote player
summary: Sends a playback command to the remote player. Use it to play, pause, or skip on a cast device.

name: start
description: Play the current item, should contain mediaUri otherwise the playback will fail.
summary: Plays the current media item on the connected remote device. Use it to start playing a song or video on a cast device.

name: prepare
description: Load the current item and mediaUri can be null, this is needed for sink media information displaying
summary: Loads a media item for casting so the receiving device can show its information. Use it to get a video or song ready to play on a cast device.

name: getCurrentItem
description: Get the current playing item
summary: Gets the item currently playing on the remote player. Use it to show what is playing while casting.

name: getValidCommands
description: Get commands supported by the current cast controller
summary: Gets the commands the current cast controller supports. Use it to know which playback controls can be sent while casting.

name: processMediaKeyResponse
description: Process the response corresponding to the media key request obtained by the application.
summary: Processes the response for a media key request obtained by the app. Use it to complete a media key exchange when casting to a remote device.

name: sendCustomData
description: Sends custom data to a remote device.
summary: Sends custom data to a remote device. Use it to pass your own information to a device you are casting to.

name: release
description: Destroy the controller
summary: Destroys the cast controller. Use it to clean up when you are done controlling a cast.

name: on
params: type: 'playbackStateChange', filter: Array<keyof AVPlaybackState> | 'all', callback: (state: AVPlaybackState) => void
description: Register playback state changed callback
summary: Listens for playback commands or events sent from the remote side or media center, such as play next, play previous, request play, end of stream, seek done, video size change, or errors. Use it to respond to remote playback controls while casting.

name: onPlaybackStateChange
description: Register playback state changed callback
summary: Watches chosen playback state properties for changes during a cast. Use it to update the remote control when play, pause, or position changes.

name: onPlaybackStateChangeAll
description: Registers a callback to be invoked whenever the playback state changes
summary: Watches every playback state change during a cast. Use it to keep the remote control up to date whenever playback state changes.

name: off
description: Unregister playback state changed callback
summary: Stops listening for playback commands sent from the remote side or media center during a cast. Use it to stop reacting to remote play, pause, or seek commands when you no longer need them.

name: offPlaybackStateChange
description: Unregister playback state changed callback
summary: Stops listening for changes in the playback state during a cast. Use it to stop being notified when a casted song is playing, paused, or stopped.

name: onMediaItemChange
description: Register listener for current media item playback events.
summary: Watches for the media item currently playing to change during a cast. Use it to keep the remote control display in step with what is playing.

name: offMediaItemChange
description: Unregister listener for current media item playback events.
summary: Stops listening for current media item playback events. Use it to stop being notified when the playing media item changes.

name: onPlayNext
description: Register playback command callback sent by remote side or media center.
summary: Listens for a next-track command from the remote side or media center. Use it to load and play the following media item when the user skips forward.

name: offPlayNext
description: Unregister playback command callback sent by remote side or media center.
summary: Stops listening for the skip-to-next-track command sent from a remote or media center. Use it to stop responding to next-song requests when casting media.

name: onPlayPrevious
description: Register playback command callback sent by remote side or media center.
summary: Listens for a previous-track command from the remote side or media center. Use it to load and play the earlier media item when the user skips back.

name: offPlayPrevious
description: Unregister playback command callback sent by remote side or media center.
summary: Stops listening for the skip-to-previous-track command sent from a remote or media center. Use it to stop responding to previous-song requests when casting media.

name: onRequestPlay
description: Register requested playback command callback sent by remote side or media center.
summary: Listens for a play request from the remote side or media center, including which item and where to start. Use it to begin playing the requested media item.

name: offRequestPlay
description: Unregister requested playback command callback sent by remote side or media center.
summary: Stops listening for playback requests sent from a remote or media center. Use it to stop responding when someone asks to play a queued item while casting.

name: onEndOfStream
description: Register endOfStream state callback.
summary: Tells you when the cast stream has ended. Use it to load and play the next media item when the current one finishes.

name: offEndOfStream
description: Unregister endOfStream state callback.
summary: Stops listening for the end of stream state. Use it to stop being notified when playback of the stream finishes.

name: onSeekDone
description: Register listens for playback events.
summary: Tells you when a seek finishes on the casted playback. Use it to know when skipping to a new position in a video or song has completed.

name: offSeekDone
description: Unregister listens for playback events.
summary: Stops listening for seek-finished events during a cast. Use it to stop being notified when a jump to another point in a casted song completes.

name: onValidCommandChange
description: Register the valid commands of the casted session changed callback
summary: Tells you which playback commands are currently allowed on the casted session. Use it to enable or disable play, pause, and skip buttons for a cast.

name: offValidCommandChange
description: Unregister the valid commands of the casted session changed callback
summary: Stops listening for changes to the list of commands a casted session supports. Use it to stop being notified when available remote-control actions change while casting.

name: onVideoSizeChange
description: Register listener for video size change event, used at remote side.
summary: Tells you when the video size changes during casting. Use it to adjust the display area for a cast video.

name: offVideoSizeChange
description: Unregister listener for video size change event, used at remote side.
summary: Stops listening for changes to the video size on a remote cast. Use it to stop reacting when the video size changes during casting.

name: onError
description: Register listeners for playback error events.
summary: Watches for playback errors during a cast. Use it to notice when a cast song or video fails to play.

name: offError
description: Unregister listens for playback error events.
summary: Stops listening for playback error events. Use it to stop being notified when playback fails.

name: onCastControlGenericError
description: Register listeners for cast control generic error events.
summary: Listens for general cast control errors. Use it to detect when something goes wrong with remote playback while casting.

name: offCastControlGenericError
description: Unregister listeners for cast control generic error events.
summary: Stops listening for general cast control errors. Use it to stop being notified of general problems during a cast.

name: onCastControlIoError
description: Register listeners for cast control input/output error events.
summary: Watches for input/output errors during cast control. Use it to notice when a cast remote control fails to send or receive data.

name: offCastControlIoError
description: Unregister listeners for cast control input/output error events.
summary: Stops listening for input/output errors while casting. Use it to stop being notified when cast data cannot be read or written.

name: onCastControlParsingError
description: Register listeners for cast control parsing error events.
summary: Watches for parsing errors in cast control content. Use it to detect when cast media data cannot be read or understood.

name: offCastControlParsingError
description: Unregister listeners for cast control parsing error events.
summary: Stops listening for cast control parsing errors. Use it to stop being notified when a cast control message cannot be parsed.

name: onCastControlDecodingError
description: Register listeners for cast control decoding error events.
summary: Listens for decoding errors during a cast. Use it to detect when video or audio decoding fails while casting.

name: offCastControlDecodingError
description: Unregister listeners for cast control decoding error events.
summary: Stops listening for decoding errors while casting. Use it to stop being notified when the cast stream cannot be decoded.

name: onCastControlAudioRendererError
description: Register listeners for cast control audio renderer error error events.
summary: Listens for audio renderer errors during a cast. Use it to detect when audio playback fails while casting.

name: offCastControlAudioRendererError
description: Unregister listeners for cast control audio renderer error events.
summary: Stops listening for audio renderer errors while casting. Use it to stop being notified when audio playback fails during a cast.

name: onCastControlDrmError
description: Register listeners for cast control drm error events.
summary: Listens for DRM errors during a cast. Use it to detect when protected content cannot be played while casting.

name: offCastControlDrmError
description: Unregister listeners for cast control drm error events.
summary: Stops listening for DRM errors while casting. Use it to stop being notified when protected content fails to play during a cast.

name: onKeyRequest
description: Register listener for drm key request.
summary: Listens for DRM key requests during a cast. Use it to supply the keys needed to play protected cast content.

name: offKeyRequest
description: Unregister listener for drm key request.
summary: Stops listening for DRM key requests. Use it to stop being notified when a DRM key is needed for playback.

name: onCustomDataChange
description: Register listener for custom data sent from remote device.
summary: Listens for custom data sent from the remote device during a cast. Use it to receive extra information the other device shares while casting.

name: offCustomDataChange
description: Unregister listener for custom data sent from remote device.
summary: Stops listening for custom data sent from the remote device. Use it to stop receiving custom messages from a connected cast device.

name: select
description: Pull up the avcastpicker based on the options.
summary: Opens a picker for choosing which device the audio plays through. Use it to let someone pick a speaker, headset, or other output for their music or call.

name: resetCommunicationDevice
description: Reset audio device to be default set by the platform which is used for communication use cases
summary: Puts the audio output back to the device the platform normally uses for voice and video calls. Use it to return a phone call's sound to the earpiece or speaker after picking another output.

name: on
description: Register picker state change callback.
summary: Starts listening for changes in the output device picker's state. Use it to know when the picker for choosing where to cast opens or closes.

name: onPickerStateChange
description: Register picker state change callback.
summary: Starts listening for changes in the output device picker's state. Use it to know when the picker for choosing where to cast opens or closes.

name: off
description: Unregister picker state change callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes in the output device picker's state. Use it when you no longer need to know when the picker opens or closes.

name: offPickerStateChange
description: Unregister picker state change callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes in the output device picker's state. Use it when you no longer need to know when the picker opens or closes.

name: getAVPlaybackState
description: Get the playback status of the current session
summary: Gets the playback status of the current session. Use it to see whether media is playing, paused, or stopped.

name: getAVPlaybackStateSync
description: Get the playback status of the current session
summary: Gets the playback status of the current session. Use it to check whether a song is playing, paused, or stopped.

name: getAVMetadata
description: Get the metadata of the current session
summary: Gets the metadata of the current session. Use it to show what song or media is playing, like its title and artist.

name: getAVMetadataSync
description: Get the metadata of the current session
summary: Gets the metadata of the current session right away. Use it to show what song or media is playing, like its title and artist.

name: getAVCallState
description: Get the call status of the current session
summary: Gets the call status of the current session. Use it to check whether a phone call is ringing, active, or ended.

name: getCallMetadata
description: Get the call metadata of the current session
summary: Gets the call metadata of the current session. Use it to show details about an ongoing phone call.

name: getAVQueueTitle
description: Get the name of the playlist of the current session
summary: Gets the name of the playlist of the current session. Use it to show which playlist is currently playing.

name: getAVQueueTitleSync
description: Get the name of the playlist of the current session
summary: Gets the name of the playlist of the current session. Use it to show which playlist is currently playing.

name: getAVQueueItems
description: Get the playlist of the current session
summary: Gets the playlist of the current session. Use it to see the list of songs queued up to play.

name: getAVQueueItemsSync
description: Get the playlist of the current session
summary: Gets the playlist of the current media session. Use it to show what is queued up next in a music or video player.

name: skipToQueueItem
description: Set the item in the playlist to be played
summary: Sets which item in the playlist should be played. Use it to jump to and play a particular song in the queue.

name: getOutputDevice
description: Get output device information
summary: Gets information about the output device. Use it to find where the audio is currently playing.

name: getOutputDeviceSync
description: Get output device information
summary: Gets information about the output device right away. Use it to find where the audio is currently playing.

name: getSupportedPlaySpeeds
description: Get supported speeds supplied by application.
summary: Gets the playback speeds the app supports. Use it to show which speed options are available when playing a song or video.

name: getSupportedLoopModes
description: Get supported loop modes supplied by application.
summary: Gets the loop modes the app supports, such as repeat or shuffle. Use it to show which repeat options are available when playing a song.

name: sendAVKeyEvent
description: Send media key event to this session
summary: Sends a media key press to the session you are controlling. Use it to play, pause, or skip a song from a remote or headset button.

name: getLaunchAbility
description: Get the {@link WantAgent} of this session that can launch the session ability
summary: Gets the agent that can launch the session's ability. Use it to open the app behind the current media session.

name: getRealPlaybackPositionSync
description: Get the adjusted playback position. The time automatically calculated by the system
summary: Gets the current playback position in milliseconds, adjusted for playback status and speed. Use it to show where you are in a song or video.

name: isActive
description: Check if the current session is active
summary: Checks whether the current media session is active. Use it to tell if a song or video is currently playing.

name: isActiveSync
description: Check if the current session is active
summary: Checks whether the current media session is active. Use it to tell if a song or video is currently playing before controlling playback.

name: destroy
description: Destroy the server controller
summary: Destroys the server controller. Use it to release a media session controller when you are done controlling playback.

name: getValidCommands
description: Get commands supported by the current session
summary: Gets the playback commands the current session supports. Use it to know which controls, such as play or pause, can be used for a song.

name: getValidCommandsSync
description: Get commands supported by the current session
summary: Gets the playback commands the current session supports. Use it to know which controls, such as play or pause, can be used for a song.

name: sendControlCommand
description: Send control commands to this session
summary: Sends a playback control command to the media session. Use it to control media playback, such as playing, pausing, or skipping a song.

name: sendCommonCommand
description: Send common commands to this session
summary: Sends a named common command with parameters to the media session. Use it to trigger playback actions like play, pause, or skip on the session you control.

name: getExtras
description: Get custom media packets provided by the corresponding session
summary: Gets custom media packets supplied by the matching session. Use it to read extra media details a session provides.

name: getExtrasWithEvent
description: Get extra information for remote device, such as volume level, connected devices.
summary: Gets extra information for a remote device, such as volume level or connected devices, by event name. Use it to check remote playback details.

name: isDesktopLyricEnabled
description: Query desktop lyric enabled state for this session.
summary: Checks whether desktop lyrics are turned on for this session. Use it to see if lyrics are shown on the desktop while a song plays.

name: onDesktopLyricEnabled
description: Register desktop lyric enable state change callback.
summary: Watches whether desktop lyrics are turned on or off. Use it to know when lyrics on the desktop get enabled or disabled while a song plays.

name: offDesktopLyricEnabled
description: Unregister desktop lyric enable state change callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes to whether desktop lyrics are enabled. Use it to stop being told when desktop lyrics are turned on or off.

name: setDesktopLyricVisible
description: Set desktop lyric visible state for this session.
summary: Shows or hides the desktop lyric window for the session. Use it to turn desktop lyrics on or off while a song plays.

name: isDesktopLyricVisible
description: Query desktop lyric visible state for this session.
summary: Checks whether desktop lyrics are currently visible for this session. Use it to tell if the on-screen lyrics are showing while a song plays.

name: onDesktopLyricVisibilityChanged
description: Register desktop lyric visible state change callback.
summary: Watches whether desktop lyrics are shown or hidden. Use it to know when the lyrics on the desktop appear or disappear while a song plays.

name: offDesktopLyricVisibilityChanged
description: Unregister desktop lyric visible state change callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes to whether desktop lyrics are visible. Use it to stop being told when desktop lyrics show or hide.

name: setDesktopLyricState
description: Set desktop lyric state such as lock state for this session.
summary: Sets the desktop lyric state, such as its lock state, for the session. Use it to control how desktop lyrics behave while a song plays.

name: getDesktopLyricState
description: Get desktop lyric state such as lock state for this session.
summary: Gets the desktop lyric state, such as whether lyrics are locked, for the current session. Use it to check if lyrics are shown on the desktop.

name: onDesktopLyricStateChanged
description: Register desktop lyric state changed callback.
summary: Watches for changes in the desktop lyric state. Use it to react when the lyrics shown on the desktop change while a song plays.

name: offDesktopLyricStateChanged
description: Unregister desktop lyric state changed callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes to the desktop lyric state. Use it when you no longer need updates about desktop lyric status.

name: getMediaCenterControlType
description: Get media control type that the can be displayed on the media center.
summary: Gets the media control types the app shows on the media center. Use it to see which playback controls are displayed there.

name: onMediaCenterControlTypeChanged
description: Register media center control type changed callback.
summary: Watches for changes in the media center control type. Use it to react when the controls offered in the media center change.

name: offMediaCenterControlTypeChanged
description: Unregister media center control type changed callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes to the media center control type. Use it to stop being notified when the media center control type changes.

name: onMetadataChange
description: Register metadata changed callback
summary: Watches for changes to chosen media metadata properties. Use it to update the song title, artist, or other track details shown while a song plays.

name: onMetadataChangeAll
description: Registers a callback to be invoked whenever any metadata changes
summary: Watches for any change to the media information of a session, such as the title or artist. Use it to keep a now-playing display up to date.

name: offMetadataChange
description: Unregister metadata changed callback
summary: Stops listening for changes to the media information. Use it to stop being notified when the song details change.

name: onPlaybackStateChange
description: Register playback state changed callback
summary: Watches for changes to chosen playback properties, such as whether the song is playing or paused. Use it to keep play and pause controls in sync.

name: onPlaybackStateChangeAll
description: Registers a callback to be invoked whenever the playback state changes
summary: Watches for any change in the playback state of a session. Use it to keep play, pause, and progress controls in sync.

name: offPlaybackStateChange
description: Unregister playback state changed callback
summary: Stops listening for changes to the playback state. Use it to stop being notified when play, pause, or stop changes.

name: on
params: type: 'callMetadataChange', filter: Array<keyof CallMetadata> | 'all', callback: Callback<CallMetadata>
description: Register call metadata changed callback
summary: Listens for changes to the name of the current playlist. Use it to show or update the playlist title while playing music.

name: onCallMetadataChange
description: Register call metadata changed callback
summary: Watches chosen details of a phone call, such as who is calling. Use it to show call information while a call is happening.

name: onCallMetadataChangeAll
description: Registers a callback for all call metadata changes
summary: Watches every detail of a phone call as it changes. Use it to keep call information up to date during a call.

name: off
description: Unregister call metadata changed callback
summary: Stops listening for session changes such as call state, playlist, output device, or custom data updates. Use it to stop receiving updates when you no longer need them.

name: offCallMetadataChange
description: Unregister call metadata changed callback
summary: Stops listening for changes to call metadata. Use it to stop receiving updates about phone call details.

name: onCallStateChange
description: Register call state changed callback
summary: Watches chosen states of a phone call, such as ringing or answered. Use it to follow what stage a call is in.

name: onCallStateChangeAll
description: Register a callback for all call attribute changes
summary: Watches all changes to a phone call's state. Use it to follow a call from ringing to ending.

name: offCallStateChange
description: Unregister playback state changed callback
summary: Stops listening for changes to the call state of a media session. Use it to stop being told when a phone call starts or ends while controlling playback.

name: onSessionDestroy
description: Register current session destroyed callback
summary: Tells you when the media session you are controlling is closed. Use it to stop showing playback controls for a song or video that has ended.

name: offSessionDestroy
description: Unregister current session destroyed callback
summary: Stops listening for when the media session ends. Use it to stop reacting when a song or video finishes playing.

name: onActiveStateChange
description: Register the active state of this session changed callback
summary: Watches whether the session becomes active or inactive. Use it to tell when playback starts or stops so your app can react.

name: offActiveStateChange
description: Unregister the active state of this session changed callback
summary: Stops listening for changes to whether this session is active. Use it to stop being notified when playback starts or stops.

name: onValidCommandChange
description: Register the valid commands of the session changed callback
summary: Tells you when the commands a media session accepts change. Use it to show or hide playback buttons like play, pause, and skip.

name: offValidCommandChange
description: Unregister the valid commands of the session changed callback
summary: Stops listening for changes to which playback commands are available. Use it to stop reacting when the allowed controls for a song or video change.

name: onOutputDeviceChange
description: Register session output device change callback
summary: Watches for changes to the device the session's audio is played through. Use it to update which speaker or headphones are shown as playing the song.

name: offOutputDeviceChange
description: Unregister session output device change callback
summary: Stops listening for changes to the output device. Use it to stop being notified when the audio output device changes.

name: onSessionEvent
description: Register session event callback
summary: Tells you when an event happens in the media session you are controlling. Use it to react to playback changes while controlling a song or video.

name: offSessionEvent
description: Unregister session event callback
summary: Stops listening for events from the media session. Use it to stop reacting to playback events like play, pause, or skip.

name: onQueueItemsChange
description: Register session playlist change callback
summary: Watches for changes to the list of songs queued in a session. Use it to refresh the playlist shown to the user.

name: offQueueItemsChange
description: Unregister session playlist change callback
summary: Stops listening for changes to the playlist items. Use it to stop being notified when the playlist changes.

name: onQueueTitleChange
description: Register the name of session playlist change callback
summary: Watches for changes to the name of a session's playlist. Use it to update the playlist title shown to the user.

name: offQueueTitleChange
description: Unregister the name of session playlist change callback
summary: Stops listening for changes to the playlist name. Use it to stop being notified when the playlist name changes.

name: onExtrasChange
description: Register the custom media packets change callback
summary: Watches for changes to custom media packets. Use it to react when extra media information changes during playback.

name: offExtrasChange
description: Unregister the custom media packets change callback
summary: Stops listening for changes to custom media packets in a session. Use it when you no longer need updates to extra media information.

name: sendCustomData
description: Send custom data to this avsession.
summary: Sends custom application data to the media session. Use it to pass your own information to the session you are controlling.

name: onCustomDataChange
description: Register listener for custom data.
summary: Watches custom data shared by the session. Use it to receive app-specific updates sent along with media playback.

name: offCustomDataChange
description: Unregister listener for custom data.
summary: Stops listening for changes to custom data in a media session. Use it when you no longer need updates to your own extra session data.

name: onSupportedPlaySpeedsChange
description: Register listener for supported play speeds.
summary: Tells you when the playback speeds a media session supports change. Use it to update the speed choices shown while playing a song or video.

name: offSupportedPlaySpeedsChange
description: Unregister listener for supported play speeds.
summary: Stops listening for changes to the available playback speeds. Use it to stop reacting when the speed options for playing a song or video change.

name: onSupportedLoopModesChange
description: Register listener for supported loop modes.
summary: Tells you when the loop modes a media session supports change. Use it to update the repeat and shuffle choices shown for playing a song.

name: offSupportedLoopModesChange
description: Unregister listener for supported loop modes.
summary: Stops listening for changes to the available repeat modes. Use it to stop reacting when the loop options for playback change.

name: getCameraManager
description: Obtains a CameraManager instance. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Gives you the camera manager for the app. Use it to start working with the camera, such as opening it or taking photos.

name: getSupportedCameras
description: Obtains the supported cameras (such as the default camera whose **CameraType** is **CAMERA_TYPE_DEFAULT**). This
summary: Gets the list of cameras the device supports, such as the default camera. Use it to find out which cameras are available before taking photos or recording video.

name: getSupportedOutputCapability
description: Obtains the output capability supported by a camera device. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Gets the output capability a camera supports in a given scene mode. Use it to check what a camera can output before taking photos or recording video.

name: getSupportedSceneModes
description: Obtains the scene modes supported by a camera device. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Gets the scene modes a camera supports. Use it to see which shooting modes, such as photo or video, a camera offers.

name: getSupportedFullOutputCapability
description: Obtains the complete output capabilities supported by a specified camera in a specified mode, including YUV,
summary: Gets all the output capabilities a chosen camera supports in a chosen scene mode, including YUV, HEIF, and HDR. Use it to check what photo and video formats a camera can produce.

name: isCameraMuted
description: Checks whether this camera is muted.
summary: Checks whether the camera is muted. Use it to find out if the camera has been silenced before taking photos or recording video.

name: isCameraMuteSupported
description: Checks whether the camera device can be muted.
summary: Checks whether the camera can be muted. Use it to find out if you can silence the camera shutter sound.

name: muteCamera
description: Mutes or unmutes the camera device.
summary: Mutes or unmutes the camera device. Use it to silence the camera, for example to turn off the shutter sound.

name: muteCameraPersistent
description: Mutes the camera device permanently.
summary: Mutes or unmutes the camera device permanently according to a policy type. Use it to keep the camera silenced across sessions.

name: createCameraInput
description: Creates a **CameraInput** instance with the specified **CameraDevice** instance. This API returns the result
summary: Creates a camera input from a chosen camera device. Use it to set up the camera you want before taking photos or recording video.

name: createCameraInputWithTokenId
description: Creates a CameraInput instance by camera and calling token.
summary: Creates a camera input from a chosen camera device and calling token. Use it to start using a specific camera for taking photos or videos.

name: createPreviewOutput
description: Creates a **PreviewOutput** instance. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Creates a preview output for showing the camera view on screen. Use it to set up the live preview before taking a photo or recording a video.

name: createPhotoOutput
description: Creates a **PhotoOutput** instance. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Creates a photo output for the camera. Use it to set up taking still photos.

name: createVideoOutput
description: Creates a **VideoOutput** instance. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Creates a video output for recording. Use it to set up video recording from the camera.

name: createMetadataOutput
description: Creates a **MetadataOutput** instance. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Creates an output for camera metadata objects. Use it to detect things like faces or barcodes in the camera view.

name: createDepthDataOutput
description: Creates a DepthDataOutput instance. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Creates an output for depth data from the camera. Use it to capture depth information along with a photo.

name: createCaptureSession
description: Creates a **CaptureSession** instance. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Creates a capture session for the camera. Use it to set up a session that takes photos or records video.

name: createSession
description: Creates a **Session** instance with a given scene mode. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Creates a camera session for a chosen scene mode. Use it to start a camera session for taking photos or recording video.

name: on
description: Subscribes to camera status events. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the result.
summary: Listens for camera mute status changes on a device. Use it to know when the camera has been muted or unmuted.

name: onCameraStatus
description: Subscribes camera status change event callback.
summary: Listens for changes in camera status. Use it to know when a camera is turned on or off.

name: off
description: Unsubscribes from camera status events. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the result.
summary: Stops listening for flashlight status change events. Use it to stop being notified when the flashlight is turned on or off.

name: offCameraStatus
description: Unsubscribes from camera status change event callback.
summary: Stops listening for camera status change events. Use it to stop being notified when a camera becomes available or unavailable.

name: onFoldStatusChange
description: Subscribes fold status change event callback.
summary: Listens for fold status changes on a foldable device. Use it to react when the device is folded or unfolded.

name: offFoldStatusChange
description: Unsubscribes from fold status change event callback.
summary: Stops listening for fold status change events. Use it to stop being notified when a foldable device is folded or unfolded.

name: onCameraMute
description: Subscribes camera mute change event callback.
summary: Starts listening for changes to whether the camera is muted. Use it to be notified when the camera is muted or unmuted.

name: offCameraMute
description: Unsubscribes from camera mute change event callback.
summary: Stops listening for camera mute change events. Use it to stop being notified when the camera is muted or unmuted.

name: onControlCenterStatusChange
description: Subscribes control center status change event callback.
summary: Starts listening for changes to the control center status. Use it to be notified when the camera control center opens or closes.

name: offControlCenterStatusChange
description: Unsubscribes control center status change event callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes to the control center status. Use it to stop being notified when the camera control center opens or closes.

name: isControlCenterActive
description: Check if the control center active.
summary: Tells you whether the camera control center is currently active. Use it to check if the camera control center is showing before acting on it.

name: createControlCenterSession
description: Create a ControlCenterSession instance.
summary: Creates a session for controlling the camera from a control center. Use it to manage camera controls from a central place.

name: isPrelaunchSupported
description: Checks whether a camera device supports prelaunch.
summary: Checks whether a given camera device can be prelaunched. Use it to find out if a camera supports starting up ahead of time.

name: setPrelaunchConfig
description: Sets prelaunch configuration.
summary: Sets the configuration used when prelaunching the camera. Use it to choose how the camera starts up ahead of time.

name: prelaunch
description: Prelaunches the camera device. This API is called when a user clicks the system camera icon to start the camera
summary: Prelaunches the camera device, as when a user taps the system camera icon to open the camera app. Use it to start the camera quickly.

name: preSwitchCamera
description: Pre-switches a camera device to speed up its startup.
summary: Pre-switches to a chosen camera device so it starts up faster. Use it to get a specific camera ready before taking a photo or video.

name: createDeferredPreviewOutput
description: Creates a deferred **PreviewOutput** instance and adds it, instead of a common **PreviewOutput** instance, to the
summary: Creates a preview output that is added later during stream setup. Use it to show the camera preview on screen before taking a photo or video.

name: isTorchSupported
description: Checks whether the camera device supports the flashlight.
summary: Checks whether the camera device has a flashlight. Use it to find out if the flashlight can be turned on at all.

name: isTorchModeSupported
description: Checks whether a flashlight mode is supported.
summary: Checks whether a particular flashlight mode is supported. Use it to find out if the flashlight can be set to a specific mode before turning it on.

name: getTorchMode
description: Obtains the flashlight mode of this camera device.
summary: Gets the current flashlight mode of the camera. Use it to check whether the flashlight is on, off, or set to automatic.

name: setTorchMode
description: Sets the flashlight mode.
summary: Sets the flashlight mode of the camera. Use it to turn the flashlight on or off.

name: isTorchLevelControlSupported
description: Checks whether the device supports flashlight brightness control.
summary: Checks whether the device supports adjusting flashlight brightness. Use it to see if you can dim or brighten the flashlight.

name: setTorchModeOnWithLevel
description: Sets the torch mode to {@link camera.TorchMode.ON} with the specified torch level.
summary: Turns on the torch at a chosen brightness level from 0.0 to 1.0. Use it to switch on the flashlight at a set strength.

name: onTorchStatusChange
description: Subscribes torch status change event callback.
summary: Listens for changes in the torch status. Use it to know when the flashlight is turned on or off.

name: offTorchStatusChange
description: Unsubscribes torch status change event callback.
summary: Stops listening for flashlight status change events. Use it to stop being notified when the flashlight status changes.

name: getCameraDevice
description: Obtains the specified camera based on the camera position and type.
summary: Gets a camera by its position and type. Use it to find the front or rear camera on the device.

name: getCameraConcurrentInfos
description: Obtains the concurrency information of the specified cameras. If the return value is an empty array, concurrency
summary: Gets whether the given cameras can be used at the same time. Use it to check if front and rear cameras can run together.

name: getCameraDevices
params: position: CameraPosition, types: Array<CameraType>, connectType: ConnectionType
description: Obtains the list of cameras that meet the search criteria based on the camera position, camera types, and
summary: Gets the list of cameras matching a position, types, and connection type. Use it to find available cameras on the device.

name: open
description: Opens this camera device. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Opens the camera so it can start working. Use it to turn the camera on before taking photos or recording video.

name: close
description: Closes this camera device. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Closes the camera device. Use it to release the camera when you are done taking photos or recording.

name: closeDelayed
description: Delay close camera.
summary: Closes the camera after a set number of seconds. Use it to turn the camera off automatically after a delay.

name: on
description: Subscribes to CameraInput error events. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the result.
summary: Starts listening for error events from a camera device, such as when the camera is unavailable or conflicts occur. Use it to be notified about camera problems.

name: onError
description: Subscribes to error events.
summary: Starts listening for error events from a camera device. Use it to be notified about camera problems.

name: off
description: Unsubscribes from CameraInput error events.
summary: Stops listening for error events from a camera device, such as when the camera is unavailable or conflicts occur. Use it to stop being notified about camera problems.

name: offError
description: Unsubscribes from error events.
summary: Stops listening for error events from a camera device. Use it to stop being notified about camera problems.

name: onCameraOcclusionDetection
description: Subscribes to camera occlusion detection results.
summary: Starts listening for camera occlusion detection results. Use it to be told when the camera view is blocked or covered.

name: offCameraOcclusionDetection
description: Unsubscribes from camera occlusion detection results.
summary: Stops listening for camera occlusion detection results. Use it to stop being told when the camera view is blocked or covered.

name: usedAsPosition
description: Sets the camera to be used as a camera at the specified position.
summary: Sets the camera to be used at a specified position. Use it to choose which camera on the device takes the picture.

name: controlAuxiliary
description: Control auxiliary.
summary: Turns an auxiliary camera feature on or off by its type and status. Use it to switch auxiliary camera hardware, such as a flash, on or off.

name: isPhysicalCameraOrientationVariable
description: Checks whether the physical camera orientation is adjustable in different fold states of the device.
summary: Checks whether the physical camera orientation can change with different fold states. Use it to know if the camera angle adjusts when the device is folded.

name: getPhysicalCameraOrientation
description: Obtains the physical camera orientation in the current fold state of the device.
