summary: Gets the physical camera orientation for the device's current fold state. Use it to know how the camera is rotated when the device is folded.

name: usePhysicalCameraOrientation
description: Enables or disables the use of the physical camera orientation.
summary: Turns the use of the physical camera orientation on or off. Use it to control whether photos and videos follow the camera's real orientation.

name: hasFlash
description: Checks whether the camera device has flash.
summary: Checks whether the camera device has a flash. Use it to find out if the device has a flashlight before trying to turn it on.

name: isFlashModeSupported
description: Checks whether a flash mode is supported.
summary: Checks whether a particular flash mode is supported. Use it to see if the device can use a chosen flashlight setting.

name: isLcdFlashSupported
description: Checks whether the LCD flash is supported.
summary: Checks whether the device supports an LCD flash. Use it to find out if the screen can be used as a flashlight before turning it on.

name: getFlashMode
description: Obtains the flash mode in use.
summary: Gets the current flash mode. Use it to check whether the flash is on, off, or automatic before taking a photo.

name: setFlashMode
description: Sets a flash mode.
summary: Sets the flash mode for the camera. Use it to turn the flashlight on, off, or set it to automatic before taking a photo.

name: enableLcdFlash
description: Enables or disables the LCD flash.
summary: Turns the LCD flash on or off. Use it to light up the screen as a flashlight for taking pictures in the dark.

name: onFlashStateChange
description: Subscribes to flash light status change events.
summary: Starts listening for changes to the flash light status. Use it to know when the flashlight turns on or off.

name: offFlashStateChange
description: Unsubscribes from flash light status change events.
summary: Stops listening for changes to the flash light status. Use it to stop being told when the flashlight turns on or off.

name: isExposureModeSupported
description: Checks whether an exposure mode is supported.
summary: Checks whether a given exposure mode is supported. Use it to see if you can lock or auto-adjust exposure before taking a photo.

name: getExposureBiasRange
description: Obtains the exposure compensation values of the camera device.
summary: Gets the range of exposure compensation values the camera supports. Use it to find how much you can brighten or darken a photo.

name: isExposureMeteringModeSupported
description: Checks whether the specified exposure metering mode is supported.
summary: Checks whether the camera supports a particular exposure metering mode. Use it to see which light-metering options you can choose before taking a photo.

name: getExposureMode
description: Obtains the exposure mode in use.
summary: Obtains the exposure mode currently in use. Use it to check how the camera is setting exposure before taking a photo.

name: setExposureMode
description: Sets an exposure mode. Before the setting, call
summary: Sets an exposure mode for the camera. Use it to choose how the camera adjusts exposure when taking a photo.

name: getMeteringPoint
description: Obtains the metering point of the camera device.
summary: Obtains the metering point of the camera device. Use it to see where the camera is measuring light for exposure.

name: setMeteringPoint
description: Sets the metering point, which is the center point of the metering rectangle. The metering point must be in the
summary: Sets the point the camera uses to measure brightness for exposure. Use it to tap a spot on the preview so the camera exposes for that area.

name: setExposureBias
description: Sets an exposure compensation value (EV).
summary: Sets an exposure compensation value to make a photo brighter or darker. Use it to brighten or darken a shot before taking a picture.

name: getExposureValue
description: Obtains the exposure value in use.
summary: Obtains the exposure value currently in use. Use it to check how bright or dark the camera is exposing the shot.

name: getExposureMeteringMode
description: Obtains the exposure metering mode in use.
summary: Tells you which exposure metering mode the camera is currently using. Use it to check how the camera is measuring light before taking a photo.

name: setExposureMeteringMode
description: Sets exposure metering mode.
summary: Chooses how the camera measures light for exposure. Use it to pick a metering mode so photos are brighter or darker as you want.

name: isFocusModeSupported
description: Checks whether a focus mode is supported.
summary: Checks whether a focus mode is supported. Use it to see if a focus mode can be used before setting it.

name: isFocusAssistSupported
description: Checks whether the focus assist is supported.
summary: Checks whether the camera can use focus assist to help focus in difficult conditions. Use it before turning on focus assist to see if the device supports it.

name: isFocusRangeTypeSupported
description: Checks whether a focus range type is supported.
summary: Checks whether a particular focus range type is supported. Use it to find out if the camera can focus at a chosen range before taking a photo.

name: isFocusDrivenTypeSupported
description: Checks whether a focus drive type is supported.
summary: Checks whether the camera supports a particular focus drive type, such as face or motion tracking. Use it before choosing that focus mode to see if it is available.

name: isLockFocusTrackingSupported
description: Checks whether lock focus tracking is supported.
summary: Checks whether the camera can lock focus tracking on a subject. Use it to find out if keeping a moving subject in focus is possible before turning that mode on.

name: getFocusMode
description: Obtains the focus mode in use.
summary: Gets the focus mode currently in use. Use it to check how the camera is focusing before taking a photo.

name: setFocusMode
description: Sets a focus mode.
summary: Sets the focus mode, such as manual or automatic. Use it to choose how the camera focuses before taking a photo.

name: setFocusPoint
description: Sets the focal point. The focal point must be in the coordinate system (0-1), where the top-left corner is {0, 0}
summary: Sets the focal point using coordinates from 0 to 1, with the top-left as {0, 0}. Use it to tap the screen and focus on a chosen spot.

name: getFocusPoint
description: Obtains the focal point in use.
summary: Gets the focal point currently in use. Use it to find where the camera is focused.

name: getFocalLength
description: Obtains the focal length in use.
summary: Gets the focal length currently in use. Use it to find out the zoom or lens distance of the camera.

name: getFocusAssist
description: Checks whether the focus assist is enabled.
summary: Checks whether focus assist is turned on. Use it to see if the camera is helping you focus.

name: setFocusAssist
description: Sets the focus assist. Before the setting, call
summary: Turns focus assist on or off, which helps the camera focus in low light or on low-contrast subjects. Use it when you want help getting a sharp picture in tricky lighting.

name: getFocusRange
description: Obtains the focus range type in use.
summary: Tells you which focus range setting the camera is currently using. Use it to check whether the camera is focused for close-up or distant shots.

name: setFocusRange
description: Sets a focus range type. Before the setting, call
summary: Sets how near or far the camera focuses, for example close-up or far away. Use it to get sharp close-up shots or distant scenery.

name: getFocusDriven
description: Obtains the focus drive type in use.
summary: Tells you which focus drive type is being used. Use it to find out how the camera is focusing.

name: setFocusDriven
description: Sets a focus drive type. Before the setting, call
summary: Chooses what the camera focuses on, such as a face or a moving subject. Use it to make the camera track the right thing while taking a photo or video.

name: lockFocusTracking
description: Lock focus tracking.
summary: Locks focus tracking on a chosen point. Use it to keep the camera focused on a subject that moves.

name: unlockFocusTracking
description: Unlock focus tracking.
summary: Unlocks focus tracking. Use it to stop keeping the camera focused on a moving subject.

name: isFocusDistanceSupported
description: Checks whether a focus distance is supported.
summary: Checks whether the camera supports setting a focus distance. Use it to find out if you can focus on a chosen distance before adjusting focus by hand.

name: getFocusDistance
description: Gets current focus distance, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with 0.0 being shortest
summary: Reads the current focus distance of the camera, from 0.0 (closest) to 1.0 (furthest). Use it to check how far the lens is focused before taking a photo.

name: setFocusDistance
description: Sets focus distance. Possible distance values range from 0.0 to 1.0, with 0.0 being shortest
summary: Sets the camera focus distance from 0.0 (closest) to 1.0 (furthest). Use it to manually focus the camera on a subject at a chosen distance.

name: isWhiteBalanceModeSupported
description: Checks whether a white balance mode is supported.
summary: Checks whether the camera supports a given white balance mode. Use it before choosing a white balance setting for your shot.

name: getWhiteBalanceRange
description: Obtains the range of white balance values in manual white balance mode.
summary: Gives the range of white balance values available in manual white balance mode, in Kelvin. Use it to see how warm or cool you can make the picture.

name: getColorTintRange
description: Obtains the supported white balance hue adjustment range.
summary: Tells you the range of color tint values you can set for white balance. Use it to find the limits before adjusting the tint.

name: isWhiteBalanceGainsSupported
description: Checks whether the RGB gain is supported.
summary: Checks whether the camera supports RGB gain for white balance. Use it to find out if you can fine-tune colour balance with gains.

name: getWhiteBalanceMode
description: Obtains the white balance mode in use.
summary: Tells you which white balance mode the camera is using. Use it to check whether white balance is automatic or set manually.

name: setWhiteBalanceMode
description: Sets a white balance mode. Before the setting, run
summary: Sets the camera's white balance mode so colours look right under different lighting. Check first whether the device supports that mode.

name: getWhiteBalance
description: Obtains the current white balance value.
summary: Reads the current white balance value in kelvin. Use it to check how warm or cool the camera's colour setting is.

name: setWhiteBalance
description: Sets a white balance value.
summary: Sets the white balance value in kelvin. Use it to make photos or video look warmer or cooler under different lighting.

name: setColorTint
description: Sets color tint.
summary: Changes the color tint for white balance. Use it to make the picture look warmer or cooler.

name: getColorTint
description: Gets current color tint.
summary: Reads the current color tint setting for white balance. Use it to check how warm or cool the colors look before adjusting them.

name: getWhiteBalanceGains
description: Gets RGB white balance gain values.
summary: Reads the current red, green and blue white balance gain values. Use it to check the colour balance the camera is applying.

name: setWhiteBalanceGains
description: Sets RGB white balance gain values.
summary: Sets the red, green and blue white balance gain values. Use it to fine-tune the colour balance of the camera image.

name: isManualIsoSupported
description: Checks whether manual ISO setting is supported.
summary: Checks whether the camera lets you set ISO light sensitivity by hand. Use it to see if manual ISO control is available before adjusting a photo.

name: getIsoRange
description: Obtains the supported ISO range.
summary: Gets the range of ISO light-sensitivity values the camera supports. Use it to find which ISO settings you can choose for a photo.

name: getSupportedIsoRange
description: Get a array of supported standard ISO sensitivity values, as defined in ISO 12232:2006.
summary: Gets the list of ISO sensitivity values the camera supports for manual ISO setting. Use it to find out which ISO values you can pick when adjusting exposure by hand.

name: getIso
description: Gets current ISO.
summary: Reads the camera's current ISO light-sensitivity value. Use it to check how sensitive the camera is to light before taking a photo.

name: setIso
description: Sets ISO sensitivity value, within the range of getSupportedIsoRange. This control can not be effective if
summary: Sets the camera's ISO light-sensitivity value within the supported range. Use it to brighten or darken a photo by hand in different lighting.

name: getZoomRatioRange
description: Obtains the supported zoom ratio range.
summary: Tells you the smallest and largest zoom ratios the camera supports. Use it to know how far you can zoom in or out.

name: getZoomPointInfos
description: Obtains the equivalent focal length information list in the current mode.
summary: Gets the list of equivalent focal length information for the current camera mode. Use it to see the zoom levels available for taking a photo or video.

name: isZoomCenterPointSupported
description: Checks whether zoom center point is supported.
summary: Checks whether the camera supports choosing a zoom center point. Use it to find out if you can zoom toward a chosen spot in the picture.

name: getRAWCaptureZoomRatioRange
description: Obtains the supported zoom ratio range during shooting in RAW format.
summary: Tells you the zoom ratios the camera supports when shooting in RAW format. Use it to know how far you can zoom for RAW photos.

name: getZoomRatio
description: Obtains the zoom ratio in use.
summary: Tells you the zoom ratio the camera is currently using. Use it to show how far in or out the camera is zoomed.

name: setZoomRatio
description: Sets a zoom ratio, with a maximum precision of two decimal places.
summary: Sets the camera zoom to a chosen ratio. Use it to zoom in or out for a photo or video.

name: setSmoothZoom
description: Sets smooth zoom.
summary: Zooms the camera in or out smoothly to a chosen ratio. Use it to zoom in on a subject without a sudden jump.

name: prepareZoom
description: Instructs the bottom layer to prepare for zooming, for example, powering on the sensor.
summary: Tells the camera to get ready for zooming, such as powering on the sensor. Use it before zooming in or out.

name: unprepareZoom
description: Instructs the bottom layer to unprepare for zooming.
summary: Tells the camera to stop being ready for zooming. Use it to release zoom preparation when zooming is no longer needed.

name: setZoomCenterPoint
description: Sets zoom center point.
summary: Sets the point that the camera zooms in on. Use it to zoom toward a chosen spot in the picture, such as a face or object.

name: getZoomCenterPoint
description: Gets zoom center point.
summary: Gets the point the camera zooms in on. Use it to find where the zoom is centred in the picture.

name: isVideoStabilizationModeSupported
description: Checks whether a video stabilization mode is supported.
summary: Checks whether a video stabilization mode is supported. Use it to find out if steady, shake-free video recording is available before turning stabilization on.

name: getActiveVideoStabilizationMode
description: Obtains the video stabilization mode in use.
summary: Gets the video stabilization mode currently in use. Use it to check which stabilization setting is active while recording a video.

name: setVideoStabilizationMode
description: Sets a video stabilization mode. Before the setting, call
summary: Sets the video stabilization mode. Use it to steady shaky video while recording.

name: getSupportedBeautyTypes
description: Obtains the supported beauty types.
summary: Lists the beauty types the camera supports. Use it to see which beauty effects you can apply when taking a photo or video.

name: getSupportedBeautyRange
description: Obtains the levels that can be set a beauty type. The beauty levels vary according to the device type. The
summary: Tells you which beauty levels you can set for a chosen beauty type, such as skin smoothing. Use it to find the allowed values before applying a beauty effect to a photo or video.

name: getSupportedPortraitThemeTypes
description: Gets supported portrait theme type.
summary: Lists the portrait theme types the camera supports. Use it to see which portrait themes you can apply when taking a photo.

name: isPortraitThemeSupported
description: Checks whether portrait theme is supported.
summary: Checks whether the camera supports portrait themes. Use it to decide whether to offer portrait theme options when taking a photo.

name: getBeauty
description: Obtains the level of the beauty type in use.
summary: Tells you the current level of a beauty effect. Use it to check how much skin smoothing or similar effect is applied before taking a selfie.

name: setBeauty
description: Sets a beauty type and its level. Beauty mode is turned off only when all the
summary: Sets a beauty effect type and how strong it is. Use it to smooth skin or adjust other beauty effects for a selfie.

name: setPortraitThemeType
description: Sets a portrait theme type for a camera device.
summary: Sets a portrait theme for the camera. Use it to apply a portrait style when taking a person's photo.

name: isEffectSuggestionSupported
description: Checks whether effect suggestion is supported.
summary: Checks whether effect suggestion is supported. Use it to see if the camera can suggest photo effects.

name: enableEffectSuggestion
description: Enable effect suggestion for session.
summary: Turns effect suggestion on or off for the camera session. Use it to let the camera suggest photo effects while shooting.

name: getSupportedEffectSuggestionTypes
description: Gets supported effect suggestion types.
summary: Gets the list of effect suggestion types the camera supports. Use it to see which photo effect suggestions are available.

name: setEffectSuggestionStatus
description: Set the range of effect suggestion type and enable status.
summary: Sets which effect suggestion types are available and whether each is on, all at once when the app starts. Use it to choose which camera effect hints the app offers.

name: updateEffectSuggestion
description: Update the enable status of the effect suggestion type.
summary: Turns a single effect suggestion type on or off. Use it to switch one camera effect hint on or off while the app is running.

name: getSupportedColorEffects
description: Obtains the supported color effects.
summary: Lists the color effects the camera can use. Check it before choosing a color effect for your photos or videos.

name: getColorEffect
description: Obtains the color effect in use.
summary: Tells you the color effect currently in use. Use it to check which color filter is applied to the camera before taking a photo or video.

name: setColorEffect
description: Sets a color effect. Before the setting, call
summary: Sets the lens color effect for photos or videos. Use it to give your shots a different look, such as a warm or cool tone.

name: getSupportedColorSpaces
description: Obtains the supported color spaces.
summary: Gets the color spaces the camera supports. Use it to pick a color space before setting one for photos or videos.

name: getActiveColorSpace
description: Obtains the color space in use.
summary: Gets the color space currently in use. Use it to find out which color space the camera is working in.

name: setColorSpace
description: Sets a color space.
summary: Sets the color space for camera capture. Use it to take photos or record videos with richer P3 colors or HDR.

name: isControlCenterSupported
description: Checks whether the camera controller is supported.
summary: Checks whether the camera controller is supported. Use it to decide if you can use a camera controller for photos or videos.

name: getSupportedEffectTypes
description: Obtains the effect types supported by the camera controller.
summary: Gets the effect types the camera controller supports. Use it to see which effects you can apply to photos or videos.

name: enableControlCenter
description: Enables the camera controller.
summary: Turns the camera controller on or off. Use it to let a camera controller manage effects while taking photos or recording videos.

name: isAutoDeviceSwitchSupported
description: Checks whether the device supports automatic camera switch.
summary: Checks whether the device supports automatic camera switch. Use it to find out if the camera can switch between lenses on its own.

name: enableAutoDeviceSwitch
description: Enables or disables automatic camera switch. You can use
summary: Turns automatic camera switching on or off, for use on foldable devices. Use it so the camera follows you as the device folds or unfolds.

name: isMacroSupported
description: Checks whether macro photography is supported in the current state. This API must be called after
summary: Checks whether macro photography is supported in the current state. Use it to see if you can take close-up shots of tiny subjects.

name: enableMacro
description: Enables or disables macro photography.
summary: Turns macro photography on or off. Use it to take close-up photos of tiny subjects like flowers or insects.

name: beginConfig
description: Starts configuration for the session.
summary: Starts setting up the camera session before adding inputs and outputs. Use it when preparing the camera to take a photo or record a video.

name: commitConfig
description: Commits the configuration for this session. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Finishes and applies the camera session setup. Use it to make the camera ready to take a photo or record a video.

name: canAddInput
description: Checks whether a **CameraInput** instance can be added to this session. This API must be called after
summary: Checks whether a camera input can be added to the session. Use it to confirm the camera can be used before taking a photo or recording a video.

name: addInput
description: Adds a [CameraInput]{@link camera.CameraInput} instance to this session.
summary: Adds a camera input to a session. Use it to connect the camera so you can take a photo or record a video.

name: removeInput
description: Removes a [CameraInput]{@link camera.CameraInput} instance from this session. This API must be called after
summary: Removes a camera input from the session. Use it to stop using a particular camera before reconfiguring the session.

name: canAddOutput
description: Determines whether a CameraOutput instance can be added to this session. This API must be called after
summary: Checks whether a camera output can be added to the session. Use it to confirm where a photo or video can go before taking or recording.

name: addOutput
description: Adds a [CameraOutput]{@link camera.CameraOutput} instance to this session.
summary: Adds a camera output to the session so the camera can send its pictures or video there. Use it to set up where a photo or video recording goes.

name: removeOutput
description: Removes a [CameraOutput]{@link camera.CameraOutput} instance from this session.
summary: Removes a camera output from the session. Use it to stop sending camera results to a particular output, such as a preview or photo output.

name: start
description: Starts this session. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Starts the camera session so it begins running. Use it to begin the camera preview or start taking photos and recording videos.

name: stop
description: Stops this session. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Stops the camera session. Use it to end the camera preview or stop taking photos and recording videos.

name: release
description: Releases this session. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Frees the camera session and its resources. Use it when you are done taking photos or recording videos.

name: setUsage
description: Set usage for the capture session.
summary: Turns a capture session usage on or off. Use it to enable or disable a specific way the camera session is used while taking a photo or recording a video.

name: getCameraOutputCapabilities
description: Get the supported camera output capability set.
summary: Lists the output capabilities a camera device supports. Use it to check what photo or video formats and resolutions a camera can produce before taking a photo or recording a video.

name: setParameters
description: Sets key-value pairs parameters for the session.
summary: Sets camera metadata key-value pairs for the session. Use it to change camera settings such as exposure or zoom before taking a photo or recording a video.

name: getParameters
description: Gets the values of the given key in camera metadata.
summary: Reads the values stored under a given camera metadata key. Use it to look up current camera settings such as exposure or zoom while taking a photo or recording a video.

name: getSupportedKeys
description: Gets the supported keys in camera metadata.
summary: Lists the camera metadata keys the session supports. Use it to find which camera settings can be read or changed before taking a photo or recording a video.

name: getActiveParameter
description: Gets the active value of the given key in camera metadata.
summary: Gets the active value of a given camera metadata key. Use it to read current camera settings like exposure or zoom.

name: beginConfig
description: Starts configuration for the session.
summary: Starts configuring the session. Use it before changing camera settings, then commit the changes to apply them.

name: commitConfig
description: Commits the configuration for this session. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Applies the session configuration. Use it after setting up the camera so the changes take effect for taking photos or recording video.

name: addInput
description: Adds a [CameraInput]{@link camera.CameraInput} instance to this session.
summary: Adds a camera input to the session so the camera can be used. Use it when setting up the camera before taking photos or recording video.

name: removeInput
description: Removes a [CameraInput]{@link camera.CameraInput} instance from this session.
summary: Removes a camera input from the session. Use it to stop using a particular camera while taking photos or recording video.

name: addOutput
description: Adds a [CameraOutput]{@link camera.CameraOutput} instance to this session.
summary: Adds a camera output to the session so results can be produced. Use it when setting up the camera before taking photos or recording video.

name: removeOutput
description: Removes a [CameraOutput]{@link camera.CameraOutput} instance from this session.
summary: Removes a camera output from the capture session. Use it to stop sending the camera feed to a preview, photo, or video output you no longer need.

name: start
description: Starts this session. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Starts the camera session so preview, photos, and video can run. Use it to turn the camera on before taking a photo or recording.

name: stop
description: Stops this session. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Stops the camera session. Use it to turn the camera off when done taking photos or recording.

name: release
description: Releases this session. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Releases the camera session and frees its resources. Use it to shut down the camera when you are done taking photos or recording video.

name: hasFlash
description: Checks whether the camera device has flash.
summary: Checks whether the camera has a flash. Use it to know if the flashlight can be used for photos.

name: isFlashModeSupported
description: Checks whether the flash mode is supported.
summary: Checks whether a given flash mode is supported. Use it to see if a camera flash setting can be used.

name: getFlashMode
description: Obtains the flash mode in use.
summary: Tells you which flash mode the camera is currently using. Use it to check whether the flash is on, off, or automatic before taking a photo.

name: setFlashMode
description: Sets a flash mode.
summary: Sets the flash mode for taking a photo. Use it to turn the flash on, off, or automatic when shooting in low light.

name: isExposureModeSupported
description: Checks whether an exposure mode is supported.
summary: Checks whether a given exposure mode is supported. Use it to see if a camera exposure setting can be used.

name: getExposureMode
description: Obtains the exposure mode in use.
summary: Tells you which exposure mode the camera is currently using. Use it to check the camera's exposure setting before taking a photo.

name: setExposureMode
description: Sets an exposure mode. Before the setting, call
summary: Sets how the camera decides exposure for a shot. Use it to choose an exposure mode such as automatic or manual when taking a photo or recording video.

name: getMeteringPoint
description: Obtains the metering point of the camera device.
summary: Gets the camera's current metering point. Use it to see where the camera is measuring light for exposure.

name: setMeteringPoint
description: Sets the metering point, which is the center point of the metering rectangle. The metering point must be in the
summary: Sets the point the camera uses to measure exposure, given as a position on the preview. Use it to tap a spot on the screen so the camera exposes for that spot.

name: getExposureBiasRange
description: Obtains the exposure compensation values of the camera device.
summary: Gives the exposure compensation values the camera supports. Use it to find how much you can brighten or darken a photo or video.

name: setExposureBias
description: Sets an exposure compensation value (EV).
summary: Sets the exposure compensation value to brighten or darken a photo or video. Use it to make a shot lighter or darker when the camera's automatic exposure is not right.

name: getExposureValue
description: Obtains the exposure value in use.
summary: Tells you the current exposure value the camera is using. Use it to check how bright or dark a photo will be before shooting.

name: isFocusModeSupported
description: Checks whether a focus mode is supported.
summary: Checks whether a camera focus mode is supported. Use it to find out if you can autofocus or use a particular focus setting before taking a photo.

name: getFocusMode
description: Obtains the focus mode in use.
summary: Tells you which focus mode the camera is currently using. Use it to check how the camera is focusing before taking a photo.

name: setFocusMode
description: Sets a focus mode.
summary: Sets how the camera focuses. Use it to choose a focus mode such as autofocus or continuous focus when taking a photo or recording video.

name: setFocusPoint
description: Sets the focal point. The focal point must be in the coordinate system (0-1), where the top-left corner is {0, 0}
summary: Sets the point in the preview where the camera should focus. Use it to tap a spot on the screen so the camera focuses there before taking a photo or recording video.

name: getFocusPoint
description: Obtains the focal point of the camera device.
summary: Tells you the point in the frame the camera is currently focusing on. Use it to check where the camera is focused before taking a photo.

name: getFocalLength
description: Obtains the focal length of the camera device.
summary: Tells you the focal length of the camera lens. Use it to check the zoom or lens setting before taking a photo.

name: getZoomRatioRange
description: Obtains the supported zoom ratio range.
summary: Gets the smallest and largest zoom ratios the camera supports. Use it to find how far you can zoom in or out.

name: getZoomRatio
description: Obtains the zoom ratio in use.
summary: Gets the zoom ratio the camera is currently using. Use it to check how far the camera is zoomed in or out.

name: setZoomRatio
description: Sets a zoom ratio, with a maximum precision of two decimal places.
summary: Sets how far the camera zooms in or out. Use it to zoom in on a distant subject or zoom out for a wider shot.

name: isVideoStabilizationModeSupported
description: Checks whether a video stabilization mode is supported.
summary: Checks whether a video stabilization mode is supported. Use it to see if you can steady shaky video while recording.

name: getActiveVideoStabilizationMode
description: Obtains the video stabilization mode in use.
summary: Tells you which video stabilization mode is currently in use. Use it to check whether shaky video is being steadied while recording.

name: setVideoStabilizationMode
description: Sets a video stabilization mode. Before the setting, call
summary: Sets the video stabilization mode for recording. Use it to steady shaky handheld video while recording.

name: on
description: Subscribes to CaptureSession error events. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the result.
summary: Starts listening for camera session error events. Use it to be notified when something goes wrong while taking photos or recording video.

name: off
description: Unsubscribes from CaptureSession error events. This API uses a callback to return the result.
summary: Stops listening for camera session error events. Use it to stop being notified when something goes wrong while taking photos or recording video.

name: getSupportedBeautyTypes
description: Obtains the supported beauty types.
summary: Lists the beauty types the camera supports. Use it to find out which beauty effects you can apply to a photo or video.

name: getSupportedBeautyRange
description: Obtains the levels that can be set a beauty type. The beauty levels vary according to the device type. The
summary: Lists the beauty levels you can set for a chosen beauty type. Use it to see which beauty strengths are available before adjusting a photo or video.

name: getBeauty
description: Obtains the level of the beauty type in use.
summary: Tells you the current beauty level for a chosen beauty type. Use it to check how much skin smoothing or other beauty effect is applied before a photo or video.

name: setBeauty
description: Sets a beauty type and its level. Beauty mode is turned off only when all the
summary: Sets a beauty type and its level for the camera. Use it to apply or adjust skin smoothing and other beauty effects when taking a photo or recording video.

name: isSceneFeatureSupported
description: Checks whether a scene feature is supported.
summary: Checks whether a particular scene feature is supported. Use it to find out if a scene-based camera feature can be used.

name: enableSceneFeature
description: Enables or disables a scene feature. This API must be called after
summary: Turns a scene feature on or off after its detection result is received. Use it to enable or disable scene-based camera enhancements.

name: isImagingModeSupported
description: Checks whether a camera imaging mode is supported.
summary: Checks whether the camera supports a particular imaging mode. Use it to see if a camera mode is available before selecting it.

name: getImagingMode
description: Gets current imaging mode.
summary: Tells you which imaging mode the camera is currently using. Use it to check the current camera mode before changing settings.

name: setImagingMode
description: Sets imaging mode.
summary: Switches the camera to a chosen imaging mode. Use it to pick the camera mode you want for your shot.

name: canPreconfig
description: Checks whether this session supports a preconfigured resolution.
summary: Checks whether the camera session supports a chosen resolution and aspect ratio. Use it to see if a photo can be taken at a specific size before setting it up.

name: preconfig
description: Preconfigures this session.
summary: Sets up the photo session in advance with a chosen resolution type and aspect ratio. Use it to prepare the camera before taking photos.

name: on
description: Subscribes to **PhotoSession** error events. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the result.
summary: Listens for camera session events such as errors and focus state changes. Use it to be alerted when something goes wrong or when the camera focus changes.

name: onError
description: Subscribes to error events.
summary: Warns you when something goes wrong while taking photos. Use it to notice and handle camera errors during a photo session.

name: off
description: Unsubscribes from **PhotoSession** error events. This API uses a callback to return the result.
summary: Stops listening for camera session error events. Use it to stop being notified about camera errors when you no longer need them.

name: offError
description: Unsubscribes from error events.
summary: Stops listening for camera error events. Use it to stop being notified about camera errors when you no longer need them.

name: onFocusStateChange
description: Subscribes focus state change event callback.
summary: Tells you when the camera's focus state changes. Use it to know when a photo is in focus or still focusing.

name: offFocusStateChange
description: Unsubscribes from focus state change event callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes in focus state. Use it to stop being notified when the camera focus changes.

name: onSmoothZoomInfoAvailable
description: Subscribes zoom info event callback.
summary: Gives you zoom information while the camera zooms smoothly. Use it to track smooth zooming while taking photos.

name: offSmoothZoomInfoAvailable
description: Unsubscribes from zoom info event callback.
summary: Stops listening for smooth zoom information during zooming. Use it to stop receiving zoom progress updates while zooming in or out.

name: onMacroStatusChanged
description: Subscribes camera macro status event callback.
summary: Tells you when the camera switches into or out of macro close-up mode. Use it to know when you can shoot very close-up photos.

name: offMacroStatusChanged
description: Unsubscribes camera macro status event callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes to the camera's macro mode status. Use it to stop being told when close-up macro mode turns on or off.

name: onFeatureDetection
description: Subscribes to feature detection results.
summary: Starts receiving results when the camera detects a chosen scene feature. Use it to be told when a particular feature is found in the scene you are photographing.

name: offFeatureDetection
description: Unsubscribes from feature detection result.
summary: Unsubscribes from feature detection results for a given feature type. Use it to stop receiving scene feature detection updates.

name: onEffectSuggestionChange
description: Subscribes to effect suggestion event callback.
summary: Starts receiving suggestions for which camera effect to use. Use it to be told when a different effect would suit the scene you are photographing.

name: offEffectSuggestionChange
description: Unsubscribes from effect suggestion event callback.
summary: Unsubscribes from effect suggestion event callbacks. Use it to stop receiving suggestions for camera effects.

name: onAutoDeviceSwitchStatusChange
description: Subscribes to auto device switch status event callback.
summary: Listens for changes in the automatic camera switch status. Use it to be told when the camera automatically switches to a different lens.

name: offAutoDeviceSwitchStatusChange
description: Unsubscribes to auto device switch status event callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes in the automatic camera switching status. Use it to stop being notified when the camera switches between lenses automatically.

name: onLcdFlashStatus
description: Subscribes to lcd flash status.
summary: Starts receiving updates about the LCD flash status. Use it to be told when the screen flash is ready or active while taking a photo.

name: offLcdFlashStatus
description: Unsubscribes from lcd flash status.
summary: Stops receiving updates about the LCD flash status. Use it to stop being told when the screen flash is ready or active while taking a photo.

name: onSystemPressureLevelChange
description: Subscribes to system pressure level event callback.
summary: Warns when the camera system is under pressure. Use it to react when the camera gets too hot or busy while taking photos.

name: offSystemPressureLevelChange
description: Unsubscribes to system pressure level event callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes in the system pressure level. Use it to stop being told when the camera's performance pressure level changes.

name: getSessionFunctions
description: Gets session functions.
summary: Gets the list of functions available for a photo session based on the camera output capability. Use it to see which camera features you can use.

name: getSessionConflictFunctions
description: Gets session conflict functions.
summary: Gets the list of functions that conflict within a photo session. Use it to find out which camera features cannot be used together.

name: onIsoInfoChange
description: Subscribes to ISO information change events.
summary: Tells you when the camera's ISO light-sensitivity value changes. Use it to keep track of how sensitive the camera is to light while taking photos.

name: offIsoInfoChange
description: Unsubscribes from ISO information change events.
summary: Stops listening for changes in the camera's ISO light-sensitivity information. Use it to stop receiving ISO updates while taking photos.

name: onExposureInfoChange
description: Subscribes to exposure information change events. After the exposure parameters are modified, the system returns
summary: Tells you when the exposure settings change and gives the updated exposure information. Use it to keep track of brightness settings while taking photos.

name: offExposureInfoChange
description: Unsubscribes from exposure information change events. If you have subscribed to exposure information change
summary: Stops listening for changes in exposure information. Use it to stop being notified about exposure changes before releasing the camera.

name: canPreconfig
description: Checks whether this session supports a preconfigured resolution.
summary: Checks whether a session supports a preconfigured resolution and aspect ratio. Use it to see if a chosen video size can be set up.

name: preconfig
description: Preconfigures this session.
summary: Sets up the video session ahead of time with a chosen resolution type and aspect ratio. Use it to prepare the camera for recording before you start.

name: on

summary: Listens for errors that happen while setting up or running a camera session. Use it to be told when something goes wrong during video recording.

name: onError
description: Subscribes to error events.
summary: Watches for errors while recording video. Use it to notice and handle problems during a video recording.

name: off
description: Unsubscribes from **VideoSession** error events. This API uses a callback to return the result.
summary: Stops listening for errors from a video session. Use it to stop being notified when the session has a problem.

name: offError
description: Unsubscribes from error events.
summary: Stops listening for error events. Use it to stop being notified when an error occurs while recording video.

name: onFocusStateChange
description: Subscribes focus state change event callback.
summary: Reports when the focus state changes. Use it to know when the camera has focused while recording video.

name: offFocusStateChange
description: Unsubscribes from focus state change event callback.
summary: Stops listening for focus state changes. Use it to stop being notified when the camera focus state changes while recording video.

name: onSmoothZoomInfoAvailable
description: Subscribes zoom info event callback.
summary: Reports zoom information during smooth zooming. Use it to follow the zoom level while recording video.

name: offSmoothZoomInfoAvailable
description: Unsubscribes from zoom info event callback.
summary: Stops listening for smooth zoom information during video recording. Use it to stop receiving zoom updates when you no longer need them.

name: onControlCenterEffectStatusChange
description: Subscribes to control center effect status change callback.
summary: Listens for changes to the control center effect status. Use it to be told when an effect applied from the control center changes while recording.

name: offControlCenterEffectStatusChange
description: Unsubscribes to control center effect status change callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes in control center effect status. Use it to stop being notified when a control center effect changes while recording video.

name: onMacroStatusChanged
description: Subscribes camera macro status event callback.
summary: Reports when the camera macro status changes. Use it to know when close-up macro mode turns on or off while recording video.

name: offMacroStatusChanged
description: Unsubscribes camera macro status event callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes to the camera's macro (close-up) status. Use it to stop being told when close-up mode turns on or off while filming.

name: onLcdFlashStatus
description: Subscribes to lcd flash status.
summary: Starts listening for updates about the screen flash used as a light while recording video. Use it to know when the screen flash is on or off.

name: offLcdFlashStatus
description: Unsubscribes from lcd flash status.
summary: Stops listening for updates about the screen flash used as a light while recording video. Use it to stop receiving screen flash status once you no longer need it.

name: onAutoDeviceSwitchStatusChange
description: Subscribes to auto device switch status event callback.
summary: Listens for changes in the automatic camera switching status. Use it to be told when the camera automatically switches between lenses while recording.

name: offAutoDeviceSwitchStatusChange
description: Unsubscribes to auto device switch status event callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes in automatic camera switching status. Use it to stop being notified when the camera switches between devices on its own while recording video.

name: onFocusTrackingInfoAvailable
description: Subscribes to focus tracking info event callback.
summary: Starts listening for focus tracking information while recording video. Use it to follow a moving subject and keep it in focus.

name: offFocusTrackingInfoAvailable
description: Unsubscribes from focus tracking info event callback.
summary: Stops listening for focus tracking information. Use it to stop receiving updates about tracked subjects while recording video.

name: onEffectSuggestionChange
description: Subscribes to effect suggestion change events.
summary: Starts listening for suggestions about which camera effect to use while recording video. Use it to show or apply a suggested effect.

name: offEffectSuggestionChange
description: Unsubscribes from effect suggestion change events.
summary: Stops listening for effect suggestion changes. Use it to stop receiving suggested camera effect updates while recording video.

name: onLightStatusChange
description: Subscribes camera light status event callback.
summary: Watches the camera light status and reports changes. Use it to react when the camera light turns on or off.

name: offLightStatusChange
description: Unsubscribes camera light status event callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes in the camera light status while recording video. Use it to stop being told when the light turns on or off.

name: onSystemPressureLevelChange
description: Subscribes to system pressure level event callback.
summary: Watches for changes in the device's system pressure level during a video session. Use it to react when the phone gets too hot or busy while recording.

name: offSystemPressureLevelChange
description: Unsubscribes to system pressure level event callback.
summary: Stops listening for changes in the device's system pressure level. Use it to stop being notified when the device gets too hot or busy while recording.

name: getSessionFunctions
description: Gets session functions.
summary: Gets the list of functions available for a video session from the camera output capability. Use it to see which camera features can be used while recording video.

name: getSessionConflictFunctions
description: Gets session conflict functions.
summary: Gets the list of functions that conflict in a video session. Use it to find which camera features cannot be used together while recording video.

name: setQualityPrioritization
description: Sets the priority level for video recording quality.
summary: Chooses whether video recording favors higher quality or other priorities. Use it to decide how good your recorded video should look.

name: onIsoInfoChange

summary: Reports the latest sensitivity (ISO) value when it changes. Use it to track how light-sensitive the camera is while recording video.

name: offIsoInfoChange
description: Unsubscribes from ISO state change events.

name: onExposureInfoChange

name: offExposureInfoChange

summary: Stops listening for exposure information changes. Use it to stop being notified about exposure changes, and cancel the subscription before releasing the camera.

name: onApertureInfoChange

summary: Starts listening for changes in the camera aperture setting while recording video. Use it to keep the aperture value up to date on screen.

name: offApertureInfoChange
description: Unsubscribes from aperture info event callback.
summary: Stops listening for aperture information changes. Use it to stop receiving updates about the camera lens opening while recording video.

name: getVirtualAperture

name: createParallelSoundPool
