summary: Creates a sound pool that can play several sounds at once without stopping the ones already playing. Use it to play overlapping sound effects, such as game sounds or alerts, at the same time.

name: createAVScreenCaptureRecorder
description: Creates an AVScreenCaptureRecorder instance. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Creates a recorder that can capture what is shown on the screen. Use it to record the screen.

name: reportAVScreenCaptureUserChoice
description: Reports the user selection result in the screen capture privacy dialog box to the AVScreenCapture server to
summary: Reports the user's answer in the screen capture privacy dialog to decide whether screen capture starts. Use it to start screen recording only after the user agrees.

name: getAVScreenCaptureConfigurableParameters
description: get Configurations which user can changes from AVScreenCapture server
summary: Gets the screen capture settings that a user is allowed to change. Use it to show or adjust the options available for a screen recording session.

name: createAVTranscoder
description: Creates an AVTranscoder instance. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Creates a tool that converts video from one format to another. Use it to transcode a video file.

name: getScreenCaptureMonitor
description: Obtains a **ScreenCaptureMonitor** instance. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets an instance that can query and monitor whether the system screen recorder is running. Use it to check or watch the status of screen recording.

name: createAVMetadataExtractor
description: Creates an AVMetadataExtractor instance. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Creates a tool that reads metadata from media files. Use it to look up details such as title, artist, or duration of a song or video.

name: createAVImageGenerator
description: Creates an AVImageGenerator instance. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Creates a tool that can produce a thumbnail image from a video. Use it to get a preview picture of a video.

name: fetchMetadata
description: Obtains the media metadata. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Reads the metadata of a media file, such as its title, artist, or duration. Use it to show song or video details in a player.

name: fetchMetadataWithTimeout
description: Obtains the media metadata. You can set the maximum timeout interval (**timeoutMs**) for obtaining the metadata.
summary: Reads the metadata of a media file, giving up if it takes too long. Use it to show song or video details without hanging.

name: fetchAlbumCover
description: Obtains the cover of the audio album. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the cover image of an audio album. Use it to show album art while playing a song.

name: setUrlSource
description: Sets the data source for a network on-demand resource. Only network metadata (
summary: Sets a network media file as the source for reading its metadata and thumbnails. Use it to look up details or grab a preview image from an online video or song.

name: fetchFrameByTime
params: timeUs: number, options: AVImageQueryOptions, param: PixelMapParams
description: Obtains a video thumbnail. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets a picture from a video at a chosen moment, returned as an image. Use it to make a video thumbnail or preview frame.

name: fetchFrameByTimeWithTimeout
params: timeUs: long, options: AVImageQueryOptions, param: PixelMapParams, timeoutMs: long
description: Obtains a video thumbnail. You can set the maximum timeout interval (**timeoutMs**) for obtaining the thumbnail.
summary: Gets a single video thumbnail at a chosen time, giving up if it takes too long. Use it to show a preview picture for a moment in a video.

name: fetchFramesByTimes
params: timesUs: long[], queryOption: AVImageQueryOptions, param: PixelMapParams, callback: OnFrameFetched
description: Obtains video thumbnails in batches. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the result.
summary: Gets many video thumbnails at once for a list of chosen times. Use it to build a strip of preview pictures from a video.

name: fetchFramesByTimesWithTimeout
params: timesUs: long[], queryOption: AVImageQueryOptions, param: PixelMapParams, timeoutMs: long, callback: OnFrameFetched
description: Obtains video thumbnails in batches. You can set the maximum timeout interval (**timeoutMs**) for obtaining each
summary: Gets many video thumbnails at once for chosen times, with a time limit for each. Use it to build preview pictures from a video without waiting too long.

name: cancelAllFetchFrames
description: Cancels the ongoing task of obtaining thumbnails in batches. (The thumbnails that have been obtained are not
summary: Stops the current job of getting many thumbnails at once; already obtained ones stay. Use it to stop a batch of video thumbnails.

name: getTimeByFrameIndex
description: Obtains the video timestamp corresponding to a video frame number. Only MP4 video files are supported.
summary: Gets the timestamp of a given video frame number in an MP4 video. Use it to find when a particular frame appears while working with video.

name: getFrameIndexByTime
description: Obtains the video frame number corresponding to a video timestamp. Only MP4 video files are supported.
summary: Gets the video frame number that matches a given timestamp in an MP4 video. Use it to find which frame appears at a certain moment while working with video.

name: release
description: Releases this AVMetadataExtractor instance. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Frees the media metadata reader when it is no longer needed. Use it to clean up after reading metadata or thumbnails.

name: fetchFrameByTime
params: timeUs: number, options: AVImageQueryOptions, param: PixelMapParams
description: Obtains a video thumbnail. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets a picture from a video at a chosen moment, returned as an image. Use it to make a video thumbnail or preview frame.

name: fetchScaledFrameByTime
params: timeUs: number, queryMode: AVImageQueryOptions, outputSize?: OutputSize
description: Fetches a scaled thumbnail from the video at a particular timestamp. This API uses a promise to return the
summary: Gets a picture from a video at a chosen moment, resized to a size you pick. Use it to make a thumbnail or preview frame at the size you need.

name: release
description: Releases this AVImageGenerator instance. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Frees the video thumbnail generator when you are done with it. Use it to clean up after making video thumbnails.

name: prepare
description: Prepares for audio and video playback. This API can be called only when the AVPlayer is in the initialized state.
summary: Gets audio or video ready to play. Use it to load a song or video before pressing play, or to preload the next short video so switching is smooth.

name: play
description: Starts to play an audio and video asset. This API can be called only when the AVPlayer is in the prepared, paused,
summary: Starts playing an audio or video asset that is ready, paused, or finished. Use it to play a song or start a video.

name: pause
description: Pauses audio and video playback. This API can be called only when the AVPlayer is in the playing state. This API
summary: Pauses audio or video that is currently playing. Use it to stop playback temporarily, such as when the user taps pause.

name: stop
description: Stops audio and video playback. This API can be called only when the AVPlayer is in the prepared, playing, paused,
summary: Stops audio and video playback. Use it to stop a song or video that is currently playing.

name: reset
description: Resets audio and video playback. This API can be called only when the AVPlayer is in the initialized, prepared,
summary: Resets audio and video playback back to its starting state. Use it to clear the current song or video and start over with something new.

name: release
description: Releases the playback resources. This API can be called when the AVPlayer is in any state except released. This
summary: Frees the resources used for playback. Use it when you are done watching or listening, to stop playback and free memory.

name: seek
description: Seeks to the specified playback position. This API can be called only when the AVPlayer is in the prepared,
summary: Jumps to a chosen position in the audio or video. Use it to skip ahead or rewind to a certain moment in a song or video.

name: setVolume
description: Sets the playback volume. This API can be called only when the AVPlayer is in the prepared, playing, paused, or
summary: Sets the playback volume from 0.00 to 1.00, where 1.00 is full volume. Use it to turn a song or video up or down.

name: getTrackDescription
description: Obtains the audio and video track information. This API can be called only when the AVPlayer is in the prepared,
summary: Gets information about the audio and video tracks in the media. Use it to list the available audio or video tracks while playing a song or video.

name: getSelectedTracks
description: Obtains the indexes of the selected audio or video tracks. This API can be called only when the AVPlayer is in
summary: Gets the indexes of the audio or video tracks currently selected. Use it to see which audio or video track is playing.

name: selectTrack
description: Selects a track when the AVPlayer plays multimedia resources with multiple audio or video tracks. This API uses a
summary: Picks which audio or video track to play when a media file has several. Use it to switch language or camera angle while watching a video.

name: deselectTrack
description: Deselects the specified track when the AVPlayer plays multimedia resources with multiple audio or video tracks.
summary: Turns off a chosen audio or video track when the media has several tracks. Use it to switch off a subtitle or alternate audio track.

name: getCurrentTrack
description: Obtains the selected track by the specified media type. This API can be called only when the AVPlayer
summary: Gives the index of the selected track for a given media type. Use it to find which audio or video track is currently playing.

name: setMediaSource
description: Sets a source of streaming media that can be pre-downloaded, downloads the media data, and temporarily stores the
summary: Sets an online media source that gets downloaded ahead of time and kept in memory. Use it to play a stream smoothly by preloading it.

name: getTrackSelectionFilter
description: Obtains the track selection filter configured for the player. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the track selection filter currently set for the player. Use it to check which tracks the player is set to pick while playing media.

name: setTrackSelectionFilter
description: Sets a track selection filter for the player. The player will use this filter to select available tracks for
summary: Chooses which tracks the player uses for playback. Use it to pick the audio or video track played from a file.

name: addSubtitleFromFd
params: fd: int, offset?: long, length?: long
description: Adds an external subtitle to a video based on the FD. Currently, the external subtitle must be set after
summary: Adds an external subtitle file to a video using a file handle. Use it to show subtitles from a file while a video plays.

name: addSubtitleFromUrl
description: Adds an external subtitle to a video based on the URL. Currently, the external subtitle must be set after
summary: Adds an external subtitle file to a video from a web address. Use it to show online subtitles while a video plays.

name: getPlaybackInfo
description: Obtains the playback information. This API can be called only when the AVPlayer is in the prepared, playing, or
summary: Gets information about the current playback. Use it to check details of the song or video that is playing.

name: getPlaybackRate
description: Obtains the playback speed of an AVPlayer. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the current playback speed. Use it to check whether a song or video is playing at normal or faster speed.

name: getLoadedTimeRanges
description: Obtains the list of loaded time ranges. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the time ranges of the media that have finished loading, given as start and end positions in milliseconds. Use it to show how much of a song or video is buffered before playing.

name: getSeekableTimeRanges
description: Obtains the list of seekable time ranges. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the time ranges you can jump to in the current media, given as start and end positions in milliseconds. Use it to know where you can skip to while playing a song or video.

name: seekToDefaultPosition
description: Seeks to the default access point of the playback source. For live streams, the latest recommended access point
summary: Jumps to the default starting point of the playback source. Use it to go back to the beginning of a video or to the latest point of a live stream.

name: getPlaybackStatisticMetrics
description: Obtains the statistic metrics of the current player. This API can be called when the AVPlayer is in the prepared,
summary: Gets statistics about the current playback, such as how much has been played. Use it to show playback stats while a song or video is playing, paused, or finished.

name: setPlaybackStrategy
description: Sets a playback strategy. This API can be called only when the AVPlayer is in the initialized state. This API
summary: Sets how the player should handle playback before it starts. Use it to choose playback behaviour for a song or video before playing.

name: setMediaMuted
description: Mutes or unmutes the audio. Since API version 20, this API also supports whether to display the video image. This
summary: Turns the sound off or on, and can also hide or show the video picture. Use it to mute a video or blank the screen while it keeps playing.

name: forceLoadVideo
description: Specifies whether to forcibly load the video. This API can be called only when the AVPlayer
summary: Sets whether the video should be forcibly loaded during playback. Use it to make a video load even when it normally would not.

name: setPlaybackRange
params: startTimeMs: int, endTimeMs: int, mode?: SeekMode
description: Sets the playback range and seeks to the start position of the range based on the specified
summary: Plays only a chosen portion of an audio or video file, starting at the range's beginning. Use it to play just a clip or skip to a specific section of a song or video.

name: isSeekContinuousSupported
description: Checks whether the media source supports [seek]{@link media.AVPlayer.seek} in SEEK_CONTINUOUS mode (specified by
summary: Checks whether the media can be seeked continuously. Use it to find out if smooth skipping through a song or video is possible.

name: getPlaybackPosition
description: Obtains the current playback position. This API can be called only when the AVPlayer is in the prepared, playing,
summary: Gets the current playback position in milliseconds. Use it to show how far into a song or video playback has reached.

name: getCurrentPresentationTimestamp
description: Obtains the current playback time. This API can be called only when the AVPlayer is in the **playing**,
summary: Gives the current playback time in microseconds while playing, paused, or finished. Use it to show how far into a song or video you are.

name: setSuperResolution
description: Enables or disables super resolution. This API can be called when the AVPlayer is in the initialized, prepared,
summary: Turns super resolution on or off to sharpen video while playing. Use it to make a video look clearer on screen.

name: setVideoWindowSize
description: Sets the resolution of the output video after super resolution. This API can be called when the AVPlayer is in
summary: Sets the output video resolution after super resolution, from 320x320 to 1920x1080 pixels. Use it to make a video play larger or sharper on screen.

name: advanceToNextMediaSource
description: Ends playback of the current mediasource and starts playback of the next mediasource in the mediasource list.
summary: Stops the current item and starts playing the next item in the playlist. Use it to skip ahead to the next song or video.

name: advanceToPrevMediaSource
description: Ends playback of the current mediasource and starts playback of the previous mediasource in the mediasource list.
summary: Stops the current item and starts playing the previous one in the playlist. Use it to skip back to the previous song or video.

name: getCurrentMediaSource
description: Return the current mediasource.
summary: Gives back the media source that is playing now, or nothing if there is none. Use it to check which song or video is currently loaded.

name: addPlaybackMediaSource
description: Add a new playback source to the player's playlist.
summary: Adds another media item to the player's playlist and returns its unique ID. Use it to queue up more songs or videos to play in order.

name: removePlaybackMediaSource
description: Removes the specified playback media source from the player's playlist.
summary: Removes a chosen media source from the player's playlist. Use it to take a song or video out of the queue you are playing through.

name: clearPlaybackList
description: Clears all the items in the player's playlist. Currently playing media will be terminated immediately.
summary: Removes everything from the player's playlist and stops the current item right away. Use it to empty the queue of songs or videos.

name: advanceToMediaSource
description: Ends playback of the current mediasource and starts playback of the specified mediasource in the mediasource
summary: Stops the current item and starts playing a chosen item from the playlist. Use it to jump to a specific song or video in the queue.

name: getMediaSources
description: Return the array of mediasources in the playlist.
summary: Returns the list of media sources in the playlist. Use it to see which songs or videos are queued up for playback.

name: setSpeed
description: Sets the playback speed. This API can be called only when the AVPlayer is in the prepared, playing, paused, or
summary: Sets the playback speed for audio or video. Use it to play a song or video faster or slower.

name: setPlaybackRate
description: Sets the playback rate. This API can be called only when the AVPlayer is in the prepared, playing, paused, or
summary: Changes how fast audio or video plays, from slow to fast. Use it to speed up a video or slow down a song while listening.

name: setBitrate
description: Sets the bitrate for the streaming media. This API is valid only for HLS/DASH streams. By default, the AVPlayer
summary: Chooses the streaming quality level for online video or audio. Use it to pick a higher or lower quality while watching a stream.

name: setLoudnessGain
description: Sets the loudness gain of the AVPlayer. After this API is called, the loudness gain takes effect immediately. This
summary: Changes how loud the playing sound is, right away. Use it to make a video or song quieter or louder.

name: setDecryptionConfig
description: Sets the decryption configuration. When receiving an
summary: Sets up the decryption needed to play protected media. Use it to play copy-protected movies or shows.

name: getMediaKeySystemInfos
description: Obtains the media key system information of the media asset that is being played. This API can be called only
summary: Gets the media key system details, such as UUID and PSSH, for the media being played. Use it to set up protected playback of a song or video.

name: enableCameraPostprocessing
description: Enable the post-processing function of Camera for video playback.
summary: Turns on camera post-processing for video playback. Use it to apply camera effects while playing a video.

name: on
description: Subscribes to media key system information changes.
summary: Listens for playback events such as errors, state changes, volume changes, end of stream, and audio interruption. Use it to react while playing a song or video, for example pausing when a phone call interrupts.

name: off
description: Unsubscribes from media key system information changes.
summary: Stops listening for playback events such as errors. Use it to stop being notified about problems while playing a song or video.

name: onMediaKeySystemInfoUpdate
description: Register listens for mediaKeySystemInfoUpdate events.
summary: Watches for updates to the media key system information needed to play protected content. Use it to keep protected video or audio playing.

name: onStateChange
description: Register listens for media playback stateChange event.
summary: Watches for changes in the media playback state, whether caused by you or the system. Use it to keep your playback controls in sync.

name: onVolumeChange
description: Subscribes to the event to check whether the volume is successfully set.
summary: Notifies you whether the volume was set successfully. Use it to confirm a volume change took effect while playing audio or video.

name: onEndOfStream
description: Subscribes to the event that indicates the end of the stream being played. If {@link #loop} = true is set,
summary: Reports when the stream being played has ended. Use it to detect that a song or video finished and decide whether to replay or stop.

name: onSeekDone
description: Subscribes to the event to check whether the seek operation takes effect.
summary: Watches for a seek operation to take effect. Use it to know when jumping to a new spot in a song or video is done.

name: onSpeedDone
description: Subscribes to the event to check whether the playback speed is successfully set.
summary: Tells you when the playback speed has been successfully changed. Use it to confirm a speed change took effect.

name: onPlaybackRateDone
description: Register listens for media playbackRateDone event.
summary: Watches for the playback rate change to finish. Use it to know when a video has switched to a new speed.

name: onBitrateDone
description: Subscribes to the event to check whether the bit rate is successfully set.
summary: Tells you whether a requested bitrate was set successfully. Use it to confirm a quality change took effect during playback.

name: onTimeUpdate
description: Subscribes to playback position changes. It is used to refresh the current position of the progress bar.
summary: Reports changes in the playback position, about every 100 ms and right after a seek. Use it to move the progress bar as a song or video plays.

name: onDurationUpdate
description: Subscribes to media asset duration changes. It is used to refresh the length of the progress bar. By
summary: Reports changes to the media duration so the progress bar length can be refreshed. Use it to keep the playback progress bar accurate, including for streams whose length changes.

name: onBufferingUpdate
description: Subscribes to audio and video buffer changes. This subscription is supported only in network
summary: Reports changes in the audio and video buffer during network playback. Use it to show buffering progress while a stream loads.

name: onStartRenderFrame
description: Subscribes to the event that indicates rendering starts for the first frame. This subscription is
summary: Tells you when the first video frame starts being rendered during video playback. Use it to know when the picture first appears.

name: onVideoSizeChange
description: Subscribes to video size (width and height) changes. This subscription is supported only in video playback
summary: Notifies you when the video width and height change during playback. Use it to resize the video view so the picture fits correctly.

name: onAudioInterrupt
description: Register listens for audio interrupt event, refer to {@link #audio.InterruptEvent}.
summary: Listens for audio interruption events, such as when another sound starts playing. Use it to pause or lower your playback when a phone call or other audio interrupts.

name: onAvailableBitrates
description: Register listens for available bitrate list collect completed events for HLS protocol stream playback.
summary: Reports the list of available bitrates once it has been collected for HLS stream playback. Use it to show or pick quality options while streaming.

name: onError
description: Register listens for playback error events.
summary: Watches for playback errors while media is playing. Use it to notice when a song or video fails to play.

name: onAudioOutputDeviceChangeWithInfo
description: Subscribes to audio stream output device changes and reasons. This API uses an asynchronous callback
summary: Watches for changes to the audio output device, such as when headphones are plugged in or removed. Use it to adjust playback when the sound switches to a different speaker or device.

name: onSubtitleUpdate
description: Subscribes to subtitle update events. When external subtitles exist, the system notifies the application
summary: Subscribes to subtitle updates during playback, giving the new subtitle text. Use it to show subtitles while playing a video.

name: onTrackChange
description: Subscribes to track change events. When the track changes, the system notifies the application through
summary: Notifies you when the playing track changes. Use it to update what is shown when a video switches tracks during playback.

name: onTrackInfoUpdate
description: Subscribes to track information update events. When the track information is updated, the system notifies the
summary: Notifies you when track information is updated. Use it to refresh the details shown for the tracks of the media being played.

name: onAmplitudeUpdate
description: Subscribes to update events of the maximum audio level value, which is periodically reported when audio
summary: Listens for periodic updates of the maximum audio level while audio is playing. Use it to show a volume meter or sound wave that moves with the music.

name: onSeiMessageReceived
description: Subscribes to events indicating that a Supplemental Enhancement Information (SEI) message is received. This
summary: Watches for Supplemental Enhancement Information messages in an HTTP-FLV live video stream. Use it to react to extra data embedded in a live stream.

name: onSuperResolutionChanged
description: Subscribes to the event indicating that super resolution is enabled or disabled.
summary: Tells you when super resolution is turned on or off. Use it to know when the picture is being sharpened.

name: offSuperResolutionChanged
description: Unsubscribes from the event indicating that super resolution is enabled or disabled.
summary: Stops listening for changes to super resolution being turned on or off. Use it to stop reacting when video sharpening is enabled or disabled.

name: offStateChange
description: Unregister listens for media playback stateChange event.
summary: Stops listening for changes in media playback state. Use it to stop reacting when a song or video starts, pauses, or finishes.

name: offVolumeChange
description: Unsubscribes from the event that checks whether the volume is successfully set.
summary: Stops listening for volume change events. Use it when you no longer need to know whether the volume was set successfully.

name: offMediaKeySystemInfoUpdate
description: Unregister listens for mediaKeySystemInfoUpdate events.
summary: Stops listening for updates about media key system information. Use it to stop being notified about protected content details while playing media.

name: offEndOfStream
description: Unregister listens for media playback endOfStream event.
summary: Stops listening for when media playback reaches the end. Use it to stop being notified that a song or video has finished playing.

name: offSeekDone
description: Unsubscribes from the event that checks whether the seek operation takes effect.
summary: Stops listening for when a seek finishes. Use it to stop being notified after jumping to a different point in a video.

name: offSpeedDone
description: Unsubscribes from the event that checks whether the playback speed is successfully set.
summary: Stops listening for when the playback speed has been set. Use it to stop being notified after changing how fast a video plays.

name: offPlaybackRateDone
description: Unregister listens for media playbackRateDone event.
summary: Stops listening for when the playback rate has been set. Use it to stop being notified after changing how fast a video plays.

name: offBitrateDone
description: Unsubscribes from the event that checks whether the bit rate is successfully set.
summary: Stops listening for the event that confirms the bit rate was set. Use it to stop being notified when a stream's quality setting finishes changing.

name: offTimeUpdate
description: Unsubscribes from playback position changes.
summary: Stops listening for playback position changes. Use it to stop updating a progress bar while a song or video plays.

name: offDurationUpdate
description: Unsubscribes from media asset duration changes.
summary: Stops listening for changes to the length of the media being played. Use it to stop being told how long a song or video is.

name: offBufferingUpdate
description: Unsubscribes from audio and video buffer changes.
summary: Stops listening for changes in the audio or video buffer. Use it to stop being notified while a song or video is loading.

name: offStartRenderFrame
description: Unregister listens for start render video frame events.
summary: Stops listening for when video frames start being rendered. Use it to stop being notified when video frames begin to display.

name: offVideoSizeChange
description: Unsubscribes from video size changes.
summary: Stops listening for changes to the video size during playback. Use it when you no longer need to adjust your layout as the video size changes.

name: offAudioInterrupt
description: Unregister listens for audio interrupt event, refer to {@link #audio.InterruptEvent}
summary: Stops listening for audio interrupt events. Use it to stop being notified when something like a phone call interrupts playback.

name: offAvailableBitrates
description: Unregister listens for available bitrate list collect completed events for HLS protocol stream playback.
summary: Stops listening for the list of available bitrates during streaming playback. Use it to stop being notified about the quality options for a stream.

name: offError
description: Unsubscribes from AVPlayer errors.
summary: Stops listening for playback errors. Use it to stop being notified when playing a song or video goes wrong.

name: offAudioOutputDeviceChangeWithInfo
description: Unsubscribes from audio stream output device changes and reasons. This API uses an asynchronous callback
summary: Stops listening for changes to the audio output device. Use it to stop being notified when playback moves to a different speaker or headset.

name: offSubtitleUpdate
description: Unsubscribes from subtitle update events.
summary: Stops listening for subtitle updates during playback. Use it to stop showing new subtitle text while a video plays.

name: offTrackChange
description: Unsubscribes from track change events.
summary: Stops listening for track changes during playback. Use it to stop reacting when the audio or video track switches.

name: offTrackInfoUpdate
description: Unsubscribes from track information update events.
summary: Stops listening for updates to the track information of the media being played. Use it to stop reacting when the track details change during playback.

name: offAmplitudeUpdate
description: Unsubscribes from update events of the maximum amplitude.
summary: Stops listening for changes in the maximum audio amplitude. Use it to stop being notified about how loud the sound gets while playing audio.

name: offSeiMessageReceived
description: Unsubscribes from the events indicating that an SEI message is received.
summary: Stops listening for SEI messages received during playback. Use it to stop being notified about SEI messages embedded in a video stream.

name: onMetricsEvent
description: Subscribes to metric events during playback.
summary: Watches playback metric events while media plays. Use it to track how a song or video is playing.

name: offMetricsEvent
description: Unsubscribes from metric events during playback.
summary: Stops listening for measurement events during playback. Use it to stop being notified about playback statistics while playing media.

name: onPlaybackContentChanged
description: Registers a listener to detect when the playback content has changed.
summary: Watches for the playback content changing and reports the ID of the media source now playing. Use it to know which item in a playlist is playing.

name: offPlaybackContentChanged
description: Unregisters listener to detect when changes occur in the playback content.
summary: Stops listening for changes in what is currently playing. Use it to stop being notified when the playback content changes.

name: onTimedMetaData
description: Register listener to detect time-based metadata,
summary: Detects time-based metadata during playback, such as HLS date-range data and DASH event streams. Use it to react to timed markers embedded in a stream while playing a video.

name: offTimedMetaData
description: Unregister listener to detect time-based metadata,
summary: Stops listening for time-based metadata in streaming media. Use it to stop receiving timed data such as date-range or event stream info during playback.

name: respondData
params: uuid: number, offset: number, buffer: ArrayBuffer
description: Sends data to the player.
summary: Sends the requested media data to the player. Use it to feed video or audio content the player is asking for during playback.

name: respondHeader
params: uuid: long, header?: Record<string, string>, redirectUrl?: string
description: Sends response header information to the player. This API must be called before the first call to
summary: Sends response header information to the player before the first data is sent. Use it to set up the response for a media resource the player is loading.

name: finishLoading
description: Notifies the player of the current request status. After pushing all the data for a single resource, the

description: Specifies whether to authorize event injection.
summary: Allows or blocks whether events can be injected into the system. Use it to turn event injection on or off before simulating taps or clicks.

name: pressKey
description: Presses a key. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Simulates pressing a key by its key code. Use it to send a key press, such as typing a character or triggering a shortcut.

name: releaseKey
description: Releases a key. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Simulates releasing a key by its key code. Use it to end a key press, such as lifting a finger off a typed key.

name: createKeyboardController
description: Creates a keyboard controller for simulating key operations. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Creates a keyboard controller for simulating key presses. Use it to make the device act as if keys were typed.

name: moveTo
params: displayId: int, displayX: int, displayY: int
description: Moves the mouse cursor to the specified display coordinates. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Moves the mouse cursor to a chosen position on a display. Use it to point the cursor at a spot on screen.

name: pressButton
description: Presses a mouse button. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Presses a mouse button down. Use it to simulate holding down a mouse click.

name: releaseButton
description: Release a mouse button. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Releases a mouse button that was pressed. Use it to simulate letting go of a mouse click.

name: beginAxis
description: Starts an axis event. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Starts a mouse axis event, such as a scroll or tilt movement. Use it to begin simulating mouse wheel or axis input.

name: updateAxis
description: Updates an axis event. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Updates an axis event that is already in progress. Use it to change the value of an ongoing simulated mouse wheel or axis movement.

name: endAxis
description: Ends an axis event. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Ends a mouse axis event that was started earlier. Use it to finish simulating mouse wheel or axis input.

name: createMouseController
description: Creates a mouse controller for simulating mouse operations. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Creates a mouse controller for simulating mouse actions. Use it to make the device act as if the mouse moved or clicked.

name: touchDown
description: Presses down a touch point. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Presses down a touch point on the display to start a simulated touch. Use it to simulate a finger touching the screen, such as tapping a button.

name: touchMove
description: Moves a touch point. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Moves a touch point that is already touching the display. Use it to simulate dragging a finger across the screen, such as swiping or scrolling.

name: touchUp
description: Releases a touch point. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Releases a touch point from the display to end a simulated touch. Use it to simulate lifting a finger off the screen after a tap or drag.

name: createTouchController
description: Creates a touch controller for simulating touch operations. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Creates a touch controller for simulating touch actions. Use it to make the device act as if the screen was tapped or swiped.

name: on
description: Listens for global touchscreen input events. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the result.
summary: Starts listening for input events such as touches, mouse movement into an area, or pinch gestures. Use it to react when someone touches the screen, moves the mouse, or pinches to zoom.

name: onTouch
description: Listens for touch input events.
summary: Listens for touch input events. Use it to react when someone touches the screen.

name: onMouse
description: Listens for mouse input events.
summary: Detects mouse input events while the pointer is inside a set rectangular area. Use it to react when the mouse moves or clicks within that region.

name: off
description: Cancels listening for global touchscreen input events. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the result.
summary: Stops listening for pinch gestures on the touchscreen. Use it to stop detecting two-finger pinch gestures when zooming is no longer needed.

name: offTouch
description: Cancel listening for touch input events.
summary: Stops listening for touch input events. Use it to stop reacting to touches on the screen.

name: offMouse
description: Cancel listening for mouse input events.
summary: Stops listening for mouse input events. Use it to stop reacting to mouse movement, clicks, or scrolling.

name: onPinch
description: Listens for touchPad pinch events.
summary: Detects a finger pinch gesture on a touchpad. Use it to zoom in or out with a pinch.

name: offPinch
description: Cancel listening for touchPad pinch events.
summary: Stops listening for touchpad finger pinch events. Use it to stop reacting when fingers pinch on a touchpad.

name: onRotate
description: Listens for touchPad fingers rotate events.
summary: Detects a finger rotate gesture on a touchpad. Use it to rotate content with two fingers.

name: offRotate
description: Cancel listening for touchPad fingers rotate events.
summary: Stops listening for touchpad finger rotate events. Use it to stop reacting when fingers rotate on a touchpad.

name: onThreeFingersSwipe
description: Listens for touchPad three fingers swipe events.
summary: Listens for three-finger swipe gestures on the touchpad. Use it to react when someone swipes three fingers on the touchpad.

name: offThreeFingersSwipe
description: Cancel listening touchPad three fingers swipe events.
summary: Stops listening for touchpad three-finger swipe events. Use it to stop reacting when three fingers swipe on a touchpad.

name: onFourFingersSwipe
description: Listens for touchPad four fingers swipe events.
summary: Detects a four-finger swipe on a touchpad. Use it to trigger actions like switching desktops or opening a task view.

name: offFourFingersSwipe
description: Cancel listening touchPad four finger swipe events.
summary: Stops listening for four-finger swipe gestures on the touchpad. Use it to stop detecting four-finger swipes.

name: onThreeFingersTap
description: Listens for touchPad three fingers tap events.
summary: Listens for three-finger tap gestures on the touchpad. Use it to react when someone taps the touchpad with three fingers.

name: offThreeFingersTap
description: Cancel listening touchPad three fingers tap events.
summary: Stops listening for three-finger tap gestures on the touchpad. Use it to turn off a three-finger tap shortcut you had switched on.

name: onFingerprint
description: Enables listening for fingerprint key events.
summary: Starts listening for fingerprint key events. Use it to react when a finger is placed on the fingerprint sensor.

name: offFingerprint
description: Cancels listening for fingerprint key events.
summary: Stops listening for fingerprint key events. Use it to stop detecting fingerprint sensor presses.

name: onSwipeInward
description: Enables listening touchPad swipe inward events.
summary: Detects an inward swipe gesture on a touchpad. Use it to trigger actions like going back or opening a panel.

name: offSwipeInward
description: Cancel listening touchPad swipe inward events.
summary: Stops listening for touchpad swipe inward events. Use it to stop reacting when a finger swipes inward on a touchpad.

name: onTouchscreenSwipe
description: Enables listening touchscreen swipe gesture events.
summary: Listens for swipe gestures on the touchscreen with a chosen number of fingers. Use it to react when someone swipes across the screen.

name: offTouchscreenSwipe
description: Disables listening touchscreen swipe gesture events.
summary: Stops listening for swipe gestures made with a given number of fingers on the touchscreen. Use it to turn off swipe gesture handling.

name: onTouchscreenPinch
description: Enables listening touchscreen pinch gesture events.
summary: Listens for pinch gestures on the touchscreen with a chosen number of fingers. Use it to react when someone pinches the screen to zoom.

name: offTouchscreenPinch
description: Disables listening touchscreen pinch gesture events.
summary: Stops listening for pinch gestures made with a given number of fingers on the touchscreen. Use it to turn off pinch-to-zoom handling.

name: onKeyPressed
description: Enables listening for release events of specified keys, such as the logo, power, and volume keys.
summary: Detects when specified keys such as the power, volume, or logo key are released. Use it to react to those button presses.

name: offKeyPressed
description: Disables listening for release events of specified keys.
summary: Stops listening for key release events. Use it to stop reacting when a key is let go.

name: queryTouchEvents
description: Queries recent touchscreen input events. A maximum of 100 events can be queried. Since API version 26.0.0, a
summary: Queries recent touchscreen input events, up to a set number. Use it to look back at recent touches on the screen.

name: setPointerSpeed
description: Sets the mouse pointer speed. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Changes how fast the mouse pointer moves across the screen. Use it to make the cursor slower for precision or faster for quick movement.

name: setPointerSpeedSync
description: Sets the mouse pointer speed. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Changes how fast the mouse pointer moves across the screen, returning immediately. Use it to make the cursor slower for precision or faster for quick movement.

name: getPointerSpeed
description: Obtains the mouse pointer speed. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Finds out how fast the mouse pointer moves. Use it to check the current pointer speed before changing it.

name: getPointerSpeedSync
description: Obtains the mouse pointer speed. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Gets the mouse pointer speed right away, on a scale from 1 to 20. Use it to check the current pointer speed before changing it.

name: setPointerStyle
description: Sets the mouse pointer style type for a specified window. This API can set only the mouse pointer style type of
summary: Changes the mouse pointer style for a chosen window. Use it to make the cursor look different, such as a hand or resize arrow, over a window.

name: setPointerStyleSync
description: Sets the mouse pointer style type for a specified window and returns the result synchronously. This API can set
summary: Changes the mouse pointer style for a chosen window right away. Use it to switch the cursor look, such as a hand or resize arrow, over a window.

name: getPointerStyle
description: Obtains the mouse pointer style type. This API can obtain only the mouse pointer style type of windows within the
summary: Finds out which mouse pointer style a window is using, such as an arrow pointing a certain way. Use it to check the current cursor shape for a window.

name: getPointerStyleSync
description: Queries the mouse pointer style type of a specified window, such as east arrow, west arrow, south arrow, and north
summary: Tells you the mouse pointer style of a window right away, such as east, west, south, or north arrow. Use it to check the current cursor shape for a window.

name: setPointerVisible
description: Sets whether the mouse pointer is visible in the current window. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Shows or hides the mouse pointer in the current window. Use it to hide the cursor while typing or show it again.

name: setPointerVisibleSync
description: Sets whether the mouse pointer is visible in the current window. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Shows or hides the mouse pointer in the current window immediately. Use it to hide the cursor while typing or show it again.

name: isPointerVisible
description: Obtains the visible status of the mouse pointer. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Tells you whether the mouse pointer is currently shown or hidden. Use it to check if the cursor is visible on screen.

name: isPointerVisibleSync
description: Checks whether the mouse pointer is visible in the current window. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Tells you right away whether the mouse pointer is visible in the current window. Use it to check if the cursor is shown or hidden.

name: setPointerColor
description: Sets the mouse pointer color. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets the mouse pointer color. Use it to change the pointer to a color you can see better.

name: setPointerColorSync
description: Sets the pointer color. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Sets the pointer color right away. Use it to change the mouse pointer color immediately.

name: getPointerColor
description: Obtains the current mouse pointer color. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the current mouse pointer color. Use it to check what color the mouse cursor is set to.

name: getPointerColorSync
description: Obtains the pointer color. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Gets the current pointer color right away. Use it to check the mouse cursor color without waiting.

name: setPointerSize
description: Sets the mouse pointer size. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Changes how big the mouse pointer looks on screen. Use it to make the cursor larger or smaller for easier pointing.

name: setPointerSizeSync
description: Sets the pointer size. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Changes how big the mouse pointer looks on screen, returning immediately. Use it to make the cursor larger or smaller for easier pointing.

name: getPointerSize
description: Obtains the current mouse pointer size. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Finds out how big the mouse pointer is, on a scale from 1 to 7. Use it to check the current pointer size before changing it.

name: getPointerSizeSync
description: Obtains the pointer size. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Gets the mouse pointer size right away, on a scale from 1 to 7. Use it to check the current pointer size before changing it.

name: setMousePrimaryButton
description: Sets the primary mouse button. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Chooses which mouse button acts as the main click button. Use it to make the left or right mouse button the primary one.

name: getMousePrimaryButton
description: Obtains the current primary mouse button. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Tells you which mouse button is set as the main click button. Use it to check the current primary mouse button setting.

name: setHoverScrollState
description: Sets the status of the mouse hover scroll switch. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Turns mouse hover scrolling on or off. Use it to let a mouse wheel scroll a page just by hovering, without clicking.

name: getHoverScrollState
description: Obtains the status of the mouse hover scroll switch. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Checks whether mouse hover scrolling is turned on. Use it to see if scrolling works by hovering the mouse without clicking.

name: setMouseScrollRows
description: Sets the number of mouse scroll lines. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets how many lines the mouse wheel scrolls at a time. Use it to make wheel scrolling move faster or slower.

name: getMouseScrollRows
description: Obtains the number of mouse scroll lines. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Tells you how many lines the mouse wheel scrolls at a time. Use it to check the current scroll speed setting.

name: setTouchpadScrollSwitch
description: Sets the touchpad scroll switch. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Turns touchpad scrolling on or off. Use it to enable or disable scrolling with the touchpad.

name: getTouchpadScrollSwitch
description: Obtains the touchpad scroll switch state. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets whether touchpad scrolling is turned on or off. Use it to check if you can scroll with the touchpad.

name: setTouchpadScrollDirection
description: Sets the touchpad scroll direction. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets whether touchpad scrolling follows your finger direction or the opposite. Use it to make scrolling feel natural when you move two fingers on the touchpad.

name: getTouchpadScrollDirection
description: Obtains the scroll direction of the touchpad. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the touchpad scroll direction, telling whether scrolling follows finger movement or is reversed. Use it to check your touchpad scroll setting.

name: setTouchpadTapSwitch
description: Sets the touchpad tap switch. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Turns touchpad tap-to-click on or off. Use it to enable or disable tapping the touchpad to click.

name: getTouchpadTapSwitch
description: Obtains the touchpad tap switch state. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets whether tapping the touchpad is turned on or off. Use it to check if you can tap the touchpad to click.

name: setTouchpadPointerSpeed
description: Sets the touchpad pointer speed. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets how fast the touchpad pointer moves. Use it to make the cursor faster or slower when using the touchpad.

name: getTouchpadPointerSpeed
description: Obtains the touchpad pointer speed. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the current touchpad pointer speed, a value from 1 to 11. Use it to check how fast the cursor moves when using the touchpad.

name: setTouchpadPinchSwitch
description: Sets the touchpad pinch switch. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Turns the touchpad pinch gesture on or off. Use it to let people zoom in and out by pinching on the touchpad.

name: getTouchpadPinchSwitch
description: Obtains the touchpad pinch switch state. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Tells whether pinching on the touchpad is turned on. Use it to check if touchpad pinch zooming is enabled.

name: setTouchpadSwipeSwitch
description: Sets the touchpad multi-finger swipe switch. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Turns multi-finger swipe gestures on the touchpad on or off. Use it to enable or disable swipe gestures on the touchpad.

name: getTouchpadSwipeSwitch
description: Obtains the touchpad multi-finger swipe switch state. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets whether multi-finger swipe on the touchpad is turned on or off. Use it to check if touchpad swipe gestures are enabled.

name: setTouchpadRightClickType
description: Sets the touchpad right-click menu type. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets how a right-click is triggered on the touchpad, such as tapping with two fingers or the right-button area. Use it to choose your preferred way to open right-click menus.

name: getTouchpadRightClickType
description: Obtains the touchpad right-click menu type. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the touchpad right-click menu type. Use it to find out how right-clicking on the touchpad is set to behave.

name: setCustomCursor
params: windowId: int, pixelMap: image.PixelMap, focusX?: int, focusY?: int
description: Sets a custom pointer style for a specified window. This API can set only the custom pointer style of windows
summary: Sets a custom image as the mouse pointer for a window. Use it to give the cursor a custom look, such as a special icon.

name: setCustomCursorSync
params: windowId: int, pixelMap: image.PixelMap, focusX?: int, focusY?: int
description: Sets a custom pointer style for a specified window synchronously. This API can set only the custom pointer style of
summary: Sets a custom image as the mouse pointer for a window right away. Use it to give the cursor a custom look, such as a special icon.

name: setTouchpadDoubleTapAndDragState
description: Sets the touchpad double-tap and drag switch state. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Turns the touchpad double-tap-and-drag gesture on or off. Use it to let people drag items by double-tapping and moving on the touchpad.

name: getTouchpadDoubleTapAndDragState
description: Obtains the touchpad double-tap and drag switch state. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Tells whether double-tapping and dragging on the touchpad is turned on. Use it to check if touchpad double-tap and drag is enabled.

name: setMouseScrollDirection
description: Sets the scroll direction of the mouse wheel. This API uses a promise to return the result asynchronously.
summary: Sets which way the mouse wheel scrolls. Use it to make scrolling follow your finger or go the opposite way.

name: getMouseScrollDirection
description: Obtains the scroll direction of the mouse wheel. This API uses a promise to return the result asynchronously.
summary: Tells you the mouse wheel scroll direction. Use it to check whether scrolling follows the finger direction.

name: setKeyDownDuration
description: Sets the delay for starting an ability using shortcut keys. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets how long a shortcut key must be held down before it starts an ability, such as taking a screenshot after holding the keys for a set time.

name: startAdvertising
description: Starts advertising.
summary: Starts advertising so nearby devices can scan and discover this device. Use it to make this device visible to nearby devices.

name: stopAdvertising
description: Stops advertising with advertising ID.
summary: Stops advertising for a given advertising ID. Use it to stop this device from being discoverable by nearby devices.

name: onAdvertisingStateChange
description: Subscribes to the advertising state change event.
summary: Starts listening for changes in the advertising state. Use it to be notified when this device starts or stops being discoverable by nearby devices.

name: offAdvertisingStateChange
description: Unsubscribes from the advertising state change event.
summary: Stops listening for changes in the advertising state. Use it to stop being notified when this device starts or stops being discoverable by nearby devices.

name: createCdsmClient
description: Creates a CDSM client instance.
summary: Creates a client for managing a set of coordinated NearLink devices. Use it to set up control of nearby linked devices.

name: getCdsmInfo
description: Gets the coordinated devices set information.
summary: Gets information about the set of coordinated devices. Use it to see which devices are working together.

name: onCdsmInfoChange
description: Subscribes to coordinated devices set information change event.
summary: Starts listening for changes to the coordinated devices set information. Use it to keep track of which devices are working together.

name: offCdsmInfoChange
description: Unsubscribes from coordinated devices set information change event.
summary: Stops listening for changes to the coordinated devices set information. Use it when you no longer need updates about which devices are coordinated.

name: createPort
description: Creates a NearLink listening port that can receive data by UUID.
summary: Creates a NearLink listening port identified by a UUID so it can receive data. Use it to set up your device to accept incoming NearLink data.

name: destroyPort
description: Destroys a listen port and releases related resources by UUID.
summary: Closes a NearLink listening port and frees its resources. Use it to stop accepting incoming NearLink data on that port.

name: connect
description: Connects to a server. If the connection is successful, data can be sent to the server.
summary: Connects to a NearLink server so data can be sent to it. Use it to link up with a nearby device before sending files or data.

name: disconnect
description: Disconnects or stops an ongoing connection to a server.
summary: Ends or stops an ongoing connection to a server. Use it to close a data transfer link when you are done sending or receiving.

name: onConnectionStateChanged
description: Subscribes to the connection state change event.
summary: Starts listening for changes in the connection state. Use it to be notified when a data link connects or disconnects.

name: offConnectionStateChanged
description: Unsubscribes from the connection state change event.
summary: Stops listening for changes in the connection state. Use it to stop being notified when a data link connects or disconnects.

name: writeData
description: Writes data by address and UUID.
summary: Writes data to a NearLink device using its address and UUID. Use it to send information to a nearby device over NearLink.

name: onReadData
description: Subscribes to the event reported when data is read from the port.
summary: Starts listening for the event reported when data is read from the port. Use it to be notified when incoming data arrives.

name: offReadData
description: Unsubscribes from the event reported when data is read from the port.
summary: Stops listening for the event reported when data is read from the port. Use it to stop being notified when incoming data arrives.

name: getConnectionState
description: Obtains the connection status for data transfer.
summary: Tells you the current connection status for data transfer. Use it to check whether a data link is connected before sending or receiving.

name: isNearLinkSupported
description: Check whether the current device supports NearLink.
summary: Checks whether the current device supports NearLink. Use it to find out if NearLink features can be used on this device.

name: enable
description: Turns on NearLink.
summary: Turns on NearLink. Use it to switch on NearLink wireless connections on the device.

name: disable
description: Turns off NearLink.
summary: Turns off NearLink. Use it to switch off NearLink wireless connections on the device.

name: getState
description: Gets the NearLink state.
summary: Gets the current NearLink state. Use it to check whether NearLink is on or off before using it.

name: getLocalAddress
description: Gets the MAC address of the local device.
summary: Gets the MAC address of the local device. Use it to find this device's own NearLink address.

name: getLocalName
description: Gets the local device's name.
summary: Gets the name of the local NearLink device. Use it to find out or show this device's own name.

name: getPairedDevices
description: Gets the list of devices that have been paired with the current device.
summary: Gets the list of devices already paired with this device, as MAC addresses. Use it to see which nearby devices are paired before connecting or sharing.

name: setConnectionMode
description: Sets the NearLink connection mode for a device.
summary: Sets the NearLink connection mode for a device, for a chosen duration in seconds. Use it to control how this device connects over NearLink.

name: factoryReset
description: Restores NearLink settings.
summary: Restores NearLink settings to their factory defaults. Use it to reset NearLink settings back to how they came.

name: onStateChange
description: Subscribes to state change events.
summary: Starts listening for NearLink state changes. Use it to be notified when NearLink turns on or off.

name: offStateChange
description: Unsubscribes from state change events.
summary: Stops listening for NearLink state changes. Use it to stop being notified when NearLink turns on or off.

name: createRemoteDevice
description: Creates a remote device instance.
summary: Creates a remote device instance from a device address. Use it to pair and connect with a nearby device.

name: onPairingRequest
description: Subscribes to pairing request events from remote NearLink devices.
summary: Listens for pairing requests from nearby devices. Use it to be notified when a device wants to pair.

name: offPairingRequest
description: Unsubscribes from pairing request events from remote NearLink devices.
summary: Stops listening for pairing requests from nearby devices. Use it to stop being asked to pair with a device.

name: onPairingStateChange
description: Subscribes to NearLink pairing state change events.
summary: Starts listening for changes in a remote device's NearLink pairing state. Use it to know when pairing with a nearby device starts, succeeds, or fails.

name: offPairingStateChange
description: Unsubscribes from NearLink pairing state change events.
summary: Stops listening for changes in the pairing state of a nearby device. Use it to stop being notified when a device finishes or drops pairing.

name: onConnectionStateChange
description: Subscribes to NearLink connection state change events.
summary: Starts listening for changes in a remote device's NearLink connection state. Use it to know when a nearby device connects or disconnects.

name: offConnectionStateChange
description: Unsubscribes from NearLink connection state change events.
summary: Stops listening for changes in a remote device's NearLink connection state. Use it to stop being notified when a nearby device connects or disconnects.

name: onAcbStateChange
description: Subscribes to the NearLink ACB connection status change event.
summary: Starts listening for changes in a remote device's NearLink connection status. Use it to know when a paired device connects or disconnects.

name: offAcbStateChange
description: Unsubscribes from the NearLink ACB connection status change event.
summary: Stops listening for changes in a remote device's NearLink connection status. Use it to stop tracking when a paired device connects or disconnects.

name: startPairing
description: Initiate pairing to remote NearLink device.
summary: Starts pairing with a remote NearLink device. Use it to pair a new device.

name: startCrediblePairing
description: Starts pairing with a credible remote NearLink device.
summary: Starts pairing with a trusted remote device without showing a dialog or asking the user to approve. Use it to connect to a device you already trust.

name: removePairedDevice
description: Remove a paired remote device.
summary: Removes a paired remote device. Use it to unpair a device you no longer want connected.

name: cancelDevicePairing
description: Cancel an in-progress pairing request.
summary: Cancels a pairing request that is currently in progress. Use it to stop pairing with a nearby device.

name: setPairingPasscode
description: Set the passcode during pairing if the pairing type is passcode
summary: Sets the passcode used when pairing with a remote device, entered as a six-digit number. Use it to pair a device that asks for a passcode.

name: setPairingConfirmation
description: Set the confirmation to a pairing request.
summary: Sets the confirmation for a pairing request. Use it to accept or reject a device that wants to pair with you.

name: connect
description: Connect all allowed profiles.
summary: Connects all allowed profiles to a remote device. Use it to link up with a paired device so its services work.

name: disconnect
description: Disconnect all connected profiles.
summary: Disconnects all connected profiles from a remote device. Use it to end the link with a paired device.

name: getPairingState
description: Gets the pairing state.
summary: Gets the pairing state of the remote device. Use it to check whether the device is paired.

name: getDeviceName

summary: Gets the name of the NearLink device. Use it to show which device you are connected to.

name: getDeviceClass
description: Gets the type of the NearLink device.
summary: Gets the type of the NearLink device. Use it to find out what kind of device you are connected to.

name: getConnectionState
description: Gets the profile connection state.
summary: Gets the profile connection state of a remote device. Use it to check whether a remote device is connected.

name: setDeviceAlias
description: Sets the alias of a remote device.
summary: Sets the alias of a remote device. Use it to give a paired device a friendly name you will recognize.

name: getDeviceAlias
description: Gets the alias of a remote device.
summary: Gets the alias of a remote device. Use it to show the friendly name of a nearby device.

name: getAcbState
description: Gets the ACB connection state.
summary: Gets the ACB connection state of a remote device. Use it to check whether the ACB link to that device is connected.

name: getDeviceModel
description: Obtains the model information of a remote device.
summary: Gets the model information of a remote device. Use it to find out what kind of device you are connected to.

name: getDeviceInformation
description: Obtains the remote device information.
summary: Obtains information about the remote device. Use it to look up details about a connected device.

name: getRssiValue
description: Gets the RSSI value of a remote device.
summary: Gets the signal strength value of a remote device. Use it to check how strong the connection to a nearby device is.

name: setConnectionInterval
description: Sets the connection interval with a remote device.
summary: Sets the connection interval with a remote device. Use it to adjust how often the connection checks in with a paired device.

name: startScan

name: stopScan

name: offDeviceFound

name: createClient
description: Creates a SSAP client instance.
summary: Creates a client for connecting to a NearLink service on another device. Use it to start talking to a nearby NearLink device.

name: createServer

name: connect
description: Connects to the server.

name: disconnect
description: Disconnects from or stops an ongoing connection to a server.
summary: Disconnects from the server or stops an ongoing connection. Use it to end a session with a server.

name: close
description: Closes the client.
summary: Closes the client connection. Use it to end a session with a server when you are done.

name: getServices
description: Starts discovering all services on server.
summary: Finds all services offered by a connected server. Use it to see what a nearby device can do before using those services.

name: readProperty
description: Reads the property of a server.
summary: Reads a property value from a server device. Use it to fetch data from a connected device, such as a sensor reading or device status.

name: writeProperty
description: Writes the property of a server.
summary: Writes a property value to a server device. Use it to send data or settings to a connected device.

name: readDescriptor
description: Reads the descriptor of a server.
summary: Reads a descriptor value from a server. Use it to fetch stored details about a connected device's data.

name: writeDescriptor
description: Writes the descriptor of a server.
summary: Writes a descriptor value to a server. Use it to store configuration details on a connected device.

name: setPropertyNotification
description: Enables or disables notification of a property when value changed.
summary: Turns notifications on or off for a property when its value changes. Use it to start or stop receiving updates when a device's data changes.

name: setPropertyIndication

name: requestMtuSize
description: Negotiate the MTU size with server.
summary: Negotiates the maximum transmission unit size with a server device. Use it to set how much data can be sent at once when transferring data to a device.

name: callMethod

summary: Calls a method on a connected server. Use it to send a request to a nearby device and get its response.

name: onPropertyChange
description: Subscribe property value changed event.
summary: Listens for changes to a property value on a connected device. Use it to react when a device's data changes, such as a sensor reading updating.

name: offPropertyChange
description: Unsubscribe property value changed event.
summary: Stops listening for changes to a property value. Use it to stop being told when a device's property value changes.

name: onEventNotify
description: Subscribes to event notifications.
summary: Subscribes to event notifications from a connected device. Use it to receive updates when something happens on the other device.

name: offEventNotify
description: Unsubscribes from event notifications.
summary: Unsubscribes from event notifications. Use it to stop receiving updates about events from a connected device.

name: onConnectionStateChange
description: Subscribes to client connection state changed events.
summary: Listens for changes in the connection state of a client. Use it to know when a nearby device connects or disconnects.

name: offConnectionStateChange
description: Unsubscribes from client connection state changed events.
summary: Stops listening for changes in the connection state of a client. Use it to stop being told when a device connects or disconnects.

name: onMtuChange
description: Subscribes to MTU changed events.
summary: Listens for changes to the maximum data packet size. Use it to know when the transfer size for a connection changes.

name: offMtuChange
description: Unsubscribes from MTU changed events.
summary: Stops listening for changes to the maximum data packet size. Use it to stop being told when the transfer size changes.

name: addService
description: Adds a SSAP service.
summary: Adds and registers a SSAP service on the server. Use it to make a service available for NearLink clients to connect to.

name: removeService
description: Removes a specific SSAP service.
summary: Removes a specific service from the server. Use it to stop offering a service you no longer want clients to find.

name: close
description: Closes this {@code Server} object and unregisters its callbacks.
summary: Closes the server and unregisters its callbacks. Use it to stop the SSAP server when you no longer need it.

name: notifyPropertyChanged
description: Notifies the client that the value of a property on the server has changed.
summary: Tells a client that a property value on the server has changed. Use it to push updated property values to a connected NearLink device.

name: sendResponse
description: Responds to read or write requests from the client.
summary: Responds to read or write requests from a client. Use it to send back the answer to a client's request.

name: onConnectionStateChange
description: Subscribes to server connection state changed events.
summary: Listens for changes in the connection state of a server. Use it to be notified when a device connects or disconnects.

name: offConnectionStateChange
description: Unsubscribes from server connection state changed events.
summary: Stops listening for changes in the connection state of a server. Use it to stop being notified when a device connects or disconnects.

name: onPropertyRead
description: Subscribes to property read events from the client.
summary: Subscribes to property read events from a client. Use it to handle a client reading a value from your server.

name: offPropertyRead
description: Unsubscribes from property read events from the client.
summary: Stops listening for property read requests from a client. Use it to stop being notified when a client reads a value.

name: onPropertyWrite
description: Subscribes to property write events from the client.
summary: Subscribes to property write events from a client. Use it to handle a client writing a value to your server.

name: offPropertyWrite
description: Unsubscribes from property write events from the client.
summary: Stops listening for property write requests from a client. Use it to stop being notified when a client writes a value.

name: onMtuChange
description: Subscribes to MTU changed events.
summary: Listens for changes to the maximum data packet size. Use it to be notified when the transfer size changes.

name: offMtuChange
description: Unsubscribes from MTU changed events.
summary: Stops listening for changes to the maximum data packet size. Use it to stop being notified when the transfer size changes.

name: createNetConnection

name: getDefaultNet

name: getDefaultNetSync

name: getAllNetsSync

name: getConnectionPropertiesSync

name: getNetCapabilitiesSync

name: getNetExtAttribute

name: getNetExtAttributeSync

name: isDefaultNetMetered

summary: Checks whether data traffic on the current network is metered. Use it to warn about data charges before streaming or downloading.

name: isDefaultNetMeteredSync

summary: Checks whether data traffic on the current network is metered. Use it to warn about data charges before streaming or downloading.

name: hasDefaultNet

summary: Checks whether the default data network is active. Use it to see if you are online before making a phone call or loading a page.

name: hasDefaultNetSync
description: Checks whether the default data network is activated.
summary: Checks whether the default data network is active. Use it to see if you are online before making a phone call or loading a page.

name: enableAirplaneMode

summary: Turns on airplane mode on the device, cutting off network connections. Use it to switch on flight mode.

name: disableAirplaneMode

summary: Turns off airplane mode on the device, restoring normal network connections. Use it to switch off flight mode so calls and data work again.

name: reportNetConnected

summary: Reports that a network is connected. Use it to tell the system a network link is up.

name: reportNetDisconnected

summary: Reports that a network is disconnected. Use it to tell the system a network link is down.

name: getAddressesByName

summary: Looks up a host name or domain and returns all its IP addresses using the default data network. Use it to find the address of a website or server before connecting.

name: getAddressesByNameWithOptions
description: Resolves a host name to obtain all IP addresses with specified query option.
summary: Looks up a host name or domain and returns all its IP addresses, with query options you choose. Use it to find the address of a website or server before connecting.

name: getAppNet

summary: Gets the data network bound to the current process. Use it to find which network your app is using.

name: getAppNetSync

name: getGlobalHttpProxy

name: setGlobalHttpProxy

name: getPacUrl

name: setPacFileUrl

name: getPacFileUrl

summary: Gets the web address of the current proxy auto-configuration script. Use it to see which proxy settings are in effect for web traffic.

name: setProxyMode

summary: Sets which proxy mode the network connection uses. Use it to choose how network traffic is routed through a proxy.

name: getProxyMode
description: Obtain the proxy mode {@link ProxyMode}.
summary: Gets the current proxy mode setting. Use it to check how the device handles proxy configuration.

name: addCustomDnsRule

name: removeCustomDnsRule

name: clearCustomDnsRules

name: factoryReset

summary: Resets the device's network settings back to their factory defaults. Use it to clear all network configuration and start fresh.

name: getConnectOwnerUid

name: queryProbeResult

summary: Binds a TCP or UDP socket to a specific network so all its data uses that network. Use it to send traffic over a chosen connection, such as Wi-Fi instead of mobile data.

name: getAddressesByNameWithOptions

name: createHttp

summary: Sends a web request to a given address and returns the response. Use it to fetch a web page or call an online service.

summary: Sends a web request to a given address and returns the response right away. Use it to fetch a web page or call an online service when you need the result immediately.

summary: Sends a web request to a given address and returns the response as a stream. Use it to download a file or fetch large content piece by piece.

name: getIfaceTxBytes

name: getCellularTxBytes

name: getAllRxBytes

name: getAllTxBytes

name: getUidTxBytes

name: offNetStatsChange
description: Unregister notifications of network traffic updates.

name: getTrafficStatsByUid

name: getSockfdTxBytes

name: getSelfTrafficStats

summary: Shows how much data your app used on a chosen network over a chosen time period. Use it to see your app's data usage.

name: getMonthTrafficStats

name: getConnectedSysVpnConfig

name: getConnectedVpnAppInfo

summary: Keeps a socket's traffic out of the VPN so it goes straight to the network. Use it so an app's own connection bypasses the VPN tunnel.

name: setAlwaysOnVpnEnabled

name: isAlwaysOnVpnEnabled

name: updateVpnAuthorizedState

summary: Updates the authorization information for a VPN dialog. Use it to refresh whether a VPN is allowed.

name: createVpnConnection
description: Create a VPN connection using the VpnExtensionContext.

name: createVpnObserver

name: onAuthorizationResult

name: offAuthorizationResult

name: create

name: generateVpnId
