name: protectProcessNet
description: Protect all socket of the VPN process. After executing this function,
summary: Keeps all sockets the current process creates later out of the VPN. Use it so an app's future connections bypass the VPN tunnel.

name: createWebSocket
description: Creates a web socket connection.
summary: Creates a web socket connection. Use it to open a live two-way link with a server.

name: connect
description: Initiates a WebSocket request to establish a WebSocket connection to a given URL.
summary: Opens a WebSocket connection to a given URL. Use it to start a live connection to a server for sending and receiving data.

name: send
description: Sends data through a WebSocket connection.
summary: Sends data over a WebSocket connection. Use it to send messages or binary data to the other side.

name: close
description: Closes a WebSocket connection.
summary: Closes a WebSocket connection. Use it to end a live connection to a server when you are done.

name: on
description: Enables listening for the error events of a WebSocket connection.
summary: Listens for events on a WebSocket connection, such as errors. Use it to react when a live connection has a problem.

name: onOpen
description: Enables listening for the open events of a WebSocket connection.
summary: Listens for a WebSocket connection opening. Use it to know when a live connection is ready to send and receive.

name: off
description: Cancels listening for the error events of a WebSocket connection.
summary: Cancels listening for message events on a WebSocket connection. Use it to stop being notified about messages from the server.

name: offOpen
description: Cancels listening for the open events of a WebSocket connection.
summary: Stops listening for open events on a WebSocket connection. Use it to stop being notified when the connection opens.

name: onOpenInfo
description: Enables listening for the open info events of a WebSocket connection.
summary: Listens for the opening details of a WebSocket connection. Use it to read information returned when a live connection opens.

name: offOpenInfo
description: Cancels listening for the open info events of a WebSocket connection.
summary: Stops listening for open info events on a WebSocket connection. Use it to stop being notified with details when the connection opens.

name: onMessage
description: Enables listening for the message events of a WebSocket connection.
summary: Listens for messages arriving on a WebSocket connection. Use it to receive chat messages or other data sent by the server.

name: offMessage
description: Cancels listening for the message events of a WebSocket connection.
summary: Stops listening for incoming messages on a WebSocket connection. Use it to stop receiving chat or data messages.

name: onWebSocketClose
description: Enables listening for the close events of a WebSocket connection.
summary: Tells you when a WebSocket connection has closed. Use it to know when a live connection has ended.

name: offWebSocketClose
description: Cancels listening for the close events of a WebSocket connection.
summary: Stops listening for close events on a WebSocket connection. Use it to stop being notified when the connection closes.

name: onWebSocketError
description: Enables listening for the error events of a WebSocket connection.
summary: Tells you when a WebSocket connection has an error. Use it to detect and handle connection problems.

name: offWebSocketError
description: Cancels listening for the error events of a WebSocket connection.
summary: Stops listening for error events on a WebSocket connection. Use it to stop being notified when the connection fails.

name: onDataEnd
description: Enables listening for receiving data ends events of a WebSocket connection.
summary: Listens for the end of incoming data on a WebSocket connection. Use it to know when the server has finished sending data.

name: offDataEnd
description: Cancels listening for receiving data ends events of a WebSocket connection.
summary: Cancels listening for data-end events on a WebSocket connection. Use it to stop being notified when the server has finished sending data.

name: onHeaderReceive

summary: Listens for HTTP response headers on a WebSocket connection. Use it to read the headers the server sends back.

name: offHeaderReceive
description: Unregisters the observer for HTTP Response Header events.
summary: Stops listening for HTTP response header events on a WebSocket connection. Use it to stop being notified when response headers arrive.

name: createWebSocketServer
description: Creates a web socket Server.
summary: Creates a web socket server. Use it to let apps or devices connect and exchange live messages over a network.

name: start
description: Start the WebSocket Server, and listen to a given port.
summary: Starts the WebSocket server and listens on a given address and port. Use it to begin accepting client connections for real-time messaging.

name: listAllConnections
description: List all alive connections.
summary: Lists all currently alive WebSocket connections. Use it to see which clients are connected.

name: close
description: Close a given WebSocket connection.
summary: Closes a given WebSocket connection. Use it to end a specific client's connection.

name: send
description: Send a message using a specific connection.
summary: Sends a message back to one specific connected client. Use it to reply to a chat message or push data to a particular user.

name: stop
description: Stop listening.
summary: Stops the WebSocket server from listening. Use it to shut down your server and stop accepting client connections.

name: on
description: Enables listening for the error events of a WebSocket Server.
summary: Starts listening for server errors. Use it to be notified when your server runs into a problem.

name: off
description: Cancels listening for the error events of a WebSocket Server.
summary: Stops listening for WebSocket server error events. Use it to stop handling server errors.

name: onWebSocketServerError
description: Enables listening for the error events of a WebSocket Server.
summary: Listens for error events on a WebSocket server. Use it to be notified when the server has a problem.

name: onConnect
description: Enables listening for events that a client requested to connect the server.
summary: Starts listening for clients asking to connect to the server. Use it to be notified when someone tries to join your server.

name: onMessageReceive
description: Enables listening for events that the server received a message.
summary: Lets a WebSocket server watch for messages sent to it by clients. Use it to react when someone sends a chat message or other data to your server.

name: onWebSocketServerClose
description: Enables listening for events that a connection from a given client has been closed.
summary: Lets a WebSocket server watch for a client connection being closed. Use it to notice when someone disconnects from your server.

name: offWebSocketServerError
description: Cancels listening for the error events of a WebSocket Server.
summary: Stops listening for errors from the server. Use it to stop being notified when your server runs into a problem.

name: offConnect
description: Cancels listening for events that a client requested to connect the server.
summary: Stops listening for clients asking to connect to the server. Use it to stop being notified when someone tries to join your server.

name: offWebSocketServerClose
description: Cancels listening for events that a connection from a given client has been closed.
summary: Stops listening for a client's connection being closed. Use it to stop being notified when someone disconnects from your server.

name: offMessageReceive
description: Cancels listening for events that the server received a message.
summary: Stops listening for messages the server receives. Use it to stop being notified when a message arrives at your server.

name: isSupported

name: hasHceCapability

name: isDefaultService
description: Checks whether a service is default for given type.
summary: Checks whether a service is the default for a given card type, such as payment. Use it to see if your app is the one handling tap-to-pay.

name: getPaymentServices
description: Gets all payment services.

summary: Turns on card emulation and registers the app's card identifiers. Use it to make the phone act as a card that can be tapped on a reader.

name: stopHCE

name: stop

name: on

name: off

name: offHceCmd

name: transmit

name: isNfcSupported

name: on

name: offNfcStateChange

name: getNfcVTag

summary: Turns HTML, plain, and URI content in a copied item into plain text. Use it to paste copied content as plain text.

name: addEntry
description: Adds PasteData of an extra type to **PasteDataRecord**. The type added using this method is not the
summary: Adds an extra piece of content of a chosen type to a copied item, such as HTML or a link. Use it to attach additional formats to the same clipboard entry.

name: getValidTypes
description: Obtains the intersection of the input types and the types of the PasteData.
summary: Finds which of the given content types are available in the copied item. Use it to check what formats you can read from the clipboard before pasting.

name: getData
description: Obtains data of the specified type from **PasteDataRecord**.
summary: Gets the copied content of a chosen type from a clipboard item. Use it to read back a specific format, such as text or a link, that was copied.

name: addHtmlRecord
description: Adds an HTML record to the PasteData, and adds **MIMETYPE_TEXT_HTML** to **mimeTypes** in
summary: Adds HTML content as a record in the paste data. Use it to put copied web or formatted text on the clipboard.

name: addWantRecord
description: Adds a Want record to the PasteData, and adds **MIMETYPE_TEXT_WANT** to **mimeTypes** in
summary: Adds a Want object as a record in the paste data. Use it to copy an app action or target to the clipboard.

name: addRecord
description: Adds a data record to the PasteData, and adds its type to **mimeTypes** in
summary: Adds a data record to the paste data and notes its type. Use it to build up the content that will be copied to the clipboard.

name: addTextRecord
description: Adds a plain text record to the PasteData, and adds **MIMETYPE_TEXT_PLAIN** to **mimeTypes** in
summary: Adds a plain text entry to clipboard data. Use it to put copied text onto the clipboard.

name: addUriRecord
description: Adds a URI record to the PasteData, and adds **MIMETYPE_TEXT_URI** to **mimeTypes** in
summary: Adds a URI as a record in the paste data. Use it to copy a link or file location to the clipboard.

name: getMimeTypes
description: Obtains types of [PasteDataProperty]{@link pasteboard.PasteDataProperty} of the PasteData.
summary: Gets the data types held in the paste data. Use it to check what kind of content is on the clipboard before pasting.

name: getPrimaryHtml
description: Obtains the HTML content of the primary record.
summary: Gets the HTML content of the main item on the clipboard. Use it when pasting copied rich web content into an editor.

name: getPrimaryWant
description: Obtains the **Want** object of the primary record.
summary: Gets the Want object of the main item on the clipboard. Use it to paste a copied item that opens another app.

name: getPrimaryMimeType
description: Obtains the data type of the primary record in the pasteboard.
summary: Gets the data type of the main item on the clipboard. Use it to check what kind of content was copied before pasting it.

name: getPrimaryText
description: Obtains the plain text of the primary record.
summary: Gets the plain text of the main item on the clipboard. Use it to paste copied words into a text field.

name: getPrimaryUri
description: Obtains the URI of the primary record.
summary: Gets the URI of the main item on the clipboard. Use it to paste a copied link or file address.

name: getPrimaryPixelMap
description: Obtains the PixelMap of the primary record.
summary: Gets the image of the main item on the clipboard. Use it to paste a copied picture into an app.

name: getProperty
description: Obtains the property of the PasteData.
summary: Gets the property description of a copied item. Use it to check details like whether the copied content is local-only before pasting.

name: setProperty
description: Sets a [PasteDataProperty]{@link pasteboard.PasteDataProperty} object.
summary: Sets the properties of copied content, such as its description. Use it to describe or label what was copied to the clipboard.

name: getRecordAt
description: Obtains the record with a specific index in PasteData.
summary: Gets one record from a copied item by its position. Use it to read a specific piece of the copied content when pasting.

name: getRecord
description: Obtains the record with a specific index in PasteData.
summary: Gets one record from a copied item by its position. Use it to read a specific piece of the copied content when pasting.

name: getRecordCount
description: Obtains the number of records in a PasteData object.
summary: Counts how many records a copied item holds. Use it to loop through all copied pieces when pasting.

name: getTag
description: Obtains the custom tag from the PasteData. If no custom tag is set, an empty string is returned.
summary: Gets the custom tag of a copied item, or an empty text if none was set. Use it to tell your own copied content apart when pasting.

name: hasMimeType
description: Checks whether the PasteData contains data of the specified type.
summary: Checks whether a copied item holds data of a given type. Use it to decide if pasted content is text, an image, or another kind before using it.

name: hasType
description: Checks whether the PasteData contains data of the specified MIME type.
summary: Checks whether the copied data contains a particular kind of content, such as plain text, HTML, or an image. Use it to see if pasted content is the type you need before using it.

name: removeRecordAt
description: Removes the record with a specific index in PasteData.
summary: Removes one item of copied content at a given position and reports whether it worked. Use it to drop an unwanted piece from the copied data.

name: removeRecord
description: Removes the record with a specific index in PasteData.
summary: Removes one item of copied content at a given position. Use it to drop an unwanted piece from the copied data.

name: replaceRecordAt
description: Replaces the record with a specific index in PasteData.
summary: Replaces one item of copied content at a chosen position with a new item. Use it to swap out a specific piece of clipboard data while keeping the rest.

name: replaceRecord
description: Replaces the record with a specific index in PasteData.
summary: Swaps out one item of copied content at a given position with a new one. Use it to correct or update a piece of the copied data.

name: pasteStart
description: Notifies the pasteboard service to retain the cross-device channel before reading data from the pasteboard.
summary: Tells the clipboard service to keep the cross-device channel open before you read copied data. Use it before pasting content that may come from another device.

name: pasteComplete
description: Invoked to notify pasteboard service the utilization of PasteData has completed and occupied resources can be released for further usage
summary: Tells the clipboard service that you have finished using copied data so its resources can be freed. Use it after you finish pasting content.

name: cancel
description: Cancels an ongoing paste task.
summary: Stops a paste task that is currently running. Use it to cancel copying or pasting content.

name: on
description: Subscribes the content change event of the system pasteboard.
summary: Starts listening for changes to the clipboard content. Use it to react whenever something new is copied to the clipboard.

name: onUpdate
description: Add a callback invoked when pasteboard content changes.
summary: Runs your callback whenever the clipboard content changes. Use it to react when something new is copied, such as updating a paste button.

name: onRemoteUpdate
description: Add a callback invoked when remote pasteboard content changes.
summary: Starts listening for clipboard changes that come from another device. Use it to react when a remote device updates the clipboard.

name: off
description: Unsubscribes the content change event of the system pasteboard.
summary: Stops listening for changes to the clipboard content. Use it when you no longer need to be notified about new clipboard items.

name: offRemoteUpdate
description: Remove a callback invoked when remote pasteboard content changes.
summary: Stops listening for clipboard changes that come from another device. Use it to stop being notified when a remote device updates the clipboard.

name: offUpdate
description: Remove a callback invoked when pasteboard content changes.
summary: Stops listening for clipboard content changes. Use it to stop being notified when the clipboard gets new content.

name: isRemoteData
description: Checks whether the data in the pasteboard is from another device.
summary: Tells you whether the clipboard content came from another device. Use it to check if copied text or data was sent over from a different device.

name: hasRemoteData
description: Checks whether the PasteData is on a remote device. Transferring data across devices takes time. If the
summary: Tells you whether the clipboard data sits on another device rather than this one. Use it to avoid reading or checking copied content on the screen thread when it comes from a remote device.

name: getDataSource
description: Obtains the name of the application that provides data.
summary: Tells you which app put the current clipboard content there. Use it to see where copied text or data came from.

name: hasDataType
description: Checks whether the pasteboard contains data of the specified type.
summary: Tells you whether the clipboard holds data of a given type, such as text or an image. Use it to check if the copied content matches what you can paste.

name: clear
description: Clears the system pasteboard. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Clears everything currently on the system clipboard. Use it to wipe copied text or content so it can no longer be pasted.

name: clearData
description: Clears the system pasteboard. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Clears everything currently on the system clipboard. Use it to wipe copied text or content so it can no longer be pasted.

name: clearDataSync
description: Clears the system pasteboard. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Clears everything currently on the system clipboard right away. Use it to wipe copied text or content so it can no longer be pasted.

name: getPasteData
description: Obtains a **PasteData** object from the pasteboard. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Reads the clipboard and gives you the copied content. Use it to paste text, images, or other copied data.

name: getData
description: Obtains a **PasteData** object from the pasteboard. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Reads the clipboard contents. Use it to paste whatever was last copied.

name: getDataSync
description: Obtains a **PasteData** object from the pasteboard. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Reads the clipboard right away and gives you the copied content. Use it to paste text or data you copied.

name: hasPasteData
description: Checks whether the system pasteboard contains data. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Tells you whether the system clipboard currently holds any data. Use it to decide whether pasting is possible before offering a paste action.

name: hasData
description: Checks whether the system pasteboard contains data. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Tells you whether the system clipboard currently holds any data. Use it to decide whether pasting is possible before offering a paste action.

name: hasDataSync
description: Checks whether the system pasteboard contains data. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Tells you right away whether the system clipboard currently holds any data. Use it to check if there is anything to paste before showing a paste option.

name: setPasteData
description: Writes a **PasteData** object to the system pasteboard. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Writes clipboard data to the system clipboard. Use it to copy content so the user can paste it somewhere else.

name: setData
description: Writes a **PasteData** object to the system pasteboard. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Writes a PasteData object to the pasteboard so it can be pasted elsewhere. Use it to copy text, images, or other content for pasting into another app.

name: setDataSync
description: Writes data to the system system pasteboard. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Writes data to the system clipboard right away. Use it to copy text or other content so it can be pasted elsewhere.

name: getUnifiedData
description: Obtains a **PasteData** object from the system pasteboard. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Reads the clipboard and gives you the copied content as unified data. Use it to paste copied items like text, images, or files.

name: getUnifiedDataSync
description: Obtains a **UnifiedData** object from the system pasteboard. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Reads the data currently on the system clipboard and gives it back right away. Use it to paste copied text, images, or other content into your app.

name: setUnifiedData
description: Writes a **PasteData** object to the system pasteboard. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Writes data to the system clipboard. Use it to copy content so the user can paste it somewhere else.

name: setUnifiedDataSync
description: Writes data to the system pasteboard. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Writes data to the system clipboard right away. Use it to copy content so the user can paste it somewhere else.

name: setAppShareOptions
description: Sets pasteable range of PasteData for application.
summary: Sets the pasteable range of copied data for the application. Use it to control whether copied content can be pasted only inside the app.

name: removeAppShareOptions
description: Deletes the global pasteable range of the application.
summary: Deletes the application's global pasteable range on the pasteboard. Use it to stop other apps from pasting the app's copied content.

name: detectPatterns
description: Detects [patterns]{@link pasteboard.Pattern} in the system pasteboard. This API uses a promise to return the
summary: Checks the clipboard for content matching given patterns, such as a phone number or web address. Use it to see what kind of data was copied before acting on it.

name: getMimeTypes
description: Obtains the types of PasteData in the system pasteboard. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Lists the kinds of content currently on the clipboard, such as text or images. Use it to check what type of data you can paste.

name: getChangeCount
description: Obtains the number of pasteboard content changes.
summary: Reports how many times the clipboard content has changed. Use it to tell whether something new was copied since you last checked.

name: getDataWithProgress
description: Obtains the PasteData from the system pasteboard with system progress.
summary: Reads the clipboard and shows progress while it loads, for large items like files. Use it to paste copied files or data with a progress indicator.

name: push
description: Pushes the component and data to the component user.
summary: Sends the information of the template a plugin component provides. Use it to push data from a component provider to its user.

name: request
description: Requests the component from the component provider.
summary: Sends a request for the template information a plugin component wants. Use it to ask a component provider for data.

name: on
description: Listens for events of the request type and returns the requested data, or listens for events of the push type and
summary: Listens for push or request events, receiving pushed data or returning requested data. Use it so a component can get data from or send data to a provider.

name: shutdown
description: Shuts down the system.
summary: Shuts down the system. Use it to turn the device off.

name: rebootDevice
description: Restarts the system.
summary: Restarts the system, optionally entering a special mode such as updater. Use it to reboot the device.

name: reboot
description: Reboots a device.
summary: Restarts the device, optionally with a reason such as entering updater mode. Use it to reboot the device.

name: isScreenOn
description: Checks the screen status of the current device. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Checks whether the screen is currently on. Use it to tell if the display is lit.

name: isActive
description: Checks whether the current device is active.
summary: Checks whether the device is active, such as when the screen is on or it has woken from sleep. Use it to tell if the device is awake.

name: wakeup
description: Wakes up a device.
summary: Wakes up a device from sleep, taking a reason string. Use it to turn a device back on or bring it out of sleep.

name: suspend
description: Enables a device to enter the sleep state.
summary: Puts the device into sleep mode, optionally right after the screen turns off. Use it to make a device go to sleep or save power.

name: getPowerMode
description: Obtains the power mode of this device.
summary: Tells you the current power mode of the device. Use it to check how the device is managing its power.

name: setPowerMode
description: Sets the power mode of a device. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets the power mode of the device. Use it to switch the device into a chosen power mode.

name: isStandby
description: Checks whether the device is in standby mode.
summary: Checks whether the device is in standby mode. Use it to tell if the device is resting in standby.

name: hibernate
description: Hibernates a device.
summary: Puts the device into hibernation, optionally clearing memory first. Use it to hibernate the device and save power.

name: setScreenOffTime
description: Sets the screen-off timeout duration, in unit of ms.
summary: Sets how long the screen stays on before turning off, in milliseconds. Use it to control the screen timeout.

name: refreshActivity
description: Refreshes the device activity status (for example, resetting the screen-off time).
summary: Resets the device activity status, such as the screen-off timer, while the device is active. Use it to keep the screen from turning off during activity.

name: registerShutdownCallback
description: Registers a callback to be invoked when the device is shut down or rebooted. This API uses an asynchronous callback
summary: Registers a callback that runs when the device is shut down or rebooted. Use it to react to the device turning off or restarting.

name: unregisterShutdownCallback
description: Unregisters the callback to be invoked when the device is shut down or rebooted. This API uses a callback to return
summary: Stops a previously registered callback from being called when the device shuts down or restarts. Use it to cancel listening for shutdown or reboot events.

name: getPowerConfig
description: Query the power configuration value for a given scene name.
summary: Looks up the power configuration value for a named scene. Use it to read device power settings for a specific situation.

name: setPowerConfig
description: Update the power configuration value for a given scene name.
summary: Updates the power configuration value for a named scene. Use it to adjust power settings for a particular situation.

name: setPowerKeyFilteringStrategy
description: Sets the power key filtering strategy. After the power service subscribes to the power key event, this API is used
summary: Sets how the power key event is processed after the power service subscribes to it. Use it to control what happens when the power key is pressed.

name: on
description: Subscribes to the block events of a print job. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the result.
summary: Listens for print job events such as blocked, successful, failed, or canceled. Use it to be notified about the outcome of a print job.

name: onBlock
description: Register event callback when the current print task is in process.
summary: Listens for when a print job becomes blocked. Use it to be notified that printing is stuck.

name: onSucceed
description: Register event callback when the current print task is in process.
summary: Tells you when the current print job finishes successfully. Use it to know when your printing is done.

name: onFail
description: Register event callback when the current print task is in process.
summary: Listens for when a print job fails. Use it to be notified that printing failed.

name: onCancel
description: Register event callback when the current print task is in process.
summary: Listens for when a print job is canceled. Use it to be notified that printing was canceled.

name: off
description: Unsubscribes from the block events of a print job. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the result.
summary: Unsubscribes from print job cancellation events. Use it to stop being notified when a print job is canceled.

name: offBlock
description: Unregister event callback when the current print task is in process.
summary: Unregisters the callback for when a print task is blocked. Use it to stop being notified that a print job is stuck.

name: offSucceed
description: Unregister event callback when the current print task is in process.
summary: Stops listening for a print job success. Use it to stop being notified when printing finishes successfully.

name: offFail
description: Unregister event callback when the current print task is in process.
summary: Stops listening for a print job failure. Use it to stop being notified when printing fails.

name: offCancel
description: Unregister event callback when the current print task is in process.
summary: Unregisters the callback for when a print task is canceled. Use it to stop being notified that a print job was canceled.

name: onStartLayoutWrite
params: jobId: string, oldAttrs: PrintAttributes, newAttrs: PrintAttributes, fd: int, writeResultCallback: (jobId: string, writeResult: PrintFileCreationState) => void
description: Sends an empty PDF file descriptor to a third-party application. The third-party application updates the file
summary: Sends an empty PDF file descriptor to an app, which updates the file with new print attributes and then prints it. Use it to prepare and print a document with updated print settings.

name: onJobStateChanged
description: Registers a listener for print job state changes.
summary: Registers a listener for changes in the state of a print job. Use it to track a print job's progress.

name: print
description: Prints files. This API uses a promise to return the result. To start the system print preview page, call the
summary: Prints files such as images and PDFs and opens the system print preview page. Use it to print a document or picture.

name: startPrint
description: Prints a file or binary data. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Prints a file or binary data. Use it to send a document or image to a printer.

name: queryAllPrinterExtensionInfos
description: Obtains the information of all installed printer extensions. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets information about every installed printer extension. Use it to see which printer add-ons are available.

name: startDiscoverPrinter
description: Discovers printers by specifying the extension list. The discovered printers contain the specified print extension
summary: Finds available printers, so you can choose one to print to.

name: stopDiscoverPrinter
description: Stops discovering printers. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Stops discovering printers. Use it to end the search for available printers.

name: connectPrinter
description: Connects to a printer by printer ID. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Connects to a printer using its printer ID. Use it to set up a printer so documents can be sent to it.

name: disconnectPrinter
description: Disconnects from the specified printer. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Disconnects from a printer by its ID. Use it to stop using a printer when you are done printing.

name: queryPrinterCapability
description: Queries the printer capability. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Checks what a printer can do. Use it to find out a printer's abilities before printing.

name: startPrintJob
description: Starts the specified print job. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Starts the specified print job. Use it to send a document to a printer and begin printing.

name: cancelPrintJob
description: Cancels the specified print job, which is on the print queue of the printer. This API uses a promise to return the
summary: Cancels a print job that is waiting in the printer's queue. Use it to stop a document from printing.

name: restartPrintJob
description: Restarts a print job that has been finished before. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Restarts a print job that has already finished, so you can print the same document again.

name: requestPrintPreview
description: Requests print preview data. This API uses a callback to return the result.
summary: Gets preview data for a print job so you can see how a document will look before printing.

name: on
params: type: 'printerStateChange', callback: (state: PrinterState, info: PrinterInfo) => void
description: Registers a listener for printer state change events. This API uses a callback to return the result.
summary: Listens for printer change events, such as printer status, job status, or extension information changes. Use it to be notified when a printer or print job changes.

name: onPrinterStateChange
description: Register event callback for the state change of printer.
summary: Watches for changes in a printer's state and reports them. Use it to keep track of whether a printer is ready, busy, or offline while printing.

name: off
description: Unregisters the listener for printer state change events. This API uses a callback to return the result.
summary: Stops listening for printer extension information change events. Use it to stop being notified when a printer's extra details change.

name: offPrinterStateChange
description: Unregister event callback for the state change of printer.
summary: Stops listening for changes to a printer's state. Use it to stop being notified when a printer goes online, offline, or changes status.

name: onJobStateChange
description: Register event callback for the state change of print job.
summary: Starts listening for changes to the state of a print job. Use it to be notified when a print job starts, finishes, or fails.

name: offJobStateChange
description: Unregister event callback for the state change of print job.
summary: Stops listening for changes to the state of a print job. Use it to stop being notified when a print job starts, finishes, or fails.

name: onExtInfoChange
description: Register event callback for the information change of print extension.
summary: Starts listening for changes to print extension information. Use it to be notified when print extension details change.

name: offExtInfoChange
description: Unregister event callback for the information change of print extension.
summary: Stops listening for changes to print extension information. Use it to stop receiving updates about print extensions.

name: addPrinters
description: Adds printers. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Adds a list of printers to the system. Use it to register several printers at once for printing.

name: removePrinters
description: Removes printers. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Removes printers from the list. Use it to delete printers you no longer need.

name: updatePrinters
description: Updates information about the specified printers. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Updates information for the specified printers. Use it to refresh details of printers you are managing for printing.

name: updatePrinterState
description: Updates the printer state. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Updates the state of a printer. Use it to keep a printer's status current when managing printing.

name: updatePrintJobState
params: jobId: string, state: PrintJobState, subState: PrintJobSubState
description: Updates the print job state. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Updates the state of a print job. Use it to track or change whether a print job is pending, printing, or finished.

name: updateExtensionInfo
description: Updates the printer extension information. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Updates the printer extension information. Use it to refresh the details of a printer extension.

name: queryAllPrintJobs
description: Queries all print jobs. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Queries all print jobs. Use it to review the full list of print jobs.

name: queryAllActivePrintJobs
description: Queries all active print jobs. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Lists all print jobs that are currently active. Use it to see what is printing right now.

name: queryPrintJobList
description: Queries all print jobs. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Lists all print jobs. Use it to see what is printing or waiting to print.

name: queryPrintJobById
description: Queries a print job by ID. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Finds a print job by its ID. Use it to look up the details of one specific print job.

name: startGettingPrintFile
params: jobId: string, printAttributes: PrintAttributes, fd: int, onFileStateChanged: Callback<PrintFileCreationState>
description: Starts to obtain the print file. This API uses an asynchronous callback to return the result.
summary: Starts obtaining the print file for a print job, reporting file state changes through a callback. Use it to fetch the document that will be printed.

name: notifyPrintService
description: Notifies the print service of the spooler shutdown information. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Tells the print service that a print job's spooler has shut down, either because it was cancelled or because it started. Use it to report print job status to the print service.

name: notifyPrintServiceSpoolerCloseForCancelled
description: Notify print service the information.
summary: Tells the print service that a print job's spooler closed because the job was cancelled. Use it to report a cancelled print job to the print service.

name: notifyPrintServiceSpoolerCloseForStarted
description: Notify print service the information.
summary: Tells the print service that a print job's spooler closed because the job started. Use it to report a started print job to the print service.

name: getAddedPrinters
description: Obtains the list of printers added to the system. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets the list of printers already added to the system. Use it to see which printers are set up for printing.

name: getPrinterInfoById
description: Obtains printer information based on the printer ID. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets details about a printer by its ID. Use it to look up a printer's information before printing.

name: notifyPrintServiceEvent
description: Notifies the print service of the print application events. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Tells the print service about events from a print application. Use it to report print app activity to the print service.

name: addPrinterToDiscovery
description: Adds a printer to the printer discovery list. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Adds a printer to the list of printers that can be discovered. Use it to make a printer available for selection when printing.

name: updatePrinterInDiscovery
description: Updates the printer capabilities to the printer discovery list. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Updates a printer's capabilities in the discovery list. Use it to refresh the details of a printer found nearby.

name: removePrinterFromDiscovery
description: Removes a printer from the printer discovery list. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Removes a printer from the list of discovered printers. Use it to hide a printer you no longer want to see when choosing where to print.

name: getPrinterInformationById
description: Obtains printer information based on the printer ID. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Gets information about a printer from its printer ID. Use it to look up a printer's details before printing a document.

name: updatePrinterInformation
description: Updates the information of a printer in the system. This API uses a promise to return the result. Currently, only
summary: Updates a printer's information in the system, such as its alias and options. Use it to rename a printer or change its settings.

name: setPrinterPreferences
description: Sets the printer preferences. This API uses a promise to return the result.

summary: Makes a second shared memory object that points to the same memory region as an existing one. Use it to share the same data between two parts of a program without copying it.

summary: Maps a shared memory object into the process's address space with the protection level you choose. Use it to access shared data in memory.

summary: Listens for when a screen is connected. Use it to react when a display is plugged in or turned on.

name: onDisconnect

name: onChange

name: offDisconnect

name: offChange

name: destroyVirtualScreen

summary: Sets a surface for a virtual screen. Use it to attach a drawing surface to a virtual display.

summary: Sets the positions of the primary and secondary screens when in extend mode. Use it to arrange where the second screen sits relative to the main one.

summary: Sets the screen orientation, but only if it matches the app's rotation policy. Use it to lock or rotate the display to a chosen orientation.

name: setDensityDpi
description: Sets the pixel density of the screen. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets the pixel density of the screen. Use it to adjust how large content appears on the display.

name: setScreenPrivacyMaskImage
description: Sets a privacy mask image for the screen. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets a privacy mask image for a screen. Use it to cover a display with a picture so onlookers cannot see what is shown.

name: makeUnique
description: Sets the screen to independent display mode. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets screens to independent display mode so each shows its own content. Use it to stop screens from mirroring and give each its own picture.

summary: Takes a screenshot and returns both standard and high dynamic range pictures when the screen has HDR content. Use it to capture the screen while keeping HDR quality.

name: capture

summary: Obtains a screenshot of the main display. Use it to grab the current screen image for saving or sharing.

name: newSEService
description: Establish a new connection that can be used to connect to all the SEs available in the system.
summary: Opens a connection to the secure elements in the device, such as the SIM or embedded chip, and reports when the connection is ready. Use it to start talking to a secure element for payments or secure access.

name: createService
description: Establish a new connection that can be used to connect to all the SEs available in the system.
summary: Opens a connection to the secure elements in the device, such as the SIM or embedded chip. Use it to start talking to a secure element for payments or secure access.

name: on
description: Register the service state changed event.
summary: Registers for changes in the secure element service state. Use it to know when the SIM or embedded secure element becomes available or unavailable.

name: off
description: Unsubscribe the service state changed event.
summary: Stops listening for changes in the secure element service state. Use it to stop being notified when the secure element connection changes.

name: getReaders
description: Returns the list of available SE readers. There must be no duplicated objects in the returned list.
summary: Returns the list of available secure element readers, including those with no card inserted. Use it to find the readers on the device.

name: isConnected
description: Checks whether or not the service is connected.
summary: Checks whether the secure element service is currently connected. Use it to confirm the service is ready before talking to secure elements.

name: shutdown
description: Releases all SE resources allocated by this SEService. As a result isConnected() will return false.
summary: Releases all secure element resources held by this service, so it is no longer connected. Use it to clean up when you are done using secure elements.

name: getVersion
description: Returns the version of the Open Mobile API Specification this implementation is based on.
summary: Returns the version of the Open Mobile API specification this implementation follows. Use it to check which secure element API version is supported on the device.

name: getName
description: Returns the name of this reader.
summary: Returns the name of this reader, such as "SIM[slot]" for a SIM reader or "eSE[slot]" for an embedded secure element reader. Use it to tell which reader you are working with.

name: isSecureElementPresent
description: Checks if a SE is present in this reader.
summary: Checks whether a secure element is present in this reader. Use it to find out if a secure element is available before connecting.

name: openSession
description: Connects to a SE in this reader.
summary: Connects to a secure element in this reader and prepares it for communication, returning a session used to create channels. Use it to start talking to a secure element.

name: closeSessions
description: Close all the sessions opened on this reader. All the channels opened by all these sessions will be closed.
summary: Closes all sessions opened on this reader, and all channels opened by those sessions. Use it to end every secure element connection on the reader at once.

name: getReader
description: Get the reader that provides this session.
summary: Gets the reader that provides this session. Use it to find out which reader is handling your secure element connection.

name: getATR
description: Get the ATR of this SE.
summary: Gets the ATR (answer to reset) of the secure element this session is connected to, or an empty array if unavailable. Use it to identify the secure element card you are talking to.

name: close
description: Close the connection with the SE. This will close any channels opened by this application with this SE.
summary: Closes the connection with the secure element and any channels opened by this application. Use it to end a secure element session when you are done.

name: isClosed
description: Check if this session is closed.
summary: Checks whether this session is closed. Use it to tell if your connection to the secure element is still open before sending commands.

name: closeChannels
description: Close any channels opened on this session.
summary: Closes any channels opened on this session. Use it to shut down open channels while keeping the session.

name: openBasicChannel
description: This method is provided to ease the development of mobile applications and for backward compatibility with
summary: Opens the basic channel (channel 0) to a secure element applet, locking it to your app until closed. Use it to start talking to a card applet over the primary channel.

name: openLogicalChannel
description: This method is provided to ease the development of mobile applications and for backward compatibility with
summary: Opens a logical channel to a secure element and selects the applet with the given AID. Use it to talk to a specific card applet without disturbing other channels.

name: getSession
description: Get the session that has opened this channel.
summary: Gets the session that opened this channel. Use it to find which session a secure element channel belongs to.

name: close
description: Closes this channel to the SE.
summary: Closes a channel to the secure element. Use it to end a secure card session when you are done.

name: isBasicChannel
description: Checks whether this channel is the basic channel.
summary: Checks whether a channel to a secure element is the basic channel. Use it to tell the basic channel apart from a logical channel before sending commands.

name: isClosed
description: Checks if this channel is closed.
summary: Checks whether a channel to a secure element has been closed. Use it to confirm a channel is no longer open before reusing or reopening it.

name: getSelectResponse
description: Returns the data as received from the application select command, including the status word received
summary: Returns the data from the application select command, including the status word. Use it to check the result of selecting an applet on a secure element.

name: transmit
description: Transmit an APDU command (as per ISO/IEC 7816) to the SE.
summary: Sends an APDU command to a secure element and returns the response bytes. Use it to talk to a smart card or secure element, such as reading card data.

name: onGetResourceId
description: Callback to get the resource ID of the crypto extension.
summary: Gets the resource ID of the crypto extension. Use it to find out which resource the external crypto provider is bound to.

name: onOpenResource
description: Callback to be called to open the resource handle before crypto operations.
summary: Opens a handle to an external crypto resource before any crypto work is done. Use it to connect to a USB key or similar device so keys and certificates can be used.

name: onCloseResource
description: Callback to be called to close the resource handle.
summary: Closes a resource handle. Use it to release a security key or crypto resource when you are done with it.

name: onGetProperty
params: handle: string, propertyId: string, params: Array<huksExternalCrypto.HuksExternalCryptoParam> | HuksCryptoExtensionParam[]
description: Callback to be called to do general get operations of the provider.
summary: Reads a named property from an external crypto provider. Use it to look up provider details such as key attributes or device information.

name: onSetProperty
params: handle: string, propertyId: string, params: HuksCryptoExtensionParam[]

summary: Sets a property on an external crypto resource, such as a method or setting. Use it to configure a USB key or token before using it for signing or authentication.

name: onAuthUkeyPin
description: Callback to be called to verify PIN of the provider handle.
summary: Verifies the PIN for a provider handle. Use it to check a user's PIN before allowing access to a security key.

name: onGetUkeyPinAuthState
description: Callback to get the PIN auth state of the provider handle.
summary: Checks whether the PIN of a connected USB key has been verified. Use it to see if the user still needs to enter their PIN before a signing or login step.

name: onClearUkeyPinAuthState
description: Callback to clear the PIN auth state of the provider handle.
summary: Clears the PIN authentication state for a provider handle. Use it to log out or reset PIN verification for a security key.

name: onInitSession
description: Callback to do the initialize operation.
summary: Starts a crypto session on an opened resource handle. Use it to begin an encryption, decryption, or signing operation with an external key.

name: onUpdateSession
description: Callback to do update operation.
summary: Continues an ongoing cryptographic operation started for an external crypto extension. Used to keep processing data in a secure key operation.

name: onFinishSession
description: Callback to do the finish operation.
summary: Finishes an ongoing crypto session started earlier. Use it to wrap up a signing or encryption operation once the data has been processed.

name: onExportCertificate
description: Callback to export certificates specified by the resource id.
summary: Exports a certificate identified by a resource id. Use it to hand out a certificate stored in an external crypto provider.

name: onImportCertificate
params: handle: string, params: HuksCryptoExtensionParam[], certInfo: HuksCryptoExtensionCertInfo
description: Callback to import a certificate specified by the resource handle.
summary: Imports a certificate into the external crypto resource identified by a handle. Use it to load a user's certificate so it can be used for signing or authentication.

name: onEnumCertificates
description: Callback to list all certificates of the provider.
summary: Lists all certificates of the provider. Use it to show or select the certificates available on a security key.

name: onGenerateKeyItem
description: Callback to generate a key pair specified by the resource handle.
summary: Generates a key pair identified by a resource handle. Use it to create a new key pair in an external crypto provider.

name: onExportKeyItem
description: Callback to export the public key specified by the resource handle.
summary: Exports the public key identified by a resource handle. Use it to share or hand over a public key from an external crypto provider.

name: onImportWrappedKeyItem
params: handle: string, wrappingHandle: string, params: HuksCryptoExtensionParam[], wrappedKey: Uint8Array
description: Callback to import the wrapped key pair specified by the resource handle.
summary: Imports a wrapped key pair, unwrapping it with another key held by the resource. Use it to bring a protected key into the device so it can be used for encryption or signing.

name: add

name: updateAsUser

name: batchUpdate
description: Updates assets in batches based on an attributes array.
summary: Updates several stored secrets, such as passwords or tokens, at once. Use it to change many saved passwords or tokens in one go.

name: updateSync
description: Updates an asset. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Changes an existing stored sensitive item, such as its password value or custom data, finishing before returning. Use it to replace an old saved password with a new one right away.

name: preQuery

summary: Starts a secret lookup that needs the user to authenticate first, giving a challenge value for that authentication. Use it to begin reading a saved password or token that is protected by user verification.

summary: Prepares to look up a stored password or token for a specific user when authentication is needed. Use it before asking the user to verify themselves, then continue the lookup afterwards.

summary: Gets the list of apps authorized to use a user's public certificate. Used by certificate management apps to see which apps may use that certificate.

summary: Gets the details of a system app's certificate. Used by certificate management apps to view a system app certificate's details.

summary: Opens the PIN entry dialog for a USB key credential so the user can authorize it. Use it to unlock the USB key credential for signing and encryption.

name: supportsCACertDialog

summary: Checks whether the device supports opening the CA certificate management dialogs. Use it to know if certificate install, uninstall, and detail dialogs can be shown.

name: clearMem

summary: Clears the private key data from memory. Use it to remove sensitive key material when you are finished with it.

name: getAsyKeySpec

summary: Gets a parameter of the private key, such as its size or curve. Use it to inspect details of a key you are working with.

summary: Gets the private key data in DER encoding for a chosen key format. Use it to export a private key so it can be stored or shared.

name: getPubKey

summary: Gets the matching public key from a private key. Use it to share the public key that pairs with your private key.

name: getPubKeySync

name: getKeyData

name: getKeyDataSync

name: getAsyKeySpec

name: getKeyData

name: getKeyDataSync
description: Obtains the public key data based on the specified key data type. This API returns the result synchronously.

name: generateRandom

name: generateRandomSync
description: Generates a random number of the specified length. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Creates a random number of a given length in bytes. Use it to make random values such as keys, tokens, or seeds.

description: Sets a seed.

summary: Turns on the hardware entropy source so random numbers come from secure hardware. Use it when you need stronger random values, such as for keys or passwords.

summary: Creates a random number generator instance. Use it to generate random values for security tasks such as creating keys or tokens.

name: generateKeyPair
description: Generates a random key pair using this asymmetric key generator. This API uses a promise to return the result.

name: generateKeyPairSync
description: Generates a random key pair using this asymmetric key generator. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Creates a new random public and private key pair right away. Use it to set up secure sign-in, encrypted messages, or protected data storage.

name: convertKey

name: convertKeySync
params: pubKey: DataBlob | null, priKey: DataBlob | null

params: pubKey: string | null, priKey: string | null

name: convertPemKeySync
params: pubKey: string | null, priKey: string | null
description: Converts data into an asymmetric key pair. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Turns public and private key text into a usable key pair right away, and can unlock a password-protected private key. Use it to load saved keys for secure sign-in or encrypted messages.

name: generateSymKey

name: generateSymKeySync

summary: Creates a random symmetric key for encryption or decryption. Use it to make a fresh secret key when setting up secure data protection.

name: convertKey
description: Converts specified data into a symmetric key. This API uses a promise to return the result.

name: convertKeySync
description: Converts specified data into a symmetric key.
summary: Turns given binary data into a symmetric key, returning it directly. Use it to load an existing key from raw bytes when you need the result right away.

name: createSymKeyGenerator
description: Creates a symmetric key generator instance with the specified algorithm.
summary: Creates a generator for symmetric keys using a chosen algorithm. Use it to make secret keys for encrypting and decrypting data.

description: Initializes the MAC computation using a symmetric key. This API returns the result synchronously. **initSync**,
summary: Starts a message authentication code calculation with a symmetric key, returning immediately. Use it as the first step to check that data is authentic and unaltered.

name: update
description: Updates the MAC status. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Adds more data to an ongoing message authentication code calculation. Use it to feed in each piece of data whose authenticity you want to check.

name: updateSync
description: Updates the MAC status. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Adds more data to an ongoing message authentication code calculation, returning immediately. Use it to feed in each piece of data whose authenticity you want to check.

summary: Finishes a message authentication code calculation and gives the result. Use it to check that a message has not been tampered with.

name: doFinalSync
description: Finishes the MAC computation. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Finishes a message authentication code calculation and returns the result right away. Use it to check that a message has not been tampered with.

name: getMacLength
description: Obtains the MAC length, in bytes.
summary: Gets the length in bytes of a message authentication code. Use it to find out how many bytes the MAC result will take.

name: createMac
description: Creates a **Mac** instance.
summary: Creates a tool that computes a message authentication code to check data integrity and authenticity. Use it to verify a message has not been tampered with.

name: update
description: Updates the message digest status. This API uses a promise to return the result. **update** must be used with

name: updateSync
description: Updates the message digest status. This API returns the result synchronously. **updateSync** must be used with
summary: Adds more data to the message digest calculation and waits until done. Use it to feed in data piece by piece before generating the digest.

name: digestSync

name: getMdLength

name: createMd

summary: Creates a tool that computes a message digest, a short fingerprint of data. Use it to check whether a file or message has changed.

summary: Sets up an encryption or decryption operation with a mode, key, and parameters. Use it to prepare a cipher before encrypting or decrypting data.

name: updateSync
description: Updates the data to encrypt or decrypt by segment.

summary: Finishes an encryption or decryption operation and returns the encrypted or decrypted data. Use it to lock or unlock a file or message in one step.

name: doFinalSync
description: Finishes the crypto operation, encrypts or decrypts the input data, and then feeds back the output data.
summary: Finishes an encryption or decryption operation and returns the encrypted or decrypted data. Use it to encrypt or decrypt a small amount of data in one go.

name: setCipherSpec

summary: Sets a cipher specification value, such as an RSA parameter. Use it to configure a cipher before encrypting or decrypting.

name: createCipher
description: Creates a **Cipher** instance.

name: initSync

name: update
description: Updates data to be signed. This API uses a promise to return the result.

name: updateSync
description: Updates data to be signed. This API returns the result synchronously.
summary: Adds more data to be signed later, returning right away. Use it to feed in a large message piece by piece before creating its digital signature.

name: signSync
description: Signs the data. This API returns the result synchronously.

name: setSignSpec
description: Sets signing specifications. You can use this API to set signing parameters that cannot be set by
summary: Sets extra signing options that cannot be chosen when the signing operation is created, for RSA and SM2 keys. Use it to fine-tune how a digital signature is produced.

name: getSignSpec
description: Obtains signing specifications. Currently, only RSA is supported.

name: initSync

name: update

name: updateSync
description: Updates the data for signature verification. This API returns the result synchronously.

name: verify
description: Verifies the message, including the update data. This API uses a promise to return the result.

name: verifySync
description: Verifies the signature. This API returns the verification result synchronously.
summary: Checks right away whether a signature matches the data and is valid. Use it to confirm a message or file really came from the claimed sender.

name: recover

summary: Recovers the original data from a signature. Use it to get back the signed content when checking that a message is authentic.

name: recoverSync
description: Recovers the original data from a signature. This API returns the result synchronously.

name: setVerifySpec

summary: Sets a signature verification setting, such as an RSA or SM2 parameter. Use it to match the options used when a signature was created so it can be verified.

name: getVerifySpec

name: createSign

summary: Creates a signer instance for a chosen signing algorithm. Use it to digitally sign data so others can confirm it came from you.

name: createVerify
description: Creates a **Verify** instance.

summary: Registers a callback so a task can receive and process data sent from a worker thread. Use it to handle results or messages coming back from background work.

summary: Adds a task to a queue that runs tasks one after another. Use it to run jobs in order, one at a time.

summary: Runs a task after a set delay and returns its result. Use it to schedule background work to start later.

summary: Cancels a task in the task pool so a queued task will not run. Use it to stop a background job you no longer need.

name: getTaskPoolInfo

summary: Stops a long-running continuous task in the task pool. Use it to end a background task once its work is done and free the thread.

name: dial

name: hasCall

name: hasCallSync

name: getCallState

name: getCallStateSync

summary: Formats a phone number into spaced groups following the Chinese telephone plan. Use it to display a number in a readable form.

name: formatPhoneNumberToE164

name: combineConference

name: getCallIdListForConference

name: stopDTMF

name: postDialProceed

name: offRttModifyInd

name: replace

summary: Swaps out a class method so only the new function runs, and its return value is the result. Use it to change what an existing method does without editing its code.

summary: Decodes part of a binary stream into text, holding back incomplete characters for the next call. Use it to turn chunks of bytes into readable text as they arrive.

summary: Turns multithreading detection on or off, adding multithreading details to crash files when on. Use it to diagnose crashes caused by multithreading problems.

summary: Turns tracking of native references and global handles on or off, so heap snapshots show native reference addresses. Use it to trace native references when investigating memory issues.

summary: Releases a paused stream and flushes any buffered data to its destination. Use it after corking to resume writing and send the held data on its way.

summary: Restarts a readable stream that was explicitly paused, so data flows again. Use it to continue reading from a file or network source after pausing.

summary: Checks whether a readable stream is paused. Use it to tell if reading from a file or network socket has been paused and not yet resumed.

name: pipe

name: vibrate
description: Triggers vibration based on a specified duration. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Makes the device vibrate for a set length of time in milliseconds. Use it to buzz the phone for an alert or notification.

name: startVibration

name: stopVibration

summary: Checks whether a given vibration effect ID is supported. Use it to confirm a preset vibration pattern can be played before making the phone buzz.

summary: Checks whether a preset vibration effect is supported. Use it to confirm a vibration pattern can be played before making the phone buzz.

summary: Gets details of a preset vibration effect by its ID to check whether the device supports it. Use it to find out if a particular vibration pattern can be played before trying to buzz.

name: stop
description: Stops vibration in the specified mode. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Stops the device vibration that is currently running in the given mode. Use it to stop a buzz or vibration that is already going.

name: isHdHapticSupported

name: getMinWidth

name: getMinWidthSync

name: getImage

name: onWallpaperChange

summary: Gets the data stream produced by a web page as bytes. Use it to save or share the generated PDF file.

name: saveCookieAsync

name: isCookieAllowed

name: putAcceptCookieEnabled

name: isThirdPartyCookieAllowed

name: putAcceptThirdPartyCookieEnabled

summary: Turns sending and accepting third-party cookies on or off for the current instance. Use it to allow or block cookies from other sites while browsing.

name: existCookie

summary: Checks whether any cookies are stored, optionally in incognito mode. Use it to see if a site has saved cookies before relying on them.

name: deleteEntireCookie

name: clearAllCookiesSync
description: Remove all cookies.
summary: Removes all stored web cookies. Use it to wipe saved login or site data so browsing starts fresh.

name: clearAllCookies

name: deleteSessionCookie

name: clearSessionCookieSync

name: clearSessionCookie
description: Delete the session cookies Asynchronously.

summary: Delays starting the web engine until a web page is opened or it is started on demand. Use it to avoid the web engine starting up too early and slowing things down.

name: fetchAllCookies
description: Fetches all stored cookies asynchronously.
summary: Fetches all stored cookies, optionally from incognito mode. Use it to read every saved cookie for a site or browsing session.

name: getType

summary: Tells you what kind of value a web message holds, such as text, number, or array. Use it to check a message's type before reading it.

name: getString

name: getNumber

summary: Reads the number value out of a message received from a web page. Use it when a web page sends a number and you need to read it in your app.

name: getBoolean
description: Get the boolean value of the web message.
summary: Reads the true-or-false value out of a message received from a web page. Use it when a web page sends a yes-or-no setting and you need to read it.

name: getArrayBuffer
description: Get the array buffer value of the web message.
summary: Reads the raw binary data out of a message received from a web page. Use it to get binary content such as a file or image sent from a web page.

name: getArray
description: Get the array value of the web message.
summary: Reads the array value out of a message received from a web page. Use it when a web page sends a list of values and you need to read them in your app.

name: getError
description: Get the error value of the web message.
summary: Reads the error value out of a message received from a web page. Use it when a web page sends an error and you need to read its details.

name: setType
description: Set the type of the web message.
summary: Sets what kind of data a web message holds. Use it to label a message as text, number, or other type before sending it.

name: setString
description: Set the string value of the web message.
summary: Stores a text value in a web message. Use it to send or receive words and text between a web page and the app.

name: setNumber
description: Set the number value of the web message.
summary: Sets a web message to hold a number. Use it to send a numeric value through a web message port.

name: setBoolean
description: Set the boolean value of the web message.
summary: Sets a web message to hold a true or false value. Use it to send a yes/no flag through a web message port.

name: setArrayBuffer
description: Set the array buffer value of the web message.
summary: Sets a web message to hold raw binary data. Use it to send binary data such as a file or image through a web message port.

name: setArray
description: Set the array value of the web message.
summary: Sets a web message to hold an array of strings, numbers, or booleans. Use it to send a list of values through a web message port.

name: setError
description: Set the error value of the web message.
summary: Sets a web message to hold an error. Use it to send error details through a web message port.

name: close
description: Close port.
summary: Closes a web message port so no more messages can pass through it. Use it to shut down a chat or data channel when you are done.

name: postMessageEvent
description: Post a message to other port.

name: onMessageEvent

name: postMessageEventExt
