summary: Sends a message from one web message port to the other. Use it to pass data between two connected ports in a web page.

name: onMessageEventExt
description: Receive message from other port.
summary: Listens for messages arriving from another port. Use it to receive typed data sent from a web page.

name: getItemAtIndex
description: Get history entry at given index.
summary: Gets the history entry at a given index in the back and forward list. Use it to look up a page you visited earlier or later.

name: getType
description: Get the type of the JavaScript code execution result.
summary: Gets the type of the result produced by running JavaScript code. Use it to check what kind of value a script returned.

name: getString
description: Get the string value of the JavaScript code execution result.
summary: Gets the text value produced by running JavaScript code. Use it when a script returns a string you need to read.

name: getNumber
description: Get the number value of the JavaScript code execution result.
summary: Gets the numeric value produced by running JavaScript code. Use it when a script returns a number you need to read.

name: getBoolean
description: Get the boolean value of the JavaScript code execution result.
summary: Gets the true or false value from a JavaScript code execution result. Use it to read a yes/no result returned by JavaScript.

name: getArrayBuffer
description: Get the array buffer value of the JavaScript code execution result.
summary: Gets the raw binary buffer value from a JavaScript code execution result. Use it to read binary data returned by JavaScript.

name: getArray
description: Get the array value of the the JavaScript code execution result.
summary: Gets the array value from a JavaScript code execution result. Use it to read a list of values returned by JavaScript.

name: getErrorDescription
description: Get the object or exception of the the JavaScript code execution result and serialize it into a string.
summary: Gets the error or object result of running JavaScript code as a text string. Use it to show why a script failed or what object it returned.

name: initializeWebEngine
description: Loads the dynamic link library (DLL) file of the web engine. This API can be called before
summary: Loads the web engine's dynamic library early so web pages start faster, and pre-connects to frequently visited sites. Use it to speed up web page startup in your app.

name: setActiveWebEngineVersion
description: Sets the ArkWeb kernel version. If the system does not support the specified version, the setting is invalid.
summary: Sets which web engine version is used, before any web page is loaded. Use it to choose the engine version for displaying web content.

name: getActiveWebEngineVersion
description: Obtains the current ArkWeb kernel version.
summary: Tells you which web engine version is currently in use. Use it to check the engine version for compatibility or troubleshooting.

name: isActiveWebEngineEvergreen
description: Checks whether the system is using the evergreen kernel, that is, the latest kernel.
summary: Checks whether the system is using the latest web engine kernel. Use it to find out if the newest web engine is active.

name: setHttpDns
description: Set web engine to use HttpDns server to resolve dns.
summary: Makes the web engine resolve domain names through an HttpDns server. Use it to look up web addresses through a chosen secure DNS service.

name: setWebDebuggingAccess
description: Sets whether to enable web debugging. By default, web debugging is disabled.
summary: Turns web debugging on or off for a web page, letting you inspect and change the page's internal state. Use it to debug web content during development, not in released apps.

name: enableSafeBrowsing
description: Enable the ability to check website security risks.
summary: Turns on checking of website security risks to warn about illegal or fraudulent sites. Use it to stay safe from dangerous websites.

name: isSafeBrowsingEnabled
description: Get whether checking website security risks is enabled.
summary: Tells whether website security risk checking is turned on. Use it to check if unsafe sites are being flagged.

name: accessForward
description: Checks whether the web page can go forward.
summary: Tells you whether the web page can go forward to a later page. Use it to decide if a forward button should be shown or enabled.

name: accessBackward
description: Checks whether the web page can go back.
summary: Tells you whether the web page can go back to a previous page. Use it to decide if a back button should be shown or enabled.

name: accessStep
description: Checks whether the web page can go back or forward the given number of steps.
summary: Tells you whether the web page can move back or forward by a given number of steps. Use it to check history navigation before jumping several pages.

name: forward
description: Goes forward in the history of the web page.
summary: Moves forward to the next page in the browsing history. Use it for a forward button to return to a page you went back from.

name: backward
description: Goes back in the history of the web page.
summary: Goes back to the previous page in the web page history. Use it for a back button in a browser or app.

name: clearHistory
description: Clears the history in the Web.
summary: Clears the browsing history in the web page. Use it to remove the list of previously visited pages.

name: onActive
description: Called when the Web component enters the active state. The application can interact with
summary: Runs when the web page becomes active and the user can interact with it. Use it to resume things like animations when the page comes back into focus.

name: onInactive
description: Called when the Web component enters the inactive state. You can implement the behavior to perform
summary: Runs when the web page becomes inactive and loses focus. Use it to pause things like animations and location updates when the page is no longer in front.

name: refresh
description: Refreshes the current URL.
summary: Reloads the currently displayed page. Use it to refresh a web page the user is viewing.

name: loadData
params: data: string, mimeType: string, encoding: string, baseUrl?: string, historyUrl?: string
description: Loads the data or URL.
summary: Loads page content from a string of data instead of a web address. Use it to show a page built from text or HTML you already have.

name: loadUrl
description: Loads the data or URL.
summary: Loads a web page from a given address. Use it to open a website or link in the browser view.

name: getHitTest
description: Obtains the element type of the area being clicked.
summary: Tells you what kind of element is under a click on a web page, such as a link or image. Use it to find out what was tapped before deciding what to do.

name: storeWebArchive
description: Stores the current page as a web archive.
summary: Stores the current page as a web archive for offline use. Use it to save a web page so it can be viewed later without a connection.

name: zoom
description: Zooms in or out of this web page. This API is effective only when
summary: Zooms a web page in or out by a given ratio. Use it to make page content bigger or smaller.

name: zoomIn
description: Zooms in on this web page by 25%.
summary: Zooms in on a web page by 25 percent. Use it to make page content bigger.

name: zoomOut
description: Zooms out of this web page by 20%.
summary: Zooms out of a web page by 20 percent. Use it to make page content smaller.

name: getHitTestValue
description: Obtains the element information of the area being clicked.
summary: Gives details about the element under a click on a web page. Use it to inspect what was tapped, such as a link address or image.

name: getWebId
description: Obtains the index value of this Web component, which can be used for **Web** component management.
summary: Gets the index number of this web component. Use it to tell web components apart when managing several of them.

name: getUserAgent
description: Gets the default user agent.
summary: Gets the default user agent text that identifies the browser. Use it to see what browser identity is being sent to websites.

name: getTitle
description: Gets the title of current Web page.
summary: Gets the title of the page currently open. Use it to show the page name in a tab, window header, or history list.

name: getPageHeight

summary: Gets the height of the current web page in vp. Use it to measure how tall a page is, for example to size a container or scroll area.

name: backOrForward

name: requestFocus

summary: Gives focus to the web page. Use it to make the web page the active element that receives input.

name: createWebMessagePorts

summary: Creates a pair of message ports for sending messages between the app and a web page. Use it to set up two-way communication with content shown in a web page.

summary: Sends a message with data and ports to a web page at a given address. Use it to pass data between the app and a web page.

name: stop
description: Stops the current load.

name: deleteJavaScriptRegister
description: Deletes a registered JavaScript object with given name.
summary: Removes a previously registered JavaScript object by name. Use it to stop a web page from calling an object you had exposed to it.

name: searchAllAsync

summary: Searches the web page for the keyword you type and highlights every match on the page. Use it to find where a word appears on a page.

name: searchNext
description: Highlights and scrolls to the next match search.
summary: Highlights and scrolls to the next match of a search on the web page. Use it to jump to the next place your search word appears.

name: clearSslCache
description: Clears the ssl cache in the Web.
summary: Clears the stored SSL certificate cache for web content. Use it to remove saved secure-connection data.

name: clearClientAuthenticationCache
description: Clears the client authentication certificate cache in the Web.
summary: Clears the client authentication certificate cache in the web page. Use it to forget saved client certificates used for secure site login.

name: runJavaScript

summary: Runs JavaScript code in the currently displayed web page and returns the result. Use it to read or change what a web page shows from your app.

name: runJavaScriptExt
description: Execute JavaScript code in the context of the currently displayed page, and return the result.
summary: Runs JavaScript code in the currently displayed web page and returns the result. Use it to read or change what a web page shows from your app.

name: getUrl

name: pageUp

name: pageDown
description: Scrolls the page down by half the viewport or jumps to the bottom of the page.

name: getOriginalUrl
description: Gets the original url of current Web page.

name: getFavicon
description: Gets the favicon of current Web page.
summary: Gets the favicon image of the current web page. Use it to show a site's small icon, such as in a tab or bookmark list.

summary: Sets the network state reported to a web page, which controls its online status. Use it to tell a web page whether the device is online or offline.

name: getBackForwardEntries

summary: Gives the list of pages you can go back or forward to in the current web view. Use it to show browsing history or enable back and forward navigation.

summary: Removes all web resource cache for every web view in the app. Use it to free up storage space or clear stale web content.

name: scrollBy

summary: Scrolls the web page by a given amount, optionally over a set time. Use it to move the page sideways or up and down.

name: slideScroll

summary: Scrolls the page as if sliding it at a given speed and direction. Use it to flick or swipe the page up, down, left, or right.

name: serializeWebState

name: restoreWebState

summary: Restores a web page's browsing history from previously saved data. Use it to bring back where someone was on a page after reopening it.

name: customizeSchemes

summary: Lets the web engine load and fetch custom protocol URLs, including cross-domain requests. Use it to make links and requests using your own URL scheme work inside a web page.

name: getCertificate
description: Get certificate for the current website.
summary: Gets the security certificate for the website currently shown. Use it to check a site's certificate, for example to show whether a connection is secure.

name: setAudioMuted

summary: Mutes or unmutes the sound of the web page. Use it to silence audio playing on a web page.

name: prefetchPage
description: Prefetch the resources required by the page, but will not execute js or render the page.

name: prepareForPageLoad

summary: Pre-resolves or pre-connects to a URL before it is loaded. Use it to make a page open faster by setting up the connection in advance.

name: setCustomUserAgent
description: Set custom user agent.
summary: Sets a custom user agent string for the web page. Use it to make a site see your app as a particular browser or device.

name: getCustomUserAgent

name: setConnectionTimeout

summary: Sets how many seconds the web engine waits when opening a network connection, 30 by default. Use it to control how long a page waits before giving up on connecting.

name: setDownloadDelegate

summary: Sets a delegate that reports the progress of downloads started from a web page. Use it to track or show progress when a user downloads a file from a web page.

name: startDownload

name: postUrl

name: createWebPrintDocumentAdapter

name: getSecurityLevel

name: isIncognitoMode

name: setScrollable

summary: Turns scrolling of a web page on or off, optionally for a chosen scrolling type. Use it to stop a page from scrolling, or to allow it again.

name: getScrollable
description: Obtains whether this web page is scrollable.
summary: Tells you whether the current web page can be scrolled. Use it to check if a page scrolls before letting the user swipe or drag it.

name: setPrintBackground

summary: Chooses whether a web page's background is included when the page is printed. Use it when printing a web page and you want its background colours or images to appear on paper.

name: getPrintBackground

summary: Tells whether the web page background is printed. Use it to check if background colors and images will appear when printing a page.

name: getLastJavascriptProxyCallingFrameUrl

summary: Turns on camera capture for the current web page. Use it when a web page needs to take a photo or video.

name: closeCamera

name: getLastPostMessageURL

name: resumeAllMedia

name: pauseAllMedia

summary: Pauses all audio and video playing on a web page. Use it to stop a video or song playing in a web view.

name: closeAllMediaPresentations

summary: Closes every full-screen video playing on a web page. Use it to exit full-screen video playback.

name: getMediaPlaybackState

name: clearWebSchemeHandler

name: setServiceWorkerWebSchemeHandler

name: clearServiceWorkerWebSchemeHandler

name: isIntelligentTrackingPreventionEnabled

summary: Lets listed hosts skip intelligent tracking prevention. Use it to allow certain sites to keep working when tracking prevention blocks them.

name: removeIntelligentTrackingPreventionBypassingList
description: Remove bypassing hosts for Intelligent Tracking Prevention.

name: clearIntelligentTrackingPreventionBypassingList

summary: Clears the list of hosts that bypass intelligent tracking prevention. Use it to stop exempting those sites from tracking prevention.

name: getDefaultUserAgent
description: Get the default user agent.
summary: Gets the default user agent string. Use it to see the standard browser identity sent to websites.

name: onCreateNativeMediaPlayer
description: Called when the
summary: Runs when a media file is played on the web page and the app has taken over media playback. Use it to play a song or video from a web page with your own player.

name: enableWholeWebPageDrawing
description: Enables the full drawing capability for the web page. This API works only during **Web** component
summary: Turns on full drawing for the web page, so the whole page is rendered. Use it when setting up a web view and you want the complete page drawn.

name: webPageSnapshot
description: Obtains the full drawing result of the web page.
summary: Captures the full drawing result of a web page. Use it to take a picture of what a page currently shows.

name: prefetchResource

description: Prefetches resource requests based on specified request information and additional HTTP request headers, saves
summary: Fetches and caches a POST request's response in memory with a chosen cache key and validity period. Use it to make a form submission or other POST request load faster.

name: clearPrefetchedResource
description: Clears the cache of prefetched resources based on the specified cache key list. The cache key in the input
summary: Deletes cached prefetched resources by their cache keys. Use it to free up space taken by pages or files fetched ahead of time.

name: setRenderProcessMode
description: Sets the ArkWeb render subprocess mode.
summary: Sets how web page rendering is split across processes, either a single process or multiple processes. Use it to control how web content is rendered on the device.

name: getRenderProcessMode
description: Obtains the ArkWeb render subprocess mode.
summary: Gets the rendering subprocess mode of the web engine on this device. Use it to check whether pages run in a single or multiple subprocess mode.

name: terminateRenderProcess
description: Terminates this render process.
summary: Terminates the render process for the web page. Use it to force-stop a page that is stuck or misbehaving.

name: precompileJavaScript
params: url: string, script: string | Uint8Array, cacheOptions: CacheOptions
description: Precompiles JavaScript to generate the bytecode cache or update the existing bytecode cache based on the provided
summary: Precompiles a local JavaScript file into a bytecode cache, or updates the existing cache, so the script loads faster. Use it to speed up loading of scripts a web page fetches from a server.

name: setHostIP
params: hostName: string, address: string, aliveTime: number
description: Set IP address for host name.
summary: Sets the IP address to use for a host name, with a validity time for the cached result. Use it to make a web page reach a server by a fixed address instead of looking it up.

name: clearHostIP
description: Clear the host name IP address.
summary: Clears the stored IP address for a given host name. Use it to forget a saved host address so it is looked up again.

name: warmupServiceWorker
description: Warmup the registered service worker associated the url.
summary: Prepares the service worker registered for a web address ahead of time. Use it to make a web page load faster when opened later.

name: injectOfflineResources
description: Injects local offline resources to the memory cache to improve the initial page startup speed.
summary: Injects local offline resources into the memory cache so web pages load faster the first time. Use it to speed up page startup with saved files.

name: enableAdsBlock
description: Enable the ability to block Ads, disabled by default.
summary: Turns ad blocking on or off for web pages. Use it to stop ads from showing while browsing.

name: isAdsBlockEnabled
description: Get whether Ads block is enabled.
summary: Checks whether ad blocking is turned on. Use it to see if ads are being blocked.

name: isAdsBlockEnabledForCurPage
description: Get whether Ads block is enabled for current Webpage.
summary: Checks whether ad blocking is turned on for the current web page. Use it to see if ads are blocked on the page you are viewing.

name: getSurfaceId
description: Obtains the ID of the surface corresponding to ArkWeb. The ID can be used to capture a screenshot of the web
summary: Gives the ID of the surface used by the web content, which can be used to capture a screenshot of the page. Use it to take a picture of what is shown on the web page.

name: setUrlTrustList
description: Set the URL trust list for the ArkWeb.
summary: Restricts a web page so it can only open addresses on a list you provide. Use it to keep browsing limited to trusted sites.

name: setPathAllowingUniversalAccess
description: Sets a path list. When a file protocol accesses resources in the path list, it can access the local files across
summary: Sets which local folders a web page may reach across domains through file links. Use it to let a web page open local files from chosen folders.

name: trimMemoryByPressureLevel
description: Trim memory by different memory pressure level.
summary: Frees up memory used by a web page according to a chosen memory pressure level. Use it to reduce memory when the device is running low.

name: enableBackForwardCache
description: Enable the BackForwardCache and indicate features that are allowed to enter BackForwardCache.
summary: Lets pages be cached so going back or forward is faster, and chooses which pages may be cached. Use it to speed up returning to a previous page.

name: setBackForwardCacheOptions
description: Configure the BackForwardCache.
summary: Sets the options for caching pages you navigate back or forward to. Use it so going back to a previous page loads quickly.

name: getScrollOffset
description: Obtains the current scrolling offset (including the over-scrolling offset) of the web page.
summary: Gets how far the web page has been scrolled, including over-scroll. Use it to find the current scroll position of a page.

name: scrollByWithResult
description: Scrolls the page by the specified amount and returns value to indicate whether the scrolling is successful.
summary: Scrolls the web page by a given amount and reports whether scrolling succeeded. Use it to move the page and check if it could scroll.

name: getLastHitTest
description: Obtains the element information of the area being clicked last time.
summary: Gives details about the element that was clicked last time on a web page. Use it to look back at what was tapped previously.

name: getPageOffset
description: Obtains the current scrolling offset of the web page (excluding the over-scrolling offset).
summary: Gets how far the web page has been scrolled, not counting over-scroll. Use it to find the current scroll position of a page.

name: setAppCustomUserAgent
description: Set the default User-Agent for the application.
summary: Sets the default User-Agent string the app uses for web pages. Use it to make web pages see your app as a particular browser or device.

name: setUserAgentForHosts
description: Set the User-Agent to be used for specified hosts, with a maximum of 20,000 hosts.
summary: Sets which browser identity string is sent to particular websites. Use it when certain sites must see a specific browser identity.

name: setUserAgentClientHintsEnabled
description: Enable the UserAgent Client Hints.
summary: Turns UserAgent Client Hints on or off for web pages. Use it when a site needs client hint information to show the right content.

name: getUserAgentClientHintsEnabled
description: Get if the UserAgent Client Hints enabled.
summary: Tells whether user agent client hints are turned on. Use it to check if websites receive extra browser details.

name: setUserAgentMetadata
description: Sets the User-Agent metadata corresponding to the User-Agent.
summary: Sets extra browser and device details that go with a chosen browser identity string. Use it to give websites accurate browser and device information.

name: getUserAgentMetadata
description: Get the User-Agent metadata corresponding to the User-Agent.
summary: Gets the user agent metadata that matches a given user agent string. Use it to look up browser details for a specific user agent.

name: getAttachState
description: Get whether webviewController is attached to a web component.
summary: Tells you whether the controller is attached to a web component. Use it to check if the controller is connected before controlling a web page.

name: on
description: Register the callback for controller attach state change.
summary: Listens for changes to whether the web page controller is attached. Use it to react when a web page is attached or detached.

name: off
description: Unregister the callback for controller attach state change.
summary: Stops listening for changes to whether the web page controller is attached. Use it to stop reacting when a web page is attached or detached.

name: waitForAttached
description: Asynchronously waits for the WebViewController to be attached to the Web component. If the attachment is complete or times out,
summary: Waits until the web controller is attached to its web component, or until a timeout. Use it to know when the web view is ready to be controlled.

name: getProgress
description: Gets the loading progress for the current page.
summary: Gets how far the current page has loaded. Use it to show a loading bar or spinner while a page loads.

name: avoidVisibleViewportBottom
description: Sets the bottom avoidance height of the visible viewport on the web page.
summary: Sets how much space at the bottom of the visible web page should be kept clear. Use it to stop page content being hidden behind a bottom bar or keyboard.

name: getBlanklessInfoWithKey
description: Obtains the prediction information about blankless loading (for details, see
summary: Gets prediction details about blankless loading and starts generating the loading transition frame, so an app can decide whether to use it. Use it to avoid a blank screen while a web page loads.

name: setBlanklessLoadingWithKey
description: Sets whether to enable blankless loading. This API must be used together with
summary: Turns smooth loading without blank frames on or off for a page identified by a key. Use it to avoid a blank screen while a page loads.

name: setBlanklessLoadingWithParams
description: Triggers frame interpolation and sets frame interpolation parameters. This API must be used in pair with the
summary: Starts smooth loading without blank frames for a keyed page and sets its parameters. Use it to avoid a blank screen while a page loads.

name: clearBlanklessLoadingCache
description: Clears the blankless loading cache of the page with a specified key value.
summary: Clears the blankless loading cache for a page with a given key. Use it when page content changes a lot and you want to avoid an obvious scene change while loading.

name: setBlanklessLoadingCacheCapacity
description: Sets the persistent cache capacity of the blankless loading solution and returns the value that takes effect. If
summary: Sets how much memory, in megabytes, is kept for smooth page loading without blank frames, and returns the value actually used. Use it to control smooth page transitions.

name: getErrorPageEnabled
description: Get whether default error page feature is enabled.
summary: Tells whether the default error page is turned on. Use it to check if a built-in error page will show when a web page fails to load.

name: setErrorPageEnabled
description: Set whether enable the error page. onOverrideErrorPage will be triggered when the page error.
summary: Turns the default error page on or off for a web page. Use it to show a friendly page when a web page fails to load.

name: getSubframeErrorPageEnabled
description: Get whether default error page feature is enabled for subframes.
summary: Tells you whether the default error page is shown for subframes. Use it to check if embedded page sections display an error page when they fail to load.

name: enablePrivateNetworkAccess
description: After enable PrivateNetworkAccess feature, ArkWeb will send a CORS preflight request before issuing any
summary: Turns checking of private network requests on or off, so pages must get permission before reaching local devices. Use it to control whether a page can access your local network.

name: isPrivateNetworkAccessEnabled
description: Get whether PrivateNetworkAccess is enabled.
summary: Tells whether access to private network addresses is allowed. Use it to check if the page may reach private network resources.

name: setWebDestroyMode
description: Sets the destroy mode of the Web component. The destroy mode of the Web component
summary: Sets when a web page's resources are released, either at the system's chosen time or immediately. Use it to free memory faster when closing a page.

name: setAutoPreconnect
description: Configure whether to enable automatic pre-connection to high-frequency URLs accessed during the application's
summary: Turns automatic pre-connection to frequently visited web addresses on or off after the web engine starts. Use it to make often-used pages open faster.

name: isAutoPreconnectEnabled
description: ‌Retrieve whether the automatic pre-connection feature is enabled‌.
summary: Checks whether automatic pre-connection is turned on. Use it to see if the browser pre-connects to sites for faster loading.

name: setSiteIsolationMode
description: Set the site isolation mode.
summary: Sets the site isolation mode for web content. Use it to choose how strictly web pages from different sites are kept apart.

name: getSiteIsolationMode
description: Queries the currently effective site isolation mode.
summary: Reports which site isolation mode is currently in effect. Use it to check how separate websites are kept apart while browsing.

name: setSocketIdleTimeout
description: Set web engine socket idle timeout.
summary: Sets how long a web page's network connection can stay idle before it is closed, from 30 seconds to 5 minutes. Use it to stop idle connections from hanging around while browsing.

name: setSoftKeyboardBehaviorMode
description: Set the behavior mode of the soft keyboard. If this API is not explicitly called, the system automatically
summary: Chooses how the on-screen keyboard behaves when a web page gains or loses focus. Use it to control when the keyboard pops up or hides while typing in a web page.

name: setScrollbarMode
description: Sets the global scrollbar mode in the web page. When this API is not explicitly called,
summary: Sets how the scroll bar is shown on a web page, such as not always displayed. Use it to control whether a scroll bar is visible while viewing a page.

name: enableAdvancedSecurityMode
description: Enable the application disable some features such as PDFViewer to enhance the security level of web application
summary: Turns on stricter security that disables risky features like the PDF viewer. Use it to make a web page safer to open.

name: resumeMicrophone
description: Resumes microphone capture on the current web page. Before using the microphone , add the
summary: Resumes microphone capture on the current web page. Use it to let a website listen through the microphone again after capture was paused.

name: pauseMicrophone
description: Pauses microphone capture on the current web page.
summary: Pauses microphone capture on the current web page. Use it to stop a web page from listening through the microphone.

name: stopMicrophone
description: Stops microphone capture on the current web page.
summary: Stops microphone capture on the current web page. Use it to turn off the microphone that a web page is using.

name: executeAIPageCommand
description: Asynchronously executes AI page command operations.
summary: Runs an AI page command given as JSON and returns the result. Use it to carry out AI-driven actions on a web page.

name: getGuid
description: Get guid.
summary: Gives the unique identifier of a download. Use it to tell one download apart from another.

name: getCurrentSpeed
description: Get current speed, in bytes per second.
summary: Tells you how fast a download is going, in bytes per second. Use it to show download speed while a file is downloading.

name: getPercentComplete
description: Get percent complete.
summary: Tells how much of a download is finished, as a percentage, or -1 if unknown. Use it to show download progress.

name: getTotalBytes
description: Get total bytes.
summary: Tells you the total size in bytes of a web download, or -1 if the size is unknown. Use it to show download progress or how much is left to download.

name: getState
description: Get state of the web download.
summary: Tells the current state of a web download, such as whether it is running or done. Use it to check a download's status.

name: getLastErrorCode
description: Get last error code of the web download.
summary: Gives the error code from the last failure of a download. Use it to find out why a download did not finish.

name: getMethod
description: Get http method of the web download request.
summary: Gives the HTTP request method used for a download. Use it to see whether the download used GET, POST, or another method.

name: getMimeType
description: Get mime type of the web download.
summary: Gives the file type of a download. Use it to know what kind of file is being downloaded.

name: getUrl
description: Get url of the web download request.
summary: Gives the web address the download came from. Use it to see or record where a downloaded file was fetched from.

name: getSuggestedFileName
description: Get suggested file name of the web download request.
summary: Gets the file name suggested for a web download. Use it to name or save a downloaded file.

name: start
description: Start the web download.
summary: Begins a web download and saves the file to the path you give. Use it to actually download a file to a chosen location.

name: cancel
description: Cancel the web download.
summary: Cancels an ongoing web download. Use it to stop a file download you no longer want.

name: pause
description: Pause the web download.
summary: Pauses a web download that is currently running. Use it to stop a download for now and continue it later.

name: resume
description: Resume the web download.
summary: Continues a web download that was paused. Use it to carry on downloading a file you stopped earlier.

name: getReceivedBytes
description: Get received bytes.
summary: Tells how many bytes of a download have been received so far. Use it to show how much data has downloaded.

name: getFullPath
description: Get full path of the web download.
summary: Gives the full path where a downloaded file is saved. Use it to find or open a file after downloading it.

name: getOriginalUrl
description: Get the original url of the web download.
summary: Gets the original web address a download came from. Use it to see where a downloaded file was fetched from.

name: getReferrerUrl
description: Get the referrer url of the web download.
summary: Gets the referrer web address of a download, the page it was started from. Use it to see which page a download came from.

name: serialize
description: Serialize web download to typed array.
summary: Turns a web download into a block of data that can be saved or passed around. Use it to store a download so it can be restored and continued later.

name: deserialize
description: Deserialize web download from typed array.
summary: Rebuilds a web download item from saved serialized data. Use it to restore a file download task that was stored earlier.

name: onBeforeDownload
description: Callback will be triggered before web download start.
summary: Runs just before a web download starts, giving you the download item. Use it to react when a file download is about to begin.

name: onDownloadUpdated
description: Callback will be triggered when web download is processing.
summary: Runs while a web download is in progress. Use it to track the progress of a file download.

name: onDownloadFinish
description: Callback will be triggered when web download is completed.
summary: Runs when a web download is completed. Use it to know a file download has finished.

name: onDownloadFailed
description: Callback will be triggered when web download is interrupted or canceled.
summary: Runs when a web download is interrupted or canceled. Use it to notice that a file download did not finish.

name: setDownloadDelegate
description: Set a delegate used to receive the progress of the download triggered from WebDownloadManager.
summary: Sets a delegate to receive the progress of downloads triggered from the download manager. Use it to track how a download is going.

name: resumeDownload
description: Resume the canceled or failed download.
summary: Resumes a canceled or failed download. Use it to restart a download that was interrupted or stopped.

name: initialize
description: Initialize data stream.
summary: Prepares the request's data stream so it can be read. Use it before reading or uploading the body data.

name: read
description: Read the data stream to the buffer. Unit: bytes.
summary: Reads a chosen number of bytes from the request's data stream into a buffer. Use it to read the data being uploaded.

name: getSize
description: Get the total size of the data stream. When data is chunked, always return zero. Unit: bytes.
summary: Tells you the total size in bytes of the request's data stream, or zero if the data is sent in chunks. Use it to check how much data is being uploaded.

name: getPosition
description: Get the current position of the data stream. Unit: bytes.
summary: Gets the current position of the data stream in bytes. Use it to check how far through the request body you are.

name: isChunked
description: Whether data stream is chunked.
summary: Tells you whether the request's data stream is sent in chunks. Use it to check how the upload data is being sent.

name: isEof
description: Whether all data stream has been consumed. For chunked uploads,
summary: Tells you whether all the request's data stream has been read. Use it to know when there is no more data to read.

name: isInMemory
description: Returns true if the upload data in the stream is entirely in memory, and all read requests will succeed
summary: Tells you whether the request's upload data is held entirely in memory, so reads finish right away. Use it to check if the data can be read without waiting.

name: getHeader
description: Gets request headers.
summary: Gets the headers sent with a web request. Use it to read details like content type or cookies from an intercepted request.

name: getRequestUrl
description: Gets the request URL.
summary: Gets the web address being requested. Use it to see which resource a page is asking for.

name: getRequestMethod
description: Get request method.
summary: Gets the method of a web request, such as GET or POST. Use it to tell what kind of request was made when intercepting it.

name: getReferrer
description: Get referrer of request.
summary: Gets the referrer of a web request, the page it came from. Use it to see which page a request originated from.

name: isMainFrame
description: Check whether the request is for getting the main frame.
summary: Checks whether a web request is for the main page frame rather than a sub-part. Use it to handle the main page differently from embedded content.

name: hasGesture
description: Check whether the request is associated with gesture.
summary: Checks whether a web request came from a user action like a tap or click. Use it to tell user-triggered requests apart from automatic ones.

name: getHttpBodyStream
description: Get http body stream.
summary: Gets the body data stream of a web request, or nothing if there is no body. Use it to read data sent with a request you intercepted.

name: getRequestResourceType
description: Get request's resource type.
summary: Tells what kind of resource a web request is asking for, such as a page, image, or script. Use it to decide how to handle a request for a web page or its files.

name: getFrameUrl
description: Gets the URL of frame which trigger this request.
summary: Gets the web address of the frame that made the request. Use it to tell which page area asked for a resource.

name: setUrl
description: Set the resolved URL after redirects or changed as a result of HSTS.
summary: Sets the final web address a page ends up at after a redirect or security upgrade. Use it to tell the browser where a request really landed.

name: getUrl
description: Get the resolved URL after redirects or changed as a result of HSTS.
summary: Gets the resolved URL of a web resource response after redirects or HSTS changes. Use it to find where a request finally ended up.

name: setNetErrorCode
description: Set net error code.
summary: Sets the network error code of a web resource response. Use it to report a network failure when a requested resource cannot be delivered.

name: getNetErrorCode
description: Get net error code.
summary: Gets the network error code of a web resource response. Use it to check whether a request failed and why.

name: setStatus
description: Set http status code.
summary: Sets the HTTP status code of a web resource response. Use it to return codes like 200 or 404 for a resource you supply.

name: getStatus
description: Get http status code.
summary: Gets the HTTP status code of a web resource response. Use it to check whether a page or resource loaded successfully.

name: setStatusText
description: Set status text.
summary: Sets the status text of a web resource response. Use it to give the short message that goes with the response status code.

name: getStatusText
description: Get status text.
summary: Gets the HTTP status text of a web resource response. Use it to show the reason phrase for a response status.

name: setMimeType
description: Set mime type.
summary: Sets the MIME type of a web resource response. Use it to tell the browser what kind of file you are returning, such as a page or an image.

name: getMimeType
description: Get mime type.
summary: Gets the MIME type of a web resource response. Use it to find out what kind of content, such as an image or a page, is being returned.

name: setEncoding
description: Set the response encoding.
summary: Sets the encoding of a web resource response. Use it to tell the browser how to read the text of a page you supply.

name: getEncoding
description: Get the response encoding.
summary: Gets the text encoding of a web response. Use it to find out how the response content is encoded.

name: setHeaderByName
params: name: string, value: string, overwrite: boolean
description: Set response hander value by name.
summary: Sets a response header by name, with a value and whether to overwrite an existing one. Use it to add headers like content type to a web response you supply.

name: getHeaderByName
description: Get the header value by name from the response.
summary: Gets the value of a named header from a web response. Use it to read a specific response header, such as the content type.

name: setCustomErrorCode
description: Set the custom error code for the Web response.
summary: Sets a custom error code for a web resource response. Use it to report your own error to the app when a request fails.

name: getCustomErrorCode
description: Get the custom error code of the Web response.
summary: Gets the custom error code set on a web response. Use it to read back a specific error value you assigned to a response.

name: didReceiveResponse
description: Pass response headers to intercepted requests.
summary: Passes response headers to an intercepted request. Use it to supply the headers for a request you intercepted before sending its body.

name: didReceiveResponseBody
description: Pass response body data to intercepted requests.
summary: Passes response body data to an intercepted request. Use it to send the content of a request you intercepted.

name: didFinish
description: Notify that this request should be finished and there is no more data available.
summary: Marks an intercepted request as finished with no more data. Use it to signal that you have sent all the response data for a request you intercepted.

name: didFail
description: Notify that this request should be failed.
summary: Marks an intercepted request as failed with a given error code. Use it to reject a request you intercepted and stop it from loading.

name: onRequestStart
description: Callback for handling the request.
summary: Runs when a request for a chosen scheme begins, letting you intercept it and decide whether to handle it yourself. Use it to catch and take over web requests for a custom scheme.

name: onRequestStop
description: Callback when the request is completed.
summary: Runs when an intercepted request finishes. Use it to know when a request you intercepted is done, so you can clean up or move on.

name: handleStatusChanged
description: Called to notify the ArkWeb engine of the playback status of the player when the playback status changes.
summary: Reports the player's playback status to the web engine when it changes. Use it to reflect whether a video or song is playing, paused, or stopped.

name: handleVolumeChanged
description: Called to notify the ArkWeb engine of the volume of the player when the volume changes.
summary: Reports the player's current volume to the web engine when it changes. Use it to keep the page's volume display in sync with your media player.

name: handleMutedChanged
description: Called to notify the ArkWeb engine of the muted status of the player when the muted status changes.
summary: Tells the web engine whether the player is muted. Use it to report when a song or video is muted or unmuted.

name: handlePlaybackRateChanged
description: Called to notify the ArkWeb engine of the playback rate of the player when the playback rate changes.
summary: Tells the web engine the player's playback speed when it changes. Use it to report when a song or video is sped up or slowed down.

name: handleDurationChanged
description: Called to notify the ArkWeb engine of the total duration of the media.
summary: Reports the total length of the media to the web engine. Use it while playing a song or video so the player knows how long it lasts.

name: handleTimeUpdate
description: Called to notify the ArkWeb engine of the playback progress when the playback progress changes.
summary: Reports the current playback progress to the web engine as it changes. Use it to update the progress bar while playing a video or song.

name: handleBufferedEndTimeChanged
description: Called to notify the ArkWeb engine of the buffer time when the buffer time changes.
summary: Reports how much media is buffered so the web engine knows the buffered time. Use it while playing a song or video to show buffering progress.

name: handleEnded
description: Called to notify the ArkWeb engine that the media playback ends.
summary: Tells the web engine that media playback has finished. Use it to report when a song or video has played to the end.

name: handleNetworkStateChanged
description: Called to notify the ArkWeb engine of the network status of the player when the network status changes.
summary: Tells the web engine the player's network status when it changes. Use it to report when a streaming song or video loses or regains its connection.

name: handleReadyStateChanged
description: Called to notify the ArkWeb engine of the cache status of the player when the cache status changes.
summary: Reports the player's cache status to the web engine whenever it changes. Use it to keep a video or song's buffering state in sync while playing media.

name: handleFullscreenChanged
description: Called to notify the ArkWeb engine of the full screen status of the player when the full screen status changes.
summary: Tells the web engine whether the player is now in full screen. Use it to report when a video switches into or out of full screen.

name: handleSeeking
description: Called to notify the ArkWeb engine that the player enters the seek state.
summary: Tells the web engine that the player has started seeking. Use it to show that a video or song is jumping to a new playback position.

name: handleSeekFinished
description: Called to notify the ArkWeb engine that the seek operation is complete.
summary: Tells the web engine that a seek operation has finished. Use it to confirm that jumping to a new point in a video or song is done.

name: handleError
description: Called to notify the ArkWeb engine that an error occurs with the player.
summary: Tells the web engine that the player hit an error, with the error type and message. Use it to report when a song or video fails to play.

name: handleVideoSizeChanged
description: Called to notify the ArkWeb engine of the video size of the player.
summary: Reports the video's width and height to the web engine. Use it to adjust the display area when a video's size changes.

name: setAdsBlockRules
description: set Ads Block ruleset file, containing easylist rules.
summary: Sets a custom ad blocking rules file using easylist rules, kept after restart. Use it to block ads on web pages with your own rules.

name: addAdsBlockDisallowedList
description: Add items to Ads Block Disallow list.
summary: Adds website domains where ad blocking is turned off. Use it to stop ads being blocked on chosen sites.

name: addAdsBlockAllowedList
description: Add items to Ads Block Allow list.

summary: Moves the main window above another main window in the same application, with child windows following. Use it to bring one main window in front of another.

summary: Maximizes the window to fill the screen. Use it to make a window full size, such as expanding an app window on a large screen.

summary: Restores the main window from full-screen, maximized, or split-screen mode back to a floating window at its previous size and position. Use it to let someone return a full-screen window to a floating one.

name: restore

summary: Brings a minimized main window back to the foreground at its previous size and position. Use it to reopen an app window that was minimized.

name: restoreMainWindow

summary: Brings the main window back to the foreground, or raises it if already there. Use it to return to the main app window from a floating window.

summary: Shows or hides the window's title bar. Use it to hide the title bar for a cleaner, more immersive window.

name: setWindowTitleMoveEnabled

summary: Turns on or off the ability to move a window by dragging its title bar and to maximize it with a double-click. Use it to control whether users can drag the title bar to move or double-click to maximize a window.

summary: Sets the title shown on a window. Use it to give a window a name in its title bar.

name: setSubWindowModal

summary: Sets the height of the window's title bar. Use it to make the title bar taller or shorter on a window that has one.

summary: Gets the height of the window's title bar, in vp. Use it to find out how tall the title bar is.

summary: Gets the style of the buttons in the window's decoration bar, in the top-right corner. Use it to read the current look of the window's close and minimize buttons.

summary: Sets which areas of the window respond to touch, letting touches outside them pass through. Use it to make only part of a window touchable.

name: getTitleButtonRect

summary: Gets the rectangle holding the minimize, maximize, and close buttons on a window's title bar. Use it to find where those title bar buttons are.

summary: Turns on landscape multi-window mode for a horizontally laid out page in the app's main window. Use it to let a page show side-by-side windows when the device is turned sideways.

summary: Frees the memory allocated for a decompression stream set up for callback-based decompression. Use it to clean up after unpacking compressed data.

name: inflateBack
params: strm: ZStream, backIn: InflateBackInputCallback, inDesc: object, backOut: InflateBackOutputCallback, outDesc: object
description: Implements decompression and uses callbacks to process input and output data. This API uses a promise to return
summary: Decompresses data using callbacks to read compressed input and write the decompressed output. Use it to unzip or unpack compressed data streams.

name: inflate
description: Inflates data. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Inflates, or decompresses, data. Use it to unzip or decompress data that was compressed in Zlib, Deflate, or Gzip format.

name: deflateInit
description: Initializes a compression stream with a specified compression level. This API uses a promise to return the
summary: Starts a compression stream at a chosen compression level. Use it to begin zipping data into Zlib, Deflate, or Gzip format.

name: deflateInit2
params: strm: ZStream, level: CompressLevel, method: CompressMethod, windowBits: int, memLevel: MemLevel, strategy: CompressStrategy
description: Initializes a compression stream with the specified compression level, compression method, window size, memory
summary: Starts a compression stream with chosen level, method, window size, memory level, and strategy. Use it to begin zipping data with fine control over the compression format and settings.

name: deflate
description: Deflates data. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Deflates data in a compression stream. Use it to compress data step by step.

name: deflateEnd
description: Releases all dynamically allocated data structs of a decompression stream. This API uses a promise to return the
summary: Releases the memory used by a decompression stream. Use it to clean up after you finish decompressing data.

name: deflateBound
description: Calculates the maximum size of the compressed data. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Calculates the largest possible size of the compressed data for a stream. Use it to reserve enough room before deflating data.

name: deflateSetHeader
description: Provides the header information of a gzip file when **deflateInit2()** requests a gzip stream. This API uses a
summary: Supplies the header information of a gzip file when a gzip stream is requested. Use it to attach gzip header details while compressing data into a gzip file.

name: deflateCopy
description: Copies a compression stream. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Copies a compression stream. Use it to duplicate an existing compression stream so you can keep compressing from the same point.

name: deflateSetDictionary
description: Initializes the compression dictionary from a given sequence of bytes. This API uses a promise to return the
summary: Sets the compression dictionary from a given sequence of bytes. Use it to improve compression by supplying a shared dictionary before compressing data.

name: deflateGetDictionary
description: Obtains the content and length of the decompression dictionary used in a compression stream. This API uses a
summary: Gets the content and length of the decompression dictionary used in a compression stream. Use it when you need the dictionary details while compressing data.

name: deflateTune
params: strm: ZStream, goodLength: int, maxLazy: int, niceLength: int, maxChain: int
description: Fine-tunes the internal compression parameters of **deflate**. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Fine-tunes the internal compression parameters of deflate. Use it to trade compression speed against compression quality when zipping data.

name: deflateReset
description: Equivalent to call the **deflateEnd** API and then the **deflateInit** API. However, this API does not release or
summary: Resets a compression stream to its starting state without freeing its internal state. Use it to reuse an existing zip stream for a new round of compression.

name: deflateResetKeep
description: Resets the initialized compression stream, but retains the compression parameters and dictionaries set by it.
summary: Resets an initialized compression stream while keeping its compression settings and dictionaries. Use it to reuse the same compression setup for new data without starting over.

name: deflatePending
description: Returns the number of bytes and bits of output that has been generated but not yet provided in the available
summary: Reports how many bytes and bits of compressed output are still waiting to be read. Use it to check whether more zipped data is ready to be collected.

name: deflateParams
params: strm: ZStream, level: CompressLevel, strategy: CompressStrategy
description: Dynamically updates the compression level and compression strategy. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Changes the compression level and strategy while compression is running. Use it to adjust how hard data is being zipped without restarting the stream.

name: deflatePrime
params: strm: ZStream, bits: int, value: int
description: Inserts bits and values into the compression stream. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Inserts a number of bits with a given value into the compression stream. Use it to feed raw bits into a zip stream before compressing.

name: gzdopen
description: Associates gzip file with the file descriptor (fd) and opens the file for reading and decompressing, or
summary: Opens a gzip file using a file descriptor for reading and decompressing, or compressing and writing. Use it to unzip or zip a file you already have open.

name: gzbuffer
description: Sets the internal buffer size for the current library function. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Sets the internal buffer size used for compression or decompression. Use it to tune memory use when compressing or decompressing files.

name: gzopen
description: Opens the .gz file in the specified path for reading and decompressing, or compressing and writing. This API uses
summary: Opens a .gz file for reading and decompressing, or compressing and writing. Use it to start working with a gzip file.

name: gzeof
description: Checks whether the position from which data is read has reached the end of the gzip file. This API uses a promise
summary: Checks whether reading has reached the end of a gzip file. Use it to know when you have finished reading all the data from a gzip file.

name: gzdirect
description: Checks whether the specified gzip file handle directly accesses the original uncompressed data and reallocates
summary: Checks whether a gzip file handle reads the original uncompressed data directly and reallocates the buffer. Use it to tell if a gzip file is stored without compression.

name: gzclose
description: Clears all pending output of the file. Closes the file and releases the decompression or compression state if
summary: Flushes pending output, closes the file, and frees compression or decompression state. Use it to finish and close a compressed or decompressed file.

name: gzclearerr
description: Clears the errors and end-of-file flags of a file. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Clears the error and end-of-file flags of a file. Use it to reset a file's status before reading or writing again.

name: gzerror
description: Describes the last error message that reported for the file. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Reports the last error message for a gzip file. Use it to find out what went wrong when working with a gzip file.

name: gzgetc
description: Reads and decompresses a byte from a file. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Reads and decompresses one byte from a compressed file. Use it to read a single character from a gzip file.

name: gzflush
description: Flushes all pending output into a compressed file. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Flushes all pending output into a compressed file. Use it to make sure everything written so far is saved into the gzip file.

name: gzfwrite
params: buf: ArrayBuffer, size: long, nitems: long
description: Compresses data blocks that are declared with size and nitems from the buffer and writes the data blocks to a
summary: Compresses data blocks from a buffer and writes them to a file. Use it to save compressed data to a gzip file.

name: gzfread
params: buf: ArrayBuffer, size: long, nitems: long
description: Decompresses and reads data from a gzip file. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Decompresses and reads data from a gzip file into a buffer. Use it to read the contents of a gzip file while unzipping it.

name: gzclosew
description: Implements the same functions as that of **gzclose()** for writing or appending. This API uses a promise to
summary: Closes a file opened for writing or appending and frees compression state. Use it to finish writing a compressed file.

name: gzcloser
description: Implements the same functions as that of **gzclose()** for reading only. This API uses a promise to return the
summary: Closes a file opened for reading and frees decompression state. Use it to finish reading a compressed file.

name: gzwrite
description: Compresses the uncompressed bytes of the declared length in the buffer and writes them to the file. This API uses
summary: Compresses uncompressed bytes from a buffer and writes them to the file. Use it to save data in compressed form to a gzip file.

name: gzungetc
description: Pushes **c** back into the input stream so that it will be read as the first character the next time the file is
summary: Pushes a character back into the input stream so it is read first next time the file is read. Use it to re-read or peek at a character while processing a compressed file.

name: gztell
description: Returns the start position of the next **gzread** or **gzwrite** in the file. This API uses a promise to return
summary: Tells you the position where the next read or write in the file will happen. Use it to check where you are in a compressed file.

name: gzsetparams
description: Dynamically updates the compression level and compression strategy of a file. This API uses a promise to return
summary: Changes the compression level and strategy of a file while it is open. Use it to make a compressed file smaller or compress it faster.

name: gzseek
description: Sets the start position to the offset position relative to the next **gzread** or **gzwrite** in the file.
summary: Sets where the next read or write in the file will start, relative to a chosen point. Use it to jump to a position in a compressed file.

name: gzrewind
description: Repositions the file pointer to the beginning of the file. This feature is applied only for reading. This API
summary: Moves the file pointer back to the beginning of the file for reading. Use it to start reading a compressed file again from the start.

name: gzread
description: Reads a maximum of **len** uncompressed bytes from a file and decompresses them into the buffer. This API uses a
summary: Reads compressed bytes from a file and decompresses them into a buffer. Use it to read back the contents of a compressed file.

name: gzputs
description: Compresses the given null-terminated strings and writes them to the file, excluding the null operator. This API
summary: Compresses text and writes it into a gzip file. Use it to save text in a compressed file.

name: gzputc
description: Compresses **char** converted to an unsigned character and writes it to a file. This API uses a promise to return
summary: Compresses one character and writes it into a gzip file. Use it to build a compressed file character by character.

name: gzprintf
description: Converts and formats the parameters under the control of the string format and then compresses and writes them
summary: Formats text and compresses it into a file. Use it to write formatted text into a gzip file.

name: gzoffset
description: Returns the current compressed read or write offset of the file. This API uses a promise to return the result.
summary: Returns the current compressed read or write position in the file. Use it to find where you are in a gzip file.

name: gzgets
description: Reads bytes from a compressed file until len-1 characters are read, a newline character is read and transferred
summary: Reads a line of bytes from a compressed file into a buffer until a newline or end of file. Use it to read text lines from a gzip file.

name: getInfo
description: Obtains the declared information in the **config.json** file of an application. In the stage model, this API
summary: Gets the declared information from an application's config file. Use it to look up an app's own details.

name: terminate
description: Terminates the current ability. In the stage model, this API has no effect.
summary: Closes the current ability. Use it to end and shut down the running ability.

name: screenOnVisible
description: Defines whether to keep the application visible when the screen is woken up.
summary: Keeps the application visible when the screen is woken up instead of returning to the home screen. Use it to stay on screen after the display wakes.

name: requestFullWindow
description: Requests the application to run in full window.
summary: Switches the application from a small or semi-modal window to full-window mode. Use it when a windowed app should fill the whole screen.

name: setImageCacheCount
description: Set image cache capacity of decoded image count.
summary: Sets how many decoded images the application keeps in memory. Use it to control image caching so pictures load faster.

name: setImageRawDataCacheSize
description: Set image cache capacity of raw image data size in bytes before decode.
summary: Sets how many bytes of raw image data the application caches before decoding. Use it to control memory used for raw image data.

name: setImageFileCacheSize
description: Set image file cache size in bytes on disk before decode.
summary: Sets how many bytes of image files the application caches on disk before decoding. Use it to control disk space used for cached images.

name: getStatus
description: Obtains the current charging state and battery level.
summary: Checks how much battery is left and whether the device is charging. Use it to show battery level or charging state on screen.

name: startBLEScan
description: Start BLE scan
summary: Starts a scan for nearby Bluetooth low-energy devices. Use it to look for nearby Bluetooth gadgets like trackers, sensors, or headphones.

name: stopBLEScan
description: Stop BLE scan
summary: Stops an ongoing scan for nearby Bluetooth low-energy devices. Use it to end the search for nearby Bluetooth gadgets once you have found what you need.

name: subscribeBLEFound
description: Subscribe BLE found
summary: Subscribes to be notified when a nearby Bluetooth low-energy device is found. Use it to keep getting alerts about nearby Bluetooth gadgets as they appear.

name: unsubscribeBLEFound
description: Stop the subscription of BLE found
summary: Stops the subscription that reports nearby Bluetooth low-energy devices. Use it to stop being alerted about nearby Bluetooth gadgets.

name: getValue
description: Obtains the current screen brightness.
summary: Gets the current screen brightness. Use it to check how bright the screen is, for example before adjusting it.

name: setValue
description: Sets the screen brightness.
summary: Sets the screen brightness. Use it to make the screen brighter or dimmer.

name: getMode
description: Obtains the screen brightness adjustment mode.
summary: Obtains the screen brightness adjustment mode. Use it to find out whether the screen brightness is set automatically or manually.

name: setMode
description: Sets the screen brightness adjustment mode.
summary: Sets how the screen brightness is adjusted. Use it to switch the screen between automatic and manual brightness.

name: setKeepScreenOn
description: Sets whether to always keep the screen on. Call this API in **onShow()**.
summary: Sets whether the screen should always stay on. Use it to stop the screen from turning off while someone is reading or watching.

name: rsa
description: Encrypts or decrypts data using RSA.
summary: Encrypts or decrypts data using RSA. Use it to protect or unlock data with an RSA key.

name: aes
description: Encrypts or decrypts data using AES.
summary: Encrypts or decrypts data using AES. Use it to keep files or messages secret, or to read data that was encrypted with AES.

name: getLocale
description: Obtains the current locale of the application, which is the same as the system locale.
summary: Gets the current locale of the application, which matches the system locale. Use it to find out the language and region settings the app is running with.

name: getInfo
description: Obtains the device information.
summary: Gets information about the device. Use it to look up details about the device you are running on.

name: move
description: Moves a specified file to a given location.
summary: Moves a file to a given location. Use it to relocate a file to another folder.

name: copy
description: Copies a file to the given URI.
summary: Copies a file to a given location. Use it to duplicate a file or save a copy somewhere else.

name: list
description: Obtains all files in the specified directory.
summary: Gets all files in a specified directory. Use it to see what files are in a folder.

name: delete
description: Deletes a local file.
summary: Deletes a local file. Use it to remove a file you no longer need.

name: writeText
description: Writes text into a file. Only text files can be read and written.
summary: Writes text into a file. Use it to save text to a file.

name: readText
description: Reads text from a file. Only text files can be read and written.
summary: Reads text from a file. Use it to open and read the contents of a text file.

name: writeArrayBuffer
description: Writes buffer data into a file. Only text files can be read and written.
summary: Writes buffer data into a file. Use it to save binary data to a text file.

name: readArrayBuffer
description: Reads buffer data from a file. Only text files can be read and written.
summary: Reads buffer data from a file; only text files can be read. Use it to load the contents of a text file.

name: access
description: Checks whether a file or directory exists.
summary: Checks whether a file or directory exists. Use it to confirm a file is there before opening or reading it.

name: mkdir
description: Creates a directory.
summary: Creates a directory. Use it to make a new folder.

name: rmdir
description: Deletes a directory.
summary: Deletes a directory. Use it to remove a folder you no longer need.

name: getLocation
description: Obtains the geographic location.
summary: Obtains the device's geographic location. Use it to find where you are.

name: getLocationType
description: Obtains the location types supported by the system.
summary: Obtains the location types the system supports. Use it to check which positioning methods are available on the device.

name: subscribe
description: Listens to the geographical location. If this method is called multiple times, the last call takes effect.
summary: Starts listening for the device's geographical location, with the latest call replacing earlier ones. Use it to keep track of where you are.

name: unsubscribe
description: Cancels listening to the geographical location.
summary: Stops listening for the device's geographical location. Use it to stop tracking where you are.

name: getSupportedCoordTypes
description: Obtains the supported coordinate system types.
summary: Obtains the coordinate system types the system supports. Use it to see which coordinate formats you can get locations in.

name: addListener
description: Adds a listening function to MediaQueryList.
summary: Adds a listening function that runs when the media query result changes. Use it to react when the screen or device conditions change.

name: removeListener
description: Removes a listening function from MediaQueryList.
summary: Removes a listening function so it no longer runs when the media query result changes. Use it to stop reacting to screen or device condition changes.

name: matchMedia
description: Queries a media item and returns a MediaQueryList object.
summary: Queries a media item and returns a list object for it. Use it to check whether the current screen or device matches a media condition.

name: show
description: Displays the notification.
summary: Displays a notification. Use it to alert the user with a message on their device.

name: hasInstalled
description: Checks whether an application exists, or whether a native application has been installed.
summary: Checks whether an application or native application is installed on the device. Use it to see if an app is already on the phone before offering to install or open it.

name: showToast
description: Displays the notification text.
summary: Shows a short notification text. Use it to briefly tell the user something, like a saved or failed message.

name: showDialog
description: Displays the dialog box.
summary: Shows a dialog box. Use it to ask the user to confirm something or enter information.

name: showActionMenu
description: Displays the menu.
summary: Shows a menu of actions for the user to choose from. Use it to offer choices such as save, share, or delete.

name: upload
description: Uploads a file. This API returns no value.
summary: Uploads a file using the given settings. Use it to send a file to a server.

name: download
description: Downloads a file. This API returns no value.
summary: Downloads a file using the given settings. Use it to save a file from the internet onto the device.

name: onDownloadComplete
description: Listens for download task status. This API returns no value.
summary: Watches a download task and reports its status. Use it to know when a download finishes.

name: push
description: Navigates to a specified page in the application.
summary: Opens a specified page in the app. Use it to go to another screen, like tapping a button to open a settings or details page.

name: replace
description: Replaces the current page with another one in the application and destroys the current page.
summary: Replaces the current page with another page and removes the current one. Use it to swap screens so the user cannot go back to the old one.

name: enableAlertBeforeBackPage
description: Enables the display of a confirm dialog box before returning to the previous page.
summary: Shows a confirmation dialog before going back to the previous page. Use it to ask users to confirm before they leave a page.

name: disableAlertBeforeBackPage
description: Disables the display of a confirm dialog box before returning to the previous page.
summary: Turns off the confirmation dialog that appears before going back to the previous page. Use it when you no longer want users asked to confirm leaving a page.

name: subscribeAccelerometer
description: Subscribes to data changes of the acceleration sensor. If this API is called multiple times for the same
summary: Starts reporting changes in the acceleration sensor's data. Use it to detect movement, tilt, or shake of the device.

name: unsubscribeAccelerometer
description: Unsubscribes from data changes of the acceleration sensor.
summary: Stops listening for changes in acceleration sensor data. Use it to stop tracking movement or tilt once you no longer need it.

name: subscribeCompass
description: Subscribes to data changes of the compass sensor. If this API is called multiple times for the same application,
summary: Starts reporting changes in the compass sensor's data. Use it to find which direction the device is facing.

name: unsubscribeCompass
description: Unsubscribes from data changes of the compass sensor.
summary: Stops receiving updates from the compass sensor. Use it to stop tracking which direction the device is facing.

name: subscribeProximity
description: Subscribes to data changes of the proximity sensor. If this API is called multiple times for the same application,
summary: Starts listening for changes in proximity sensor data. Use it to detect when something is close to the screen, such as during a phone call.

name: unsubscribeProximity
description: Unsubscribes from data changes of the proximity sensor.
summary: Stops receiving updates from the proximity sensor. Use it to stop detecting when an object is near the device.

name: subscribeLight
description: Subscribes to data changes of the ambient light sensor. If this API is called multiple times, the last call takes
summary: Starts listening for changes in ambient light sensor data. Use it to detect how bright the surroundings are, such as for auto screen brightness.

name: unsubscribeLight
description: Unsubscribes from data changes of the ambient light sensor.
summary: Stops receiving updates from the ambient light sensor. Use it to stop tracking surrounding light levels.

name: subscribeStepCounter
description: Subscribes to data changes of the step counter sensor. If this API is called multiple times for the same
summary: Starts listening for changes in step counter sensor data. Use it to count your steps as you walk or run.

name: unsubscribeStepCounter
description: Unsubscribes from data changes of the step counter sensor.
summary: Stops receiving updates from the step counter sensor. Use it to stop counting steps.

name: subscribeBarometer
description: Subscribes to data changes of the barometer sensor. If this API is called multiple times for the same application,
summary: Starts reporting changes in the barometer sensor's data. Use it to track air pressure changes, such as for altitude or weather.

name: unsubscribeBarometer
description: Unsubscribes from data changes of the barometer sensor.
summary: Stops receiving updates from the barometer sensor. Use it to stop tracking air pressure or altitude changes.

name: subscribeHeartRate
description: Subscribes to data changes of the heart rate sensor. If this API is called multiple times for the same application,
summary: Starts listening for changes in heart rate sensor data. Use it to track your heart rate during exercise or rest.

name: unsubscribeHeartRate
description: Unsubscribes from data changes of the heart rate sensor.
summary: Stops receiving updates from the heart rate sensor. Use it to stop tracking the user's heart rate.

name: subscribeOnBodyState
description: Subscribes to wearing status changes of a wearable device. If this API is called multiple times for the same
summary: Starts listening for changes in whether a wearable device is being worn. Use it to tell when the watch is put on or taken off.

name: unsubscribeOnBodyState
description: Unsubscribes from wearing status changes of a wearable device.
summary: Stops receiving updates about whether a wearable device is being worn. Use it to stop tracking when the device is put on or taken off.

name: getOnBodyState
description: Obtains the wearing state of a wearable device.
summary: Checks whether a wearable device is currently being worn. Use it to tell if the watch or band is on the body.

name: subscribeDeviceOrientation
description: Subscribes to data changes of the device orientation sensor.
summary: Starts reporting changes in the device orientation sensor's data. Use it to tell how the device is turned or held.

name: unsubscribeDeviceOrientation
description: Unsubscribes from data changes of the device orientation sensor.
summary: Stops receiving updates from the device orientation sensor. Use it to stop tracking how the device is tilted or rotated.

name: subscribeGyroscope
description: Subscribes to data changes of the gyroscope sensor.
summary: Starts reporting changes in the gyroscope sensor's data. Use it to detect rotation or spinning of the device.

name: unsubscribeGyroscope
description: Unsubscribes from data changes of the gyroscope sensor.
summary: Stops receiving updates from the gyroscope sensor. Use it to stop tracking the device's rotation.

name: vibrate
description: Triggers device vibration.
summary: Makes the device vibrate. Use it to buzz the phone for an alert, notification, or touch feedback.
